author.name: Yinbo Yu, Jing Fang, Xuewen Zhang, Chunwei Tian, Qi Zhu, Daoqiang Zhang, Jiajia Liu

entry.summary: Proposes DFBScanner, a lightweight static parameter inspection framework for fast backdoor detection in DNNs. Leverages the observation that backdoor-induced perturbations create anomalous parameter patterns detectable without clean samples.

entry.title: Shaping the Prior: How Synthetic Task Distributions Determine Tabular Foundation Model Quality

author.name: Mohamed Bouadi, Nassim Bouarour, Varun Kulkarni, Shivam Dubey, Aditya Tanna, Vinay Kumar Sankarapu

entry.summary: Introduces O'Prior, a compositional realism prior for tabular foundation models that includes hierarchical SCM meta-generators, modular realism engines, stress modules, and curriculum scheduling to improve deployment robustness.

entry.title: FAGER: Factually Grounded Evaluation and Refinement of Text-to-Image Models

author.name: Youngsun Lim, Cusuh Ham, Pin-Yu Chen, Deepti Ghadiyaram

entry.summary: Proposes FAGER, an agentic framework for evaluating text-to-image models on factual correctness by constructing structured factual rubrics and verifying visually grounded facts implied by prompts.

entry.title: Be Kind, Rewrite: Benign Projections via Rewriting Defend Against LLM Data Poisoning Attacks

author.name: John T. Halloran, Noopur S. Bhatt

entry.summary: Proposes open-book benign rewriting (OBBR) as a proactive defense against LLM backdoor attacks, theoretically showing that rewriting with benign reference samples projects poisoned data to safe space.

entry.title: Diagnosing Multi-step Reasoning Failures in Black-box LLMs via Stepwise Confidence Attribution

author.name: Xiaoou Liu, Tiejin Chen, Dengjia Zhang, Yaqing Wang, Lu Cheng, Hua Wei

entry.summary: Introduces Stepwise Confidence Attribution (SCA) for diagnosing reasoning failures in black-box LLMs by assigning step-level confidence scores based on alignment with consensus structures across correct solutions.

entry.title: Inference-Time Scaling in Diffusion Models through Iterative Partial Refinement

author.name: Taegu Kang, Jaesik Yoon, Sungjin Ahn

entry.summary: Proposes Iterative Partial Refinement (IPR), an inference-time scaling method for sequential diffusion models that requires no external verifier, iteratively refining regions to improve generation quality.

entry.title: CaptchaMind: Training CAPTCHA Solvers via Reinforcement Learning with Explicit Reasoning Supervision

author.name: Pengcheng Wang, Haoxiang Liu, Yang Dai, Xiangxiang Zeng, Guanhua Chen, Baotian Hu, Longyue Wang, Weihua Luo

entry.summary: Introduces CaptchaBench (16K samples across 8 CAPTCHA types) and CaptchaMind, a reinforcement learning approach for training CAPTCHA solvers with explicit reasoning supervision. First training-based approach leveraging process-level annotations.

entry.title: EgoCoT-Bench: Benchmarking Grounded and Verifiable Operation-Centric Chain of Thought Reasoning for MLLMs

author.name: Yang Dai, Dian Jiao, Tianwei Lin, Wenqiao Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces EgoCoT-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating multimodal LLMs on fine-grained egocentric video understanding, specifically grounded chain-of-thought reasoning about hand-object interactions and operation sequences.

entry.title: Implicit Action Chunking for Smooth Continuous Control

author.name: Bosun Liang, Shuo Pei, Zirui Chen, Chuanzhi Fan, Chen Sun, Yuankai Wu, Huachun Tan, Yong Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Dual-Window Smoothing (DWS), an implicit action chunking framework that produces smooth control signals for physical deployment without expanding the action space dimension. Uses execution and planning windows for temporal coherence.

entry.title: Block-Sphere Vector Quantization

author.name: Heesang Ann, Joongkyu Lee, Min-hwan Oh

entry.summary: Provides unified theoretical comparison of rotation-based vector quantizers (EDEN, RabitQ, TurboQuant), showing their advantages are criterion-dependent. Proposes Block-Sphere VQ with new guarantees.

entry.title: Beyond Isotropy in JEPAs: Hamiltonian Geometry and Symplectic Prediction

author.name: Robert Jenkinson Alvarez

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis showing that isotropic regularization in Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) is suboptimal when downstream geometry is structured, deriving the minimax-optimal covariance and a closed-form 'price of isotropy'.

entry.title: CP-MoE: Consistency-Preserving Mixture-of-Experts for Continual Learning

author.name: Yang Liu, Toan Nguyen, Flora D. Salim

entry.summary: Proposes CP-MoE, a continual learning framework using a transient expert mechanism with consistency-preserving routing bias to balance knowledge transfer and catastrophic forgetting in Mixture-of-Experts architectures.

entry.title: FBOS-RL: Feedback-Driven Bi-Objective Synergistic Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Xikai Zhang, Yongzhi Li, Likang Xiao, Yingze Zhang, Yanhua Cheng, Quan Chen, Peng Jiang, Wenjun Wu, Liu Liu

entry.summary: Proposes FBOS-RL, enhancing GRPO for reinforcement learning of LLMs by using feedback-driven sampling that adapts rollouts based on model capability, rather than always conditioning on the original prompt.

entry.title: Modality-Decoupled Online Recursive Editing

author.name: Siyuan Li, Youyuan Zhang, Fangming Liu, Jing Li

entry.summary: Proposes M-ORE, a modality-decoupled online recursive editor for multimodal LLMs that addresses cross-modal conflict and inter-edit interference during lifelong model editing with constant per-edit overhead.

entry.title: Weasel: Out-of-Domain Generalization for Web Agents via Importance-Diversity Data Selection

author.name: Fatemeh Pesaran zadeh, Seyeon Choi, Xing Han L\`u, Siva Reddy, Gunhee Kim

entry.summary: Proposes Weasel, a trajectory selection method for offline training of web agents that optimizes importance-diversity balance over states, websites, and interaction patterns to improve out-of-domain generalization.

entry.title: Neural Collapse by Design: Learning Class Prototypes on the Hypersphere

author.name: Panagiotis Koromilas, Theodoros Giannakopoulos, Mihalis A. Nicolaou, Yannis Panagakis

entry.summary: Shows that cross-entropy and supervised contrastive learning are different views of the same method (prototype contrast on the hypersphere), and proposes normalized losses that close the gap between them for achieving Neural Collapse.

entry.title: Fast Reconstruction of Exact Maxwell Dynamics from Sparse Data

author.name: Dan DeGenaro, Xin Li, Obed Amo, Michael Pokojovy, Sarah Adel Bargal, Markus Lange-Hegermann, Bogdan Rai\c{t}\u{a}

entry.summary: Introduces FLASH-MAX, a shallow neural network architecture for electromagnetic field prediction that satisfies Maxwell's equations by construction, achieving sub-1% error from ~1K observations in seconds with zero PDE residual.

entry.title: Latent Process Generator Matching

author.name: Lukas Billera, Hedwig Nora Nordlinder, Ben Murrell

entry.summary: Introduces latent process generator matching, a framework that treats observed generative state as a deterministic image of a tractable Markov process. Generalizes existing projection results for augmented-state flow matching and diffusion models.

entry.title: AVSD: Adaptive-View Self-Distillation by Balancing Consensus and Teacher-Specific Privileged Signals

author.name: Duy Nguyen, Hanqi Xiao, Archiki Prasad, Zaid Khan, Anirban Das, Austin Zhang, Sambit Sahu, Hyunji Lee, Elias Stengel-Eskin, Mohit Bansal

entry.summary: Proposes AVSD, a self-distillation framework for language models that balances consensus across multiple teacher views (solutions, demonstrations, feedback) while filtering view-specific information the student cannot access.

entry.title: Runtime-Certified Bounded-Error Quantized Attention

author.name: Dean Calver

entry.summary: Presents a tiered KV cache architecture with runtime-certified bounds on quantization error, using INT8 keys and INT4 values with FP16 fallback in system RAM for deterministic error recovery.

entry.title: PREFINE: Preference-Based Implicit Reward and Cost Fine-Tuning for Safety Alignment

author.name: Richa Verma, Bavish Kulur, Sanjay Chawla, Balaraman Ravindran

entry.summary: PREFINE fine-tunes a pre-trained RL policy for safety by incorporating cost constraints from trajectory-level preferences without retraining from scratch. Unlike standard RLHF, it works with trajectory-level preferences in continuous control environments.

entry.title: What Twelve LLM Agent Benchmark Papers Disclose About Themselves: A Pilot Audit and an Open Scoring Schema

author.name: Mahdi Naser Moghadasi (BrightMind AI, Texas Tech University), Faezeh Ghaderi (University of Texas at Arlington)

entry.summary: Audits twelve well-known LLM agent benchmark papers using a structured schema to assess reproducibility of evaluation details, finding significant gaps in reporting that prevent fair comparison across papers.

entry.title: EvoStruct: Bridging Evolutionary and Structural Priors for Antibody CDR Design via Protein Language Model Adaptation

author.name: Mansoor Ahmed, Sujin Lee, Umar Khayaz, Murray Patterson

entry.summary: EvoStruct bridges protein language models with 3D structural context via cross-attention adapters for antibody CDR design, addressing vocabulary collapse in GNN-based methods that over-predict few amino acids.

entry.title: The Economics of Model Collapse: Equilibrium, Welfare, and Optimal Provenance Subsidies in Synthetic Data Markets

author.name: Gustav Olaf Yunus Laitinen-Fredriksson Lundstr\"om-Imanov

entry.summary: Develops microeconomic theory of synthetic data markets under model collapse, proving existence/uniqueness of equilibrium, deriving welfare decomposition, and characterizing optimal provenance subsidies.

entry.title: Multi-agent Collaboration with State Management

author.name: Mengyang Liu, Taozhi Chen, Zhenhua Xu, Xue Jiang, Yihong Dong

entry.summary: STORM proposes state-oriented management for multi-agent code collaboration, mediating agent interactions with shared workspaces to detect and resolve conflicting edits in real-time rather than deferring to post-hoc merge steps.

entry.title: Llamas on the Web: Memory-Efficient, Performance-Portable, and Multi-Precision LLM Inference with WebGPU

author.name: Reese Levine, Rithik Sharma, Nikhil Jain, Abhijit Ramesh, Zheyuan Chen, Neha Abbas, James Contini, Tyler Sorensen

entry.summary: LlamaWeb presents a WebGPU backend for llama.cpp enabling memory-efficient LLM inference in browsers with static memory planning, tunable kernel library for cross-device variability, and support for numerous quantization formats.

entry.title: Conflict-Aware Additive Guidance for Flow Models under Compositional Rewards

author.name: Xuehui Yu, Fucheng Cai, Meiyi Wang, Xiaopeng Fan, Harold Soh

entry.summary: Identifies that gradient misalignment causes off-manifold drift when composing multiple constraints in guided diffusion/flow sampling, and proposes Conflict-Aware Additive Guidance to actively detect and resolve conflicting gradients.

entry.title: Linear-DPO: Linear Direct Preference Optimization for Diffusion and Flow-Matching Generative Models

author.name: Kesong Li, Yixuan Xu, Kuo-kun Tseng, Weiyi Lu, Kan Liu, Tao Lan

entry.summary: Linear-DPO derives a generalized DPO objective for both diffusion and flow-matching models via a unified reverse-time SDE framework, replacing sigmoid utility with linear utility for better text-to-image alignment.

entry.title: TextReg: Mitigating Prompt Distributional Overfitting via Regularized Text-Space Optimization

author.name: Lucheng Fu, Ye Yu, Yiyang Wang, Yiqiao Jin, Haibo Jin, B. Aditya Prakash, Haohan Wang

entry.summary: TextReg identifies prompt distributional overfitting in LLM prompt optimization (where prompts accumulate narrow rules and generalize poorly) and proposes regularized text-space optimization with a dual-factor inefficiency measure.

entry.title: Mind the Sim-to-Real Gap & Think Like a Scientist

author.name: Harsh Parikh, Gabriel Levin-Konigsberg, Dominique Perrault-Joncas, Alexander Volfovsky

entry.summary: Studies when and how a planner should supplement a pre-trained simulator with real experiments, providing decomposition of simulator error into identifiable calibration-deployment shift and irreducible parametric residual.

entry.title: Collocational bootstrapping: A hypothesis about the learning of subject-verb agreement in humans and neural networks

author.name: Claire Hobbs, R. Thomas McCoy

entry.summary: Proposes 'collocational bootstrapping' - a mechanism where statistical regularities in word co-occurrence help acquire syntax. Shows neural networks can learn subject-verb agreement from synthetic data with appropriate variability, matching patterns in child-directed language.

entry.title: Interpretable Discriminative Text Representations via Agreement and Label Disentanglement

author.name: Tong Wang, Yiqing Xu, Leo Yang Yang

entry.summary: Proposes operational criteria for interpretable text representations requiring both conceptual clarity (inter-annotator agreement) and label disentanglement (features shouldn't just paraphrase the target). Introduces concrete metrics for evaluating interpretability.

entry.title: Terminal-World: Scaling Terminal-Agent Environments via Agent Skills

author.name: Zihao Cheng, Hongru Wang, Zeming Liu, Xinyi Wang, Xiangrong Zhu, Yuhang Guo, Wei Lin, Jeff Z. Pan, Yunhong Wang

entry.summary: Introduces Terminal-World, an automated pipeline for generating training data for terminal agents using 'agent skills' as synthesis primitives that jointly encode tasks, preconditions, and environment states.

entry.title: Why Latent Actions Fail, and How to Prevent It

author.name: Jung Min Lee, Taehyun Cho, Li Zhao, Jungwoo Lee

entry.summary: Analyzes why latent action models fail due to exogenous state in videos, showing the standard reconstruction objective encodes exogenous information. Proposes learning in representation spaces focusing on endogenous components.

entry.title: ConceptSeg-R1: Segment Any Concept via Meta-Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yuan Zhao, Youwei Pang, Jiaming Zuo, Wei Ji, Kailai Zhou, Bin Fan, Yunkang Cao, Lihe Zhang, Xiaofeng Liu, Huchuan Lu, Weisi Lin, Dacheng Tao, Xiaoqi Zhao

entry.summary: Formalizes generalized concept segmentation through a three-level taxonomy (context-independent, context-dependent, context-reasoning) and proposes ConceptSeg-R1 using Meta-GRPO, a meta-reinforcement learning approach for rule-induced concept grounding.

entry.title: VISTAQA: Benchmarking Joint Visual Question Answering and Pixel-Level Evidence

author.name: Mozhgan Nasr Azadani, Yimu Wang, Yongpeng Zhu, Lihong Chen, Milan Ganai, Sean Sedwards, Marco Pavone, Krzysztof Czarnecki

entry.summary: Introduces VISTAQA, a benchmark for jointly evaluating free-form answer correctness and pixel-level evidence grounding in VQA, with 1,157 expert-curated samples across six task types and six visual domains.

entry.title: What Semantics Survive the Connector? Diagnosing VLM-to-DiT Alignment in Video Editing

author.name: Hangyu Lin, Chao Wen, Chengming Xu, Jianxiong Gao, Jiangning Zhang, Xiaobin Hu, Yanwei Fu

entry.summary: Investigates the semantic bottleneck between VLM connectors and DiT models in video editing, proposing a controlled diagnostic pipeline to identify what fine-grained semantics survive alignment versus what gets degraded.

entry.title: Bridging Structure and Language: Graph-Based Visual Reasoning for Autonomous Road Understanding

author.name: Lena Wild, Katie Z Luo, Marco Pavone

entry.summary: Introduces Combined Road Substrate (CRS), a graph-grounded framework bridging geometric road structure and open-vocabulary semantics for autonomous driving. Enables automatic generation of compositionally complex question-answer pairs for road understanding.

entry.title: DAMA: Disentangled Body-Anchored Gaussians for Controllable Multi-Layered Avatars

author.name: Daniel Eskandar, Berna Kabadayi, Garvita Tiwari, Gerard Pons-Moll

entry.summary: DAMA introduces a method for reconstructing physically plausible multi-layered clothed avatars using Gaussian splatting bound to SMPL-X with explicit garment disentanglement. Addresses the lack of geometric constraints in existing methods that leads to ambiguous garment boundaries.

entry.title: Q-ARVD: Quantizing Autoregressive Video Diffusion Models

author.name: Siao Tang, Xinyin Ma, Gongfan Fang, Xingyi Yang, Xinchao Wang

entry.summary: Q-ARVD is the first systematic study of quantization for autoregressive video diffusion models, identifying two critical challenges specific to ARVDs that make standard quantization schemes suboptimal. Proposes tailored solutions for efficient deployment.

entry.title: SurgOnAir: Hierarchy-Aware Real-Time Surgical Video Commentary

author.name: Jingyi He, Yue Zhou, Long Bai, Kun Yuan, Nassir Navab, Yuan Bi

entry.summary: SurgOnAir is a streaming vision-language model for real-time surgical video commentary that processes frames sequentially without future access and generates narration tokens as visual input arrives, addressing the fundamental need for immediate reaction in the operating room.

entry.title: ProtoPathway: Biologically Structured Prototype-Pathway Fusion for Multimodal Cancer Survival Prediction

author.name: Amaya Gallagher-Syed, Costantino Pitzalis, Myles J. Lewis, Michael R. Barnes, Gregory Slabaugh

entry.summary: ProtoPathway introduces an interpretable multimodal framework for cancer survival prediction using learnable morphological prototypes for histopathology and pathway-structured graph networks for genomics, producing biologically grounded representations.

entry.title: Demo-JEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for One-shot Cross-Embodiment Imitation

author.name: Jingyang He, Guangrun Li, Jieyu Zhang, Chengkai Hou, Zhengping Che, Shanghang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Demo-JEPA, a cross-embodiment imitation framework using Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture that decouples demonstration intent from embodiment-specific execution. Enables one-shot imitation from demonstrations by different morphologies by inferring goal states rather than copying actions.

entry.title: Library Drift: Diagnosing and Fixing a Silent Failure Mode in Self-Evolving LLM Skill Libraries

author.name: Xing Zhang, Yanwei Cui, Guanghui Wang, Ziyuan Li, Wei Qiu, Bing Zhu, Peiyang He

entry.summary: Identifies and formalizes 'library drift' in self-evolving LLM skill libraries where unbounded skill accumulation causes retrieval degradation. Provides reproducible triggers, diagnostics, and lifecycle management solutions.

entry.title: Progressive Autonomy as Preference Learning: A Formalization of Trust Calibration for Agentic Tool Use

author.name: Changkun Ou

entry.summary: Formalizes trust calibration for agentic tool use as a preference-learning problem using Gaussian process posterior over human risk-tolerance. Shows this is an instance of Preferential Bayesian Optimization, enabling progressive autonomy where agents learn when to ask for human approval.

entry.title: PRISM: A Benchmark for Programmatic Spatial-Temporal Reasoning

author.name: Qiran Zhang, Yuheng Wang, Runde Yang, Lin Wu, Jingru Fan, Shu Yao, Jie Zhang, Tianle Zhou, Huatao Li, Ruijie Shi, Yihan Li, Chen Qian

entry.summary: Introduces PRISM, a 10,372-sample benchmark for programmatic video generation through code, testing whether LLMs can produce spatially correct animated outputs. Spans 437 subject categories with human-calibrated instruction-code pairs and multi-level evaluation metrics.

entry.title: Minimax Optimal Variance-Aware Regret Bounds for Multinomial Logistic MDPs

author.name: Pierre Boudart (SIERRA), Pierre Gaillard (Thoth), Alessandro Rudi (PSL, DI-ENS, Inria)

entry.summary: Proves minimax optimal variance-aware regret bounds for reinforcement learning in MDPs with multinomial logistic transitions. Introduces a problem-dependent constant measuring normalized average variance, achieving regret that improves when variance is small.

entry.title: AutoResearchClaw: Self-Reinforcing Autonomous Research with Human-AI Collaboration

author.name: Jiaqi Liu, Shi Qiu, Mairui Li, Bingzhou Li, Haonian Ji, Siwei Han, Xinyu Ye, Peng Xia, Zihan Dong, Congyu Zhang, Letian Zhang, Guiming Chen, Haoqin Tu, Xinyu Yang, Lu Feng, Xujiang Zhao, Haifeng Chen, Jiawei Zhou, Xiao Wang, Weitong Zhang, Hongtu Zhu, Yun Li, Jieru Mei, Hongliang Fei, Jiaheng Zhang, Linjie Li, Linjun Zhang, Yuyin Zhou, Sheng Wang, Caiming Xiong, James Zou, Zeyu Zheng, Cihang Xie, Mingyu Ding, Huaxiu Yao

entry.summary: Presents AutoResearchClaw, a multi-agent autonomous research pipeline with structured debate, self-healing execution, pivot/refine decision loops, and cross-run memory. Addresses the linear pipeline limitation of existing auto-research systems.

entry.title: Theory-optimal Quantization Based on Flatness

author.name: Xiusheng Huang, Zhe Li, Xuanwu Yin, Lu Wang, Yequan Wang, Dong Li, Emad Barsoum, Kang Liu

entry.summary: Introduces a flatness-based metric for post-training quantization that mathematically models the relationship between quantization error and outliers, proposing transformations to flatten outlier distributions for better low-bit quantization.

entry.title: Composition of Memory Experts for Diffusion World Models

author.name: Sebastian Stapf, Pablo Acuaviva Huertos, Aram Davtyan, Paolo Favaro

entry.summary: Proposes a diffusion-based world model framework that integrates heterogeneous memory experts (transformers, recurrent models, state-space models) through a contrastive product-of-experts formulation to overcome memory trade-offs.

entry.title: The 99% Success Paradox: When Near-Perfect Retrieval Equals Random Selection

author.name: Vyzantinos Repantis, Harshvardhan Singh, Tony Joseph, Cien Zhang, Akash Vishwakarma, Svetlana Karslioglu, Michael Wyatt Thot, Ameya Gawde

entry.summary: Introduces Bits-over-Random (BoR), a chance-corrected measure of retrieval selectivity that reveals when high success rates mask random-level performance, particularly important when LLMs consume retrieval results without human filtering.

entry.title: ZeroUnlearn: Few-Shot Knowledge Unlearning in Large Language Models

author.name: Yujie Lin, Chengyi Yang, Zhishang Xiang, Yiping Song, Jinsong Su

entry.summary: Proposes ZeroUnlearn, a few-shot machine unlearning framework that reformulates unlearning as knowledge re-mapping via model editing, enforcing representational orthogonality to remove sensitive information without degrading model utility.

entry.title: Auditing Reasoning-Trace Memorization Claims after Unlearning with Head-Conditioned Canaries

author.name: Yanhang Li, Zhichao Fan, Zexin Zhuang

entry.summary: Audits unlearning claims on reasoning models using head-conditioned canaries, finding that apparent 'bypass' patterns (thinking traces retaining forgotten content) may be artifacts of the evaluation method rather than evidence of memorization.

entry.title: Fast and Lightweight Backdoor Detection via Head Random Probing

author.name: Yinbo Yu, Xueyu Yin, Jing Fang, Chunwei Tian, Qi Zhu, Jiajia Liu, Daoqiang Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces HTell, a data-free backdoor detector that uses random probing of model prediction heads to identify abnormal response concentration on target classes. Fast and lightweight without requiring clean data or gradient access.

entry.title: ReacTOD: Bounded Neuro-Symbolic Agentic NLU for Zero-Shot Dialogue State Tracking

author.name: Yanjun Lin, Zimo Xiao, Kartik Natarajan, Mahesh Sankaranarayanan, Niraj Nawanit, Rakshit Parashar, Austin Zhang, Karthik Konaraddi, Rishita Mote, Wei Niu

entry.summary: Proposes ReacTOD, a bounded neuro-symbolic architecture for zero-shot dialogue state tracking that reformulates NLU as discrete tool calls within a self-correcting ReAct loop with deterministic validation.

entry.title: Rotation-Aligned Key Channel Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Model Inference

author.name: Beomseok Kang, Dongwon Jo, Jiwon Song, Donghwee Son, Jae-Joon Kim

entry.summary: Proposes RotateK, a rotation-based structured key channel pruning method for vision-language models that compresses the KV cache channel dimension while preserving more visual tokens than token pruning.

entry.title: Brain alignment of reasoning and action representations from vision-language and action models during naturalistic gameplay

author.name: Subba Reddy Oota, Anant Khandelwal, Khushbu Pahwa, Satya Sai Srinath Namburi, Tanmoy Chakraborty, Bapi S. Raju, Manish Gupta

entry.summary: Studies brain alignment of VLMs and Large Action Models using fMRI during naturalistic Atari gameplay, finding distinct neural correlates for reasoning and action representations.

entry.title: Multi-Scale Generative Modeling with Heat Dissipation Flow Matching

author.name: Jun Ma, Hanquan Zhang, Yanjun Qin, Haoyuan Guan, Ke Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Heat Dissipation Flow Matching (HDFM), integrating blur-based corruption into ODE-based flow matching framework, providing multi-scale priors while avoiding ill-posed inverse problems.

entry.title: Conflict-Free Replicated Data Types for Neural Network Model Merging: A Two-Layer Architecture Enabling CRDT-Compliant Model Merging Across 26 Strategies

author.name: Ryan Gillespie

entry.summary: Proves that all 26 tested neural network merge strategies fail CRDT algebraic properties, and proposes CRDTMergeState, a two-layer architecture wrapping any merge strategy in a CRDT-compliant layer for distributed operation.

entry.title: CANINE: Coaching Visually Impaired Users for Interactive Navigation with a Robot Guide Dog

author.name: Cunjun Yu, Zishuo Wang, Anxing Xiao, Linfeng Li, David Hsu

entry.summary: Presents CANINE, an automated coaching system that trains visually impaired users to work with robot guide dogs through personalized adaptive verbal feedback. Uses knowledge tracing to prioritize weak sub-skills and generates real-time coaching.

entry.title: Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models: Benchmarks, Architectures, Evaluation, and Open Challenges

author.name: Husnain Amjad, Raja Khurram Shahzad, Aamir Shahzad, Mehwish Fatima

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of mathematical reasoning in LLMs covering ~120 studies, synthesizing benchmarks, architectures, training strategies, and evaluation protocols into a unified analytical framework.

entry.title: Smooth Piecewise Cutting for Neural Operator to Handle Discontinuities and Sharp Transitions

author.name: Ha Dang, Sebastian Schmidt, Juergen Hesser

entry.summary: Proposes Cut-DeepONet for neural operators handling discontinuities and sharp transitions in PDEs by reformulating the problem via domain partitioning and lifting to higher-dimensional spaces.

entry.title: Atoms of Thought: Universal EEG Representation Learning with Microstates

author.name: Xinyang Tian, Ruitao Liu, Ziyi Ye, Siyang Xue, Xin Wang, Xuesong Chen

entry.summary: Proposes using EEG microstates as universal tokenized representations for brain-computer interfaces, building a universal microstate tokenizer from a large medical EEG dataset that works across multiple downstream tasks.

entry.title: TabPFN-MT: A Natively Multitask In-Context Learner for Tabular Data

author.name: Cormac Cureton, Narges Armanfard

entry.summary: Proposes TabPFN-MT, extending Prior-Data Fitted Networks to handle multitask tabular prediction in context, enabling inter-task information sharing and simultaneous inference for small-to-medium datasets.

entry.title: Smaller Abstract State Spaces Enable Cross-Scale Generalization in Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Nasehatul Mustakim, Lucas Lehnert

entry.summary: Presents the first theoretical model of out-of-distribution generalization in RL through state abstractions in POMDPs, showing that smaller abstract state spaces enable cross-scale generalization.

entry.title: Weight Decay Regimes in Grokking Transformers: Cheap Online Diagnostics

author.name: Lucky Verma

entry.summary: Studies weight decay as a control parameter for grokking in transformers, introducing cheap online diagnostics (attention-head cosine similarity and entropy standard deviation) to track memorization-generalization transitions.

entry.title: Online Conformal Prediction with Corrupted Feedback

author.name: Bowen Wang, Matteo Zecchin, Osvaldo Simeone

entry.summary: Studies online conformal prediction under corrupted feedback (noisy, adversarial miscoverage indicators), analyzing how arbitrary binary flips degrade calibration guarantees and proposing corrective mechanisms.

entry.title: Mechanistic Interpretability for Learning Assurance of a Vision-Based Landing System

author.name: Romeo Valentin, Olivia Beyer Bruvik, Marc R. Schlichting, Mykel J. Kochenderfer

entry.summary: Proposes using mechanistic interpretability for learning assurance of a vision-based aircraft landing system, demonstrating content/style separation in a vision transformer trained for runway keypoint regression.

entry.title: Distribution-Aware Reward: Reinforcement Learning over Predictive Distributions for LLM Regression

author.name: Jungsoo Park, Hyungjoo Chae, Ethan Mendes, Jay DeYoung, Varsha Kishore, Wei Xu, Alan Ritter

entry.summary: Introduces Distribution-Aware Reward, an RL objective that trains LLMs to produce calibrated predictive distributions for regression tasks by evaluating multiple decoded samples as an empirical distribution.

entry.title: Learning to Think in Physics: Breaking Shortcut Learning in Scientific Diffusion via Representation Alignment

author.name: Haozhe Jia, Pengyu Yin, Wenshuo Chen, Shaofeng Liang, Lei Wang, Bowen Tian, Xiucheng Wang, Nanqian Jia, Yutao Yue

entry.summary: Introduces REPA-P, a framework that aligns intermediate diffusion model features with physical states using PDE residual losses through lightweight projection heads, preventing shortcut learning in physics-informed diffusion.

entry.title: Multi-Step Likelihood-Ratio Correction for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards

author.name: Deokgyu Yoon, Hyungkyu Kang, Joongkyu Lee, Byeongchan Kim, Gyungin Shin, Sungrae Park, Min-hwan Oh

entry.summary: Proposes N-Step Forward-Trace Policy Optimization (NFPO) that augments PPO's surrogate objective with cumulative likelihood ratios of next N-1 tokens, reducing structural bias in RLVR for LLMs.

entry.title: HORST: Composing Optimizer Geometries for Sparse Transformer Training

author.name: Tom Jacobs, Rohan Jain, Rebekka Burkholz

entry.summary: Proposes HORST optimizer that composes adaptive optimizer steps with L1 sparsity bias through hyperbolic mirror maps, achieving both training stability and sparsity in transformers.

entry.title: Graph Navier Stokes Networks

author.name: Zexing Zhao, Guangsi Shi, Yu Gong, Tianyu Wang, Shirui Pan, Hongye Cheng, Yuxiao Li

entry.summary: Graph Navier-Stokes Networks (GNSN) introduces convection into graph message passing inspired by fluid dynamics equations, defining a dynamic velocity field on graphs to enable more efficient message propagation and mitigate oversmoothing.

entry.title: Polynomial-Time Robust Multiclass Linear Classification under Gaussian Marginals

author.name: Ilias Diakonikolas, Giannis Iakovidis, Mingchen Ma

entry.summary: Develops polynomial-time robust algorithms for agnostic multiclass linear classification under Gaussian marginals, overcoming the exponential dependence on inverse accuracy that plagued prior methods for k≥3 classes.

entry.title: Lean Refactor: Multi-Objective Controllable Proof Optimization via Agentic Strategy Search

author.name: Jialin Lu, Soonho Kong, Rodrigo Stehling, Kaiyu Yang, Zhangyang Wang, Weiran Sun, Wuyang Chen

entry.summary: Lean Refactor is a retrieval-augmented agentic framework for multi-objective Lean proof refactoring that handles proof length, compilation cost, and version compatibility without requiring model fine-tuning across LLM or Lean releases.

entry.title: Adaptive Probe-based Steering for Robust LLM Jailbreaking

author.name: Junxi Chen, Junhao Dong, Xiaohua Xie

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive probe-based steering for LLM jailbreaking that uses model extraction to guide steering vectors and adaptively tunes steering strength based on activation statistics, improving robustness.

entry.title: DEL: Digit Entropy Loss for Numerical Learning of Large Language Models

author.name: Zhaohui Zheng, Chenhang He, Shihao Wang, Yuxuan Li, Ming-Ming Cheng, Lei Zhang

entry.summary: DEL (Digit Entropy Loss) addresses number prediction in LLMs by analyzing existing numerical learning methods as criterion-distance formulations and proposing entropy-based optimization that avoids over-sharpened or over-flattened distributions.

entry.title: Activation-Free Backbones for Image Recognition: Polynomial Alternatives within MetaFormer-Style Vision Models

author.name: Jeffrey Wang, Jonathan Gregory, Grigorios G. Chrysos

entry.summary: Demonstrates that pointwise activations and softmax are not required in MetaFormer vision backbones by replacing them with Hadamard product-based polynomial alternatives, achieving competitive performance on ImageNet and downstream tasks.

entry.title: PlanningBench: Generating Scalable and Verifiable Planning Data for Evaluating and Training Large Language Models

author.name: Ziliang Zhao, Zenan Xu, Shuting Wang, Hongjin Qian, Yan Lei, Minda Hu, Zhao Wang, Shihan Dou, Zhicheng Dou, Pluto Zhou

entry.summary: PlanningBench introduces a framework for generating scalable, diverse, and verifiable planning data for LLM evaluation and training, addressing limitations of fixed benchmark collections with controllable difficulty and automatic verification.

entry.title: Distill to Think, Foresee to Act: Cognitive-Physical Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Yang Wu, Qiang Meng, Zhaojiang Liu, Youquan Liu, Jian Yang, Jin Xie

entry.summary: CoPhy proposes a cognitive-physical RL framework for autonomous driving that distills VLM knowledge into BEV encoders (discarding VLM at inference) and uses a world model for foresighted action evaluation.

entry.title: Large-Step Training Dynamics of a Two-Factor Linear Transformer Model

author.name: Krishnakumar Balasubramanian

entry.summary: Analyzes finite-step gradient descent dynamics of a simplified linear transformer at large learning rates, showing the dynamics reduce to a two-factor product map exhibiting phase transitions between convergence, periodic orbits, chaos, and divergence.

entry.title: Insights Generator: Systematic Corpus-Level Trace Diagnostics for LLM Agents

author.name: Akshay Manglik (Emily), Apaar Shanker (Emily), Kaustubh Deshpande (Emily), Jason Qin (Emily), Yash Maurya (Emily), Veronica Chatrath (Emily), Vijay S. Kalmath (Emily), Levi Lentz (Emily), Yuan (Emily), Xue

entry.summary: Formalizes corpus-level trace diagnostics for LLM agents and presents Insights Generator, a multi-agent system that produces grounded natural-language insights about systematic behavioral patterns across trace populations.

entry.title: Disentangling Generation and Regression in Stochastic Interpolants for Controllable Image Restoration

author.name: Yi Liu, Jia Ma, Wengen Li, Jihong Guan, Shuigeng Zhou, Yichao Zhang

entry.summary: DiSI proposes disentangling stochastic interpolant processes into independent generation and regression components for image restoration, enabling controllable transition between pure regression and full generative processes.

entry.title: roto 2.0: The Robot Tactile Olympiad

author.name: Elle Miller, Jayaram Reddy, Ayush Deshmukh, Trevor McInroe, David Abel, Oisin Mac Aodha, Sethu Vijayakumar

entry.summary: roto 2.0 introduces a GPU-parallelized benchmark for tactile-based RL across four robotic morphologies, achieving 13 Baoding ball rotations in 10 seconds through blind manipulation using only proprioception and touch.

entry.title: When Reasoning Supervision Hurts: TTCW-Based Long-Form Literary Review Generation

author.name: Jinlong Liu, Mohammed Bahja, Mark Lee

entry.summary: Constructs a large dataset of 263K stories annotated with creativity scores across 14 TTCW-based dimensions, then fine-tunes Qwen3 models finding that explicit reasoning supervision can hurt performance on creative writing review generation tasks.

entry.title: MTR-Suite: A Framework for Evaluating and Synthesizing Conversational Retrieval Benchmarks

author.name: Junhao Ruan, Abudukeyumu Abudula, Bei Li, Yongjing Yin, Xinyu Liu, Kechen Jiao, Xin Chen, Jingang Wang, Xunliang Cai, Tong Xiao, Jingbo Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces MTR-Suite for evaluating and synthesizing conversational retrieval benchmarks, featuring an LLM-based auditor for existing benchmarks, a multi-agent dialogue generation system at 1/400th human cost, and a rigorous general-domain benchmark.

entry.title: APM: Evaluating Style Personalization in LLMs with Arbitrary Preference Mappings

author.name: Philipp Spohn, Leander Girrbach, Zeynep Akata

entry.summary: Introduces APM benchmark for evaluating LLM style personalization by decoupling user attributes from response principles via randomized hidden mappings, preventing conflation of personalization with general quality.

entry.title: Tracing the ongoing emergence of human-like reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Paolo Morosi, Nikoleta Pantelidou, Fritz G\"unther, Elena Pagliarini, Evelina Leivada

entry.summary: Tests 25 LLMs on conditional inference (pragmatic reasoning beyond literal meaning) across four languages, comparing to matched human populations. Finds humans consistently enrich logic with pragmatic inferences while models show variable, scale-dependent behavior.

entry.title: $\Delta$ynamics: Language-Based Representation for Inferring Rigid-Body Dynamics From Videos

author.name: Chia-Hsiang Kao, Cong Phuoc Huynh, Chien-Yi Wang, Noranart Vesdapunt, Stefan Stojanov, Bharath Hariharan, Oleksandr Obiednikov, Ning Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces Δynamics, a vision-language framework that uses structured text as a unified representation for rigid-body dynamics inference from monocular video, generating scene configurations for physics simulation rather than directly predicting parameters.

entry.title: Beyond Routing: Characterising Expert Tuning and Representation in Vision Mixture-of-Experts

author.name: Gene Tangtartharakul, Katherine R. Storrs

entry.summary: Characterizes expert specialization in vision MoE models beyond routing analysis, using neuroscience-inspired tools to measure per-expert category separability and feature-level tuning, revealing that routing alone doesn't explain what experts encode.

entry.title: VIHD: Visual Intervention-based Hallucination Detection for Medical Visual Question Answering

author.name: Jiayi Chen, Benteng Ma, Zehui Liao, Winston Chong, Yasmeen George, Jianfei Cai

entry.summary: Proposes VIHD for detecting hallucinations in medical VQA by performing visual interventions on cross-modal attention during decoding, rather than relying on external input perturbations, to expose visual dependency of generated tokens.

entry.title: DrawMotion: Generating 3D Human Motions by Freehand Drawing

author.name: Tao Wang, Lei Jin, Zhihua Wu, Qiaozhi He, Jiaming Chu, Yu Cheng, Junliang Xing, Jian Zhao, Shuicheng Yan, Li Wang

entry.summary: DrawMotion introduces a diffusion-based framework that generates 3D human motions from both text descriptions and freehand drawings, providing semantic and spatial control. Addresses the limitation that users struggle to precisely convey intended motions through text alone.

entry.title: ROAR-3D: Routing Arbitrary Views for High-Fidelity 3D Generation

author.name: Hanxiao Sun, Mingxin Yang, Shuhui Yang, Zebin He, Xintong Han, Hongbo Fu, Chunchao Guo, Wenhan Luo

entry.summary: ROAR-3D enables high-fidelity 3D generation from multiple arbitrary viewpoints by disentangling orientation control from geometry transfer in pretrained single-view models, avoiding the need for fixed canonical viewpoints or external reconstruction.

entry.title: FTerViT: Fully Ternary Vision Transformer

author.name: Szymon Ruci\'nski, Pietro Bonazzi, Engin T\"uretken, Simon Narduzzi, Michele Magno, Nadim Maamari

entry.summary: FTerViT introduces the first fully ternary Vision Transformer where all weight matrices and normalization parameters are ternarized, introducing TernaryBitConv2d and TernaryLayerNorm operators for deployment on microcontrollers.

entry.title: Semantic Granularity Navigation in Image Editing

author.name: Liangsi Lu, Minzhe Guo, Xuhang Chen, Yang Shi

entry.summary: NaviEdit is a training-free inference-time controller for image editing that decouples edit progress from model scale traversal through a self-consistency contract, addressing the trade-off between semantic editability and structural fidelity in diffusion/flow models.

entry.title: VLA-REPLICA: A Low-Cost, Reproducible Benchmark for Real-World Evaluation of Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Alex S. Huang, Jiahui Zhang, Shiqing Tang, Yu Xiang

entry.summary: Introduces VLA-REPLICA, a low-cost, reproducible real-world benchmark for evaluating Vision-Language-Action models built from off-the-shelf components. Aims to enable consistent policy evaluation across laboratories worldwide with diverse manipulation tasks.

entry.title: Lost in Fog: Sensor Perturbations Expose Reasoning Fragility in Driving VLAs

author.name: Abhinaw Priyadershi, Jelena Frtunikj

entry.summary: Studies the robustness of Vision-Language-Action models for autonomous driving under sensor perturbations, finding that reasoning consistency is a high-fidelity indicator of trajectory reliability. When chain-of-causation explanations change after perturbation, trajectory deviation spikes 5.3×.

entry.title: Synthetic Persona Pretraining: Alignment from Token Zero

author.name: Julian Minder

entry.summary: Proposes 'Synthetic Persona Pretraining' - incorporating alignment properties from the very start of pretraining by generating synthetic data embodying desired personas/values, rather than relying solely on post-training alignment methods like RLHF.

entry.title: When Skills Don't Help: A Negative Result on Procedural Knowledge for Tool-Grounded Agents in Offensive Cybersecurity

author.name: Samuel Jacob Chacko, James Hugglestone, Chashi Mahiul Islam, Xiuwen Liu

entry.summary: Reports a negative result showing that procedural knowledge skills don't help LLM agents in offensive cybersecurity CTF tasks, re-analyzing a 180-run study. Finds documentation conditions map directly to No-Skill baselines, challenging the assumption that skills always help.

entry.title: Trustworthy Agent Network: Trust in Agent Networks Must Be Baked In, Not Bolted On

author.name: Yixiang Yao, Yuhang Yao, Xinyi Fan, Jiechao Gao, Jie Wang, Minjia Zhang, Srivatsan Ravi, Carlee Joe-Wong

entry.summary: A vision paper arguing that trustworthiness in Agent-to-Agent (A2A) networks must be designed as an intrinsic property rather than added after deployment. Identifies systemic vulnerabilities including adversarial composition, semantic misalignment, and cascading failures.

entry.title: AQuaUI: Visual Token Reduction for GUI Agents with Adaptive Quadtrees

author.name: Yuankai Li, Tinghui Zhu, Ha Min Son, Zhe Zhao, Xin Liu, Muhao Chen

entry.summary: Proposes AQuaUI, a training-free token reduction method for GUI agents using adaptive quadtrees that exploit non-uniform spatial information density in screenshots. Reduces visual tokens while maintaining performance on GUI tasks.

entry.title: Projecting Latent RL Actions: Towards Generalizable and Scalable Graph Combinatorial Optimization

author.name: Franco Terranova (UL, LORIA, Inria), Guillermo Bernardez (UC Santa Barbara), Albert Cabellos-Aparicio (UPC), Nina Miolane (UC Santa Barbara), Abdelkader Lahmadi (LORIA, UL, Inria)

entry.summary: Introduces projection agents for graph combinatorial optimization that operate in continuous GNN-based action embedding spaces, predicting latent actions in a single forward pass then projecting to valid discrete actions. Addresses generalization and scalability limitations.

entry.title: Query-Aware Flow Diffusion for Graph-Based RAG with Retrieval Guarantees

author.name: Zhuoping Zhou, Davoud Ataee Tarzanagh, Sima Didari, Wenjun Hu, Baruch Gutow, Oxana Verkholyak, Masoud Faraki, Heng Hao, Hankyu Moon, Seungjai Min

entry.summary: Proposes QAFD-RAG, a training-free graph-based RAG framework that uses query-aware flow diffusion for dynamic graph traversal with theoretical retrieval guarantees, adapting exploration to each query's semantics.

entry.title: Hybrid-LoRA: Bridging Full Fine-Tuning and Low-Rank Adaptation for Post-Training

author.name: Chengqian Zhang, Wei Zhu, Kyumin Lee

entry.summary: Proposes Hybrid-LoRA that bridges full fine-tuning and LoRA for RLVR post-training by combining their benefits, addressing the performance gap between LoRA and full fine-tuning while maintaining efficiency.

entry.title: EVA-0: Test-Time Model Evolution with Only Two Forward Passes per Sample

author.name: Guohao Chen, Shuaicheng Niu, Geng Li, Yunbei Zhang, Shilin Shan, Chunyan Miao, Jianfei Yang

entry.summary: Proposes EVA-0 for test-time model evolution using only two forward passes per sample (no backpropagation), addressing gradient explosion, weight drift, and ineffective updates in zeroth-order test-time optimization.

entry.title: Does Your Wildfire Prediction Model Actually Work, or Just Score Well?

author.name: Yangshuang Xu, Yuyang Dai, Liling Chang, Qi Wang, Yushun Dong

entry.summary: Introduces WILDFIRE-FM, the first foundation model pretrained specifically for wildfire prediction, along with a fixed-contract evaluation framework addressing the sparsity of wildfire events and evaluation sensitivity issues.

entry.title: Markov Chain Decoders Overcome the Heavy-Tail Limitations of Lipschitz Generative Models

author.name: Abdelhakim Ziani (MICS), Andras Horvath (UNITO), Paolo Ballarini (MICS)

entry.summary: Shows that standard VAEs with Gaussian decoders and Lipschitz-constrained networks are structurally incapable of producing heavy-tailed outputs, and proposes Markov Chain decoders as a solution.

entry.title: GRASP: Deterministic argument ranking in interaction graphs

author.name: Diganta Misra, Antonio Orvieto, Rediet Abebe, Volkan Cevher

entry.summary: Proposes GRASP, a deterministic framework for ranking arguments in debates by aggregating stable local interaction judgments rather than relying on holistic LLM-as-judge evaluations that suffer from inter-model disagreement.

entry.title: ContextFlow: Hierarchical Task-State Alignment for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents

author.name: Shuhan Guo, Kun Zhang, Haifei Liu, Xingyu Gao, Yongqi Zhang, Yaqing Wang, Quanming Yao

entry.summary: Proposes ContextFlow for long-horizon embodied agents, addressing task-state misalignment where planner stage, runtime evidence, memory, and executor become inconsistent, using explicit stage contracts.

entry.title: STAR-P\'olyaMath: Multi-Agent Reasoning under Persistent Meta-Strategic Supervision

author.name: Jiaao Wu, Xian Zhang, Hanzhang Liu, Sophia Zhang, Fan Yang, Yinpeng Dong

entry.summary: Introduces STAR-PólyaMath, a multi-agent framework for mathematical reasoning with meta-level supervision, structured Reasoner-Verifier interaction, and reasoning-free orchestrator to address hallucination and memory fragmentation.

entry.title: Targeted Downstream-Agnostic Attack

author.name: Zhuxin Lei, Ziyuan Yang, Yi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes targeted downstream-agnostic attacks on pre-trained encoders under a stricter threat model where attacks must be both targeted (directing to specific outputs) and agnostic to the downstream task.

entry.title: Lens Privacy Sealing: A New Benchmark and Method for Physical Privacy-Preserving Action Recognition

author.name: Mengyuan Liu, Ziyi Wang, Peiming Li, Junsong Yuan

entry.summary: Proposes Lens Privacy Sealing (LPS), a physical hardware solution using laminating film on camera lenses for pre-sensor privacy protection in surveillance. Introduces P³AR dataset for privacy-preserving action recognition.

entry.title: Synthesis and Evaluation of Long-term History-aware Medical Dialogue

author.name: Hebin Hu, Renke Dai, Ah-Hwee Tan, Yilin Kang

entry.summary: Introduces a framework for synthesizing realistic long-term medical dialogues with LLMs, addressing the lack of datasets capturing cross-session reasoning over longitudinal patient histories.

entry.title: ST-TGExplainer: Disentangling Stability and Transition Patterns for Temporal GNN Interpretability

author.name: Hongjiang Chen, Xin Zheng, Pengfei Jiao, Huan Liu, Zhidong Zhao, Huaming Wu, Feng Xia, Shirui Pan

entry.summary: Proposes ST-TGExplainer for temporal graph neural network interpretability, disentangling 'stability patterns' (recurring interactions) from 'transition patterns' (first-time interactions) for more faithful temporal explanations.

entry.title: StableGrad: Backward Scale Control without Batch Normalization

author.name: Jose I. Mestre, Alberto Fern\'andez-Hern\'andez, Cristian P\'erez-Corral, Manuel F. Dolz, Enrique S. Quintana-Ort\'i

entry.summary: Proposes StableGrad, a method for controlling backward gradient scale without batch normalization, specifically targeting Physics-Informed Neural Networks where normalization layers are problematic.

entry.title: Beyond Prediction Accuracy: Target-Space Recovery Profiles for Evaluating Model-Brain Alignment

author.name: Ken Nakamura, Tomoya Nakai, Ryuto Yashiro, Ayumu Yamashita, Kaoru Amano

entry.summary: Introduces a framework for evaluating model-brain alignment beyond prediction accuracy by identifying which specific dimensions of brain response space are recovered by vision models, using repeated fMRI measurements to separate reproducible from noise dimensions.

entry.title: Catching a Moving Subspace: Low-Rank Bandits Beyond Stationarity

author.name: Hamed Khosravi, Xiaoming Huo

entry.summary: Studies piecewise-stationary low-rank linear contextual bandits where the latent subspace drifts over time, providing tight results on identification boundaries, regret bounds, and information-theoretic limits.

entry.title: Causal Unlearning in Collaborative Optimization: Exact and Approximate Influence Reversal under Adversarial Contributions

author.name: Ali Mahdavi, Azadeh Zamanifar, Amirfarhad Farhadi, Omid Kashefi

entry.summary: Presents HF-KCU for federated unlearning that removes client contributions via conjugate gradient in Krylov subspaces, with causal weighting to prevent spurious updates to unaffected clients and robustness to adversarial perturbations.

entry.title: Deep Learning Surrogates for Emulating Stochastic Climate Tipping Dynamics

author.name: Adeline Hillier, Jennifer Sleeman, Jay Brett, Caroline Tang, Jenelle Millison, Anand Gnanadesikan

entry.summary: Develops a dynamics-informed Temporal Fusion Transformer as a surrogate for Earth system simulations, achieving 465x computational speedup while forecasting climate tipping events across thousands of timesteps.

entry.title: AGPO: Adaptive Group Policy Optimization with Dual Statistical Feedback

author.name: Miaobo Hu, Shuhao Hu, Bokun Wang, Ruohan Wang, Xin Wang, Xiaobo Guo, Daren Zha, Jun Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes AGPO, an adaptive refinement of GRPO that uses group-level statistics to drive adaptive clipping (trust-region sizing) and bidirectional adaptive temperature sampling for LLM reasoning.

entry.title: Training distribution determines the ceiling of drug-blind cancer sensitivity prediction

author.name: Taekyung Heo

entry.summary: Shows that drug-blind cancer sensitivity prediction plateaus are due to metric artifacts (global Pearson r dominated by between-drug differences) rather than representational bottlenecks, with no drug encoding improving over cell-only features.

entry.title: Beyond the Bellman Recursion: A Pontryagin-Guided Framework for Non-Exponential Discounting

author.name: Hojin Ko, Jeonggyu Huh

entry.summary: Shows that Bellman recursions break under non-exponential discounting and proposes Pontryagin-Guided DPO, a variational framework coupling Pontryagin Maximum Principle with Monte Carlo rollouts for hyperbolic and survival discounting.

entry.title: Improved Guarantees for Constrained Online Convex Optimization via Self-Contraction

author.name: Dhruv Sarkar, Abhishek Sinha

entry.summary: Proposes improved algorithms for constrained online convex optimization achieving O(log T) regret and O(log T) cumulative constraint violation for strongly convex losses, improving the state-of-the-art O(√(T log T)) CCV.

entry.title: Preference-aware Influence-function-based Data Selection Method for Efficient Fine-Tuning

author.name: Qihao Lin, Guanxu Chen, Dongrui Liu, Jing Shao

entry.summary: PRISM uses the current model's preference to weight target examples in influence-function-based data selection for efficient LLM fine-tuning, prioritizing examples closer to the model's current behavior for more actionable guidance.

entry.title: Mitigating Label Bias with Interpretable Rubric Embeddings

author.name: Calvin Isley, Johann D. Gaebler, Sharad Goel

entry.summary: Proposes rubric embeddings to mitigate label bias in settings like hiring and admissions, replacing black-box embeddings with features derived from expert-defined criteria aligned with the construct of interest.

entry.title: Variance Reduction for Expectations with Diffusion Teachers

author.name: Jesse Bettencourt, Xindi Wu, Matan Atzmon, James Lucas, Jonathan Lorraine

entry.summary: CARV is a compute-aware variance reduction framework for diffusion model teacher gradients, using hierarchical MC estimation with timestep importance sampling to reduce variance in text-to-3D and attribution tasks.

entry.title: NaP-Control: Navigating Diffusion Prior for Versatile and Fast Character Control

author.name: Chia-Wen Chen, Yan Wu, Korrawe Karunratanakul, Siyu Tang

entry.summary: NaP-Control uses RL to manipulate the latent noise of a task-agnostic diffusion policy prior for physics-based character animation, achieving fast control with high motion fidelity by steering the prior toward task-specific behaviors.

entry.title: Contradiction Graphs Determine VC Dimension

author.name: Jesse Campbell, Daniel Ibaibarriaga, Lev Reyzin

entry.summary: Proves that contradiction graphs associated with binary concept classes determine the VC dimension, answering a question posed by Alon et al. (2024) about whether graph structure captures learnability information.

entry.title: \ECUAS{n}: A family of metrics for principled evaluation of uncertainty-augmented systems

author.name: Lautaro Estienne, Erik Ernst, Mat\'ias Vera, Pablo Piantanida, Luciana Ferrer

entry.summary: Proposes ECUAS, a family of metrics for evaluating uncertainty-augmented systems that output both predictions and uncertainty scores. Argues existing evaluation approaches are inadequate for assessing decision-making under uncertainty.

entry.title: Accelerating Video Inverse Problem Solvers with Autoregressive Diffusion Models

author.name: Taesung Kwon, Jonghyun Park, Hyungjin Chung, Jong Chul Ye

entry.summary: AVIS leverages autoregressive video diffusion models for streaming video inverse problem solving, eliminating latency bottlenecks of holistic approaches and reducing sampling steps through measurement-consistent initialization.

entry.title: Calibration vs Decision Making: Revisiting the Reliability Paradox in Unlearned Language Models

author.name: Divyaksh Shukla, Ashutosh Modi

entry.summary: Investigates the gap between calibration and reliable decision-making in unlearned language models, showing that low calibration error doesn't guarantee reliable behavior as models may rely on spurious correlations.

entry.title: Stimulus symmetries can confound representational similarity analyses

author.name: Farhad Pashakhanloo, Jacob A. Zavatone-Veth

entry.summary: Shows that stimulus symmetries can confound representational similarity analyses (RSMs) because functionally equivalent representations under symmetry can yield different RSMs reflecting different geometries, with SGD generating drifting codes.

entry.title: Semiparametric Efficient Bilevel Gradient Estimation

author.name: Fares El Khoury, Houssam Zenati, Nathan Kallus, Michael Arbel, Aur\'elien Bibaut

entry.summary: Develops semiparametric debiasing theory for bilevel optimization gradients, producing a cross-fitted orthogonal hypergradient estimator with asymptotic normality that removes first-order bias from nonparametric lower-level estimation.

entry.title: Under Pressure: Emotional Framing Induces Measurable Behavioral Shifts and Structured Internal Geometry in Small Language Models

author.name: Rana Muhammad Usman

entry.summary: Studies how emotionally framed follow-up prompts (pressure, shame, threat, etc.) change both behavior and internal representations in small language models on impossible coding tasks. Finds pressure produces the most shortcut-seeking behavior while calm and curiosity preserve honesty.

entry.title: Beyond Semantic Similarity: A Two-Phase Non-Parametric Retrieval Workflow for Corporate Credit Underwriting

author.name: Linus Ng Junjia, Ezekiel Tee Kongquan, Kelvin Heng, Kenneth Zhu Ke, Zhao Jing Yuan

entry.summary: Proposes a two-phase retrieval architecture for corporate credit underwriting that separates high-recall candidate retrieval from high-precision utility ranking, addressing the 'similarity-utility gap' in standard RAG pipelines for financial documents.

entry.title: Findings of the Counter Turing Test: AI-Generated Text Detection

author.name: Rajarshi Roy, Gurpreet Singh, Ashhar Aziz, Shashwat Bajpai, Nasrin Imanpour, Shwetangshu Biswas, Kapil Wanaskar, Parth Patwa, Subhankar Ghosh, Shreyas Dixit, Nilesh Ranjan Pal, Vipula Rawte, Ritvik Garimella, Amitava Das, Amit Sheth, Vasu Sharma, Aishwarya Naresh Reganti, Vinija Jain, Aman Chadha

entry.summary: Comprehensive analysis of AI-generated text detection techniques through the Counter Turing Test shared tasks, evaluating methods for distinguishing human vs AI text and multi-class source attribution across GPT-4, Claude 3.5, and Llama.

entry.title: Refining and Reusing Annotation Guidelines for LLM Annotation

author.name: Kon Woo Kim, Jin-Dong Kim, Akiko Aizawa

entry.summary: Proposes systematic reuse and refinement of annotation guidelines as an alignment mechanism for LLM annotation, introducing an iterative moderation framework. Tests across biomedical NER tasks with GPT, Gemini, and DeepSeek, confirming benefits of guideline integration.

entry.title: Strategy-Induct: Task-Level Strategy Induction for Instruction Generation

author.name: Po-Chun Chen, Hen-Hsen Huang, Hsin-Hsi Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Strategy-Induct, a framework that derives task-level instructions from example questions alone (without labeled answers) by first generating reasoning strategies per question, then inducing general task instructions from strategy-question pairs.

entry.title: Fine-grained Claim-level RAG Benchmark for Law

author.name: Souvick Das, Sallam Abualhaija, Domenico Bianculli

entry.summary: Creates a fine-grained claim-level RAG benchmark for law with granular evaluation of retrieval and generation performance separately, covering multiple languages and non-expert queries.

entry.title: SymbolicLight V1: Spike-Gated Dual-Path Language Modeling with High Activation Sparsity and Sub-Billion-Scale Pre-Training Evidence

author.name: Ting Liu

entry.summary: Presents SymbolicLight V1, a spike-gated dual-path language model combining binary Leaky Integrate-and-Fire dynamics with continuous residual stream, achieving high activation sparsity (>95%) while maintaining reasonable perplexity at 194M parameters.

entry.title: MAPS: A Synthetic Dataset for Probing Vision Models in a Controlled 3D Scene Space

author.name: Santiago Galella, Pamela Osuna-Vargas, Maren Wehrheim, Martina G. Vilas, Gemma Roig, Matthias Kaschube

entry.summary: Introduces MAPS, a scalable synthetic dataset with 2,618 3D meshes across 560 ImageNet classes with a Blender pipeline for controlled attribution of vision model behavior to specific scene parameters like lighting, pose, and background.

entry.title: TASTE: A Designer-Annotated Multi-Dimensional Preference Dataset for AI-Generated Graphic Design

author.name: Haonan Zhu, Elad Hirsch, Alexandria Minetti, Allison Nulty, Purvanshi Mehta

entry.summary: Releases TASTE, a dataset where 10 professional designers rated AI-generated graphic designs from 4 models on 9 criteria (typography, hierarchy, color, etc.), providing multi-dimensional preference data beyond single overall verdicts.

entry.title: PaintCopilot: Modeling Painting as Autonomous Artistic Continuation

author.name: Yunge Wen, Yuancheng Shen, Paul Pu Liang

entry.summary: PaintCopilot is a co-creative neural painting assistant that models painting as open-ended autoregressive artistic behavior, predicting future strokes from canvas state and brushstroke history without requiring a target image. It proposes three models: a target predictor, next stroke predictor, and style conditioner.

entry.title: Dynamic Video Generation: Shaping Video Generation Across Time and Space

author.name: Shikang Zheng, Jingkai Huang, Jiacheng Liu, Guantao Chen, Lixuan, Yuqi Lin, Peiliang Cai, Linfeng Zhang

entry.summary: DVG proposes a dynamic video generation framework that jointly allocates computation across time and space dimensions, adapting to different spatio-temporal demands across videos for efficient diffusion-based video generation.

entry.title: Hyper-V2X: Hypernetworks for Estimating Epistemic and Aleatoric Uncertainty in Cooperative Bird's-Eye-View Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Abhishek Dinkar Jagtap, Sanath Tiptur Sadashivaiah, Andreas Festag

entry.summary: Hyper-V2X introduces a hypernetwork-based framework for estimating both epistemic and aleatoric uncertainties in V2X-based cooperative perception for autonomous driving, using partial weight generation conditioned on fused multi-agent features.

entry.title: OcclusionFormer: Arranging Z-Order for Layout-Grounded Image Generation

author.name: Ziye Li, Henghui Ding

entry.summary: OcclusionFormer addresses inter-object occlusion in layout-to-image generation by constructing SA-Z, a large-scale dataset with explicit occlusion ordering, and introducing an occlusion-aware Diffusion Transformer that handles z-order relationships.

entry.title: iTryOn: Mastering Interactive Video Virtual Try-On with Spatial-Semantic Guidance

author.name: Jun Zheng, Zhengze Xu, Mengting Chen, Jing Wang, Jinsong Lan, Xiaoyong Zhu, Kaifu Zhang, Bo Zheng, Xiaodan Liang

entry.summary: iTryOn formalizes Interactive Video Virtual Try-On where subjects actively engage with clothing, introducing unique challenges beyond texture preservation including semantic ambiguity of interactions and dynamic garment deformation.

entry.title: Latent Dynamics for Full Body Avatar Animation

author.name: Shichong Peng, Chengxiang Yin, Fei Jiang, Zhongshi Jiang, Lingchen Yang, Qingyang Tan, Amin Jourabloo, Jason Saragih, Ke Li, Christian H\"ane

entry.summary: Proposes latent dynamics for pose-driven full-body avatars to model clothing dynamics (loose garments, dynamic elements) that cannot be explained by pose alone. Learns a dynamics model in latent space that accounts for history and inertia.

entry.title: HyperBones: Realtime Bone-driven Neural Garment Simulation with Hypernetwork Conditioning

author.name: Astitva Srivastava, Hsiao-Yu Chen, Ryan Goldade, Philipp Herholz, Zhongshi Jiang, Gene Wei-Chin Lin, Lingchen Yang, Nikolaos Sarafianos, Tuur Stuyck, Doug Roble, Avinash Sharma, Egor Larionov

entry.summary: HyperBones presents a fast bone-driven neural garment simulation using hypernetwork conditioning with independent coarse and fine-level dynamics components for real-time plausible clothing animation.

entry.title: Spacetime Optimal-Transport Attention for Visuo-Haptic Imitation Learning of Contact-Rich Manipulation

author.name: Yue Feng, Weicheng Huang, I-Ming Chen

entry.summary: Proposes a spacetime optimal-transport attention mechanism for fusing vision, force/torque, and proprioceptive sensing in contact-rich manipulation tasks. The attention module provides an explicit prior on how attention mass should be distributed across time and modalities during imitation learning.

entry.title: A Differentiable Measure of Algebraic Complexity: Provably Exact Discovery of Group Structures

author.name: Dongsung Huh, Lior Horesh, Halyun Jeong

entry.summary: Introduces HyperCube, an operator-valued tensor factorization whose global infimum defines an exact differentiable measure of algebraic complexity (associativity violation). Proves this enables provably exact discovery of group structures from data via Cayley-table completion.

entry.title: MOCHA: Multi-Objective Chebyshev Annealing for Agent Skill Optimization

author.name: Md Mehrab Tanjim, Jayakumar Subramanian, Xiang Chen, Branislav Kveton, Subhojyoti Mukherjee, Anlan Zhang, Sungchul Kim, Somdeb Sarkhel, Sunav Choudhury

entry.summary: Introduces MOCHA, a multi-objective optimization framework for LLM agent skills that must simultaneously maximize task performance and satisfy platform constraints. Uses Chebyshev annealing to find Pareto-optimal skill variants.

entry.title: Prior Knowledge or Search? A Study of LLM Agents in Hardware-Aware Code Optimization

author.name: Dmitry Redko (Applied AI Institute), Albert Fazlyev (AI Talent Hub, ITMO University), Konstantin Sozykin (Applied AI Institute), Maria Ivanova (YSDA, Applied AI Institute), Evgeny Burnaev (Applied AI Institute), Egor Shvetsov (Applied AI Institute)

entry.summary: Studies LLM agents for hardware-aware code optimization through controlled experiments, finding that LLMs act as greedy optimizers in black-box optimization and that explicit input-size information has no measurable effect on zero-shot kernel generation.

entry.title: Neurosymbolic Learning for Inference-Time Argumentation

author.name: Gabriel Freedman, Adam Dejl, Adam Gould, Mansi, Lihu Chen, Jianqi Jiang, Francesca Toni

entry.summary: Introduces Inference-Time Argumentation (ITA), a neurosymbolic framework for ternary claim verification using formal argumentation semantics. LLMs generate arguments with base scores, and a formal system computes true/false/uncertain predictions.

entry.title: RLFTSim: Realistic and Controllable Multi-Agent Traffic Simulation via Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning

author.name: Ehsan Ahmadi, Hunter Schofield, Behzad Khamidehi, Fazel Arasteh, Jinjun Shan, Lili Mou, Dongfeng Bai, Kasra Rezaee

entry.summary: Introduces RLFTSim, a reinforcement learning fine-tuning framework for traffic simulation that improves realism by aligning with real-world distributions and adds goal-conditioned controllability on Waymo Open Motion Dataset.

entry.title: RE-VLM: Event-Augmented Vision-Language Model for Scene Understanding

author.name: Hanqing Liu, Mingjie Liu, Luoping Cui, Endian Lin, Donghong Jiang, Chuang Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes RE-VLM, the first dual-stream vision-language model jointly leveraging RGB images and event camera streams for robust scene understanding under adverse conditions like low light and fast motion.

entry.title: The Evaluation Game: Beyond Static LLM Benchmarking

author.name: Paul Wang, Jade Garcia-Bourr\'ee, Anne-Marie Kermarrec, Vincent Corruble

entry.summary: Introduces game-theoretic framework formalizing LLM robustness fine-tuning as two-player game between evaluator and trainer, using group actions to represent data augmentation with analysis on simple settings.

entry.title: Dynamic Shapley Computation

author.name: Xuan Yang, Hsi-Wen Chen, Ming-Syan Chen, Jian Pei

entry.summary: Formulates dynamic Shapley value computation as a structured matrix maintenance problem, exploiting utility locality and coalition locality for efficient recomputation when tasks or training data evolve.

entry.title: Markovian Circuit Tracing for Transformer State Dynamic

author.name: Abdullah X

entry.summary: Introduces Markovian Circuit Tracing, a diagnostic pipeline testing whether transformer activations contain coarse state-transition structure, validated on synthetic HMM tasks where ground truth is known.

entry.title: Continual Segmentation under Joint Nonstationarity

author.name: Prashant Pandey, Himanshu Kumar, Devineni Sri Venkatraya Chowdary, Brejesh Lall

entry.summary: Formalizes continual segmentation under coupled class, domain, and label shifts (joint nonstationarity), introducing gradient-adaptive stabilization for learning in heterogeneous dense prediction environments with limited annotations.

entry.title: Spatial Gram Alignment for Ultra-High-Resolution Image Synthesis

author.name: Jinjin Zhang, Xiefan Guo, Di Huang

entry.summary: Proposes Spatial Gram Alignment (SGA) for ultra-high-resolution image synthesis that uses Gram-matrix style statistics from foundation models rather than direct feature distillation, avoiding perturbation of the pretrained latent manifold.

entry.title: ArchSIBench: Benchmarking the Architectural Spatial Intelligence of Vision-Language Models

author.name: Qirui Shen, Wenda Wang, Jiachen Lu, Zilong Huang, Jin Bai, Lei He, Hongxuan Chen, Weixin Huang

entry.summary: Introduces ArchSIBench, a benchmark for evaluating VLMs on architectural spatial intelligence including layout understanding, circulation patterns, and functional zoning, going beyond basic spatial skills.

entry.title: SR-Ground: Image Quality Grounding for Super-Resolved Content

author.name: Artem Borisov, Evgeney Bogatyrev, Khaled Abud, Dmitriy Vatolin

entry.summary: SR-Ground introduces a large-scale dataset for fine-grained artifact segmentation in super-resolved images, with pixel-level annotations for multiple artifact types from diverse SR models. Conducted a 1,062-participant crowdsourcing study.

entry.title: When Tabular Foundation Models Meet Strategic Tabular Data: A Prior Alignment Approach

author.name: Xinpeng Lv, Yunxin Mao, Renzhe Xu, Chunyuan Zheng, Yikai Chen, Haoxuan Li, Jinxuan Yang, Kun Kuang, Yuanlong Chen, Mingyang Geng, Wanrong Huang, Shixuan Liu, Shaowu Yang, Wenjing Yang, Zhouchen Lin, Haotian Wang

entry.summary: Studies how tabular foundation models (PFN-based) fail under strategic manipulation where individuals modify features to game classifiers. Proposes a prior alignment approach to handle the distribution shift from strategic behavior.

entry.title: RelWitness: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph Generation with Visual-Geometric Relation Witnesses

author.name: Minh Anh Nguyen, Quang Huy Tran, Bao Ngoc Le, Tuan Kiet Pham, Sui Yang Guang

entry.summary: Proposes RelWitness for open-vocabulary 3D scene graph generation that defines relation witnesses (concrete visual-geometric cues) for different relationship types, handling incomplete supervision in 3D scene graph datasets.

entry.title: SimGym: A Framework for A/B Test Simulation in E-Commerce with Traffic-Grounded VLM Agents

author.name: Han Li, Vibhor Malik, Zahra Zanjani Foumani, Alberto Castelo, Shuang Xie, Ailin Fan, Keat Yang Koay, Yuanzheng Zhu, Meysam Feghhi, Ronie Uliana, Zhaoyu Zhang, Angelo Ocana Martins, Mingyu Zhao, Francis Pelland, Jonathan Faerman, Nikolas LeBlanc, Aaron Glazer, Andrew McNamara, Zhong Wu, Lingyun Wang

entry.summary: Presents SimGym, a framework for simulating A/B tests on e-commerce storefronts using VLM agents in live browsers. Generates traffic-grounded personas from production data and validates against real A/B test results.

entry.title: Conflict-Resilient Multi-Agent Reasoning via Signed Graph Modeling

author.name: Longgang He, Longzhu He, Daojing He, Chaozhuo Li

entry.summary: Introduces SIGMA, a signed-graph multi-agent reasoning framework that explicitly models trust, conflict, and neutral relations among agents. Addresses error propagation from naive aggregation in graph-based multi-agent systems.

entry.title: M3DocDep: Multi-modal, Multi-page, Multi-document Dependency Chunking with Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Joongmin Shin, Jeongbae Park, Jaehyung Seo, Heuiseok Lim

entry.summary: Proposes M3DocDep, a pipeline using large vision-language models to recover block-level dependencies in multi-page documents for better RAG chunking, handling cross-page relationships and figure/table-caption bindings.

entry.title: Compositional Literary Primitives in Instruction-Tuned LLMs: Cross-Architectural SAE Features for Self, Style, and Affect

author.name: Joao Paulo Cavalcante Presa, Savio Salvarino Teles de Oliveira

entry.summary: Uses sparse autoencoders to identify compositional literary primitives in instruction-tuned LLMs, finding naming-gates, self-cluster features, stylistic modulators, and compositional emotions that emerge from multi-feature steering.

entry.title: Fine-Grained Benchmark Generation for Comprehensive Evaluation of Foundation Models

author.name: Mohammed Saidul Islam, Negin Baghbanzadeh, Farnaz Kohankhaki, Afshin Cheraghi, Ali Kore, Shayaan Mehdi, Elham Dolatabadi, Arash Afkanpour

entry.summary: Introduces a framework for automated benchmark generation using multi-agent architectures to create evaluation problems from reference materials like textbooks, with a solution-graph strategy for reliable ground truth.

entry.title: FLUIDSPLAT: Reconstructing Physical Fields from Sparse Sensors via Gaussian Primitives

author.name: Huaxi Huang, Meng Li, Zhengqing Gao, Xi Zhou, Xiaoshui Huang, Xiao Sun

entry.summary: Introduces FLUIDSPLAT, applying Gaussian splatting principles to reconstruct continuous flow fields from sparse sensors, with theoretical approximation guarantees for the Gaussian primitive approach.

entry.title: Prediction Is Not Physics: Learning and Evaluating Conserved Quantities in Neural Simulators

author.name: Andrew Bukowski, Aditya Kothari, Simba Shi, Ishir Rao

entry.summary: Shows that neural simulators trained on Hamiltonian trajectories can achieve low MSE while violating conservation laws by factors of 7500-36000x. Investigates structured vs. black-box approaches to learning conserved quantities.

entry.title: MoCo-EA: Exploiting Adversarial Mode Connectivity for Efficient Evolutionary Attacks

author.name: Hyo Seo Kim, Gang Luo, Can Chen, Binghui Wang, Yue Duan, Ren Wang

entry.summary: Introduces MoCo-EA, which replaces traditional crossover in evolutionary adversarial attacks with a Bézier curve operator, exploiting mode connectivity between adversarial examples for more efficient gradient-free attacks.

entry.title: LiFT: Lifted Inter-slice Feature Trajectories for 3D Image Generation from 2D Generators

author.name: Xinhe Zhang, Yuyang Zhang, Pengfei Jin, Arnau Marin-Llobet, Na Li, Quanzheng Li

entry.summary: Proposes LiFT for 3D medical image generation by factorizing volume synthesis into per-slice generation and inter-slice trajectory learning in feature space, using a tri-planar drifting loss.

entry.title: MANGO: Meta-Adaptive Network Gradient Optimization for Online Continual Learning

author.name: Ankita Awasthi, Marco Apolinario, Kaushik Roy

entry.summary: Introduces MANGO for online continual learning, using meta-adaptive gradient optimization to balance stability and plasticity without the biases of replay-based rehearsal or fixed regularization.

entry.title: FormalASR: End-to-End Spoken Chinese to Formal Text

author.name: Wanyi Ning, Yinshang Guo, Haitao Qian, Jiyuan Cheng, Weiyuan Feng, Yufei Zhang

entry.summary: Presents FormalASR, compact end-to-end models (0.6B and 1.7B) that directly transcribe spoken Chinese into formal written text, built on Qwen3-ASR with new spoken-to-formal datasets.

entry.title: Concept-Guided Noisy Negative Suppression for Zero-Shot Classification and Grounding of Chest X-Ray Findings

author.name: Chenyu Lian, Hong-Yu Zhou, Chun-Ka Wong, Jing Qin

entry.summary: Proposes CoNNS for zero-shot chest X-ray classification that suppresses noisy negative pairs in contrastive learning by using concept-guided hierarchical representations to handle similar findings across patients.

entry.title: KappaPlace: Learning Hyperspherical Uncertainty for Visual Place Recognition via Prototype-Anchored Supervision

author.name: Maya Yanko, Yoli Shavit

entry.summary: Proposes KappaPlace for uncertainty-aware visual place recognition using von Mises-Fisher distributions on hyperspheres. Learns a concentration parameter as a proxy for aleatoric uncertainty, enabling safety-critical robotics to know when matches are unreliable.

entry.title: P2DNav: Panorama-to-Downview Reasoning for Zero-shot Vision-and-Language Navigation

author.name: Kai Sheng, Liuyi Wang, Haojie Dai, Jinlong Li, Yongrui Qin, Zongtao He, Chengju Liu, Qijun Chen

entry.summary: Proposes P2DNav, a hierarchical zero-shot framework for vision-and-language navigation that decomposes decisions into panoramic direction selection and downview local grounding, avoiding entangled waypoint prediction.

entry.title: Operationalising Artificial Intelligence Bills of Materials (AIBOMs) for Verifiable AI Provenance and Lifecycle Assurance

author.name: Petar Radanliev, Omar Santos, Carsten Maple, Kay Atefi

entry.summary: Presents an AIBOM schema extending CycloneDX for AI-specific provenance, model lineage, and lifecycle assurance. Develops autonomous pipeline for continuous environment inspection and vulnerability enrichment.

entry.title: FLUXtrapolation: A benchmark on extrapolating ecosystem fluxes

author.name: Anya Fries, Jacob A Nelson, Martin Jung, Markus Reichstein, Jonas Peters

entry.summary: Introduces FLUXtrapolation, a benchmark for extrapolating ecosystem fluxes under progressively harder distribution shifts. Provides a quantitative framework for evaluating domain generalization in climate science applications.

entry.title: CADENet: Condition-Adaptive Asynchronous Dual-Stream Enhancement Network for Adverse Weather Perception in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Sherif Khairy, Catherine M. Elias

entry.summary: Presents CADENet, a training-free three-thread system for autonomous driving perception in adverse weather, with separate threads for real-time detection, enhancement, and quality-gated fusion.

entry.title: Learning with Foresight: Enhancing Neural Routing Policy via Multi-Node Lookahead Prediction

author.name: Xia Jiang, Yaoxin Wu, Yew-Soon Ong, Yingqian Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces Multi-node Lookahead Prediction (MnLP) for neural routing policies, training models to predict multiple future nodes simultaneously to overcome myopic next-node decision-making.

entry.title: Training Neural Networks with Optimal Double-Bayesian Learning

author.name: Vy Bui, Hang Yu, Karthik Kantipudi, Ziv Yaniv, Stefan Jaeger

entry.summary: Proposes a double-Bayesian framework for deriving theoretically optimal learning rates in SGD, using two antagonistic Bayesian processes as a decision mechanism.

entry.title: k-Inductive Neural Barrier Certificates for Unknown Nonlinear Dynamics

author.name: Ben Wooding, Hongchao Zhang, Taylor T. Johnson, Abolfazl Lavaei

entry.summary: Develops k-inductive neural barrier certificates for verifying safety of partially unknown nonlinear systems, relaxing strict single-step safety constraints by allowing temporary increases within bounds while maintaining overall safety guarantees.
