entry.summary: Formulates surrogate modeling for tendon-driven continuum robots as operator learning, enabling a single model to generalize across robot designs by mapping design parameters and actuation inputs to configurations.

entry.title: Knowing When Not to Predict: Self Supervised Learning and Abstention for Safer DR Screening

author.name: Muskaan Chopra, Lorenz Sparrenberg, Jan H. Terheyden, Rafet Sifa

entry.summary: Examines how SSL pretraining length affects calibrated confidence and confidence-based abstention for diabetic retinopathy screening, showing SSL improves selective prediction for safety-critical deployment.

entry.title: Component-Aware Structure-Preserving Style Transfer for Satellite Visual Sim2Real Data Construction

author.name: Zongwu Xie, Yonglong Zhang, Yifan Yang, Yang Liu, Baoshi Cao

entry.summary: Presents a component-aware style transfer framework for constructing realistic satellite imagery from synthetic renders, preserving structural annotations while bridging the sim-to-real appearance gap.

entry.title: Synergistic Foundation Models for Semi-Supervised Fetal Cardiac Ultrasound Analysis: SAM-Med2D Boundary Refinement and DINOv3 Semantic Enhancement

author.name: Tonghao Zhuang (Zhuhai College of Science and Technology, Zhuhai, China), Shanglong Hu (Zhuhai College of Science and Technology, Zhuhai, China), Yongsheng Luo (Zhuhai College of Science and Technology, Zhuhai, China), Zhiqi Zhang (Zhuhai College of Science and Technology, Zhuhai, China), Yu Li (Zhuhai College of Science and Technology, Zhuhai, China)

entry.summary: Presents a semi-supervised framework for fetal cardiac ultrasound analysis combining SAM-Med2D for boundary refinement and DINOv3 for pseudo-label enhancement, with view-specific masking and two-stage optimization.

entry.title: Chunking German Legal Code

author.name: Max Prior, Natalia Milanova, Andreas Schultz

entry.summary: Investigates chunking strategies for RAG on German statutory law, comparing structural, semantic, and hierarchical approaches. Finds that chunking aligned with legal structure (sections/subsections) achieves best retrieval results.

entry.title: Deep Tech to Space: Space Data Centers and AI Revolution at the Edge

author.name: Jonas Weiss, Patricia Sagmeister, Gabriel Maiolini Capez, Dinesh Verma, Roberto Garello, Alberto Perotti, Dawid Lazaj, Alicja Musial, Jakub Nalepa, Thomas Morf, Martin Schmatz, Marek Krawczyk, Mateusz Przeliorz, Kevin Roche, Sagar Tayal, Mahalakshmi Lakshminarayanan, Nicolas Long\'ep\'e, Pierre-Philippe Mathieu, Agata Wijata

entry.summary: Discusses Space Data Centers (SDCs) as AI-based service platforms for processing satellite data in orbit, addressing challenges of space-to-Earth link congestion and latency in the growing satellite constellation era.

entry.title: When Critics Disagree: Adaptive Reward Poisoning Attacks in RIS-Aided Wireless Control System

author.name: Deemah H. Tashman, Soumaya Cherkaoui

entry.summary: Proposes a disagreement-guided reward poisoning attack on Soft Actor-Critic agents in RIS-aided wireless networks, exploiting high-uncertainty states where dual critics disagree.

entry.title: Towards LLM-Assisted Architecture Recovery for Real-World ROS~2 Systems: An Agent-Based Multi-Level Approach to Hierarchical Structural Architecture Reconstruction

author.name: Dominique Briechle, Raj Chanchad, Tobias Geger, Ruidi He, Dhruv Jajadiya, Dhruv Kapadiya, Andreas Rausch, Meng Zhang

entry.summary: Extends LLM-assisted architecture recovery for ROS 2 robotic systems to multi-level hierarchical structural decomposition, going beyond node-level entity extraction.

entry.title: Instance Discrimination for Link Prediction

author.name: Valentin Cuzin-Rambaud (SyCoSMA, DM2L, LIRIS, UCBL), Mathieu Lefort (LIRIS, SyCoSMA, IRISA, MALT, UR), R\'emy Cazabet (DM2L, LIRIS, UCBL, IXXI)

entry.summary: Adapts instance discrimination methods from self-supervised learning to link prediction on graphs, proposing a new structural augmentation based on community structure that improves performance.

entry.title: FusionCell: Cross-Attentive Fusion of Layout Geometry and Netlist Topology for Standard-Cell Performance Prediction

author.name: Haoyi Zhang, Kairong Guo, Bojie Zhang, Yibo Lin, Runsheng Wang

entry.summary: Introduces FusionCell, a dual-modality predictor for standard-cell circuit performance that fuses routed layout geometry (via DeiT encoder) with netlist topology (via graph transformer) using cross-attention.

entry.title: AirfoilGen: A valid-by-construction and performance-aware latent diffusion model for airfoil generation

author.name: Zhijie Yang, Min Tang, Qiang Zou

entry.summary: Proposes AirfoilGen, a latent diffusion model for airfoil design that guarantees geometric validity through a novel circle sweeping representation and conditions on aerodynamic performance.

entry.title: Nonlocal operator learning for fMRI encoding and decoding tasks

author.name: Andreas Kramer, Saugat Acharya, Alice Giola, Emanuele Zappala

entry.summary: Investigates neural integral-operator-based models for fMRI encoding and decoding, emphasizing the role of nonlocal spatiotemporal context in capturing brain activity patterns.

entry.title: Can Conversational XAI Improve User Performance? An Experimental Study

author.name: Sven Kruschel, Julian Rosenberger, Lasse Bohlen, Mathias Kraus, Patrick Zschech

entry.summary: Proposes an experimental design for evaluating conversational XAI assistants on objective performance measures, creating conditions where users can outperform models by identifying systematic errors.

entry.title: SURF: Steering the Scalarization Weight to Uniformly Traverse the Pareto Front

author.name: Liuyuan Jiang, Chentong Huang, Lisha Chen

entry.summary: Proposes SURF for uniformly traversing the Pareto front in multi-objective optimization by inverting the arc-length CDF of the scalarization path to select weights that produce uniform coverage.

entry.title: The General Theory of Localization Methods

author.name: Congwei Song

entry.summary: Proposes a general 'localization method' framework built on localization kernels and local means, connecting self-attention, kernel methods, lazy learning, MeanShift, Hopfield networks, and other ML methods.

entry.title: ShapeBench: A Scalable Benchmark and Diagnostic Suite for Standardized Evaluation in Aerodynamic Shape Optimization

author.name: Shaghayegh Fazliani, Krissh Chawla, Jack Guo, Yiren Shen, Matthias Ihme, Madeleine Udell

entry.summary: Introduces ShapeBench, an open-source aerodynamic shape optimization benchmark with 103 tasks, unified API, validated surrogates, and CFD verification pipelines across eight shape categories.

entry.title: Sutra: Tensor-Op RNNs as a Compilation Target for Vector Symbolic Architectures

author.name: Emma Leonhart

entry.summary: Introduces Sutra, a typed functional programming language that compiles to PyTorch neural networks, with vector symbolic architecture operations lowered to tensor operations over frozen embeddings.

entry.title: Choose Wisely and Privately: Proactive Client Selection for Fair and Efficient Federated Learning

author.name: Adda Akram Bendoukha, Heber Hwang Arcolezi, Nesrine Kaaniche, Aymen Boudguiga

entry.summary: Proposes proactive client selection for federated learning that finds optimal federations matching utility distributions before training, rather than reactively filtering gradient updates.

entry.title: Divide et Calibra: Multiclass Local Calibration via Vector Quantization

author.name: Cesare Barbera, Lorenzo Perini, Giovanni De Toni, Andrea Passerini, Andrea Pugnana

entry.summary: Proposes vector quantization-based multiclass calibration that constructs region-specific calibration maps from shared codeword-dependent Dirichlet concentration factors, balancing local and global calibration.

entry.title: A Unified Framework for Uncertainty-Aware Explainable Artificial Intelligence: A Case Study in Power Quality Disturbance Classification

author.name: Yinsong Chen, Samson S. Yu, Zhong Li, Chee Peng Lim

entry.summary: Formalizes the explanation distribution as push-forward of BNN posterior through attribution operators and proposes uncertainty-aware relevance attribution operators (UA-RAO) with theoretical Monte Carlo accessibility guarantees.

entry.title: Divide and Contrast: Learning Robust Temporal Features without Augmentation

author.name: Abdul-Kazeem Shamba, Kerstin Bach, Gavin Taylor

entry.summary: Di-COT is an unsupervised self-supervised learning framework for time-series that avoids data augmentation by contrasting informative substructures within windows, using stochastic partitioning into overlapping sub-blocks to enable efficient contrast.

entry.title: Optimized Federated Knowledge Distillation with Distributed Neural Architecture Search

author.name: Chaimaa Medjadji, Sylvain Kubler, Yves Le Traon, Guilain Leduc, Sadi Alawadi, Feras M. Awaysheh

entry.summary: FedKDNAS combines federated knowledge distillation with distributed neural architecture search, allowing heterogeneous client architectures to be adapted to varying data complexity and hardware constraints.

entry.title: Efficient Table QA via TableGrid Navigation and Progressive Inference Prompting

author.name: Amritansh Maurya, Navjot Singh, Mohammed Javed, Omar Moured

entry.summary: Proposes TableGrid Navigation and Progressive Inference Prompting for training-free Table QA that iteratively navigates rows/columns to locate evidence and enforces structured reasoning steps.

entry.title: WildRoadBench: A Wild Aerial Road-Damage Grounding Benchmark for Vision-Language Models and Autonomous Agents

author.name: Bingnan Liu, Chenhang Cui, Rui Huang, Jiani Luo, Zhirong Shen, Tinghao Wang, Xiande Huang, Lingbei Meng, Fei Shen, An Zhang

entry.summary: WildRoadBench introduces a wild aerial road-damage grounding benchmark evaluating both VLMs for direct localization and LLM-driven agents for autonomous research-and-engineering on UAV imagery.

entry.title: Corrected Integrated Laplace Approximation for Bayesian Inference in Latent Gaussian Models

author.name: Jinlin Lai, Charles C. Margossian, Daniel R. Sheldon

entry.summary: Proposes corrected Integrated Laplace Approximation using importance sampling to fix errors introduced by ILA in latent Gaussian models, improving posterior accuracy for Bayesian hierarchical models.

entry.title: Mahjax: A GPU-Accelerated Mahjong Simulator for Reinforcement Learning in JAX

author.name: Soichiro Nishimori, Shinri Okano, Keigo Habara, Sotetsu Koyamada, Eason Yu, Masashi Sugiyama

entry.summary: Mahjax introduces a fully vectorized Riichi Mahjong environment in JAX for GPU-accelerated reinforcement learning, enabling large-scale parallel rollouts for tabula rasa learning in this complex imperfect-information game.

entry.title: Scale-Calibrated Median-of-Means for Robust Distributed Principal Component Analysis

author.name: Kisung You

entry.summary: Proposes a scale-calibrated median-of-means estimator for distributed PCA that properly handles the different scales of mean estimation and subspace estimation on the product geometry of Euclidean and Grassmann manifolds.

entry.title: AiraXiv: An AI-Driven Open-Access Platform for Human and AI Scientists

author.name: Junshu Pan, Panzhong Lu, Yixuan Weng, Qiyao Sun, Fang Guo, Zijie Yang, Qiji Zhou, Yue Zhang

entry.summary: AiraXiv proposes an AI-driven open-access publishing platform where both human and AI scientists participate as authors/readers, with AI-augmented analysis, review, and continuous feedback-driven iteration.

entry.title: When Irregularity Helps: A Subclass Analysis of Inductive Bias in Neural Morphology

author.name: Wen Zhang

entry.summary: Shows that a tiny structurally-specific irregular verb subtype (<1% of data) in Japanese accounts for disproportionate model errors in morphological generation. Removing this subtype yields larger improvements than removing all irregular verbs.

entry.title: Divide-Prompt-Refine: a Training-Free, Structure-Aware Framework for Biomedical Abstract Generation

author.name: Sylvey Lin, Joe Menke, Shufan Ming, Dongin Nam, Neil Smalheiser, Halil Kilicoglu

entry.summary: Proposes DPR-BAG, a training-free framework for generating biomedical abstracts for articles that lack them, decomposing full texts into rhetorical facets and performing parallel LLM-based summarization with iterative refinement.

entry.title: Text Analytics Evaluation Framework: A Case Study on LLMs and Social Media

author.name: Yuefeng Shi, Nedjma Ousidhoum, Jose Camacho-Collados

entry.summary: Introduces an evaluation framework for LLMs processing long sequences of social media posts, with 470 manually curated questions testing semantic understanding and reasoning over aggregated text data across various NLP tasks.

entry.title: Hiding in Plain Sight: Finding MAHA on Reddit

author.name: Sabit Ahmed, Subigya Nepal, Henry Kautz

entry.summary: Introduces a Reddit dataset spanning 6 years (2020-2025) with 19.4M posts from 4M users for studying the Make America Healthy Again movement, using LLM-assisted classification across health-related themes.

entry.title: HAPS: Rethinking Image Similarity for Virtual Staining

author.name: Fedor Gubanov, Svetlana Illarionova, Vlad Kozlovskiy, Mikhail Romanov, Yersultan Akhmetov, Aida Akaeva, Vyacheslav Grinevich, Rifat Hamoudi, Maxim Sharaev

entry.summary: Proposes HAPS, a domain-specific image similarity metric for virtual staining in histopathology that addresses the misalignment between generic metrics (SSIM, PSNR, LPIPS) and histological evaluation needs including tissue morphology and biomarker patterns.

entry.title: Findings of the Counter Turing Test: AI-Generated Image Detection

author.name: Rajarshi Roy, Nasrin Imanpour, Ashhar Aziz, Shashwat Bajpai, Gurpreet Singh, Shwetangshu Biswas, Kapil Wanaskar, Parth Patwa, Subhankar Ghosh, Shreyas Dixit, Nilesh Ranjan Pal, Vipula Rawte, Ritvik Garimella, Amitava Das, Amit Sheth, Vasu Sharma, Aishwarya Naresh Reganti, Vinija Jain, Aman Chadha

entry.summary: Presents findings from the Counter Turing Test competition for AI-generated image detection, covering binary classification and model attribution tasks with analysis of winning approaches across multiple generative models.

entry.title: Decomposing Subject-Driven Image Generation via Intermediate Structural Prediction

author.name: Hanzhong Guo, Yizhou Yu

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage framework for subject-driven image generation that decouples structure from appearance by first predicting Canny maps then rendering conditioned on both, with a 100k-pair text-aware dataset for text handling.

entry.title: OSGNet with MLLM Reranking @ Ego4D Episodic Memory Challenge 2026

author.name: Yisen Feng, Leigang Qu, Haoyu Zhang, Qiaohui Chu, Meng Liu, Xuemeng Song, Weili Guan, Liqiang Nie

entry.summary: Champion solution for Ego4D Episodic Memory Challenge at CVPR 2026 using MLLM reranking of OSGNet candidates for temporal segment localization in egocentric video.

entry.title: LiteViLNet: Lightweight Vision-LiDAR Fusion Network for Efficient Road Segmentation

author.name: Daojie Peng, Bingtao Wang, Fulong Ma, Liang Zhang, Jun Ma

entry.summary: LiteViLNet proposes a lightweight multi-modal network fusing RGB and LiDAR for road segmentation, designed for deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. Uses dual-stream lightweight encoder with depth-wise separable convolutions.

entry.title: STiTch: Semantic Transition and Transportation in Collaboration for Training-Free Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval

author.name: Miaoge Li, Dongsheng Wang, Zening Sun, Jinsen Zhang, Wenhan Luo, Jingcai Guo

entry.summary: STiTch addresses training-free zero-shot composed image retrieval by handling semantic gaps between reference images and text modifications through semantic transition and transportation mechanisms.

entry.title: RoadTones: Tone Controllable Text Generation from Road Event Videos

author.name: Chirag Parikh, Siddhi Pravin Lipare, Ravi Kiran Sarvadevabhatla

entry.summary: RoadTones introduces tone-controllable video captioning for road events, with a dataset (RoadTones-51K) and model that generates captions with controlled urgency, style, and tone using chain-of-thought reasoning.

entry.title: E-ReCON: An Energy- and Resource-Efficient Precision-Configurable Sparse nvCIM Macro for Conventional and Spiking Neural Edge Inference

author.name: Ankit Kumar Tenwar, Mukul Lokhande, Santosh Kumar Vishvakarma

entry.summary: E-ReCON presents a 16Kb energy-efficient digital compute-in-memory macro based on 3T1R ReRAM bitcell achieving up to 419 TOPS/W efficiency for both CNN and SNN workloads on edge devices.

entry.title: Anomaly-Informed Confidence Calibration for Vision-Based Safety Prediction

author.name: Zhenjiang Mao, Jiawen Wu, Gabriel Wagner, Zhongzheng Zhang, Ivan Ruchkin

entry.summary: Proposes anomaly-informed online calibration for vision-based safety prediction in autonomous racing that fuses perceptual and dynamics anomaly signals from a world model. Identifies a 'perception-dynamics gap' where visual anomaly detection misses dynamics failures.

entry.title: Safety-Critical Control for Smoothed Implicit Contact Dynamics

author.name: Haegu Lee, Yitaek Kim, Christoffer Sloth

entry.summary: Provides formal methods for safety-critical control with smoothed implicit contact dynamics, bounding actual contact forces despite relaxed complementarity constraints. Shows that constraint violations can be non-monotonic in the smoothing parameter.

entry.title: If AI is normal technology, history is not reassuring.

author.name: Davidmanheim

entry.summary: Argues that major technological revolutions (agriculture, industrial revolution) historically harmed the majority of people during the transition period, even if long-term outcomes were positive. Applies this lens to AI development to challenge the assumption that AI progress will be smoothly beneficial.

entry.title: KAN-MLP-Mixer: A comprehensive investigation of the usage of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) for improving IMU-based Human Activity Recognition

author.name: Mengxi Liu, Sizhen Bian, Vitor Fortes, Francisco Calatrava Nicolas, Daniel Gei{\ss}ler, Maximilian Kiefer-Emmanouilidis, Bo Zhou, Paul Lukowicz

entry.summary: Proposes KAN-MLP-Mixer, a hybrid architecture combining Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with MLPs for IMU-based Human Activity Recognition. Systematically explores where to place KAN modules to balance KANs' precision with MLPs' noise robustness.

entry.title: Explainable Wastewater Digital Twins: Adaptive Context-Conditioned Structured Simulators with Self-Falsifying Decision Support

author.name: Gary Simethy, Daniel Ortiz Arroyo, Petar Durdevic

entry.summary: Develops an explainable digital twin for wastewater treatment plant aeration and dosing, using interpretable locally linear state-space experts with context-aware gating. Applies conformal risk control for safety-critical decision support.

entry.title: Mask-to-Correct$^+$: Leveraging Retriever Diversity for Masking-guided Faithful Fact Correction

author.name: Payel Santra, Lavisha Sharma, Madhusudan Ghosh, Partha Basuchowdhuri

entry.summary: Proposes Mask-to-Correct, a training-free RAG framework for automated fact correction that uses diversity-aware masking to identify erroneous spans in claims and evaluates correction faithfulness using retrieved evidence.

entry.title: Euclidean Embedding of Data Using Local Distances

author.name: Dimitris Arabadjis

entry.summary: Studies recovering globally consistent Euclidean embeddings from local distance graphs by solving variational problems matching on-graph distances to Euclidean metrics, with coordinate-free Euler-Lagrange equations.

entry.title: Latent Space Guided Scenario Sampling for Multimodal Segmentation Under Missing Modalities

author.name: Irem Ulku, \"O. \"Ozg\"ur Tanr{\i}\"over, Erdem Akag\"und\"uz

entry.summary: Proposes a training strategy for multimodal segmentation that learns a scenario sampling distribution from pretrained latent space rather than uniform random modality dropout, addressing the practical problem of missing modalities in remote sensing.

entry.title: GAMR: Geometric-Aware Manifold Regularization with Virtual Outlier Synthesis for Learning with Noisy Labels

author.name: Ningkang Peng, Jingyang Mao, Xiaoqian Peng, Peirong Ma, Xichen Yang, Weiguang Qu, Yanhui Gu

entry.summary: Proposes GAMR for learning with noisy labels that actively reshapes feature space geometry by constructing energy barriers between data manifolds using virtual outlier synthesis and geometric-aware manifold regularization.

entry.title: Lying Is Just a Phase: The Hidden Alignment Transition in Language Model Scaling

author.name: Adil Amin

entry.summary: Continuing our coverage from yesterday, Measures coupling between reasoning and truthfulness across 63 base models, discovering a phase transition at ~3.5B parameters where capabilities shift from anticorrelation to cooperation. Shows architecture and data curation can shift this critical scale.

entry.title: From Prompts to Pavement Through Time: Temporal Grounding in Agentic Scene-to-Plan Reasoning

author.name: Ahmed Y. Gado, Omar Y. Goba, Alaa Hassanein, Catherine M. Elias, Ahmed Hussein

entry.summary: Explores temporal grounding in autonomous vehicle planning using LLM/LMM ensembles. Introduces three planner architectures with progressive temporal integration and evaluates on BDD-X dataset.

entry.title: Learn-by-Wire Training Control Governance: Bounded Autonomous Training Under Stress for Stability and Efficiency

author.name: Anis Radianis

entry.summary: Introduces LBW-Guard, a training control governance layer that sits above AdamW optimizer, monitoring training telemetry to detect and mitigate instability during LLM training. Evaluated on Qwen2.5 models (3B to 14B) under stress conditions.

entry.title: Can Large Language Models Revolutionize Survey Research? Experiments with Disaster Preparedness Responses

author.name: Yan Wang, Ziyi Guo, Christopher McCarty

entry.summary: Evaluates LLMs across a five-stage survey research framework (questionnaire design, sample selection, pilot testing, imputation, analysis) using the 2024 Hurricane Milton preparedness survey. Introduces a PMT-constrained evaluation for disaster contexts.

entry.title: Efficient Elicitation of Collective Disagreements

author.name: Mohamed Ouaguenouni, Felipe Garrido-Lucero, Umberto Grandi, C\'esar Hidalgo, Magdalena Tydrichova

entry.summary: Proposes a stratified framework to identify minimal aggregated preference information needed to compute disagreement measures, introducing the plurality matrix as a generalization of pairwise comparisons that captures structural disagreement efficiently.

entry.title: GroupAffect-4: A Multimodal Dataset of Four-Person Collaborative Interaction

author.name: Meisam Jamshidi Seikavandi, Alice Modica, Anna Obara, Shan Ahmed Shaffi, Fabricio Batista Narcizo, Tanya Ignatenko, Ted Vucurevich, Karim Haddad, Daniel Barratt, Daniel Overholt, Jesper Bunsow Boldt, Paolo Burelli, Andrew Burke Dittberner

entry.summary: Introduces GroupAffect-4, a multimodal dataset of 40 participants in 10 four-person groups performing collaborative tasks, with physiological sensors, eye tracking, audio, self-reports, and personality data.

entry.title: An Efficient Multilevel Preconditioned Nonlinear Conjugate Gradient Method for Incremental Potential Contact

author.name: Yu Zhang, Xing Shen, Kemeng Huang, Wei Chen, Yin Yang, Taku Komura, Tiantian Liu, Xingang Pan

entry.summary: Presents MAS-PNCG, combining Multilevel Additive Schwarz preconditioners with Preconditioned Nonlinear Conjugate Gradient for Incremental Potential Contact simulation. Achieves efficient intersection-free simulation without expensive per-iteration Hessian assembly.

entry.title: Interoceptive Divergence in Aesthetic Evaluation and Implications for Human-AI Alignment

author.name: Yoshia Abe, Tatsuya Daikoku, Yasuo Kuniyoshi

entry.summary: Studies how humans and AI systems converge or diverge in aesthetic evaluation, examining the role of interoception (internal body states) in beauty judgments and its implications for human-AI alignment.

entry.title: Query-Conditioned Graph Retrieval for Contextualized LLM Reasoning in Personalized Wearable Data

author.name: Zhenyu Lu, Mahyar Abbasian, Amir M. Rahmani

entry.summary: Proposes WAG (Wearable As Graph), a framework that organizes wearable sensor data into a personalized knowledge graph and retrieves query-conditioned subgraphs for LLM reasoning. Addresses the challenge of selecting appropriate context from long-term, multimodal wearable data.

entry.title: Retrieve Only Relevant Tables Whether Few or Many: Adaptive Table Retrieval Method

author.name: Taehee Kim, Seungbin Yang, Jihwan Kim, Jaegul Choo

entry.summary: Proposes an adaptive table retrieval method that dynamically adjusts the number of tables retrieved per query rather than using a fixed k, addressing the variable information needs across different text-to-SQL queries.

entry.title: DualView: Adaptive Local-Global Fusion for Multi-Hop Document Reranking

author.name: Litong Zhang, Jiaxin Li, Kuo Zhao

entry.summary: Presents a dual-view cascaded reranking framework for multi-hop document reranking that combines local cross-attention scoring with global inter-document dependency modeling through adaptive fusion.

entry.title: Robust Basis Spline Decoupling for the Compression of Transformer Models

author.name: Joppe De Jonghe, Van Tien Pham, Mariya Ishteva

entry.summary: Proposes using basis spline (B-spline) parameterizations for the nonlinear functions in tensor-based decoupling methods for transformer compression, addressing numerical instability issues of polynomial approaches.

entry.title: EUPHORIA: Efficient Universal Planning via Hybrid Optimization for Robust Industrial Robotic Assembly

author.name: Shih-Yu Lai, Chia-Ching Yen, Yang-Ting Shen, Peter Yichen Chen, Yu-Lun Liu, Bing-Yu Chen

entry.summary: Presents EUPHORIA, a robotic assembly planning framework using meta-geometric encoders based on graph hypernetworks for few-shot adaptation to new architectural designs without retraining.

entry.title: GenAI-FDIA: Physics-Informed Generative Models for False Data Injection Attacks

author.name: Mohammad A. Razzaque, Muta Tah Hira

entry.summary: Benchmarks 20 generative model architectures for synthesizing physics-compliant false data injection attacks on power systems, spanning GANs, VAEs, flows, and diffusion models across three IEEE testbeds.

entry.title: The Extremum Stack is a Minimal Sufficient Statistic for Rate-Independent Functionals: A Kolmogorov Complexity Characterisation

author.name: Piotr Frydrych

entry.summary: Proves the extremum stack of a discrete sequence is a minimal sufficient statistic for all computable, causal, rate-independent functionals in the Kolmogorov complexity sense.

entry.title: Data-Free Client Contribution Estimation via Logit Maximization for Federated Learning

author.name: Asim Ukaye, Nurbek Tastan, Mubarak Abdu-Aguye, Karthik Nandakumar

entry.summary: Proposes CELM, a data-free client contribution estimation method for federated learning that uses logit maximization to probe client updates without sharing raw data, addressing class imbalance issues.

entry.title: Benchmarking Commercial ASR Systems on Code-Switching Speech: Arabic, Persian, and German

author.name: Sajjad Abdoli (MAD), Ghassan Al-Sumaidaee (MAD), Clayton W. Taylor (MAD), Ahmad (MAD), ElShiekh, Ahmed Rashad

entry.summary: Benchmarks five commercial ASR systems on code-switching speech across Arabic-English, Persian-English, and German-English, revealing significant performance gaps in multilingual conditions.

entry.title: Learning Long-Term Temporal Dependencies in Photovoltaic Power Output Prediction Through Multi-Horizon Forecasting

author.name: Sumit Laha, Ankit Sharma, Hassan Foroosh

entry.summary: Proposes multi-horizon forecasting framework for photovoltaic power prediction using ground-based sky images, demonstrating architecture-independent improvements over single-horizon estimation.

entry.title: On-Device Continual Learning with Dual-Stage Buffer and Dynamic Loss for Point-of-Care Pneumonia Diagnosis

author.name: Danu Kim

entry.summary: Presents PneumoNet for on-device continual learning in pneumonia diagnosis using dual-stage balanced buffer and dynamic class-weighted loss, achieving 86.6% accuracy with minimal forgetting.

entry.title: Skinned Motion Retargeting with Spatially Adaptive Interaction Guidance

author.name: Soojin Choi, Seokhyeon Hong, Chaelin Kim, Junghyun Nam, Junhyuk Jeon, Junyong Noh

entry.summary: Presents geometry-aware motion retargeting framework using spatially adaptive anchors that dynamically reposition to handle characters with exaggerated body proportions while preserving interaction semantics.

entry.title: ARC-RL: A Reinforcement Learning Playground Inspired by ARC Raiders

author.name: Carlo Romeo, Andrew D. Bagdanov

entry.summary: Introduces ARC-RL, a suite of MuJoCo environments featuring game-inspired robotic morphologies (hexapods, quadrupeds) from ARC Raiders. Targets the gap between sim-to-real robotics benchmarks and game NPC locomotion requirements.

entry.title: A novel YOLO26-MoE optimized by an LLM agent for insulator fault detection considering UAV images

author.name: Jo\~ao Pedro Matos-Carvalho, Laio Oriel Seman, Stefano Frizzo Stefenon, Mohammad Khalaf Mohammad Khreasat, Gabriel Villarrubia Gonz\'alez

entry.summary: Proposes YOLO26-MoE, integrating sparse Mixture-of-Experts into YOLO26's high-resolution branch for insulator fault detection from UAV images, with LLM-agent hyperparameter optimization.

entry.title: A Closed-loop, State-centric, Multi-agent Framework for Passenger Load Estimation from Heterogeneous Data Streams

author.name: Yiyao Xu, Hao Zhou, Yuhang Wang, Jingran Sun

entry.summary: Proposes a closed-loop multi-agent framework for passenger load estimation from heterogeneous sensor data, enforcing physical feasibility and dynamic trust allocation among evidence sources.

entry.title: Passive Construction Site Safety Monitoring via Persona-Scaffolded Adversarial Chain-of-Thought VLM Verification

author.name: Ananth Sriram, Neel Mokaria, Rajveer Singh

entry.summary: Presents a passive construction site safety monitoring pipeline using YOLO11, SAM 3, and Qwen3-VL with adversarial chain-of-thought verification for PPE compliance checking from body-worn and fixed cameras.

entry.title: INSHAPE: Instance-Level Shapelets for Interpretable Time-Series Classification

author.name: Seongjun Lee, Seokhyun Lee, Changhee Lee

entry.summary: Proposes INSHAPE, a method for discovering instance-level shapelets (discriminative temporal patterns) for time-series classification, addressing limitations of population-level approaches that can misalign with individual instances.

entry.title: Physics-informed convolutional neural networks for fluid flow through porous media

author.name: Rafa{\l} Topolnicki, Pawe{\l} D{\l}otko, Maciej Matyka

entry.summary: Presents a physics-informed CNN framework for predicting pore-scale fluid velocity fields from geometry, using a custom loss combining velocity reconstruction with incompressibility and boundary conditions.

entry.title: WaveGraphNet: Physics-Consistent Guided-Wave Damage Localization through Coupled Inverse-Forward Graph Learning

author.name: Vinay Sharma, Aditya Bharade, Olga Fink

entry.summary: Introduces WaveGraphNet, a coupled inverse-forward graph learning framework for guided-wave damage localization in composite plates that explicitly models the sensor network as a graph.

entry.title: Miller-Index-Based Latent Crystallographic Fracture Plane Reasoning with Vision-Language Models

author.name: Qinwu Xu, Yifan Jiang

entry.summary: Studies whether multimodal LLMs can use Miller indices as latent representations for reasoning about crystallographic fracture geometry, evaluating inference of plane hypotheses from visual observations.

entry.title: Machine-Learning-Enhanced Non-Invasive Testing for MASLD Fibrosis: Shallow-Deep Neural Networks Versus FIB-4, Tabular Foundation Models, and Large Language Models

author.name: Athanasios Angelakis, Gabriele De Vito, Eleni-Myrto Trifylli, Filomena Ferrucci

entry.summary: Compares ML approaches (shallow-deep neural networks, tabular foundation models, LLMs) against FIB-4 for detecting advanced fibrosis in MASLD using the same four clinical variables, showing ML can improve over fixed formulas.

entry.title: ReversedQ: Opportunities for Faster Q-Learning in Episodic Online Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Sofia R. Miskala-Dinc, Aviva Prins

entry.summary: Identifies three opportunities for faster model-free Q-learning in episodic MDPs: value-function update order, update frequencies, and initialization. Combined modifications (ReversedQ) significantly improve cumulative reward over RandomizedQ.

entry.title: Same Target, Different Basins: Hard vs. Soft Labels for Annotator Distributions

author.name: Mirerfan Gheibi, Gashin Ghazizadeh

entry.summary: Studies hard-label delivery (multipass and stochastic label sampling) as alternatives to soft labels when learning from annotator disagreement, finding advantages with sparse annotations on CIFAR-10H.

entry.title: CAdam: Context-Adaptive Moment Estimation for 3D Gaussian Densification in Generative Distillation

author.name: SeungJeh Chung, Geonho Park, Misong Kim, HyeongYeop Kang

entry.summary: Proposes CAdam (Context-Adaptive Moment Estimation) for 3D Gaussian Splatting densification in generative distillation, treating densification as a statistical decision problem to avoid over/under-densification.

entry.title: Robust Personalized Recommendation under Hidden Confounding in MNAR

author.name: Zongyu Li, Wanting Su, Tianyu Xia

entry.summary: Proposes instance-specific sensitivity analysis for recommender systems under hidden confounders in MNAR settings, moving beyond uniform sensitivity bounds to capture user-item heterogeneity.

entry.title: DeCoR: Design and Control Co-Optimization for Urban Streets Using Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Bibek Poudel, Lei Zhu, Kevin Heaslip, Sai Swaminathan, Weizi Li

entry.summary: DeCoR uses reinforcement learning to co-optimize crosswalk layout and signal control on urban streets, encoding pedestrian networks as graphs and learning generative policies for crosswalk placement parameterized as Gaussian mixtures.

entry.title: A New Framework to Analyse the Distributional Robustness of Deep Neural Networks

author.name: Divij Khaitan, Subhashis Banerjee

entry.summary: Proposes a framework to analyze distributional robustness of DNNs by modeling interactions between layer weights and activations using Bernoulli distributions, using class separation as a diagnostic proxy.

entry.title: Oracle Supervision Transfers for Hyperparameter Prediction in Model-Based Image Denoising

author.name: Jianmin Liao, Lixin Shen, Yuesheng Xu

entry.summary: HyperDn proposes a configuration-conditioned predictor that transfers oracle supervision across different hyperparameter configurations for model-based image denoisers, reducing the need for expensive grid searches for each new configuration.

entry.title: Spectral bandits for smooth graph functions with applications in recommender systems

author.name: Tom\'a\v{s} Koc\'ak, Michal Valko, R\'emi Munos, Branislav Kveton, Shipra Agrawal

entry.summary: Studies bandit problems where arm payoffs are smooth functions on a graph, introducing effective dimension concept and two algorithms that scale linearly in this dimension rather than the number of nodes, applicable to recommendation systems.

entry.title: GraphRAG on Consumer Hardware: Benchmarking Local LLMs for Healthcare EHR Schema Retrieval

author.name: Peter Fernandes, Ria Kanjilal

entry.summary: Evaluates GraphRAG for healthcare EHR schema retrieval using locally deployed open-source LLMs, benchmarking four models under resource-constrained, privacy-sensitive conditions.

entry.title: Retrieval-Augmented Long-Context Translation for Cultural Image Captioning: Gators submission for AmericasNLP 2026 shared task

author.name: Aashish Dhawan, Christopher Driggers-Ellis, Dzmitry Kasinets, Daisy Zhe Wang, Christan Grant

entry.summary: Presents a retrieval-augmented translation pipeline for indigenous language image captioning (Bribri, Guaraní, Nahuatl) achieving 122-164% improvements over baselines. Uses Qwen2.5-VL for Spanish intermediate captions with Gemini 2.5 Flash for target translation.

entry.title: Evaluating Speech Articulation Synthesis with Articulatory Phoneme Recognition

author.name: Vinicius Ribeiro, Yves Laprie

entry.summary: Proposes using phoneme recognition from articulatory features as a proxy for evaluating speech articulation synthesis quality, addressing the difficulty of subjective assessment requiring specialized anatomical knowledge.

entry.title: Building a Custom Taxonomy of AI Skills and Tasks from the Ground Up with Job Postings

author.name: Stephen Meisenbacher, Peter Norlander

entry.summary: Proposes TaxonomyBuilder for constructing AI skills taxonomies from job postings using LLMs, investigating design decisions about data inclusion for optimal taxonomy construction. Demonstrates that less data can provide more clarity.

entry.title: GradeLegal: Automated Grading for German Legal Cases

author.name: Abdullah Al Zubaer, Lorenz Wendlinger, Simon Alexander Nonn, Michael Granitzer, Jelena Mitrovic

entry.summary: Investigates LLMs for automated grading of German legal exam solutions, evaluating 27 models with various prompting strategies across criminal and public law.

entry.title: LoCar: Localization-Aware Evaluation of In-Vehicle Assistants through Fine-Grained Sociolinguistic Control

author.name: Seogyeong Jeong, Kiwoong Park, Seyoung Song, Eunsu Kim, Ken E. Friedl, Jaeho Kim, Alice Oh

entry.summary: Proposes LoCar, an evaluation framework for in-vehicle conversational assistants focusing on Korean localization, revealing instability in honorific control and weaker performance in strategic conversational metrics.

entry.title: Smarter edits? Post-editing with error highlights and translation suggestions

author.name: Fleur V. J. van Tellingen, Gautam Ranka, Dora \v{Z}ug\v{c}i\'c, Joyce van der Wal, Andrea Camasta, Livio Guerra, Alina Karakanta

entry.summary: Explores usefulness of LLM-derived error highlights and correction suggestions for machine translation post-editing. Finds no productivity/quality gains but improved user experience with APE-based suggestions over QE-derived highlights.

entry.title: Manga109-v2026: Revisiting Manga109 Annotations for Modern Manga Understanding

author.name: Jeonghun Baek, Atsuyuki Miyai, Shota Onohara, Hikaru Ikuta, Kiyoharu Aizawa

entry.summary: Revisits Manga109 dataset annotations identifying five categories of issues (transcription errors, missing text, overlapping annotations, etc.) and proposes corrections combining OCR-based detection with human verification for modern manga understanding tasks.

entry.title: Do LLMs Know What Luxembourgish Borrows? Probing Lexical Neology in Low-Resource Multilingual Models

author.name: Nina Hosseini-Kivanani

entry.summary: Introduces LexNeo-Bench, a 3,050-instance benchmark for probing LLM knowledge of lexical borrowing in Luxembourgish, finding models perform near chance without external context but improve with a linguistic knowledge graph.

entry.title: Findings of the Fifth Shared Task on Multilingual Coreference Resolution: Expanding Datasets for Long-Range Entities

author.name: Michal Nov\'ak, Miloslav Konop\'ik, Anna Nedoluzhko, Martin Popel, Ond\v{r}ej Pra\v{z}\'ak, Jakub Sido, Milan Straka, Zden\v{e}k \v{Z}abokrtsk\'y, Daniel Zeman

entry.summary: Describes the fifth edition of Multilingual Coreference Resolution shared task emphasizing long-range entities, expanding to 27 datasets in 19 languages with CorefUD 1.4. Ten systems participated.

entry.title: Leveraging Vision-Language Models to Detect Attention in Educational Videos

author.name: Gabriel Becquet (LIP6, CNRS, SU), S\'ebastien Lall\'e (CNRS, LIP6, SU), Vanda Luengo (LIP6, CNRS, SU), Ali Abou-Hassan (SU, CNRS, PHENIX, IUF)

entry.summary: Explores using vision-language models to detect learner attention in educational videos, shifting from classical ML with engineered features to multimodal foundation models for temporal engagement patterns.

entry.title: Co-Fusion4D: Spatio-temporal Collaborative Fusion for Robust 3D Object Detection

author.name: Wenxuan Li, Qin Zou, Shoubing Chen, Chi Chen, Yingyi Yang, Shoubing Chen, Qingxiang Meng

entry.summary: Proposes Co-Fusion4D for autonomous driving 3D object detection that explicitly preserves cross-frame spatiotemporal consistency by treating the current frame as primary and selectively incorporating historical frames after filtering and alignment.

entry.title: End-to-End Unmixing with Material Prompts for Hyperspectral Object Tracking

author.name: Xu Han, Mohammad Aminul Islam, Lei Wang, Zekun Long, Guanmanyi Fu, Wangshu Cai, Kuldip K. Paliwal, Jun Zhou

entry.summary: Formulates hyperspectral object tracking as joint optimization of material abundance estimation and target localization, using material prompts that encode spectral composition to guide the tracker.

entry.title: DarkShake-DVS: Event-based Human Action Recognition under Low-light andShaking Camera Conditions

author.name: Jiaqi Chen, Qinfu Xu, Liyuan Pan

entry.summary: Proposes DarkShake-DVS for event-based human action recognition under low-light and shaking camera conditions, introducing a benchmark with synchronized IMU data and Event-IMU Stabilized HAR method.

entry.title: Holistic Reliability Propagation: Decoupling Annotation and Prediction for Robust Noisy-Label

author.name: Jingyang Mao, Ningkang Peng, Yanhui Gu

entry.summary: Proposes Holistic Reliability Propagation (HRP) for noisy-label learning that separately estimates reliability for given labels and pseudo-labels using bilevel meta-learning, routing them to different training objectives.

entry.title: AttriStory: Fine-grained Attribute Realization for Visual Storytelling with Diffusion Models

author.name: Manogna Sreenivas, Rohit Kumar, Soma Biswas

entry.summary: Introduces AttriStory, a benchmark for fine-grained attribute realization in visual storytelling with 200 multi-scene stories across 10 styles, evaluating whether diffusion models faithfully render specified attributes like clothing colors and accessories.

entry.title: HyDAR-Pano3D: A Hybrid Disentangled Anatomical Recovery Framework for Panoramic-to-3D Reconstruction

author.name: Yaoyao Yue, J\'er\^ome Schmid, Xiaoshuang Li, Eduardo Delamare, Jinman Kim

entry.summary: Proposes HyDAR-Pano3D, a two-stage framework for reconstructing 3D dental anatomy from panoramic radiographs by disentangling common anatomical structures from patient-specific variations.

entry.title: HDMoE: A Hierarchical Decoupling-Fusion Mixture-of-Experts Framework for Multimodal Cancer Survival Prediction

author.name: Huayi Wang, Haochao Ying, Yuyang Xu, Qiyao Zheng, jun wang, Cheng Zhang, Ying Sun, Jian Wu

entry.summary: Proposes HDMoE, a hierarchical decoupling-fusion mixture-of-experts framework for multimodal cancer survival prediction that reduces redundant information before decoupling and models fine-grained feature relationships.

entry.title: VDFP: Video Deflickering with Flicker-banding Priors

author.name: Zhiyi Zhou, Libo Zhu, Zihan Zhou, Yulun Zhang, Xiaokang Yang

entry.summary: VDFP addresses video banding artifacts from smartphone screen capture by modeling the degradation based on rolling shutter mechanisms and proposing a perception-guided generation framework with a new real-world dataset.

entry.title: SAM-Sode: Towards Faithful Explanations for Tiny Bacteria Detection

author.name: Wanying Tan, Shuo Yan, Dazhi Huang, Yazheng Liu, Zili Shao, Rufeng Chen, Hechang Chen, Mude Shi, Tianxing Ji, Sihong Xie

entry.summary: SAM-Sode proposes an explainable AI framework for tiny bacteria detection that transforms feature attribution maps into geometry-aware prompts for SAM3, achieving spatial refinement and morphological reconstruction for interpretable clinical diagnosis.

entry.title: RePCM: Region-Specific and Phenotype-Adaptive Bi-Ventricular Cardiac Motion Synthesis

author.name: Xuan Yang, Xiaohan Yuan, Hao Li, Lingyu Chen, Yanan Liu, Lei Li

entry.summary: RePCM proposes region-aware and phenotype-adaptive bi-ventricular cardiac motion synthesis from a single end-diastolic frame, addressing oversmoothing in traditional methods by modeling regional and disease-specific differences.

entry.title: Ordering Matters: Rank-Aware Selective Fusion for Blended Emotion Recognition

author.name: Junghyun Lee, Hyunseo Kim, Hanna Jang, Junhyug Noh

entry.summary: Proposes a rank-aware multi-encoder framework for blended emotion recognition that selectively fuses the top-n most informative encoders based on sample-wise importance estimation, with separate heads for presence and salience.

entry.title: ReMATF: Recurrent Motion-Adaptive Multi-scale Turbulence Mitigation for Dynamic Scenes

author.name: Zhiming Liu, Zhicheng Zou, Nantheera Anantrasirichai

entry.summary: ReMATF proposes a lightweight recurrent framework for atmospheric turbulence mitigation that processes only two frames at a time, combining multi-scale encoding with motion-adaptive temporal fusion for real-time deployment.

entry.title: Privacy-Preserving Distributed Optimization Under Time Constraints Using Secure Multi-Party Computation and Evolutionary Algorithms

author.name: Sebastian Gruber, Tobias Harzfeld, Christoph G. Schuetz, Florian Wohner, Thomas Lor\"unser

entry.summary: Presents an approach combining secure multi-party computation with evolutionary algorithms for privacy-preserving distributed optimization under time constraints, reducing privacy overhead impact on runtime.

entry.title: Adaptive Human-Robot Collaboration for Masonry Construction Under Material and Assembly Uncertainty

author.name: Jutang Gao (Princeton University), Arash Adel (Princeton University)

entry.summary: Presents an adaptive human-robot collaborative workflow for masonry construction with a projector for spatial guidance and laser scanning for feedback-driven pose correction, addressing material and assembly uncertainties.

entry.title: Scalable Multi-robot Motion Planning via Hierarchical Subproblem Expansion and Workspace Decomposition Refinement

author.name: Isaac Ngui, Courtney McBeth, James D. Motes, Marco Morales, Nancy M. Amato

entry.summary: Presents a hierarchical workspace decomposition method for multi-robot motion planning that achieves up to an order of magnitude speedup by using discrete search to coordinate robots without composing their full joint configuration space. The approach iteratively refines workspace decompositions to reduce conflicts.

entry.title: MC-Risk: Multi-Component Risk Fields for Risk Identification and Motion Planning

author.name: Maximilian Link, Yingjie Xu, Yingbai Hu, Yinlong Liu

entry.summary: Presents MC-Risk, a multi-component risk field for autonomous driving that composes three interpretable modules: motorized-agent predictions, VRU risk with anisotropic kernels, and HD-map-aware road penalties. Provides early, calibrated risk localization for motion planning.

entry.title: HITL-D: Human In The Loop Diffusion Assisted Shared Control

author.name: Riley Zilka, Sergey Khlynovskiy, Allie Wang, Martin Jagersand

entry.summary: Proposes HITL-D, a shared control framework combining diffusion-based policies with human control for manipulation tasks. Reduces joystick axes needed by providing autonomous orientation updates, lowering mental workload while maintaining user agency.

entry.title: Toward Interoperability of Minimal Programs

author.name: johnswentworth

entry.summary: John Wentworth explores the interoperability of minimal programs in the context of Kolmogorov complexity and Solomonoff induction, examining how different minimal descriptions of data relate to each other.

entry.title: BLINKG: A Benchmark for LLM-Integrated Knowledge Graph Generation

author.name: Carla Castedo, Enrique Iglesias, Manuel Lama, Alberto Bugarin-Diz, Maria-Esther Vidal, David Chaves-Fraga

entry.summary: Introduces BLINKG, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs' ability to assist in Knowledge Graph generation by establishing correspondences between data sources and ontology terms. Addresses the lack of standardized evaluation for LLM-assisted KG construction.

entry.title: Generative Auto-Bidding with Unified Modeling and Exploration

author.name: Mingming Zhang, Feiqing Zhuang, Na Li, Shengjie Sun, Xiaowei Chen, Junxiong Zhu, Fei Xiao, Keping Yang, Lixin Zou, Chenliang Li

entry.summary: Proposes GUIDE, a generative auto-bidding framework for digital advertising that integrates directed exploration with safe fallback mechanisms. Addresses the exploration-safety tradeoff missing from existing generative bidding models.

entry.title: Transforming Constraint Programs to Input for Local Search

author.name: Jo Devriendt, Patrick De Causmaecker, Marc Denecker

entry.summary: Establishes a link between symmetry properties of constraint optimization problems and local search neighborhoods, using this to automatically generate neighborhoods from constraint specifications in the IDP system.

entry.title: Robust Checkpoint Selection for Multimodal LLMs via Agentic Evaluation and Stability-Aware Ranking

author.name: Qinwu Xu, Zhuoheng Li, Jessie Salas

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-stage framework for robust checkpoint selection in multimodal LLMs, combining curated real-world data, structured LLM-based judgment, and progressive refinement through pointwise filtering and pairwise ranking.

entry.title: ExECG: An Explainable AI Framework for ECG models

author.name: Jong-Hwan Jang, Yong-yeon Jo

entry.summary: Presents ExECG, a Python framework providing standardized three-stage pipeline (Wrapper, Explainer, unified interface) for explainable AI on ECG models, improving reproducibility across studies.

entry.title: ShadeBench: A Benchmark Dataset for Building Shade Simulation in Sustainable Society

author.name: Longchao Da, Mithun Shivakoti, Xiangrui Liu, T Pranav Kutralingam, Yezhou Yang, Hua Wei

entry.summary: Presents ShadeBench, a benchmark for urban shade understanding with geographically diverse scenes, temporally varying simulated shade maps, and aligned satellite imagery for studying building shade patterns affecting pedestrian thermal exposure.

entry.title: LER-YOLO: Reliability-Aware Expert Routing for Misaligned RGB-Infrared UAV Detection

author.name: Liming Hou, Yueping Peng, Hexiang Hao, Ji Wang, Xuekai Zhang, Wei Tang, Zecong Ye, Xin Ying, Yubo He

entry.summary: Proposes LER-YOLO for misaligned RGB-infrared UAV detection with reliability-aware sparse mixture-of-experts that assesses local cross-sensor correspondence quality before fusion.

entry.title: Sketch2MinSurf: Vision-Language Guided Generation of Editable Minimal Surfaces from Hand-Drawn Sketches

author.name: Wenda Wang, Anqi Liu, Junqi Yang, Lei He, Luying Wang, Jiachen Lu, Weixin Huang

entry.summary: Presents Sketch2MinSurf, combining vision-language guidance with minimal-surface theory to generate smooth, editable 3D surfaces from hand-drawn sketches with topological consistency via spatial-topological encoding.

entry.title: Enhancing Graph-Based SLAM in GNSS-Denied environments by leveraging leg odometry

Demonstrates that fusing kinematic data with LiDAR dramatically improves localization in geometrically sparse scenes.

entry.title: Time-To-Reach Separation and Safety Filtering for Safe, Fair, and Efficient Multi-Agent Coordination

author.name: Matthew Low, Jasmine Jerry Aloor, Victoria Marie Tuck, Pierluigi Nuzzo, Jason J. Choi

entry.title: Discoverable Agent Knowledge -- A Formal Framework for Agentic KG Affordances (Extended Version)

author.name: Terry R. Payne, Valentina Tamma, Enrico Daga

entry.summary: Proposes a formal framework for making Knowledge Graph affordances discoverable by agents, extending Semantic Web Services concepts (OWL-S, WSMO) to modern KG metadata. Addresses what agents can prove from a KG given their ontological commitments.

entry.title: Agentic GraphRAG: Navigating Unstructured Financial Data with Collaborative AI

author.name: Arthur Capozzi, Dirk Helbing

entry.summary: Presents a collaborative agentic GraphRAG framework for analyzing commercial registry data, building a Neo4j knowledge graph through deterministic ingestion and LLM-based extraction, with modular analytical agents on top.

entry.title: INSIGHTS: Demonstration-Based Summaries of Time Series Predictors

author.name: Bar Eini Porat, Rom Gutman, Uri Shalit, Ofra Amir

entry.summary: Introduces INSIGHTS, a model-agnostic approach for generating global explanations of time series models through informative sample summaries that balance importance and diversity.

entry.title: Aerial Inspection Behaviors via RL-based Quadrotor Control for Under-canopy Forest Environments

author.name: Fausto Mauricio Lagos Suarez, Akshit Saradagi, Vidya Sumathy, Viswa Narayanan Sankaranarayanan, George Nikolakopoulos

entry.summary: Addresses quadrotor control for aerial inspection in under-canopy forest environments using deep RL, combining low-level RPM control with TSP planning and RRT path planning for navigation.

entry.title: Long-term Power Grid Planning via Answer Set Programming

author.name: Antonio Ielo, Francesco Doria, Sandra Castellanos-Paez, Marco Maratea, Francesco Percassi, Mauro Vallati

entry.summary: Applies Answer Set Programming (ASP) to long-term power grid planning, handling complex topological and combinatorial constraints that are difficult to express in traditional planning languages.

entry.title: Robust Subspace-Constrained Quadratic Models for Low-Dimensional Structure Learning

author.name: Zheng Zhai, Xiaohui Li

entry.summary: Proposes robust subspace-constrained quadratic models for learning low-dimensional structure from high-dimensional data, accommodating a broad class of noise distributions beyond Gaussian.

entry.title: Ada2MS: A Hybrid Optimization Algorithm Based on Exponential Mixing of Elementwise and Global Second-Moment Estimates

author.name: Meng Zhu, Quan Xiao, Weidong Min

entry.summary: Proposes Ada2MS, an optimizer that smoothly interpolates between AdamW-like and momentum SGD behavior using exponential mixing of elementwise and global second-moment estimates. Aims to combine AdamW's stability with momentum SGD's better generalization.

entry.title: Tunable MAGMAX: Preference-Aware Model Merging for Continual Learning

author.name: Kei Hiroshima, Kento Uchida, Shinichi Shirakawa

entry.summary: Proposes Tunable MAGMAX for continual learning that enables preference-aware control of task-specific performance through a preference vector controlling model merging parameters.

entry.title: Parallel LLM Reasoning for Bias-Resilient, Robust Conceptual Abstraction

author.name: Aisvarya Adeseye, Jouni Isoaho, Adeyemi Adeseye

entry.summary: Proposes parallel chunk-level processing with evidence-anchored consolidation to reduce cumulative analytical bias and over-generalization when LLMs analyze long documents sequentially.

entry.title: Pseudo-Siamese Network for Planning in Target-Oriented Proactive Dialogues

author.name: Xinyue Kang, Maodong Li, Yibin Zheng, Fang Kong

entry.title: Time-Dependent PDE-Constrained Optimization via Weak-Form Latent Dynamics

entry.title: Musical Attention Transformer: Music Generation Using a Music-Specific Attention Model

author.name: Shinnosuke Taksuka, Hideo Mukai

entry.title: Enhanced Reinforcement Learning-based Process Synthesis via Quantum Computing

entry.summary: Presents quantum RL for process synthesis problems with state encoding algorithms that decouple qubit requirements from problem size, overcoming prior scalability limitations.

entry.title: Neural Negative Binomial Regression for Weekly Seismicity Forecasting: Per-Cell Dispersion Estimation and Tail Risk Assessment

author.name: Alim Igilik

entry.summary: EarthquakeNet provides per-cell overdispersion estimates for seismicity forecasting via neural networks, demonstrating that the standard Poisson assumption is strongly violated in Central Asian seismic data.

entry.title: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework for Efficient Prompt Selection in Microscopy Vision-Language Models

author.name: Abhiram Kandiyana, Ankur Mali, Lawrence O. Hall, Peter R. Mouton, Dmitry Goldgof

entry.summary: Proposes a human-in-the-loop framework for efficient prompt selection in microscopy VLMs, addressing which unlabeled images should be prioritized for expert verification and how many verified exemplars are needed.

entry.title: Pareto-Enhanced Portrait Generation: Vision-Aligned Text Supervision for Alignment, Realism, and Aesthetics

author.name: Yunlong Wang, Jinjin Shi, Wenbin Gao, Xuran Xu, Runyu Shi, Ying Huang

entry.title: STAR-IOD: Scale-decoupled Topology Alignment with Pseudo-label Refinement for Remote Sensing Incremental Object Detection

author.name: Yaoteng Zhang, Qing Zhou, Junyu Gao, Qi Wang

entry.title: JFAA: Technical Report for the EPIC-KITCHENS-100 Action Anticipation Challenge at EgoVis 2026

author.name: Qiaohui Chu, Haoyu Zhang, Yisen Feng, Meng Liu, Weili Guan, Dongmei Jiang, Liqiang Nie

entry.title: A Non-Reference Diffusion-Based Restoration Framework for Landsat 7 ETM+ SLC-off Imagery in Antarctica

author.name: Leyue Tang, Jonathan Louis Bamber, Gang Qiao, Yuanhang Kong

entry.summary: DiffGF proposes a diffusion-based framework for filling scan-line corrector gaps in Landsat 7 ETM+ imagery in Antarctica without reference images, addressing challenges of rapid surface changes in polar environments.

author.name: Dimuthu D. K. Arachchige

entry.summary: Comprehensive review of terrestrial soft mobile robots covering locomotion strategies, actuation methods, modeling approaches, and control systems for wheelless locomotion.

author.name: Yao Fehlis, Benjamin Bengfort, Zhangzhang Si, Vahid Eyorokon, Prema Roman, Patrick Deziel, Devon Slonaker, Steve Veldman, Ben Johnson, Joyce Rigelo, Michael Wharton, Steve Kramer

Describes design decisions around hybrid classification, GPU/CPU separation, async processing, and horizontal scaling.

entry.title: Dimensional Balance Improves Large Scale Spatiotemporal Prediction Performance

author.name: Jing Chen, Shixiang Pan, Yujie Fan, Haocheng Ye, Haitao Xu, Wenqiang Xu

entry.summary: Analyzes spatiotemporal prediction bottlenecks through spatial and temporal entropy measures, finding that larger mismatches correlate with higher prediction uncertainty. Proposes a framework to harmonize spatial and temporal complexity.

entry.title: Adaptive Multi-Scale Goodness Aggregation for Forward-Forward Learning

author.name: Salar Beigzad, Vansh Verma

entry.summary: Proposes AMSGA, extending the Forward-Forward algorithm with multi-scale goodness aggregation, adaptive thresholds, and curriculum-guided hard negative mining. Tests on MNIST/Fashion-MNIST showing improvements over base FF.

entry.title: Towards Family-Grouped Hierarchical Federated Learning on Sub-5KB Models: A Feasibility Study of Privacy-Preserving ECG Monitoring for Ultra-Resource-Constrained Wearables

author.name: Hangyu Wu

entry.summary: Proposes Family-Grouped Hierarchical Federated Learning with a tiny 669-parameter CNN-LSTM for ECG monitoring on ultra-low-power wearables, using family groupings as natural privacy boundaries.

author.name: Federico Melis, Davide Bilardello, Emanuele Prato, Evelyn Turri, Lorenzo Baraldi

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates supervised and self-supervised backbones (DINO, CLIP) as feature extractors for artwork classification and retrieval, finding self-supervised models consistently outperform supervised ones.

author.name: Sumanth Meenan Kanneti, Aryan Shah

entry.summary: Presents multi-strategy compression framework for brain tumor classification including quantization-aware training, knowledge distillation, and post-training quantization for deployment in low-resource settings.

author.name: Meisam Jamshidi Seikavandi, Alice Modica, Anna Obara, Fabricio Batista Narcizo, Tanya Ignatenko, Ted Vucurevich, Jesper B\"unsow Boldt, Paolo Burelli, Andrew Burke Dittberner

entry.summary: Presents AffectAI-Capture, a protocol for collecting synchronized multimodal data (eye tracking, physiology, audio, video) in four-person meeting interactions. Still in pilot validation phase.

entry.summary: Compares three prompt design strategies (raw, checklist-improved, clarifying-question) across four task types and three LLM systems, finding that checklist-improved prompts achieve the highest quality scores while reducing interaction rounds.

author.name: Ipsita Bhar, Huseyin Tuna Erdinc, Thales Souza, Charles Jones, Felix J. Herrmann

entry.summary: Presents OpenSeisML, a collection of real seismic datasets from the UK National Data Repository designed to support generative AI workflows for seismic inversion. Addresses data scarcity in geoscience ML.

entry.title: Robust Recommendation from Noisy Implicit Feedback: A GMM-Weighted Bayes-label Transition Matrix Framework

author.name: Zongyu Li, Xuanyu Liu, Gongce Cao, Shirui Sun, Yaqi Fang, Yongshuai Yu

entry.summary: Proposes RGBT framework for recommender systems that uses GMM-derived reliability scores to calibrate Bayes-label transition matrix estimation, addressing label noise in implicit feedback.

entry.title: Memory-Efficient Partitioned DNN Inference on Resource-Constrained Android Crowds

author.name: Lakshani Manamperi, Disumi Pathirana, Thiwanka Pathirana, Nipun Premarathna, Kutila Gunasekera

entry.summary: Presents CROWDio's DNN pipeline scheduling system for distributing ONNX inference across memory-constrained Android devices using JIT partition loading, affinity scheduling, and compressed tensor transport.

author.name: Xiangyu Yang, Feng Xu, Jian-Qiang Hu, Jiaqiao Hu

entry.summary: Studies nonparametric dynamic pricing with one-point revenue feedback under nonstationarity, developing a learning framework using revenue-based gradient approximations without parametric demand assumptions.

author.name: Vaibhav Chhabra

author.name: Amirhossein Mohammadi, Hina Tabassum

author.name: Arun D. Kulkarni

entry.summary: Compares Vision Transformers and CNN architectures for remote sensing land use scene classification, providing a comparative assessment of their relative strengths for global context vs. local feature capture.

entry.title: Q-SpiRL: Quantum Spiking Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Robot Navigation

author.name: Mohamed Khair Altrabulsi, Nouhaila Innan, Alberto Marchisio, Muhammad Kashif, Muhammad Shafique

entry.summary: Presents Q-SpiRL, a quantum spiking reinforcement learning framework for robot navigation that combines spike-based neural processing with variational quantum circuits. Compares five agent architectures including classical and quantum-enhanced variants across grid-world environments.

entry.title: Comparative Evaluation of Deep Learning Models for Fake Image Detection

author.name: Akhitha Pakala, Mohammed Mahir Rahman, Shahzad Memon, Tauseef Ahmed

entry.summary: Compares VGG16, ResNet50, EfficientNetB0, and XceptionNet for GAN-generated fake image detection, finding VGG16 achieves 91% accuracy. Uses a standard preprocessing pipeline with augmentation.

entry.title: Validating Navmesh using Geometry: Voxel-Based Analysis with Prioritized Exploration

author.name: Ramesh Raghavan, Ojas Sharma, Sebastien Larrue, Alan Isaac Kunder, Aakash Sai, Rishi Mathur

entry.summary: Proposes voxel-based geometric analysis for validating navigation meshes in game environments by directly comparing navmesh geometry against world geometry. Addresses the problem of navmesh-environment mismatches that accumulate during game development.

entry.title: If I Were Emperor of New AI Safety Researcher Training...

author.name: Lorxus

entry.summary: A curated reading/resource list for new AI safety researchers, emphasizing underutilized materials beyond the standard canon (Bostrom, List of Lethalities, etc.). Covers a spectrum from newcomers to established researchers.

entry.title: Decentralized autonomous organization and blockchain-based incentivization framework for community-based facilities management

author.name: Reachsak Ly, Alireza Shojaei, Xinghua Gao, Philip Agee, Abiola Akanmu

entry.summary: Proposes a blockchain and DAO-based framework for community-based facilities management in smart buildings, combining decentralized governance with tokenized incentives for building maintenance.

entry.title: Augmented Analytics and Decision Quality: The Role of Trust among Non-Technical BI Users

author.name: Thuy Pham Thi Phuong, Ha Nguyen Manh, Ngan Nguyen Thi Thuy, Lan Hoang Thi

entry.summary: Survey-based study examining how trust mediates the relationship between augmented analytics and decision quality for non-technical BI users, using cognitive delegation theory.

entry.title: Puzzled By ChatGPT? No more! A Jigsaw Puzzle to Promote AI Literacy and Awareness

author.name: Francesca Padovani, Malvina Nissim

entry.summary: Introduces a jigsaw puzzle game designed to promote AI literacy, where completed pieces form a comic-based infographic explaining LLM capabilities, limitations, and societal implications. Created through collaborative sessions with illustrators and multidisciplinary experts.

entry.title: A Comprehensive Comparison of Deep Learning Architectures for COVID-19 Classification on CT & X-ray Imagery

author.name: Sarmad Khan, Arslan Shaukat, Umer Asgher, Basim Azam

entry.summary: Comprehensive comparison of deep learning architectures for COVID-19 classification on CT and X-ray imagery, evaluating multiple CNN-based models for computer-aided diagnosis.

entry.title: Pixel Wised Lesion Prediction on COVID-19 CT Imagery: A Comparative Analysis of Automated Image Segmentation Architectures

author.name: Sarmad Khan, Arslan Shaukat, Umer Asgher, Basim Azam

entry.summary: Evaluates contemporary segmentation frameworks with pre-trained backbones for COVID-19 lesion prediction in CT images, providing a standardized methodology for performance analysis.

entry.title: Apply now to Human-Aligned AI Summer School 2026

author.name: Anna Gajdova

entry.summary: Announcement for the 6th Human-Aligned AI Summer School in Prague, July 13-16, 2026, covering technical AI alignment topics including revisited risk arguments, scalable oversight, and governance.

entry.title: So you don't want everybody to die

author.name: Rattengift

entry.summary: Advice on effective outreach and communication for AI safety concerns, drawing from observations of petitioners and persuasion tactics. Written from the perspective of someone not particularly worried about x-risk.

entry.title: Advanced Scientific Methodology Plays Rossini

author.name: Silvia Licciardi, Daniela Macchione, Emmanuel Caronna, Elisa Francomano

entry.summary: Applies computational analysis methods (parsing, data mining, graph theory) to analyze melodic, harmonic, and textual structure of Rossini's musical compositions, bridging scientific methodology and music philology.

entry.title: Temporal Proportional Representation

author.name: thomascolthurst

entry.summary: Proposes 'Temporal Proportional Representation' as a voting system that achieves proportionality over time for singleton offices without redrawing districts. Discusses implementation using sortition-informed mechanisms.

entry.title: Pythagorean addition

author.name: kqr

entry.summary: Explains the concept of 'Pythagorean addition' (adding in quadrature) as a mathematical tool, showing its applications in combining independent uncertainties and other contexts.

entry.title: Fundamental Uncertainty $2,000 Essay Contest

author.name: Gordon Seidoh Worley

entry.summary: An essay contest announcement for a book about epistemology and uncertainty, offering $2,000 in prizes for essays engaging with the book's themes.

entry.title: Give my children minds

author.name: momom2

entry.summary: A creative poem/song adaptation expressing hopes and anxieties about AI and the singularity, adapting Kathy Mar's 'Give My Children Wings' to an AI context.

entry.title: Check out my technological uplifting, civilization-building, and science in a magic world fiction!

author.name: Jens Brandt

entry.summary: Self-promotion of a fiction book on Royal Road about technological uplift and civilization building in a fantasy setting.

entry.title: Research Summary: May 20, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research centers on challenging training orthodoxies and improving systems efficiency. A Bitter Lesson for Data Filtering (Stanford) finds that sufficient compute eliminates the need for data filtering in data-scarce regimes. CODA from Tri Dao's team fuses transformer operators into GEMM epilogue programs, eliminating memory-bandwidth bottlenecks.

  • optimize_anything (Berkeley/Stanford) introduces a universal API treating all optimization as improving text artifacts scored by functions
  • ScheduleFree+ achieves 31% improvement over SOTA training schedules without learning rate tuning
  • Controlled 10T-token experiments show code improves reasoning only via structured signals, not code execution itself
  • Toto 2.0 demonstrates reliable scaling from 4M to 2.5B parameters for time series foundation models

In safety and interpretability, Agent Meltdowns identifies a novel failure mode where agents behave unsafely from benign environmental errors. Lying Is Just a Phase reveals a phase transition at ~3.5B parameters where reasoning and truthfulness decouple. The Silent Hyperparameter shows inference backend differences introduce noise rivaling state-of-the-art benchmark improvements, threatening reproducibility across the field.
entry.content:
Today's research centers on challenging training orthodoxies and improving systems efficiency. A Bitter Lesson for Data Filtering (Stanford) finds that sufficient compute eliminates the need for data filtering in data-scarce regimes. CODA from Tri Dao's team fuses transformer operators into GEMM epilogue programs, eliminating memory-bandwidth bottlenecks.

  • optimize_anything (Berkeley/Stanford) introduces a universal API treating all optimization as improving text artifacts scored by functions
  • ScheduleFree+ achieves 31% improvement over SOTA training schedules without learning rate tuning
  • Controlled 10T-token experiments show code improves reasoning only via structured signals, not code execution itself
  • Toto 2.0 demonstrates reliable scaling from 4M to 2.5B parameters for time series foundation models

In safety and interpretability, Agent Meltdowns identifies a novel failure mode where agents behave unsafely from benign environmental errors. Lying Is Just a Phase reveals a phase transition at ~3.5B parameters where reasoning and truthfulness decouple. The Silent Hyperparameter shows inference backend differences introduce noise rivaling state-of-the-art benchmark improvements, threatening reproducibility across the field.

entry.title: A Bitter Lesson for Data Filtering

author.name: Christopher Mohri, John Duchi, Tatsunori Hashimoto

entry.summary: Presents scaling studies showing that with sufficient compute in data-scarce regimes, the best data filter is no data filter—large models benefit from nominally 'poor' data. This challenges the common belief that aggressive data filtering is essential for pretraining.

entry.title: optimize_anything: A Universal API for Optimizing any Text Parameter

author.name: Lakshya A Agrawal, Donghyun Lee, Shangyin Tan, Wenjie Ma, Karim Elmaaroufi, Rohit Sandadi, Sanjit A. Seshia, Koushik Sen, Dan Klein, Ion Stoica, Joseph E. Gonzalez, Omar Khattab, Alexandros G. Dimakis, Matei Zaharia

entry.summary: Introduces optimize_anything, a universal API that formulates optimization as improving text artifacts scored by functions. Achieves strong results across diverse tasks including nearly tripling Gemini Flash's ARC-AGI accuracy and outperforming AlphaEvolve on circle packing.

entry.title: Toto 2.0: Time Series Forecasting Enters the Scaling Era

author.name: Emaad Khwaja, Chris Lettieri, Gerald Woo, Eden Belouadah, Marc Cenac, Guillaume Jarry, Enguerrand Paquin, Xunyi Zhao, Viktoriya Zhukov, Othmane Abou-Amal, Chenghao Liu, Ameet Talwalkar, David Asker

entry.summary: Demonstrates that time series foundation models scale reliably from 4M to 2.5B parameters with a single training recipe. Releases Toto 2.0, a family of five open-weights forecasting models achieving SOTA on three major benchmarks (BOOM, GIFT-Eval, TIME).

entry.title: How Far Are We From True Auto-Research?

author.name: Zhengxin Zhang, Ning Wang, Sainyam Galhotra, Claire Cardie

entry.summary: Introduces ResearchArena, a framework letting off-the-shelf AI agents (Claude Code/Opus 4.6, Codex/GPT-5.4, Kimi Code/K2.5) perform complete research loops. Evaluates 117 agent-generated papers across 13 CS domains with three complementary review lenses.

entry.title: What Really Improves Mathematical Reasoning: Structured Reasoning Signals Beyond Pure Code

author.name: Yuze Zhao, Junpeng Fang, Lu Yu, Zhenya Huang, Kai Zhang, Qing Cui, Qi Liu, Jun Zhou, Enhong Chen

entry.summary: Challenges the claim that code improves LLM reasoning through controlled 10T-token pretraining experiments. Finds reasoning gains come from structured reasoning traces (code-text interleavings) rather than executable programs alone.

entry.title: Features have life history. And we should care

author.name: Philipp Stecher, Sandro Radovanovi\'c, Vlasta Sikimi\'c, Reinhard Kahle

entry.summary: Identifies a 'carrier scaffold' of ~50 sparse features with stable life histories in Pythia models that form a persistent representational backbone. Shows these features assemble early in training and are load-bearing for model function.

entry.title: ScheduleFree+: Scaling Learning-Rate-Free & Schedule-Free Learning to Large Language Models

author.name: Aaron Defazio

entry.summary: Presents ScheduleFree+, a learning-rate-free and schedule-free method for training large language models. Shows 31% improvement over SOTA schedules at 1000 tokens per parameter, greatly outperforming Warmup-Stable-Decay schedules.

entry.title: ThoughtTrace: Understanding User Thoughts in Real-World LLM Interactions

author.name: Chuanyang Jin, Binze Li, Haopeng Xie, Cathy Mengying Fang, Tianjian Li, Shayne Longpre, Hongxiang Gu, Maximillian Chen, Tianmin Shu

entry.summary: Presents ThoughtTrace, the first large-scale dataset pairing real-world multi-turn human-AI conversations with users' self-reported thoughts (reasons for prompts and reactions to responses). Covers 1,058 users, 2,155 conversations across 20 language models.

entry.title: CODA: Rewriting Transformer Blocks as GEMM-Epilogue Programs

author.name: Han Guo, Jack Zhang, Arjun Menon, Driss Guessous, Vijay Thakkar, Yoon Kim, Tri Dao

entry.summary: Introduces CODA, a GPU kernel abstraction that fuses transformer operators (normalization, activations, residuals) into GEMM epilogue programs, eliminating memory-bound overhead by executing while GEMM output tiles remain on-chip.

entry.title: The Silent Hyperparameter: Quantifying the Impact of Inference Backends on LLM Reproducibility

author.name: David Pape, Jonathan Evertz, Lea Sch\"onherr

entry.summary: Systematically quantifies how different inference backends (CUDA kernels, reduced precision) affect LLM benchmark reproducibility. Surveys 200 inference engines and analyzes 35,000 ML publications, finding that backend choice is rarely reported yet can meaningfully alter results.

entry.title: Agent Meltdowns: The Road to Hell Is Paved with Helpful Agents

author.name: Rishi Jha, Harold Triedman, Arkaprabha Bhattacharya, Vitaly Shmatikov

entry.summary: Introduces 'accidental meltdowns' - a new failure mode where AI agents exhibit unsafe behavior in response to benign environmental errors without any adversarial input. Develops taxonomy and measurement infrastructure for this previously uncharacterized failure type.

entry.title: Lying Is Just a Phase: The Hidden Alignment Transition in Language Model Scaling

author.name: Adil Amin

entry.summary: Measures coupling between reasoning and truthfulness across 63 base models from 16 families, finding a phase transition: below ~3.5B parameters capabilities anticorrelate, above they cooperate. Architecture and data curation shift the critical scale.

entry.title: Base Models Look Human To AI Detectors

author.name: Yixuan Even Xu, Ziqian Zhong, Aditi Raghunathan, Fei Fang, J. Zico Kolter

entry.summary: Discovers that base (non-instruction-tuned) LLMs generate text that commercial AI detectors classify as human-written. Proposes HIP, a pipeline that fine-tunes a base model into a paraphraser to evade detectors while preserving semantics.

entry.title: Generative Recursive Reasoning

author.name: Junyeob Baek, Mingyu Jo, Minsu Kim, Mengye Ren, Yoshua Bengio, Sungjin Ahn

entry.summary: Introduces GRAM (Generative Recursive Reasoning Models), which adds probabilistic multi-trajectory computation to recursive latent reasoning. Enables multiple hypotheses and inference-time scaling through both depth and parallel sampling.

entry.title: Agent Security is a Systems Problem

author.name: Mihai Christodorescu, Earlence Fernandes, Ashish Hooda, Somesh Jha, Johann Rehberger, Kamalika Chaudhuri, Xiaohan Fu, Khawaja Shams, Guy Amir, Jihye Choi, Sarthak Choudhary, Nils Palumbo, Andrey Labunets, Nishit V. Pandya

entry.summary: Argues that agent security must be treated as a systems problem where the AI model is an untrusted component, with security invariants enforced at the system level. Draws on decades of systems security principles for agentic AI design.

entry.title: A Measure-Theoretic Analysis of Reasoning: Structural Generalization and Approximation Limits

author.name: Yuyang Zhang, Yifu Zhang, Xuehai Zhou, Xiaoyin Chen

entry.summary: Formalizes LLM reasoning via optimal transport, bounding OOD generalization through architectural Lipschitz continuity. Shows that positional encoding choices (absolute vs. rotary) fundamentally determine generalization properties.

entry.title: DynaTrain: Fast Online Parallelism Switching for Elastic LLM Training

author.name: Yuanqing Wang, Yuchen Zhang, Hao Lin, Junhao Hu, Chunyang Zhu, Quanlu Zhang, Boxun Li, Guohao Dai, Zhi Yang, Daning Cheng, Yunquan Zhang, Yu Wang

entry.summary: Presents DynaTrain, a distributed training system enabling sub-second online reconfiguration across arbitrary multi-dimensional parallelism for LLM training, using a Virtual Parameter Space abstraction that unifies all distributed training states.

entry.title: CEPO: RLVR Self-Distillation using Contrastive Evidence Policy Optimization

author.name: Ahmed Heakl, Abdelrahman M. Shaker, Youssef Mohamed, Rania Elbadry, Omar Fetouh, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Salman Khan

entry.summary: Introduces CEPO, a method for better credit assignment in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) by asking at each token whether the correct answer changes what the model would generate.
