Addresses the fundamental problem that standard RLVR gives equal reward signal to decisive reasoning steps and filler tokens.

entry.title: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Routing in Visual Diffusion Transformers:Diagnosis, Boundary Calibration and Evolutionary Roadmap from Routing Collapse to Selective Deadlock

author.name: Haiying Sha

entry.summary: Systematically diagnoses five failure modes of sparse Mixture-of-Experts routing in video Diffusion Transformers, from soft saturation to selective deadlock. Provides detailed analysis of a ~5B parameter model conversion from dense to MoE, identifying hierarchy of training instabilities.

entry.title: Mechanisms of Object Localization in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Timothy Schauml\"offel, Martina G. Vilas, Gemma Roig

entry.summary: Investigates mechanisms of object localization in vision-language models using mechanistic interpretability tools. Discovers a 'containerization' mechanism where object-aligned tokens define spatial extent while semantic arrangement within boundaries is largely ignored.

entry.title: Beyond Mode Collapse: Distribution Matching for Diverse Reasoning

author.name: Xiaozhe Li, Yang Li, Xinyu Fang, Shengyuan Ding, Peiji Li, Yongkang Chen, Yichuan Ma, Tianyi Lyu, Linyang Li, Dahua Lin, Qipeng Guo, Qingwen Liu, Kai Chen

entry.summary: Proposes DMPO (Distribution-Matching Policy Optimization) that prevents mode collapse in GRPO-style RL by approximating forward KL minimization. Constructs group-level target distributions proportional to rewards and aligns policy to them.

entry.title: Block-Based Double Decoders

author.name: Asher Labovich, Benjamin Bradley, Vanessa Alexander, Chaitanya Harsha

entry.summary: Proposes block-based double decoders, a novel transformer architecture using doubly-causal block attention masks to combine decoder-only training efficiency with encoder-decoder inference efficiency. Cuts KV-cache by at least 2/3.

entry.title: Position: Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs is Just Unsupervised Clustering

author.name: Tiejin Chen, Longchao Da, Xiaoou Liu, Hua Wei

entry.summary: Argues that mainstream uncertainty quantification methods for LLMs are fundamentally just unsupervised clustering algorithms that measure internal consistency rather than external correctness, making them blind to confident hallucinations.

entry.title: When the Majority Votes Wrong, the Intervention Timing for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning Hides in the Extinction Window

author.name: Hongxiang Lin, Zhirui Kuai, Erpeng Xue, Lei Wang

entry.summary: Critiques test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL), arguing that reported gains mostly reflect sharpening of already-solvable problems rather than genuine learning. Identifies a 'Correct-Answer Extinction Window' where correct signals are briefly available before being permanently suppressed.

entry.title: LionMuon: Alternating Spectral and Sign Descent for Efficient Training

author.name: Arman Bolatov, Artem Riabinin, Nikita Kornilov, Andrey Veprikov, Samuel Horv\'ath, Martin Tak\'a\v{c}, Aleksandr Beznosikov

entry.summary: Proposes LionMuon, an optimizer that alternates between cheap Lion (sign-based) and powerful Muon (spectral) updates, matching Muon's effectiveness at much lower average per-step cost. Uses half the optimizer state memory of AdamW while sharing a single dual-EMA momentum buffer.

entry.title: SWEET: Sparse World Modeling with Image Editing for Embodied Task Execution

author.name: Yiren Song, Yihan Wang, Xiyao Deng, Zhuoran Yan, Mike Zheng Shou

entry.summary: Studies whether image editing models can serve as sparse visual world models for robot manipulation, predicting task-level future states without dense video generation. Compares video generation (Wan2.2) vs image editing (FLUX-Kontext) and finds editing produces more reliable predictions. Proposes SWEET framework for embodied task execution.

entry.title: Thinking in Scales: Accelerating Gigapixel Pathology Image Analysis via Adaptive Continuous Reasoning

author.name: Jiusong Ge, Yingkang Zhan, Wenjie Zhao, Di Zhang, Ke Wang, Jiashuai Liu, Chunze Yang, Chengzu Li, Jian Zhang, Yuxin Dong, Ni Zhang, Qidong Liu, Mireia Crispin-Ortuzar, Huazhu Fu, Chen Li, Zeyu Gao

entry.summary: Proposes PathCTM for efficient gigapixel pathology image analysis using continuous thought reasoning that adaptively transitions from low to high magnification. Formulates diagnostic inference as dynamic sequential information pursuit, avoiding exhaustive patch processing.

entry.title: Causal Evidence for Attention Head Imbalance in Modality Conflict Hallucination

author.name: Jinrui Jiang, Zhangtai Wu, Zhen Wu, Xinyu Dai

entry.summary: Provides causal evidence that modality-conflict hallucination in MLLMs stems from asymmetric attention heads: hallucination-driving heads are broadly distributed while resisting heads are concentrated. Uses path patching across five MLLMs.

entry.title: The Routing and Filtering Structure of Attention

author.name: Shafayeth Jamil, Rehan Kapadia

entry.summary: Decomposes the attention QK^T matrix into symmetric (filtering) and skew-symmetric (routing) components across 1776 heads in five transformers. Finds routing operates at low rank and proposes S-D attention as a diagnostic parameterization.

entry.title: Measuring Safety Alignment Effects in Autonomous Security Agents

author.name: Isaac David, Arthur Gervais

entry.summary: Benchmarks safety-aligned vs uncensored/abliterated LLMs as autonomous security agents on 30 vulnerability analysis tasks. Finds that safety alignment effects vary significantly between model families, with Gemma showing largest differences.

entry.title: Lossless Anti-Distillation Sampling

author.name: Zibo Diao, Jingchu Gai, Xinyue Ai, Zhang Zhang, Zhenyu He, Di He

entry.summary: Proposes Lossless Anti-Distillation Sampling (LADS), a sampling scheme that counters multi-account model distillation attacks while maintaining lossless response quality for benign users, using private seeds tied to generation randomness.

entry.title: When Does Model Collapse Occur in Structured Interactive Learning?

author.name: Yuchen Wu, Kangjie Zhou, Weijie Su

entry.summary: Provides theoretical framework for understanding when model collapse occurs in interactive learning environments where models train on each other's synthetic outputs. Studies structured interactions where multiple models are interconnected in complex topologies.

entry.title: FlowErase-RL: Rethinking Concept Erasure as Reward Optimization in Flow Matching Models

author.name: Yi Sun, Zhiqi Zhang, Xinhao Zhong, Yimin Zhou, Shuoyang Sun, Bin Chen, Shu-Tao Xia, Ke Xu

entry.summary: Proposes FlowErase-RL, the first GRPO-based framework for concept erasure in flow matching models. Reformulates concept erasure as reward optimization with dynamic dual-path reward for both suppressing unwanted concepts and preserving generation quality.

entry.title: A Nash Equilibrium Framework For Training-Free Multimodal Step Verification

author.name: Rohit Sinha, Kunal Tilaganji, Tanuja Ganu, Nagarajan Natarajan, Amit Sharma, Vineeth N. Balasubramanian

entry.summary: Proposes a Nash equilibrium framework for training-free multimodal step verification. Treats step-wise verification as a coordination problem among specialized judges, where disagreement carries information about step validity.

entry.title: Hallucination as Exploit: Evidence-Carrying Multimodal Agents

author.name: Guijia Zhang, Hao Zheng, Harry Yang

entry.summary: Formalizes 'hallucination-to-action conversion' as a security failure mode in multimodal agents and proposes Evidence-Carrying Agents (ECA) that require typed certificates from constrained verifiers before executing privileged actions.

entry.title: Can LLMs Emulate Human Belief Dynamics?

author.name: Adiba Mahbub Proma, Neeley Pate, James N. Druckman, Gourab Ghoshal, Hangfeng He, Ehsan Hoque

entry.summary: Tests whether LLMs can simulate human belief dynamics in social networks by replicating established studies across 12 models. Finds LLMs systematically fail: they are more conformist than humans and cannot capture initial belief distributions.

entry.title: KVBuffer: IO-aware Serving for Linear Attention

author.name: Longwei Zou, Lin Zhong

entry.summary: Proposes KVBuffer, an IO-aware serving mechanism for linear attention models that buffers recent keys and values to avoid expensive recurrent state updates. Significantly improves throughput for long-context inference.

entry.title: When to Stop Reusing: Dynamic Gradient Gating for Sample-Efficient RLVR

author.name: Yuchun Miao, Sen Zhang, Yuqi Zhang, Yaorui Shi, Qi Gu, Xunliang Cai, Lefei Zhang

entry.summary: Identifies the 'Disproportionate Weight Divergence' phenomenon in RLVR where performance degradation correlates with sharp changes in the lm_head weights. Proposes dynamic gradient gating to know when to stop reusing rollout batches for multiple gradient updates.

entry.title: LLM Benchmark Datasets Should Be Contamination-Resistant

author.name: Ali Al-Lawati, Jason Lucas, Dongwon Lee, Suhang Wang

entry.summary: Argues that LLM benchmark datasets should be contamination-resistant (unlearnable during training but supporting inference), exploiting the asymmetry between training and inference pipelines in Transformers.

entry.title: What Do Evolutionary Coding Agents Evolve?

author.name: Nico Pelleriti, Sree Harsha Nelaturu, Zhanke Zhou, Zongze Li, Max Zimmer, Bo Han, Sebastian Pokutta

entry.summary: Introduces EvoTrace, a dataset for analyzing what evolutionary coding agents (LLMs paired with evolutionary search) actually evolve - whether progress comes from new algorithmic structure, re-tuning, recombination, or overfitting. This addresses a fundamental gap in understanding LLM-driven code evolution systems.

entry.title: Not All Tokens Are Worth Caching: Learning Semantic-Aware Eviction for LLM Prefix Caches

author.name: Shaoke Fang, Ziang Li, Wenfei Wu, Jiatong Ji, Qingsong Liu, Ruizhi Pu

entry.summary: Proposes SAECache, a semantic-aware eviction policy for LLM prefix caching that exploits the finding that different token types (system prompts, user queries, etc.) exhibit up to 756x variation in reuse rates.

entry.title: Rethinking Muon Beyond Pretraining: Spectral Failures and High-Pass Remedies for VLA and RLVR

author.name: Chongyu Fan, Gaowen Liu, Mingyi Hong, Ramana Rao Kompella, Sijia Liu

entry.summary: Identifies fundamental limitations of the Muon optimizer beyond pretraining (in VLA training and RLVR), where uniform spectral whitening amplifies noisy tail directions or disrupts per-head specialization. Proposes high-pass filtering remedies.

entry.title: OScaR: The Occam's Razor for Extreme KV Cache Quantization in LLMs and Beyond

author.name: Zunhai Su, Rui Yang, Chao Zhang, Yaxiu Liu, Yifan Zhang, Wei Wu, Jing Xiong, Dayou Du, Xialie Zhuang, Yulei Qian, Yuchen Xie, Yik-Chung Wu, Hongxia Yang, Ngai Wong

entry.summary: Introduces OScaR for extreme KV cache quantization in LLMs, identifying Token Norm Imbalance (TNI) as the primary bottleneck for per-channel quantization at high compression rates. Proposes a simple solution following Occam's Razor principles to address TNI.

entry.title: From Seeing to Thinking: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning Improves Post-Training of Vision-Language Models

author.name: Juncheng Wu, Hardy Chen, Haoqin Tu, Xianfeng Tang, Freda Shi, Hui Liu, Hanqing Lu, Cihang Xie, Yuyin Zhou

entry.summary: Systematically studies decoupling perception and reasoning in VLM post-training, showing that visual perception requires targeted optimization, should be trained before reasoning, and is more effectively trained with supervised learning.

entry.title: What Makes Synthetic Data Effective in Image Segmentation

author.name: Jinjin Zhang, Xiefan Guo, Yizhou Jin, Nan Zhou, Di Huang

entry.summary: Conducts systematic analysis of what makes synthetic images from diffusion models effective for training segmentation models. Finds that dense scene composition and fine instance fidelity are key factors. Proposes SENSE framework for leveraging these insights to generate better training data.

entry.title: Vision Harnessing Agent for Open Ad-hoc Segmentation

author.name: Zilin Wang, Stella X. Yu

entry.summary: Proposes VASA, a training-free vision-guided agent for open ad-hoc segmentation that couples a VLM agent with a segmentation foundation model. Uses a persistent working mask to reason about complex segmentation concepts through parts, relations, and exclusions.

entry.title: TideGS: Scalable Training of Over One Billion 3D Gaussian Splatting Primitives via Out-of-Core Optimization

author.name: Chonghao Zhong, Linfeng Shi, Hua Chen, Tiecheng Sun, Hao Zhao, Binhang Yuan, Chaojian Li

entry.summary: TideGS introduces an out-of-core training framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting that enables training over one billion primitives on a single GPU by managing parameters across an SSD-CPU-GPU hierarchy. The key insight is that 3DGS training is inherently sparse—only Gaussians visible from current camera views need to be in GPU memory at any time.

entry.title: Sealing Conditional Misalignment in Inoculation Prompting with Consistency Training

author.name: David Africa

entry.summary: Shows that consistency training (BCT) can 'seal' the backdoor vulnerability introduced by inoculation prompting, reducing conditional misalignment as a cheap training intervention. Demonstrates composability of alignment methods.

entry.title: Benchmarking and Evolving Reason-Reflect-Rectify for Reflective Visual Generation

author.name: Junjie Wang, Xinghua Lou, Jason Li, Ye Tian, Keyu Chen, Yulin Li, Bin Kang, Jacky Mai, Yanwei Li, Zhuotao Tian, Liqiang Nie

entry.summary: Formalizes Reason-Reflect-Rectify (R³) loop for reflective visual generation and introduces R³-Bench with 600+ expert-annotated instances. Reveals that models can identify errors but fail to generate actionable rectification instructions. Proposes R³-Refiner.

entry.title: Not all uncertainty is alike: volatility, stochasticity, and exploration

author.name: Payam Piray

entry.summary: Proves that volatility and stochasticity drive optimal exploration in opposite directions despite both increasing uncertainty. Extends Gittins index framework to Gaussian state-space bandits with formal results.

entry.title: Emergence of Frontier Superposition: M\"obius attractor and Cascade Supervision

author.name: Hongyu Gu, Jingwen Fu

entry.summary: Proves that gradient descent can find superposition representations in Transformers for graph reachability by identifying a Möbius attractor in the training dynamics. Shows cascade supervision helps escape saddle points.

entry.title: OEP: Poisoning Self-Evolving LLM Agents via Locally Correct but Non-Transferable Experiences

author.name: Kaixiang Wang, Jiong Lou, Zhaojiacheng Zhou, Jie Li

entry.summary: Introduces Obsessive Experience Poisoning (OEP), a subtle attack on memory-augmented LLM agents that generates locally correct but non-transferable experiences, causing harmful generalization during agent self-reflection.

entry.title: Going PLACES: Participatory Localized Red Teaming for Text-to-Image Safety in the Global South

author.name: Charvi Rastogi, Mukul Bhutani, Minsuk Kahng, Shamsuddeen Hassan Muhammad, Evgeniia Razumovskaia, Priyanka Suresh, Ibrahim Said Ahmad, Charu Kalia, Yaaseen Mahomed, Madhurima Maji, Minjae Lee, Alicia Parrish, Jessica Quaye, Vijay Janapa Reddi, Aishwarya Verma, Lora Aroyo

entry.summary: Conducts localized red teaming of T2I models in the Global South, producing PLACES dataset of 26,000+ model failures collected from communities in Ghana, Nigeria, India, and other regions. Reveals Western-centric safety calibration gaps.

entry.title: Detecting Fluent Optimization-Based Adversarial Prompts via Sequential Entropy Changes

author.name: Mohammed Alshaalan, Miguel R. D. Rodrigues

entry.summary: Casts adversarial suffix detection as online change-point detection over token-level entropy streams. The resulting CPD detector is model-agnostic, training-free, and localizes attack onset.

entry.title: CopT: Contrastive On-Policy Thinking with Continuous Spaces for General and Agentic Reasoning

author.name: Dachuan Shi, Hanlin Zhu, Xiangchi Yuan, Wanjia Zhao, Kejing Xia, Wen Xiao, Wenke Lee

entry.summary: Introduces CopT, which reverses the standard CoT paradigm by first generating a draft answer then invoking on-policy thinking for reflection. Uses continuous latent spaces and contrastive training to determine when thinking is needed.

entry.title: Multi-Token Residual Prediction

author.name: Yufeng Xu, Zishuo Bao, Qian Wang, Zeshen Zhang, Haoqi Zhang, Bowen Peng, Ang Li, Rahul Chalamala, Yucheng Lu

entry.summary: Introduces Multi-token Residual Prediction (MRP) for diffusion language models, a lightweight module that predicts residuals between adjacent denoising steps to enable dependency-aware multi-token denoising without quality degradation.

entry.title: Mapping Uncharted Symmetries: Machine Discovery in Combinatorics

author.name: Eugenio Cainelli, Lorenzo Luccioli, Alessandro Iraci, Michele D'Adderio, Giovanni Paolini

entry.summary: Shows machine learning can contribute to verifiable mathematical discoveries in algebraic combinatorics, introducing MapSeek-Functional and MapSeek-Symbolic methods and discovering a new combinatorial interpretation of q,t-Narayana polynomials.

entry.title: Fine-Tuning Without Forgetting via Loss-Adaptive Learning Rates

author.name: Parjanya Prajakta Prashant, Jiongli Zhu, Aldan Creo, Babak Salimi

entry.summary: Identifies that per-step forgetting during LLM fine-tuning is bounded by the product of learning rate and square root of training loss. Proposes loss-adaptive learning rates that automatically reduce learning rates on high-loss batches to prevent catastrophic forgetting.

entry.title: Tweedie's Formulae and Diffusion Generative Models Beyond Gaussian

author.name: Wenpin Tang, Nizar Touzi, Zikun Zhang, Xun Yu Zhou

entry.summary: Extends Tweedie's formula to non-Gaussian diffusion processes including geometric Brownian motion, squared Bessel processes, and Cox-Ingersoll-Ross processes. Enables score-based generative modeling beyond Gaussian perturbation.

entry.title: TextAlign: Preference Alignment for Text Rendering with Hierarchical Rewards

author.name: Mingxuan Cui, Jingpu Yang, Fengxian Ji, Qian Jiang, Zhecheng Shi, Jiaming Wang, Zirui Song, Fajri Koto, Xiuying Chen

entry.summary: Proposes TextAlign, a non-invasive framework that treats faithful text rendering in images as a post-training preference alignment problem. Uses hierarchical VLM-based rewards decomposing errors into global, word, and glyph levels. Architecture-agnostic approach that can work across different foundation models.

entry.title: Cross-View Splatter: Feed-Forward View Synthesis with Georeferenced Images

author.name: Matias Turkulainen, Akshay Krishnan, Filippo Aleotti, Mohamed Sayed, Guillermo Garcia-Hernando, Juho Kannala, Arno Solin, Gabriel Brostow, Daniyar Turmukhambetov

entry.summary: Presents Cross-View Splatter, a feed-forward method that fuses ground-level photos with satellite imagery to predict Gaussian splats for outdoor scene reconstruction. Aligns bird's-eye and ground feature representations in a unified 3D coordinate frame.

entry.title: We Need to Get Serious about Uplift Studies

author.name: frmsaul

entry.summary: Argues for better 'uplift studies' measuring how much AI accelerates human work, proposing four types of cyborg experiments and noting current methods struggle to measure whether AI provides uplift at all due to difficulty of time estimation.

entry.title: Towards Camera-Robust 3D Localization: Equation-Anchored Tool-Use for MLLMs

author.name: Xueying Jiang, Wenhao Li, Quanhao Qian, Deli Zhao, Shijian Lu, Gongjie Zhang, Ran Xu

entry.summary: Proposes an equation-anchored tool-use framework for camera-robust 3D localization in MLLMs. Addresses camera intrinsic ambiguity by deterministically propagating camera parameters into predictions through formula variables rather than treating them as hints.

entry.title: Efficient Long-Context Modeling in Diffusion Language Models via Block Approximate Sparse Attention

author.name: Wenhu Zhang, Yiming Wu, Huanyu Wang, Yaoyang Liu, Huanzhang Dou, Senqiao Yang, Sitong Wu, Hanbin Zhao, Jiaya Jia

entry.summary: Proposes BA-Att, a block approximate sparse attention framework for efficient long-context diffusion language models. Identifies informative regions in compact downsampled space rather than relying on fixed positional priors.

entry.title: Depth2Pose: A Pose-Based Benchmark for Monocular Depth Estimation without Ground-Truth Depth

author.name: Viktor Kocur, Sithu Aung, Gabrielle Flood, Yaqing Ding, Lukas Bujnak, Torsten Sattler, Zuzana Kukelova

entry.summary: Proposes Depth2Pose, a framework for evaluating monocular depth estimators via downstream relative camera pose estimation accuracy rather than standard depth metrics. Shows standard metrics may not reflect utility for geometric downstream tasks.

entry.title: Evaluating the Utility of Personal Health Records in Personalized Health AI

author.name: Rory Sayres, Kejia Chen, Ayush Jain, Matthew Thompson, Jonathan Richina, Xiang Yin, Jimmy Hu, Fan Zhang, Bob Lou, Mike Sanchez, Ines Mezerreg, Meredith Schreier, Hamsa Subramaniam, I-Ching Lee, Yugang Jia, Daniel Mcduff, Yossi Matias, Avinatan Hassidim, Dale Webster, Yun Liu, Jackie Barr, Quang Duong

entry.summary: Google-affiliated study evaluating whether LLMs (Gemini 3.0 Flash) can provide better health answers when given access to Personal Health Records. Tests across 2,257 queries matched with de-identified PHRs, comparing responses with and without clinical context.

entry.title: From SGD to Muon: Adaptive Optimization via Schatten-p Norms

author.name: Thomas Massena (IRIT, DTIPG - SNCF, UT3), Corentin Friedrich (IRIT), Mathieu Serrurier (IRIT)

entry.summary: Introduces a data-driven criterion for dynamically choosing optimal update geometries (interpolating from SGD to Muon) per layer based on gradient statistics. Derives the criterion from a random feature regression surrogate.

entry.title: ReCrit: Transition-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Scientific Critic Reasoning

author.name: Wanghan Xu, Yuhao Zhou, Hengyuan Zhao, Shuo Li, Dianzhi Yu, Zhenfei Yin, Yaowen Hu, Fengli Xu, Wanli Ouyang, Wenlong Zhang, Lei Bai

entry.summary: Introduces ReCrit, a reinforcement learning framework that addresses LLM sycophancy by framing critic interaction as correctness-transition problem. Decomposes responses into four quadrants: Correction, Sycophancy, Robustness, and Boundary.

entry.title: The Growing Pains of Frontier Models: When Leaderboards Stop Separating and What to Measure Next

author.name: Adil Amin

entry.summary: Analyzes 34 frontier models from 10 labs (2024-2026) to show that as models approach ceiling on SWE-bench and GPQA, the coupling between capabilities and per-release emphasis patterns become more informative than absolute scores.

entry.title: First-Passage Prediction of Grokking Delay: ACalibrated Law under AdamW with Causal Validation

author.name: Truong Xuan Khanh, Truong Quynh Hoa, Luu Duc Trung, Phan Thanh Duc

entry.summary: Derives the first quantitative prediction of grokking delay under AdamW as a first-passage time, with a closed-form law relating delay to parameter norm, weight decay, and learning rate. Validates on 26+ held-out runs.

entry.title: Exact Linear Attention

author.name: Weinuo Ou

entry.summary: Proposes Exact Linear Attention (ELA) achieving linear complexity through exact kernel decomposition without approximation error. Addresses gradient explosion and token attention dilution with constrained kernels and introduces Hyper Link structure.

entry.title: DMN: A Compositional Framework for Jailbreaking Multimodal LLMs with Multi-Image Inputs

author.name: Wenzhuo Xu, Zhipeng Wei, Zonghao Ying, Deyue Zhang, Dongdong Yang, Xiangzheng Zhang, Quanchen Zou

entry.summary: Proposes DMN, a compositional jailbreak framework for multimodal LLMs that exploits multi-image inputs by distributing harmful requests across images, providing multimodal evidence, and using number chain tasks as distraction.

entry.title: Flash PD-SSM: Memory-Optimized Structured Sparse State-Space Models

author.name: Aleksandar Terzi\'c, Francesco Carzaniga, Nicolas Menet, Yannick Biehl, Michael Hersche, Thomas Hofmann, Abbas Rahimi

entry.summary: Proposes Flash PD-SSM, a structured sparse state-space model achieving comparable throughput to efficient structured SSMs while maintaining better expressivity for modeling finite-state automata transitions.

entry.title: Token by Token, Compromised: Backdoor Vulnerabilities in Unified Autoregressive Models

author.name: Tobias Braun, Jonas Henry Grebe, Hossein Shakibania, Anna Rohrbach, Marcus Rohrbach

entry.summary: First to demonstrate multimodal backdoor attacks on unified autoregressive models (UAMs) where triggers propagate across text and image modalities. Presents ToBAC attack showing common words can serve as backdoor triggers.

entry.title: Backtracking When It Strays: Mitigating Dual Exposure Biases in LLM Reasoning Distillation

author.name: Bing Wang, Shaotian Yan, Chen Shen, kaiyuan liu, Sinan Fan, Ximing Li, Rui Miao, Xiaosong Yuan, Zhanming Shen, Jieping Ye

entry.summary: Addresses dual exposure biases in LLM reasoning distillation—off-policy methods suffer from distribution mismatch while on-policy methods explore poorly. Proposes a backtracking mechanism that mitigates error cascades in long chain-of-thought reasoning.

entry.title: Stitched Value Model for Diffusion Alignment

author.name: Hyojun Go, Hyungjin Chung, Prune Truong, Goutam Bhat, Li Mi, Zhaochong An, Zixiang Zhao, Dominik Narnhofer, Serge Belongie, Federico Tombari, Konrad Schindler

entry.summary: Proposes a stitched value model for diffusion alignment that bridges biased Tweedie estimates and expensive Monte Carlo rollouts, training a value function specifically for noisy intermediate latents.

entry.title: Does Code Cleanliness Affect Coding Agents? A Controlled Minimal-Pair Study

author.name: Priyansh Trivedi (SonarSource), Olivier Schmitt (SonarSource)

entry.summary: Studies whether code cleanliness affects coding agent performance using minimal pairs of repositories that differ only in code quality. Introduces an evaluation protocol isolating cleanliness from agent capability.

entry.title: Probability-Conserving Flow Guidance

author.name: Parsa Esmati, Junha Hyung, Amirhossein Dadashzadeh, Jaegul Choo, Majid Mirmehdi

entry.summary: Analyzes guidance in diffusion/flow models through the continuity equation, showing standard CFG breaks probability conservation. Proposes time-dependent divergence-free guidance that stays on the generative manifold.

entry.title: Draft Less, Retrieve More: Hybrid Tree Construction for Speculative Decoding

author.name: Yuhao Shen, Tianyu Liu, Xinyi Hu, Quan Kong, Baolin Zhang, Jun Dai, Jun Zhang, Shuang Ge, Lei Chen, Yue Li, Mingcheng Wan, Cong Wang

entry.summary: Introduces Graft, a hybrid tree construction method for speculative decoding that compensates for pruned draft branches by retrieving validated tokens, breaking the Pareto tradeoff between acceptance rate and computational overhead in LLM inference.

entry.title: PASC: Pipeline-Aware Conformal Prediction with Joint Coverage Guarantees for Multi-Stage NLP and LLM Pipelines

author.name: Varun Kotte

entry.summary: Introduces PASC, a pipeline-aware conformal prediction method that provides finite-sample joint coverage guarantees across multi-stage NLP/LLM pipelines by reducing the problem to a single scalar conformal prediction on joint maximum nonconformity scores.

entry.title: STRIDE: Learnable Stepwise Language Feedback for LLM Reasoning

author.name: Junjie Zhang, Guozheng Ma, Shunyu Liu, Zetian Hu, Yongcheng Jing, Ting-En Lin, Yongbin Li, Dacheng Tao

entry.summary: Proposes STRIDE, a training framework that replaces scalar step-level rewards with learnable language feedback for LLM reasoning, shifting from information-bottlenecked scalar scores to rich textual stepwise guidance.

entry.title: Learning Orthonormal Bases for Function Spaces

author.name: Hamidreza Kamkari, Mohammad Sina Nabizadeh, Justin Solomon

entry.summary: Proposes learning infinite-dimensional orthonormal bases using neural networks by viewing bases as points on the Lie manifold of the orthogonal group. Uses neural ODEs to parameterize paths from reference bases (e.g., Fourier) to data-adapted bases.

entry.title: Language models struggle with compartmentalization

author.name: Thomas Vincent Howe, David Wingate

entry.summary: Demonstrates that LLMs exhibit 'compartmentalization' - failing to share statistical strength between distinct presentations of the same concept (e.g., same facts in different languages). Shows synthetic parallel data can fail to integrate representations.

entry.title: Auditing Privacy in Multi-Tenant RAG under Account Collusion

author.name: Florian A. D. Burnat, Brittany I. Davidson

entry.summary: Formally analyzes privacy leakage in multi-tenant RAG services under account collusion, showing that joint leakage degrades at rate Θ(√k · ε_acc) for k colluding accounts, and proposes countermeasures including rate limiting and collusion-aware noise calibration.

entry.title: GoLongRL: Capability-Oriented Long Context Reinforcement Learning with Multitask Alignment

author.name: Minxuan Lv, Tiehua Mei, Tanlong Du, Junmin Chen, Zhenpeng Su, Ziyang Chen, Ziqi Wang, Zhennan Wu, Ruotong Pan, jian Liang, Ruiming Tang, Han Li

entry.summary: Presents GoLongRL, a fully open-source post-training recipe for long-context reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards spanning 9 task types, including a 23K sample dataset, construction pipeline, and training code release.

entry.title: Distribution Matching Distillation without Fake Score Network

author.name: Youngjoong Kim, Deokyeong Lee, Jaesik Park

entry.summary: Proposes FSF-DMD, a method that eliminates the auxiliary fake-score network in Distribution Matching Distillation for few-step image generation. Leverages the flow-map structure of generators to derive a pseudo-velocity that replaces the separate score estimator. Reduces memory and computational overhead while maintaining generation quality.

entry.title: LMM-Track4D: Eliciting 4D Dynamic Reasoning in LMMs via Trajectory-Grounded Dialogue

author.name: Chaoyue Li, Yongxue Xu, Jie Feng, Jiayu Ding

entry.summary: Introduces LMM-Track4D for 4D spatiotemporal dynamic reasoning in large multimodal models, with trajectory-grounded multi-turn dialogue. Proposes Track4D-Bench benchmark with 526 samples and RTGE encoding for streaming 3D trajectory prediction.

entry.title: Are Watermarked Images Editable? SafeMark for Watermark-Preserving Text-Guided Image Editing

author.name: Xiaodong Wu, Qi Li, Xiangman Li, Zelin Zhang, Lingshuang Liu, Jianbing Ni

entry.summary: Introduces SafeMark, a framework for watermark-preserving text-guided image editing that integrates watermark integrity into the diffusion editing process. Adds watermark-decoding loss to the editor's training objective so edits preserve embedded watermarks.

entry.title: Trust It or Not: Evidential Uncertainty for Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction with Trust3R

author.name: Zihao Zhu, Wenyuan Zhao, Nuo Chen, Chao Tian, Zhiwen Fan

entry.summary: Presents Trust3R, a lightweight evidential uncertainty framework for feed-forward 3D reconstruction. Combines gated residual mean refinement with Normal-Inverse-Wishart evidential head to produce probabilistically grounded per-point uncertainty estimates.

entry.title: Tango3D: Towards Alignment for Global and Local 2D-3D Correspondence

author.name: Zebin He, Mingxin Yang, Shuhui Yang, Hanxiao Sun, Xintong Han, Chunchao Guo, Wenhan Luo

entry.summary: Presents Tango3D, a 3D foundation model unifying dense pixel-to-point correspondence with global retrieval in a shared space. Uses geometry-aware 2D backbone and pretrained 3D VAE with three-stage progressive training.

entry.title: When Preference Labels Fall Short: Aligning Diffusion Models from Real Data

author.name: Weiyan Chen, Weijian Deng, Yao Xiao, Weijie Tu, ZiYi Dong, Ibrahim Radwan, Liang Lin, Pengxu Wei

entry.summary: Investigates whether real data can serve as supervision for preference alignment of diffusion models, as an alternative to model-generated preference pairs. Studies curation strategies treating real images as reference points.

entry.title: MetaEarth-MM: Unified Multimodal Remote Sensing Image Generation with Scene-centered Joint Modeling

author.name: Zhiping Yu, Chenyang Liu, Jinqi Cao, Qinzhe Yang, Siwei Yu, Zhengxia Zou, Zhenwei Shi

entry.summary: Develops MetaEarth-MM, a generative foundation model for multi-modal remote sensing enabling paired joint generation and any-to-any translation across five modalities. Uses scene-centered joint modeling paradigm leveraging intrinsic scene consistency.

entry.title: SetCon: Towards Open-Ended Referring Segmentation via Set-Level Concept Prediction

author.name: Zhixiong Zhang, Yizhuo Li, Shuangrui Ding, Yuhang Zang, Shengyuan Ding, Long Xing, Yibin Wang, Qiaosheng Zhang, Jiaqi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes SetCon for open-ended referring segmentation as explicit set-level concept prediction. Uses LVLM-generated natural-language concepts instead of segmentation-specific tokens, capturing set-level properties like completeness.

entry.title: Next-Acceleration-Scale Prediction for Autoregressive MRI Reconstruction

author.name: Yilmaz Korkmaz, Vishal M. Patel

entry.summary: This paper reformulates MRI reconstruction as autoregressive next-acceleration-scale prediction in discrete multi-scale latent space, using codebook tokens rather than continuous pixel predictions. This avoids the blurring from averaging over feasible solutions in ill-posed inverse problems.

entry.title: RoboJailBench: Benchmarking Adversarial Attacks and Defenses in Embodied Robotic Agents

author.name: Doguhuan Yeke, Yanming Zhou, Leo Y. Lin, Hongyu Cai, Antonio Bianchi, Z. Berkay Celik

entry.summary: RoboJailBench introduces a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating adversarial jailbreak attacks and defenses on embodied AI systems (robots, autonomous vehicles), addressing the gap between chat-based jailbreak evaluation and physical-world safety.

entry.title: Learning to Hand Off: Provably Convergent Workflow Learning under Interface Constraints

author.name: Jiayu Li, Enpei Zhang, Dawei Zhou, Elynn Chen, Yujun Yan

entry.summary: Formalizes workflow learning under interface constraints as an IC-SMDP, where agents hand off control through shared artifacts without centralized access. Proposes IC-Q with finite-sample convergence bounds requiring only scalar communication at handoffs.

entry.title: DEFLECT: Delay-Robust Execution via Flow-matching Likelihood-Estimated Counterfactual Tuning for VLA Policies

author.name: Yixiang Zhu, Yonghao Chen, Rui Meng, Jingyu Guo, Jiaxiang Zou, Zijie Yang, Taowen Wang, Xinyu Chen

entry.summary: Introduces DEFLECT, an offline post-training method that makes Vision-Language-Action policies robust to inference latency by converting delay itself into a preference signal using counterfactual fresh/stale action comparisons.

entry.title: SPHERICAL KV: Angle-Domain Attention and Rate-Distortion Retention for Efficient Long-Context Inference

author.name: Anay Chauhan, Gurucharan Marthi Krishna Kumar, Arion Das, Amit Dhanda, Vinija Jain, Aman Chadha, Amitava Das

entry.summary: Presents Spherical KV, a long-context inference method treating KV allocation as a rate-distortion problem in attention geometry, representing directional information cheaply for efficient decoding.

entry.title: MMGS: 10$\times$ Compressed 3DGS through Optimal Transport Aggregation based on Multi-view Ranking

author.name: Beizhen Zhao, Sicheng Yu, Ziran Yin, Dongxu Shen, Hao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes MMGS for 10x compression of 3D Gaussian Splatting using multi-view contribution ranking and optimal transport-based aggregation. Formulates Gaussian optimization as global geometric distribution matching rather than local pruning. Achieves significant compression while maintaining rendering quality.

entry.title: UniRefiner: Teaching Pre-trained ViTs to Self-Dispose Dross via Contrastive Register

author.name: Congpei Qiu, Zhaoyu Hu, Wei Ke, Zhuotao Tian, Yanhao Wu, Tong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes UniRefiner to address spurious tokens in Vision Transformers for dense prediction tasks. Categorizes three types of spurious tokens that corrupt spatial representations and uses contrastive registers to suppress them.

entry.title: Physics-in-the-Loop: A Hybrid Agentic Architecture for Validated CAD Engineering Design

author.name: Elias Berger, Muhammad Usama, Jan Mehlst\"aubl, Bernhard Saske, Kristin Paetzold-Byhain

entry.summary: Proposes a Hybrid Agentic-Physical Architecture for CAD engineering design that embeds physics-based engineering tools into LLM agent decision loops. Formulates engineering design as closed-loop sequential decision making with physical verification.

entry.title: Fast 4D Mesh Generation by Spatio-Temporal Attention Chains

author.name: Dvir Samuel, Yuval Atzmon, Gal Chechik, Yoni Kasten

entry.summary: Introduces a training-free approach to accelerate 4D mesh generation using Spatio-Temporal Attention Chains. Key observation is that temporal correspondences emerge early in backbone processing before meshes become visually accurate.

entry.title: RECIPE: Procedural Planning via Grounding in Instructional Video

author.name: Luigi Seminara, Antonino Furnari, Lorenzo Torresani

entry.summary: Proposes RECIPE for visual planning in instructional videos using verification rather than supervised fine-tuning. Identifies asymmetry where verifying step grounding in ASR transcripts is easier than extracting clean labels, enabling RL-based training.

entry.title: CogOmniControl: Reasoning-Driven Controllable Video Generation via Creative Intent Cognition

author.name: Hongji Yang, Songlian Li, Yucheng Zhou, Xiaotong Zhao, Alan Zhao, Chengzhong Xu, Jianbing Shen

entry.summary: Presents CogOmniControl, a reasoning-driven framework for controllable video generation that separates creative intent cognition from generation. Trains specialized CogVLM for understanding storyboard sketches and clay render conditions.

entry.title: POLAR-Bench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Privacy-Utility Trade-offs in LLM Agents

author.name: Qiaoyuan Zheng, Yiqu Yang, Qi Gao, Imanol Schlag

entry.summary: Introduces POLAR-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating privacy-utility tradeoffs in LLM agents. Tests how well agents follow user privacy policies when interacting with adversarial third-party systems across 10 domains and 7,852 samples.

entry.title: OpenComputer: Verifiable Software Worlds for Computer-Use Agents

author.name: Jinbiao Wei, Qianran Ma, Yilun Zhao, Xiao Zhou, Kangqi Ni, Guo Gan, Arman Cohan

entry.summary: Presents OpenComputer, a verifier-grounded framework for evaluating computer-use agents across 33 desktop applications and 1,000 tasks. Uses app-specific state verifiers for reliable evaluation with partial-credit rewards.

entry.title: Not Every Rubric Teaches Equally: Policy-Aware Rubric Rewards for RLVR

author.name: Utkarsh Tyagi, Xingang Guo, MohammadHossein Rezaei, Daniel George, Anas Mahmoud, Jackson Lee, Bing Liu, Yunzhong He

entry.summary: Introduces POW3R, a policy-aware rubric reward mechanism for RLVR that dynamically adjusts criterion weights based on their current optimization utility rather than static human importance weights.

entry.title: Transformers Linearly Represent Highly Structured World Models

author.name: Roman Kniazev, Nathana\"el Fijalkow

entry.summary: Trains an 8-layer transformer on Sudoku solving traces and finds it builds a 'substructure world model' organized around rows/columns/boxes rather than individual cells. Identifies a 'naked-single circuit' with dedicated detection neurons.

entry.title: HalluWorld: A Controlled Benchmark for Hallucination via Reference World Models

author.name: Emmy Liu, Varun Gangal, Michael Yu, Zhuofu Tao, Karan Singh, Sachin Kumar, Steven Y. Feng

entry.summary: Introduces HalluWorld, a benchmark for hallucination grounded in explicit reference-world formulations. Addresses fragmentation across existing benchmarks by providing a unified definition of hallucination as claims false with respect to a specified world.

entry.title: TORQ: Two-Level Orthogonal Rotation for MXFP4 Quantization

author.name: Zukang Xu, Xing Hu, Dawei Yang

entry.summary: Proposes TORQ, a two-level orthogonal rotation method for MXFP4 quantization of LLM activations. Addresses inter-block variance imbalance and intra-block codebook utilization imbalance through theoretical analysis.

entry.title: TEMPO: Temporal Enforcement via Mode-Separated Policy Optimization for Trustworthy LLM Backtesting

author.name: Zeyu Zhang, Bradly C. Stadie

entry.summary: Introduces TEMPO, a training framework for temporal discipline in LLM backtesting that teaches models to select evidence conditioned on cutoff dates without erasing knowledge, using mode-separated policy optimization.

entry.title: iGSP:Implicit Gradient Subspace Projection for Efficient Continual Learning of Vision-Language Models

author.name: Xuezhi Cui, Dongbo Zhou, Wang Guo, Zeyuan Wang, Ziyu Li, Gaozhi Zhou, Xian Li, Ling Zhao, Wentao Yang, Chao Tao, Haifeng Li

entry.summary: Proposes iGSP for continual learning of vision-language models by treating alignment sharing as a geometric problem of overlapping optimization trajectories in low-rank subspaces. Uses implicit gradient subspace projection to prevent catastrophic forgetting without per-task parameter isolation.

entry.title: EventPrune: Cascaded Event-Assisted Token Pruning for Efficient First-Person Dynamic Spatial Reasoning

author.name: Pengtao Ma, Ziliang Zhou, Ciyu Ruan, Haoyang Wang, Kaiyuan Li, Zihang Gong, Wenhua Ding, Chen Gao, Jingao Xu, Xinlei Chen

entry.summary: Proposes EventPrune, the first framework using event camera data as continuous motion priors to guide token pruning in Video-LLMs for first-person dynamic spatial reasoning. Combines event-triggered keyframe sampling with motion saliency filtering.

entry.title: deadtrees.earth-aerial: A Multi-Resolution Aerial Image Dataset for Tree Cover and Mortality Detection

author.name: Ayushi Sharma, Clemens Mosig, Lukas Drees, Salim Soltani, Janusch Vajna-Jehle, Aaron Sheppard, Belqis Ahmadi, Jonathan Schmid, Paul Neumeier, Nathan Jacobs, Jan Dirk Wegner, Teja Kattenborn

entry.summary: Introduces deadtrees.earth-aerial, globally representative datasets for joint tree cover and mortality segmentation from centimeter-scale aerial imagery. Includes 385K training patches and 63 test sites for benchmarking.

entry.title: Structured Layout Priors for Robust Out-of-Distribution Visual Document Understanding

author.name: Peter El Hachem, Ahmed Nassar, A. Said Gurbuz, Christoph Auer, Peter W. J. Staar

entry.summary: Proposes structured layout priors for document understanding VLMs by pre-resolving layout entity classification/localization outside the decoder using RT-DETR. Identifies a two-hop bottleneck where layout recognition failure cascades into content extraction failure.

entry.title: SphericalDreamer: Generating Navigable Immersive 3D Worlds with Panorama Fusion

author.name: Antoine Schnepf, Karim Kassab, Flavian Vasile, Andrew Comport

entry.summary: Introduces SphericalDreamer for generating fully immersive 360° navigable 3D outdoor environments from text prompts. Fuses multiple panoramic images lifted into 3D with visual and geometric consistency.

entry.title: Exposing Functional Fusion: A New Class of Strategic Backdoor in Dynamic Prompt Architectures

author.name: Zeyao Liu, Zhendong Zhao, Xiaojun Chen, Xin Zhao, Yuexin Xuan, Xiaoshuang Ji

entry.summary: VIPER exposes a new class of backdoor attack targeting dynamic Visual Prompt Tuning (VPT) architectures for Vision Transformers, showing that context-aware prompt mechanisms create dangerous vulnerabilities not present in static approaches.

entry.title: Embedding by Elicitation: Dynamic Representations for Bayesian Optimization of System Prompts

author.name: Zhiyuan Jerry Lin, Benjamin Letham, Samuel Dooley, Maximilian Balandat, Eytan Bakshy

entry.summary: Introduces ReElicit, a Bayesian optimization framework for tuning system prompts using aggregate feedback metrics. Uses LLMs to elicit interpretable feature spaces and Gaussian process surrogates for efficient prompt optimization.

entry.title: What and When to Distill: Selective Hindsight Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents

author.name: Xiaozhe Li, Tianyi Lyu, Yang Li, Yichuan Ma, Peiji Li, Linyang Li, Qipeng Guo, Dahua Lin, Kai Chen

entry.summary: Introduces SERL, a selective environment-reweighted learning framework that uses per-step environmental feedback (error messages, observations) for credit assignment in multi-turn LLM agents. Studies five feedback sources and two insertion granularities.

entry.title: Position: The Turing-Completeness of Real-World Autoregressive Transformers Relies Heavily on Context Management

author.name: Guanyu Cui, Zhewei Wei, Kun He

entry.summary: Position paper arguing that Turing-completeness proofs for transformers conflate two settings, and that real-world autoregressive transformers' computational power depends critically on context management methods.

entry.title: Probing Embodied LLMs: When Higher Observation Fidelity Hurts Problem Solving

author.name: Oussama Zenkri, Oliver Brock

entry.summary: Studies embodied LLM agents on a sequential mechanical puzzle, finding counterintuitively that agents perform best under raw RGB input and worst under perfect ground-truth observations.

entry.title: ALDEN: Boosting Private Data Extraction from Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems via Active Learning and Distribution Estimation

author.name: Xingyu Lyu, Jianfeng He, Ning Wang, Yidan Hu, Tao Li, Danjue Chen, Shixiong Li, Yimin Chen

entry.summary: Proposes ALDEN, an attack that extracts private data from RAG systems using active learning to diversify queries and distribution estimation to reconstruct unseen data. Boosts extraction rates significantly.

entry.title: PROWL: Prioritized Regret-Driven Optimization for World Model Learning

author.name: Ahmet H. G\"uzel, Jenny Seidenschwarz, Benjamin Graham, Jonathan Sadeghi, Jeffrey Hawke, Jack Parker-Holder, Ilija Bogunovic

entry.summary: Introduces PROWL, a world model training approach that uses KL-constrained adversarial curriculum to actively discover failure modes of diffusion-based world models, then fine-tunes on those failure trajectories.

entry.title: Precision Tracked Transformer via Kalman Filtering, Kriging and Process Noise

author.name: Bo Long, Deepak Agarwal, Jelena Markovic-Voronov, Yi Wang, Liuqing Li

entry.summary: Reinterprets Transformers through Bayesian filtering: attention becomes precision-weighted kriging, residual connections become Kalman updates, and FFNs propagate precision. Proposes Bayesian Filtering Transformer (BFT) with uncertainty handling.

entry.title: SAGE: Shaping Anchors for Guided Exploration in RLVR of LLMs

author.name: Chanuk Lee, Minki Kang, Sung Ju Hwang

entry.summary: Proposes SAGE for RLVR that addresses the exploration limitation caused by reverse-KL regularization. Shapes anchors to guide exploration beyond what the base model already knows, aiming to improve pass@k alongside pass@1.

entry.title: ESLD (External Surrogate Latent Defense): A Latent-Space Architecture for Faster, Stronger Prompt-Injection Defense

author.name: Yash Narendra

entry.summary: Proposes ESLD, a latent-space defense architecture against prompt injection attacks on AI assistants. Uses an external surrogate model to detect malicious content in the latent space before it reaches the main model.

entry.title: Counterfactual Likelihood Tests for Indirect Influence in Private Reasoning Channels

author.name: Alexander Boesgaard Lorup (Openhagen)

entry.summary: Presents a counterfactual likelihood test for measuring indirect influence between private reasoning channels in AI systems. Replaces upstream private blocks with donors and measures downstream NLL shifts.

entry.title: EgoBabyVLM: Benchmarking Cross-Modal Learning from Naturalistic Egocentric Video Data

author.name: Dongyan Lin, Phillip Rust, Angel Villar Corrales, Alvin W. M. Tan, Mahi Luthra, Charles-\'Eric Saint-James, Rashel Moritz, Sheila Krogh-Jespersen, Vanessa Stark, Surya Parimi, Jiayi Shen, Youssef Benchekroun, Yosuke Higuchi, Martin Gleize, Tom Fizycki, Nicolas Hamilakis, Manel Khentout, Sho Tsuji, Bal\'azs K\'egl, Juan Pino, Michael C. Frank, Emmanuel Dupoux

entry.summary: Introduces EgoBabyVLM, training VLMs on naturalistic infant and adult egocentric videos to benchmark cross-modal learning from sparse, weakly-aligned data streams. Evaluates with comprehensive suite spanning multimodal language grounding.

entry.title: COBALT: Crowdsourcing Robot Learning via Cloud-Based Teleoperation with Smartphones

author.name: Ayush Agarwal, Ansh Gandhi, Jeremy A. Collins, Omar Rayyan, Aryan Sarswat, Ranjani Koushik, Masoud Moghani, Ajay Mandlekar, Animesh Garg

entry.summary: Presents COBALT, a crowdsourcing platform for robot learning demonstrations using smartphones, VR headsets, and other common devices. Supports concurrent teleoperation in vectorized environments on a single GPU.

entry.title: PhyWorld: Physics-Faithful World Model for Video Generation

author.name: Pu Zhao, Juyi Lin, Timothy Rupprecht, Arash Akbari, Chence Yang, Rahul Chowdhury, Elaheh Motamedi, Arman Akbari, Yumei He, Chen Wang, Geng Yuan, Weiwei Chen, Yanzhi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes PhyWorld, a video generation world model designed for physically faithful scene continuations through two-stage post-training that enforces physical consistency beyond visual realism.

entry.title: Inference-Time Scaling in Diffusion Models through Iterative Partial Refinement

author.name: Taegu Kang, Jaesik Yoon, Sungjin Ahn

entry.summary: Proposes Iterative Partial Refinement (IPR), a verifier-free inference-time scaling method for sequential diffusion models that iteratively refines generated regions without external reward models.

entry.title: Sampling-Based Safe Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Luca Vignola, Bruce D. Lee, Manish Prajapat, Manuel Wendl, Melanie Zeilinger, Andreas Krause, Yarden As

entry.summary: Proposes SBSRL, a model-based safe RL algorithm that maintains safety throughout learning by enforcing constraints across sampled dynamics. Provides high-probability safety guarantees and introduces epistemic uncertainty-based exploration.

entry.title: CutVerse: A Compositional GUI Agents Benchmark for Media Post-Production Editing

author.name: Haobo Hu, Xiangwu Guo, Zhiheng Chen, Difei Gao, Haotian Liu, Libiao Jin, Qi Mao

entry.summary: Introduces CutVerse, a benchmark for evaluating GUI agents in professional media post-production (Premiere Pro, Photoshop) with 186 complex long-horizon tasks. Addresses the gap between simple web navigation benchmarks and real creative workflows.

entry.title: MiMuon: Mixed Muon Optimizer with Improved Generalization for Large Models

author.name: Feihu Huang, Yuning Luo, Songcan Chen

entry.summary: Analyzes generalization properties of the Muon optimizer for matrix-structured parameters, proving a generalization error bound of O(1/(Nκ^T)). Proposes MiMuon combining Muon and AdamW for improved generalization.

entry.title: ContextRAG: Extraction-Free Hierarchical Graph Construction for Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Roman Prosvirnin, Sergei Kuznetsov, Seungmin Jin

entry.summary: Presents ContextRAG, a graph RAG system that constructs graph topology without LLM-based extraction, using fuzzy concept analysis and residual-quantization k-means. Matches or exceeds LLM-extracted graphs at lower cost.

entry.title: Rethinking Visual Attribution for Chest X-ray Reasoning in Large Vision Language Models

author.name: Guangzhi Xiong, Qiao Jin, Sanchit Sinha, Zhiyong Lu, Aidong Zhang

entry.summary: Develops a causal evaluation framework for visual attribution in chest X-ray reasoning by LVLMs, using counterfactual editing to verify whether expert-annotated regions are causally responsible for model predictions, finding standard attribution methods often don't reflect actual model reasoning.

entry.title: How Faithful Is Trajectory-Based Data Attribution? Error Sources, Remedies, and Practical Guidelines

author.name: Junwei Deng, Pingbang Hu, Suliang Jin, Hao Lu, Jiachen T. Wang, Shichang Zhang, Jiaqi W. Ma

entry.summary: Provides the first systematic error analysis of trajectory-based data attribution methods, identifying three error categories (config-level, algorithm-level, system-level) and offering concrete remedies and practical guidelines for deployment.

entry.title: Delta Attention Residuals

author.name: Cheng Luo, Zefan Cai, Junjie Hu

entry.summary: Proposes Delta Attention Residuals, which attend over layer-wise deltas rather than cumulative hidden states, addressing routing collapse in deeper layers where attention weights become near-uniform.

entry.title: Reasoning Portability: Guiding Continual Learning for MLLMs in the RLVR Era

author.name: Qiuhe Hong, Yuyang Liu, Shuo Yang, Tiantian Peng, Fei Zhu, Yonghong Tian

entry.summary: Proposes Reasoning Portability for continual learning of multimodal LLMs with RLVR, showing reasoning-level signals remain reliable on OOD samples while answer-level signals don't, enabling better continual adaptation.

entry.title: LoRA vs. Full Fine-Tuning: A Theoretical Perspective

author.name: Ali Zindari, Rotem Mulayoff, Sebastian U. Stich

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis comparing LoRA vs full fine-tuning in linear regression, identifying regimes where LoRA achieves lower excess risk, particularly when the task difference is low-rank and data is limited.

entry.title: Generative Pseudo-Force Fields for Molecular Generation

author.name: Stefaan Simon Pierre Hessmann, Khaled Kahouli, Stefan Gugler, Michael Plainer, Frank No\'e, Klaus-Robert M\"uller, Niklas Wolf Andreas Gebauer

entry.summary: Proposes Generative Pseudo-Force Fields (GPFFs) that bridge force field relaxation and diffusion models by training an MLFF on a quadratic pseudo-potential relative to equilibrium structures, avoiding costly ab-initio calculations.

entry.title: Backdooring Masked Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Daniel Yiming Cao, Chengzhong Wang, Sheng-Yen Chou, Chengyu Huang, Pin-Yu Chen, Shengwei An

entry.summary: Presents SHADOWMASK, the first systematic study of training-time backdoor attacks on masked diffusion language models, modifying the forward corruption process to create a dedicated denoising pathway from trigger tokens.

entry.title: Training-Free Bayesian Filtering with Generative Emulators

author.name: Thomas Savary, Fran\c{c}ois Rozet, Gilles Louppe

entry.summary: Shows that diffusion-based emulators of dynamical systems can implement an optimal particle filter variant without additional training, scaling particle filtering to high-dimensional chaotic systems including atmospheric dynamics.

entry.title: Optimal Representation Size: High-Dimensional Analysis of Pretraining and Linear Probing

author.name: Valentina Njaradi, Cl\'ementine Domin\'e, Rachel Swanson, Marco Mondelli, Andrew Saxe

entry.summary: Provides analytical model of pretrain-then-probe paradigm using PCA for structure extraction and linear regression for downstream learning. Derives exact expressions for generalization error as a function of representation dimensionality in the high-dimensional regime.

entry.title: Towards Discovery of Polymers for Insulin Delivery via Physics-Grounded Agentic Workflows

author.name: Martins Otun

entry.summary: Demonstrates an agentic workflow using LLMs with physics-based tools (via Model Context Protocol) for discovering polymers for insulin delivery. The LLM acts as an implicit acquisition function, achieving superior interaction energies compared to baselines under matched compute budgets.

entry.title: Reducing Diffusion Model Memorization with Higher Order Langevin Dynamics

author.name: Benjamin Sterling, M\'onica F. Bugallo, Tom Tirer

entry.summary: Studies Higher-Order Langevin Dynamics (HOLD) as a method to reduce training data memorization in diffusion models. The auxiliary velocity/acceleration variables regularize trajectories, potentially reducing privacy and copyright risks.

entry.title: OpenCompass: A Universal Evaluation Platform for Large Language Models

author.name: Maosong Cao, Kai Chen, Haodong Duan, Yixiao Fang, Tong Gao, Ge Jiaye, Mo Li, Hongwei Liu, Junnan Liu, Yuan Liu, Chengqi Lyu, Han Lyu, Ningsheng Ma, Zerun Ma, Yu Sun, Zhiyong Wu, Linchen Xiao, Jun Xu, Haochen Ye, Zhaohui Yu, Yike Yuan, Songyang Zhang, Yufeng Zhao, Fengzhe Zhou, Peiheng Zhou, Dongsheng Zhu, Lin Zhu, Jingming Zhuo

entry.summary: Presents OpenCompass, a universal evaluation platform for LLMs that addresses challenges of diverse task types, inconsistent criteria, and fragmented workflows. Enables efficient cross-domain and large-scale model evaluation with standardized pipelines.

entry.title: HiLiftAeroML: High-Fidelity Computational Fluid Dynamics Dataset for High-Lift Aircraft Aerodynamics

author.name: Neil Ashton, Adam Clark, Liam Heidt, Christopher Ivey, Sanjeeb Bose, Rahul Agrawal, Konrad Goc, Rishi Ranade, Corey Adams, Peter Sharpe, Sheel Nidhan, Semit Akkurt, Daniel Leibovici, Jean Kossaifi

entry.summary: Introduces the first open-source high-fidelity CFD dataset for high-lift aircraft aerodynamics, comprising 1800 samples from GPU-accelerated wall-modeled LES simulations for AI surrogate model development. Uses the NASA Common Research Model geometry.

entry.title: Beyond Binary Success: A Diagnostic Meta-Evaluation Framework for Fine-Grained Manipulation

author.name: He-Yang Xu, Pengyuan Zhang, Zongyuan Ge, Xiaoshuai Hao, Serge Belongie, Xin Geng, Yuxin Peng, Xiu-Shen Wei

entry.summary: Introduces MetaFine, a diagnostic evaluation framework for fine-grained manipulation in embodied AI that decomposes capabilities into understanding, perception, and controlled behavior axes, revealing that current benchmarks inflate capabilities by up to 70%.

entry.title: Time to REFLECT: Can We Trust LLM Judges for Evidence-based Research Agents?

author.name: Leyao Wang, Yanan He, Peng Chen, Asaf Yehudai, Yixin Liu, Rex Ying, Michal Shmueli-Scheuer, Arman Cohan

entry.summary: Addresses the meta-evaluation problem for LLM judges in deep research agents, questioning whether LLM judges can reliably assess factual accuracy, evidence use, and reasoning quality in evidence-based research outputs.

entry.title: DECOR: Auditing LLM Deception via Information Manipulation Theory

author.name: Linyue Cai, Samuel Yeh, Jwala Dhamala, Rahul Gupta, Sharon Li

entry.summary: Introduces DECOR, a multi-agent framework grounded in Information Manipulation Theory for auditing strategic deception in LLM responses by decomposing contexts into atomic informational units and scoring along manipulation dimensions.

entry.title: Taming the Thinker: Conditional Entropy Shaping for Adaptive LLM Reasoning

author.name: Shuyu Wei, Jian Sun, Delai Qiu, Yining Wang, Shengping Liu, Jiaen Liang, Ying Fu, Wei Huang, Jitao Sang

entry.summary: Introduces Conditional Entropy Shaping (CES) for LLM reasoning that uses token-level entropy as an uncertainty signal to dynamically control response length - penalizing high-entropy tokens on correct paths for conciseness and rewarding exploration on wrong paths.

entry.title: Rewarding Beliefs, Not Actions: Consistency-Guided Credit Assignment for Long-Horizon Agents

author.name: Wenjie Tang, Minne Li, Sijie Huang, Liquan Xiao, Yuan Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes ReBel, a process-level RL algorithm for LLM agents that models structured belief states to address credit assignment in partially observable long-horizon tasks, using belief-consistency supervision for dense rewards.

entry.title: ClinSeekAgent: Automating Multimodal Evidence Seeking for Agentic Clinical Reasoning

author.name: Juncheng Wu, Letian Zhang, Yuhan Wang, Haoqin Tu, Hardy Chen, Zijun Wang, Cihang Xie, Yuyin Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces ClinSeekAgent, an automated framework for dynamic multimodal evidence seeking in clinical settings that actively queries knowledge bases, navigates EHRs, and invokes imaging tools rather than passively consuming pre-curated evidence.

entry.title: Efficient coding along the visual hierarchy

author.name: Ananya Passi, Brian S. Robinson, Michael F. Bonner

entry.summary: Tests whether efficient coding (learning representations that capture statistical structure of natural inputs) can build human-aligned visual feature hierarchies from limited data without labels or backpropagation, finding progression from edges to textures to shapes.

entry.title: FPED: A Functional-Network Prior-Guided Mixture-of-Experts Framework for Interpretable Brain Decoding

author.name: Yudan Ren, Pengcheng Shi, Zihan Ma, Xiaowei He, Xiao Li

entry.summary: Introduces FPED, a mixture-of-experts framework for brain decoding from fMRI that preserves brain network topology rather than flattening signals. Uses functional network priors to guide expert routing, improving both reconstruction quality and neuroscientific interpretability. Bridges brain-computer interfaces with modern deep learning architectures.

entry.title: DynaTok: Temporally Adaptive and Positional Bias-Aware Token Compression for Video-LLMs

author.name: Minyoung Park, Taehun Kong, Sangjun Ahn

entry.summary: Presents DynaTok, a training-free token compression framework for Video-LLMs that adaptively allocates token budgets across temporal and spatial dimensions while accounting for positional bias. Addresses the prohibitive computational cost of processing long video sequences in Video-LLMs.

entry.title: MatPhys: Learning Material-Aware Physics Parameters for Deformable Object Simulation from Videos

author.name: Yang Yang, Yiyan Wang, Zheming Liu, Naoya Iwamoto

entry.summary: Proposes MatPhys, a material-aware feed-forward framework for predicting spring-mass simulation parameters from single-view video. Uses DINO features to handle heterogeneous materials and addresses the inconsistency of physics parameters across scenes.

entry.title: Replacement Learning: Training Neural Networks with Fewer Parameters

author.name: Yuming Zhang, Peizhe Wang, Tianyang Han, Hengyu Shi, Junhao Su, Dongzhi Guan, Jiabin Liu, Jiaji Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Replacement Learning (RepL), a training paradigm that reduces full-depth backpropagation redundancy by replacing selected blocks during training. Addresses parameter redundancy and activation-memory costs in deep networks.

entry.title: Aero-World: Action-Conditioned Aerial Video Generation from Inertial Controls

author.name: Abdul Mohaimen Al Radi, Kunyang Li, Yuzhang Shang, Mubarak Shah, Yu Tian

entry.summary: Proposes Aero-World for converting pretrained image-to-video diffusion models into controllable aerial video generators conditioned on inertial control signals. Addresses the gap between foundation video models and embodied aerial AI applications.

entry.title: GoTTA be Diverse: Rethinking Memory Policies for Test-Time Adaptation

author.name: Shyma Alhuwaider, Yasmeen Alsaedy, Merey Ramazanova, Silvio Giancola, Bernard Ghanem

entry.summary: Provides systematic benchmark decoupling memory policies from adaptation algorithms in test-time adaptation. Shows effective memory management requires diversity-aware selection, revealing that memory design is as critical as the adaptation objective.

entry.title: OP2GS: Object-Aware 3D Gaussian Splatting with Dual-Opacity Primitives

author.name: Guiyu Liu, Niklas Vaara, Janne Mustaniemi, Juho Kannala, Janne Heikkil\"a

entry.summary: Proposes OP2GS, an object-aware Gaussian representation with dual-opacity primitives that separates appearance reconstruction opacity from object identity. Addresses label contamination in 2D-to-3D mask lifting for scene understanding.

entry.title: CaMo: Camera Motion Grounded Evaluation and Training for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Hsiang-Wei Huang, Junbin Lu, Kuang-Ming Chen, Jianxu Shangguan, Cheng-Yen Yang, Jenq-Neng Hwang

entry.summary: CaMo reveals that state-of-the-art spatial Vision-Language Models lack basic camera motion understanding despite scoring well on spatial QA benchmarks. They propose a new evaluation framework (Spatial Narrative Score) and a camera-motion-grounded VLM that addresses this gap.

entry.title: PRISM-SLAM: Probabilistic Ray-Grounded Inference for Scale-aware Metric SLAM

author.name: Eunsoo Im

entry.summary: PRISM-SLAM integrates vision foundation model depth priors into a Bayesian factor graph for monocular SLAM, introducing a Plücker Ray-Distance Factor that mathematically resolves scale ambiguity and achieves metric-consistent localization.

entry.title: Self-assembling Modular Aerial Robot for Versatile Aerial Tasks

author.name: Junichiro Sugihara, Masaki Kitagawa, Jinjie Li, Yunong Li, Takuzumi Nishio, Kei Okada, Moju Zhao

entry.summary: LEGION introduces modular aerial robots that can self-assemble in flight for cooperative manipulation, inspired by ant collective behavior. Individual units maintain nimble maneuverability while assembled configurations provide sufficient thrust for physical interaction.

entry.title: Beyond Action Residuals: Real-World Robot Policy Steering via Bottleneck Latent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Dongjie Yu, Kun Lei, Zhennan Jiang, Jia Pan, Huazhe Xu

entry.summary: ZPRL proposes steering pretrained imitation policies through a compact bottleneck latent space rather than through action-space residuals or weight updates, enabling structured exploration during RL fine-tuning of robot manipulation policies.

entry.title: A Visual Guide to Natural Latents

author.name: Alfred Harwood

entry.summary: Visual guide explaining Natural Latents using mutual information framing rather than KL-divergences, providing intuitive diagrams of probability distributions to illustrate when a variable satisfies natural latent conditions.

entry.title: Tracking Difficulty with Feature Portfolios

author.name: kaivu

entry.summary: Proposes tracking a portfolio of task attributes (not just human completion time) for forecasting AI capabilities, highlighting that 'combined human+AI cost' is more measurable than pure human time as tasks lengthen.

entry.title: Robotics-Inspired Guardrails for Foundation Models in Socially Sensitive Domains

author.name: Rebecca Ramnauth, Drazen Brscic, Brian Scassellati

entry.summary: Proposes robotics-inspired guardrails for foundation models treating safety as runtime behavioral control over interaction trajectories, using formal constructs from closed-loop control theory.

entry.title: MetaRA: Metamorphic Robustness Assessment for Multimodal Large Language Model-based Visual Question Answering Systems

author.name: Quanxing Xu, Yuhao Tian, Ling Zhou, Xian Zhong, Xiaohua Huang, Rubing Huang, Chia-Wen Lin

entry.summary: Introduces MetaRA, a metamorphic testing framework for evaluating robustness of multimodal LLM-based VQA systems. Uses metamorphic relations to systematically generate controlled input variations and assess model consistency. Reveals vulnerabilities in current MLLMs beyond what static benchmarks capture.

entry.title: CPC-VAR:Continual Personalized and Compositional Generation in Visual Autoregressive Models

author.name: Junhao Li, Xinhao Zhong, Yi sun, Yuxia Qiao, Bin Chen, Shu-Tao Xia, Yaowei Wang

entry.summary: Presents the first systematic study of continual personalized generation in visual autoregressive (VAR) models. Addresses catastrophic forgetting during sequential concept learning and feature entanglement in multi-concept synthesis.

entry.title: Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting from Sparse Aerial Views

author.name: Dongli Wu, Zhuoxiao Li, Tongyan Hua, Yinrui Ren, Xiaobao Wei, Rongjun Qin, Wufan Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes a feed-forward Gaussian Splatting method for large-scale urban scene reconstruction from sparse aerial views. Addresses evidence imbalance between well-observed roofs and poorly-observed facades with uncertainty-aware generation.

entry.title: Spatially Prompted Visual Trajectory Prediction for Egocentric Manipulation

author.name: Yifan Li, Xinyu Zhou, Yunhao Ge, Yu Kong

entry.summary: Formalizes Spatially Prompted Visual Trajectory Prediction (SP-VTP) for robotic manipulation using spatial prompts like bounding boxes to specify task objectives. Collects EgoSPT dataset for egocentric manipulation trajectories.

entry.title: Attention-Guided Reward for Reinforcement Learning-based Jailbreak against Large Reasoning Models

author.name: Zheng Lin, Zhenxing Niu, Haoxuan Ji, Yuzhe Huang, Haichang Gao

entry.summary: Proposes attention-guided reward for jailbreak attacks against Large Reasoning Models, finding that successful jailbreaks correlate with specific attention patterns on harmful tokens.

entry.title: DOTRAG: Retrieval-Time Reasoning Along Paths

author.name: Larnell Moore, Naihao Deng, Rada Mihalcea, Farnaz Jahanbakhsh

entry.summary: Proposes DotRAG, a training-free GraphRAG framework that reformulates retrieval as reasoning over paths with query-conditioned constraints. Introduces Division of Thought (DOT) for decomposing retrieval into structured subproblems.

entry.title: To Call or Not to Call: Diagnosing Intrinsic Over-Calling Bias in LLM Agents

author.name: Wei Shi, Ziheng Peng, Sihang Li, Xiting Wang, Xiang Wang, Mengnan Du, Na Zou

entry.summary: Diagnoses intrinsic over-calling bias in LLM agents using Sparse Autoencoders, finding that models have an activation-independent offset favoring tool calls even when none is needed. Proposes bias correction via SAE feature analysis.

entry.title: Distilling Linearized Behavior for Effective Task Arithmetic

author.name: Thomas Sommariva, Francesca Morandi, Simone Calderara, Angelo Porrello

entry.summary: Shows that linearized fine-tuning behavior (important for task vector composition) can be distilled into standard non-linear models through constraints in representation space, bridging the gap between linear and standard fine-tuning.

entry.title: Diagnosing Multi-step Reasoning Failures in Black-box LLMs via Stepwise Confidence Attribution

author.name: Xiaoou Liu, Tiejin Chen, Dengjia Zhang, Yaqing Wang, Lu Cheng, Hua Wei

entry.summary: Introduces Stepwise Confidence Attribution (SCA) for diagnosing reasoning failures in black-box LLMs. Uses Information Bottleneck principle to assign step-level confidence based on generated traces without requiring model internals.

entry.title: Learning When to Adapt

author.name: Ali Zindari, Xiaowen Jiang, Rotem Mulayoff, Sebastian U. Stich

entry.summary: Introduces DISeL (Dynamic Input-Sensitive LoRA), which adds lightweight input-dependent gates over rank-one LoRA components to selectively activate adaptations, preserving pre-trained behavior by default and reducing catastrophic forgetting.

entry.title: Semantic-Enriched Latent Visual Reasoning

author.name: Tianrun Xu, Yue Sun, Qixun Wang, Jingyi Lu, Yuan Wang, Tianren Zhang, Longteng Guo, Fengyun Rao, Jing Lyu, Feng Chen, Jing Liu

entry.summary: Introduces SLVR, a two-stage framework for enriching latent visual representations with attribute-level semantics for multimodal reasoning. Enables region-level reasoning tasks by learning semantically enriched region-centric latents under fine-grained attribute supervision.

entry.title: CAD-Free Learning of Spacecraft Pose Estimators via NeRF-Based Augmentations

author.name: Antoine Legrand, Renaud Detry, Christophe De Vleeschouwer

entry.summary: Introduces NeRF-based image augmentation method for training spacecraft pose estimators from only a few tens to hundreds of images, eliminating the need for CAD models. Enables data-efficient learning through geometrically-consistent viewpoint and appearance augmentation.

entry.title: AffectVerse: Emotional World Models for Multimodal Affective Computing

author.name: Bo Zhao, Fanghua Ye, Yixin Ji, Sicheng Zhao, Xiaojiang Peng, Zitong YU

entry.summary: Proposes AffectVerse, a model with Emotion World Module for multimodal affective computing that predicts future affective states. Uses cross-modal temporal imagination and modality-aware attention for emotion recognition beyond static fusion.

entry.title: Beyond Imitation: Learning Safe End-to-End Autonomous Driving from Hard Negatives

author.name: Junli Wang, Zhihua Hua, Xueyi Liu, Zebin Xing, Haochen Tian, Kun Ma, Hangjun Ye, Guang Chen, Long Chen, Qichao Zhang

entry.summary: BeyondDrive proposes failure-aware imitation learning that jointly learns from successful and failed driving behaviors, using a flow matching-based generator to synthesize safety-critical negative trajectories that are realistic but lead to collisions.

entry.title: PAPO-VLA: Planning-Aware Policy Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Peizheng Guo, Jingyao Wang, Changwen Zheng, Wenwen Qiang

entry.summary: PAPO-VLA introduces planning-aware policy optimization for Vision-Language-Action models, distinguishing between planning actions (task-direction decisions) and execution actions (continuous motion), with specific optimization focus on the planning actions.

entry.title: Interference-Aware Multi-Task Unlearning

author.name: Ying-Hua Huang, Rui Fang, Hsi-Wen Chen, Ming-Syan Chen

entry.summary: Introduces multi-task unlearning framework addressing interference between tasks when removing training data from shared-backbone models. Proposes solutions for both full-task and partial-task unlearning scenarios.

entry.title: Library Drift: Diagnosing and Fixing a Silent Failure Mode in Self-Evolving LLM Skill Libraries

author.name: Xing Zhang, Yanwei Cui, Guanghui Wang, Ziyuan Li, Wei Qiu, Bing Zhu, Peiyang He

entry.summary: Diagnoses 'library drift' in self-evolving LLM skill libraries where unbounded skill accumulation causes retrieval degradation. Provides reproducible triggers and proposes lifecycle management solutions.

entry.title: PEEK: Context Map as an Orientation Cache for Long-Context LLM Agents

author.name: Zhuohan Gu, Qizheng Zhang, Omar Khattab, Samuel Madden

entry.summary: Introduces PEEK, a system that caches reusable 'orientation knowledge' about recurring contexts as a context map for LLM agents, providing persistent understanding of what contexts contain and how they're organized.

entry.title: AutoResearchClaw: Self-Reinforcing Autonomous Research with Human-AI Collaboration

author.name: Jiaqi Liu, Shi Qiu, Mairui Li, Bingzhou Li, Haonian Ji, Siwei Han, Xinyu Ye, Peng Xia, Zihan Dong, Congyu Zhang, Letian Zhang, Guiming Chen, Haoqin Tu, Xinyu Yang, Lu Feng, Xujiang Zhao, Haifeng Chen, Jiawei Zhou, Xiao Wang, Weitong Zhang, Hongtu Zhu, Yun Li, Jieru Mei, Hongliang Fei, Jiaheng Zhang, Linjie Li, Linjun Zhang, Yuyin Zhou, Sheng Wang, Caiming Xiong, James Zou, Zeyu Zheng, Cihang Xie, Mingyu Ding, Huaxiu Yao

entry.summary: Presents AutoResearchClaw, a multi-agent autonomous research system with structured debate, self-healing execution, and cross-run experience accumulation for iterative scientific discovery.

entry.title: OmniGUI: Benchmarking GUI Agents in Omni-Modal Smartphone Environments

author.name: Felix Henry, Xiaochen Lin, Jiangyou Zhu, Yangfan, Bingqian Zhang, Min Chen, Shiyu Huang

entry.summary: Introduces OmniGUI, the first step-level benchmark for GUI agents in omni-modal smartphone environments requiring processing of audio, video, and images at each action step. Contains 709 episodes across 29 applications.

entry.title: Simply Stabilizing the Loop via Fully Looped Transformer

author.name: Rao Fu, Zixuan Yang, Jiankun Zhang, Jing Ma, Hechang Chen, Yu Li, Yi Chang

entry.summary: Proposes Fully Looped Transformer that addresses training instability in looped transformers (which reuse blocks iteratively) by solving gradient oscillation and residual explosion through specific stabilization techniques.

entry.title: When Individually Calibrated Models Become Collectively Miscalibrated

author.name: Zhaohui Wang

entry.summary: Proves that individually calibrated probabilistic predictors become collectively miscalibrated when aggregated in multi-agent settings, due to game-theoretic optimal local responses with positively correlated beliefs.

entry.title: DarkLLM: Learning Language-Driven Adversarial Attacks with Large Language Models

author.name: Ye Sun, Xin Wang, Jiaming Zhang, Yifeng Gao, Yixu Wang, Yifan Ding, Qixian Zhang, Henghui Ding, Xingjun Ma, Yu-Gang Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces DarkLLM, a framework training an LLM to translate natural-language attack instructions into adversarial perturbations against vision/multimodal models. Unifies targeted, untargeted, and multi-model attacks via instruction tuning.

entry.title: Stop Drawing Scientific Claims from LLM Social Simulations Without Robustness Audits

author.name: Jinyi Ye, Lei Cao, Ding Chen, Emilio Ferrara

entry.summary: Argues that LLM social simulations require robustness audits before drawing scientific claims, as small architectural perturbations can cascade into macro-level outcome changes ('butterfly effect').

entry.title: Lightweight and Fast Backdoor Model Detection

author.name: Yinbo Yu, Jing Fang, Xuewen Zhang, Chunwei Tian, Qi Zhu, Daoqiang Zhang, Jiajia Liu

entry.summary: Proposes DFBScanner, a lightweight static parameter inspection framework for fast backdoor detection in DNNs. Leverages the observation that backdoor-induced feature perturbations lead to distinctive parameter patterns, enabling detection without clean samples or trigger knowledge.

entry.title: Shaping the Prior: How Synthetic Task Distributions Determine Tabular Foundation Model Quality

author.name: Mohamed Bouadi, Nassim Bouarour, Varun Kulkarni, Shivam Dubey, Aditya Tanna, Vinay Kumar Sankarapu

entry.summary: Introduces O'Prior, a compositional synthetic prior for tabular foundation models that addresses the gap between simple synthetic pretraining distributions and real-world data irregularities. Includes hierarchical SCM generation, realism engine, and stress testing.

entry.title: FAGER: Factually Grounded Evaluation and Refinement of Text-to-Image Models

author.name: Youngsun Lim, Cusuh Ham, Pin-Yu Chen, Deepti Ghadiyaram

entry.summary: Proposes FAGER, an agentic framework for evaluating factual correctness of text-to-image models against implicit facts grounded in scientific knowledge, historical events, products, and culture. Also provides actionable feedback for improvement.

entry.title: Be Kind, Rewrite: Benign Projections via Rewriting Defend Against LLM Data Poisoning Attacks

author.name: John T. Halloran, Noopur S. Bhatt

entry.summary: Proposes open-book benign rewriting (OBBR) as a proactive defense against backdoor attacks in LLMs. Theoretically shows OBBR neutralizes harmful content by projecting training samples to benign prompt space.

entry.title: Exploring and Developing a Pre-Model Safeguard with Draft Models

author.name: Hongyu Cai, Arjun Arunasalam, Yiming Liang, Antonio Bianchi, Z. Berkay Celik
