entry.summary: Proposes using draft models (smaller models) as pre-model safeguards for jailbreak detection, leveraging the transferability of jailbreak attacks to detect harmful prompts before invoking the target model.

entry.title: Rebalancing Reference Frame Dominance to Improve Motion in Image-to-Video Models

author.name: Wooseok Jeon, Seungho Park, Seunghyun Shin, Sangeyl Lee, Hyeonho Jeong, Hae-Gon Jeon

entry.summary: Identifies 'reference-frame dominance' as the mechanism behind static videos in image-to-video models, where non-reference frames over-attend to reference tokens. Proposes DyMoS, a training-free method that rebalances attention to improve motion without sacrificing fidelity.

entry.title: AR1-ZO: Topology-Aware Rank-1 Zeroth-Order Queries for High-Rank LoRA Fine-Tuning

author.name: Ziye Chen, Hongbin Lin, Chenyu Zhang, Xiangda Yan, Yongjie Yang, Yao Shu

entry.summary: Proposes AR1-ZO for zeroth-order LoRA fine-tuning that resolves the rank paradox by querying one rank-1 atom per step, keeping the finite-difference signal observable regardless of adapter rank.

entry.title: Latent Laplace Diffusion for Irregular Multivariate Time Series

author.name: Zinuo You, Jin Zheng, John Cartlidge

entry.summary: Introduces Latent Laplace Diffusion for irregular multivariate time series forecasting, modeling targets as latent trajectories in the Laplace domain with complex-conjugate poles for direct evaluation at irregular timestamps.

entry.title: Breaking Modality Heterogeneity in Low-Bit Quantization for Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Yi Zhong, Haotong Qin, Xindong Zhang, Lei Zhang, Guolei Sun

entry.summary: Proposes SplitQ for low-bit quantization of Vision-Language Models, using channel-splitting to decouple modality-specific outliers that cause heterogeneous activation distributions during quantization.

entry.title: BalanceRAG: Joint Risk Calibration for Cascaded Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Zijun Jia, Yuanchang Ye, Sen Jia, Yiyao Qian, Haoning Wang, Baojie Chen, Diyin Tang, Jinsong Yu, Zhiyuan Wang

entry.summary: Proposes BalanceRAG for calibrating cascaded RAG systems where queries are first handled by LLM-only and escalated to RAG only if uncertain, with joint threshold certification at target risk levels.

entry.title: UCCI: Calibrated Uncertainty for Cost-Optimal LLM Cascade Routing

author.name: Varun Kotte

entry.summary: Presents UCCI, a calibration-first LLM cascade router that uses isotonic regression to map token-level margin uncertainty to per-query error probability, achieving cost-optimal threshold selection with O(n^{-1/3}) sample complexity for calibration error.

entry.title: In-Context Learning Operates as Concept Subspace Learning

author.name: Wei Tang, Xinyan Jiang, Fakhri Karray, Lijie Hu

entry.summary: Studies in-context learning through a concept-subspace view, showing that for ridge/least-squares ICL proxies, prediction decomposes into concept-coordinate regression and off-subspace leakage, with theoretical analysis of estimation and nuisance terms.

entry.title: Distance-Aware Muon: Adaptive Step Scaling for Normalized Optimization

author.name: Yury Demidovich, Abhishek Chakraborty, Grigory Malinovsky, Angelia Nedi\'c, Peter Richt\'arik

entry.summary: Develops Distance-Aware Muon with adaptive step scaling for normalized optimizers, proving stationarity guarantees for non-convex objectives and convergence for star-convex objectives.

entry.title: Chessformer: A Unified Architecture for Chess Modeling

author.name: Daniel Monroe, George Eilender, Philip Chalmers, Zhenwei Tang, Ashton Anderson

entry.summary: Introduces Chessformer, a unified encoder-only transformer for chess that advances SOTA on playing strength, human play prediction, and interpretability simultaneously, using board squares as tokens with spatial attention augmentation.

entry.title: Identifiable Multimodal Causal Representation Learning under Partial Latent Sharing

author.name: Manal Benhamza, Marianne Clausel, Myriam Tami

entry.summary: Addresses identifiability in multimodal causal representation learning with partial latent sharing, proving recovery guarantees for causal latent variables under flexible assumptions with nonlinear mixing.

entry.title: Agentic Discovery of Cryomicroneedle Formulations

author.name: Hao Li, Lifu Du, Nurul Hameed, Shemonti Saha Authai, Zlata Stefanovic, Chenjie Xu

entry.summary: Reports an AI-assisted closed-loop workflow for discovering cryomicroneedle formulations using Gaussian process surrogates, Bayesian optimization, and wet-lab validation. Demonstrates that literature-derived models fail prospectively, motivating iterative correction with real experiments.

entry.title: General Lower Bounds for Differentially Private Federated Learning with Arbitrary Public-Transcript Interactions

author.name: Yicheng Li

entry.summary: Proves general lower bounds for differentially private federated learning with arbitrary public-transcript interactions, establishing a federated van Trees lower bound. The key technical tool is a privacy-information contraction inequality for complete public transcripts.

entry.title: Your Neighbors Know: Leveraging Local Neighborhoods for Backdoor Detection in Decentralized Learning

author.name: Sayan Biswas, Antoine Boutet, Davide Frey, Romaric Gaudel, Rachid Guerraoui, Maxime Jacovella, Anne-Marie Kermarrec, Dimitri Ler\'ev\'erend, Fran\c{c}ois Ta\"iani, Martijn de Vos

entry.summary: Introduces Argus, a backdoor detection framework for decentralized learning that uses local analysis of model updates and collective sharing of findings among honest nodes without requiring a central coordinator. Works without prior knowledge of trigger patterns.

entry.title: SpecX: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Multi-Modal Spectroscopy and Cross-Paradigm Evaluation

author.name: Chengrui Xiang, Tengfei Ma, Yujie Chen, Tong Wang, Haowen Chen, Xiangxiang Zeng

entry.summary: Introduces SpecX, a 1.7M molecule benchmark for multi-modal spectroscopy (NMR, IR, MS, UV, Raman, FL) organized in three tiers. Enables cross-paradigm evaluation of both specialized models and multimodal language models on spectral tasks.

entry.title: Mat\'ern Noise for Triangulation-Agnostic Flow Matching on Meshes

author.name: Tianshu Kuai, Arman Maesumi, Daniel Ritchie, Noam Aigerman

entry.summary: Proposes using Matérn noise distributions for triangulation-agnostic flow matching on triangle meshes. Mathematically defines triangulation agnosticism via spectral properties and proves Matérn distributions satisfy this requirement.

entry.title: Drifting Objectives for Refining Discrete Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Daisuke Oba, Hiroki Furuta, Naoaki Okazaki

entry.summary: Introduces TokenDrift, which transfers the drifting objective concept from continuous diffusion to discrete diffusion language models. Lifts categorical predictions to soft-token features and applies anti-symmetric drifting in a frozen semantic space.

entry.title: Provable Fairness Repair for Deep Neural Networks

author.name: Jianan Ma, Jingyi Wang, Qi Xuan, Zhen Wang

entry.summary: Proposes ProF, a fairness repair framework for DNNs that uses interval bound propagation to provide provable guarantees on individual fairness, unlike data-centric approaches that lack generalization. The method captures model outputs over entire sets around biased samples to guide repair.

entry.title: Multi-axis Analysis of Image Manipulation Localization

author.name: Keanu Nichols, Divya Appapogu, Giscard Biamby, Dina Bashkirova, Anna Rohrbach, Bryan A. Plummer

entry.summary: Introduces AUDITS, a comprehensive benchmark for image manipulation detection across domains with 530K+ images, studying axes including domain shifts, quality, manipulation type, and size, covering both traditional and generative AI manipulations.

entry.title: Fine-tuning language encoding models on slow fMRI improves prediction for fast ECoG

author.name: Aditya R. Vaidya, Richard J. Antonello, Alexander G. Huth

entry.summary: Shows that language encoding models fine-tuned on slow fMRI data can improve prediction of fast ECoG neural recordings, demonstrating cross-modality transfer despite two orders of magnitude difference in temporal resolution.

entry.title: m3BERT: A Modern, Multi-lingual, Matryoshka Bidirectional Encoder

author.name: Yaoxiang Wang, Simiao Zuo, Qingguo Hu, Yucheng Ding, Yeyun Gong, Jian Jiao, Jinsong Su

entry.summary: Introduces m3BERT, a multilingual encoder with Matryoshka-style flexible dimensionality that supports multiple embedding sizes from a single pretrained model, enabling efficient deployment across varying resource constraints.

entry.title: Rethinking How to Remember: Beyond Atomic Facts in Lifelong LLM Agent Memory

author.name: Jingwei Sun, Jianing Zhu, Jiangchao Yao, Tongliang Liu, Bo Han

entry.summary: Proposes TriMem, a triple-memory system for LLM agents that maintains raw dialogues, extracted facts, and reasoning traces simultaneously, addressing limitations of purely fact-based memory that discards fine-grained details.

entry.title: Trust or Abstain? A Self-Aware RAG Approach

author.name: Xi Zhu, Ziqi Wang, Kai Mei, Wujiang Xu, Minghao Guo, Bangji Yang, Jiajun Fan, Dimitris N. Metaxas

entry.summary: Proposes a self-aware RAG approach where LLMs recognize limits of both parametric and contextual knowledge, constructing a 69K instance benchmark to evaluate knowledge conflicts and designing abstention mechanisms.

entry.title: Structuring Open-Ended NAS: Semi-Automated Design Knowledge Structuring with LLMs for Efficient Neural Architecture Search

author.name: Yuiko Sakuma, Masakazu Yoshimura, Marcel Gr\"opl, Zitang Sun, Junji Otsuka, Atsushi Irie, Takeshi Ohashi

entry.summary: Proposes a semi-automated method to structure model design knowledge from research papers using LLMs to guide neural architecture search (NAS). Introduces FairNAD for efficient exploration of the resulting diverse search space using multi-type mutations. Addresses the problem of biased/low-quality design ideas in LLM-assisted open-ended NAS.

entry.title: EpiDiffVO: Geometry-Aware Epipolar Diffusion for Robust Visual Odometry

author.name: Prateeth Rao

entry.summary: Proposes EpiDiffVO, a sparse epipolar matching framework for visual odometry that uses diffusion to model correspondence uncertainty and refine keypoints toward epipolar consistency. Constructs a Steiner graph representation for pose estimation.

entry.title: WBCAtt+: Fine-Grained Pixel-Level Morphological Annotations for White Blood Cell Images

author.name: Satoshi Tsutsui, Winnie Pang, Shuting He, Bihan Wen

entry.summary: Introduces WBCAtt+, a dataset of white blood cell images with 11 morphological attributes and pixel-level cell component annotations (113k image-level labels, 10k segmentation maps). First comprehensive morphological annotation for WBC images.

entry.title: Real-World On-Vehicle Evaluation of Embedding-Based Anomaly Detection

author.name: Albert Schotschneider, Daniel Bogdoll, Svetlana Pavlitska, Ahmed Abouelazm, Johann Marius Zoellner

entry.summary: Proposes adaptable real-time anomaly detection for autonomous driving using foundation model embeddings and nearest-neighbor similarity in latent space. Achieves dense anomaly localization through patch-wise processing.

entry.title: Structural Energy Guidance for View-Consistent Text-to-3D Generation

author.name: Qing Zhang, Jinguang Tong, Jing Zhang, Jie Hong, Xuesong Li

entry.summary: Proposes Structural Energy-Guided Sampling (SEGS) for view-consistent text-to-3D generation, addressing the Janus problem. Constructs structural energy in PCA subspace of U-Net features and injects its gradient into denoising.

entry.title: Stage-adaptive Token Selection for Efficient Omni-modal LLMs

author.name: Zijie Xin, Jie Yang, Ruixiang Zhao, Tianyi Wang, Fengyun Rao, Jing Lyu, Xirong Li

entry.summary: Proposes stage-adaptive token selection for omni-modal LLMs processing audio-visual inputs. Analyzes layer-wise token dependency finding block-wise patterns that gradually weaken, enabling progressive pruning across modalities.

entry.title: SafeAlign-VLA: A Negative-Enhanced Safe Alignment Framework for Risk-Aware Autonomous Driving

author.name: Kefei Tian, Yuansheng Lian, Kai Yang, Xiangdong Chen, Shen Li

entry.summary: SafeAlign-VLA proposes a framework that incorporates negative (unsafe) driving samples into both supervised and reinforcement learning for end-to-end autonomous driving VLA models. It uses counterfactual safety pairing to generate structured safety labels from risky scenarios.

entry.title: Neuromorphic Control of a Flapping-Wing Robot on Resource-Constrained Hardware

author.name: Rim El Filali, Chenrui Feng, Chao Gao, Weibin Gu

entry.summary: Demonstrates neuromorphic control of a flapping-wing robot using spiking neural networks on a $5 ESP32 microcontroller, achieving closed-loop flight with state estimation and CPG-based control under extreme size/weight/power constraints.

entry.title: Causal Inference with Categorical Unobserved Confounder via Mixture Learning

author.name: Aytijhya Saha, Stephen Bates, Devavrat Shah

entry.summary: Addresses causal inference with categorical unobserved confounders by combining insights from proximal causal inference and the Deconfounder approach through mixture learning, avoiding the need for asymmetric proxy variable roles.

entry.title: GeoX: Mastering Geospatial Reasoning Through Self-Play and Verifiable Rewards

author.name: Kyeongjin Ahn, Seungeon Lee, Krishna P. Gummadi, Meeyoung Cha

entry.summary: Proposes GeoX, a self-play framework for geospatial reasoning that acquires spatial logic through executable programs yielding verifiable rewards, combining abduction, deduction, and induction.

entry.title: Eyes on VLM: Benchmarking Gaze Following and Social Gaze Prediction in Vision Language Models

author.name: Hengfei Wang, Anshul Gupta, Pierre Vuillecard, Jean-Marc Odobez

entry.summary: Presents EyeVLM, a systematic evaluation framework for gaze understanding in VLMs across gaze following and social gaze prediction tasks. Reveals limitations in current VLMs' ability to understand human gaze behavior.

entry.title: DecisionBench: A Benchmark for Emergent Delegation in Long-Horizon Agentic Workflows

author.name: Yuxuan Gao, Megan Wang, Yi Ling Yu, Zijian Carl Ma, Ao Qu

entry.summary: Introduces DecisionBench, a benchmark for studying emergent delegation behavior in multi-agent workflows. Tests 11 models across 7 vendors with metrics covering quality, cost, latency, delegation rate, and vendor self-preference.

entry.title: Minimax Optimal Variance-Aware Regret Bounds for Multinomial Logistic MDPs

author.name: Pierre Boudart (SIERRA), Pierre Gaillard (Thoth), Alessandro Rudi (PSL, DI-ENS, Inria)

entry.summary: Proves minimax optimal variance-aware regret bounds for multinomial logistic MDPs, introducing a problem-dependent constant measuring variance that can improve over worst-case bounds by up to sqrt(T).

entry.title: Distribution-Free Uncertainty Quantification for Continuous AI Agent Evaluation

author.name: Yuxuan Gao, Megan Wang, Yi Ling Yu

entry.summary: Adapts conformal prediction and adaptive conformal inference for continuous AI agent evaluation, providing distribution-free coverage guarantees and compositional uncertainty bounds for multi-agent pipelines.

entry.title: Probabilistic Tiny Recursive Model

author.name: Amin Sghaier, Ali Parviz, Alexia Jolicoeur-Martineau

entry.summary: Introduces Probabilistic TRM (PTRM), adding Gaussian noise at each deep recursion step of Tiny Recursive Models to enable stochastic exploration across solution basins, avoiding convergence to suboptimal solutions.

entry.title: Metric-Gradient Projection for Stable Multi-Agent Policy Learning

author.name: Zuyuan Zhang, Sizhe Tang, Mahdi Imani, Tian Lan

entry.summary: Introduces HPML (Hodge-Projected Multi-agent Learning), which decomposes multi-agent update fields using Hodge decomposition to separate cooperative improvement from cyclic interaction dynamics, improving stability in general-sum MARL.

entry.title: D-PACE: Dynamic Position-Aware Cross-Entropy for Parallel Speculative Drafting

author.name: Tianyu Wu, Yu Yao, Zhenting Qi, Han Zheng, Zhuohan Wang, Haoran Ma, Lawrence Liao, Himabindu Lakkaraju, Ju Li, Yilun Du

entry.summary: Proposes D-PACE, a dynamic position-aware training objective for parallel speculative drafters that derives per-position weights from a differentiable surrogate of expected accepted draft length, adapting weights during training.

entry.title: Fast and Lightweight Backdoor Detection via Head Random Probing

author.name: Yinbo Yu, Xueyu Yin, Jing Fang, Chunwei Tian, Qi Zhu, Jiajia Liu, Daoqiang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes HTell, a fast data-free backdoor detector that uses random probing of prediction heads to identify backdoored models. Exploits the observation that backdoored models show abnormal response concentration on target classes under random latent probes.

entry.title: Surviving the Unseen: Predictive Defense for Novel Multi-Turn Multimodal Attacks

author.name: Doohee You

entry.summary: Proposes TRIAD, a triple-tier anomaly defense framework that formulates MLLM safety as a dynamic survival prediction problem. Addresses progressive cross-modal adversarial attacks distributed across multi-turn conversations.

entry.title: GRASP: Deterministic argument ranking in interaction graphs

author.name: Diganta Misra, Antonio Orvieto, Rediet Abebe, Volkan Cevher

entry.summary: Proposes GRASP, a deterministic framework that aggregates stable local interaction judgments into global argument rankings, addressing inconsistency in LLM-as-judge evaluations of debates.

entry.title: Rotation-Aligned Key Channel Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Model Inference

author.name: Beomseok Kang, Dongwon Jo, Jiwon Song, Donghwee Son, Jae-Joon Kim

entry.summary: Proposes RotateK, a rotation-based structured Key channel pruning method for Vision-Language Models that compresses the channel dimension rather than pruning tokens, preserving visual content while reducing KV cache.

entry.title: Brain alignment of reasoning and action representations from vision-language and action models during naturalistic gameplay

author.name: Subba Reddy Oota, Anant Khandelwal, Khushbu Pahwa, Satya Sai Srinath Namburi, Tanmoy Chakraborty, Bapi S. Raju, Manish Gupta

entry.summary: Studies brain alignment of vision-language models and large-action models with fMRI data from participants playing Atari-style video games. Bridges neuroscience and interactive AI understanding.

entry.title: Multi-Scale Generative Modeling with Heat Dissipation Flow Matching

author.name: Jun Ma, Hanquan Zhang, Yanjun Qin, Haoyuan Guan, Ke Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Heat Dissipation Flow Matching (HDFM), integrating blur-based corruption into the Flow Matching framework rather than noise-based corruption, preserving multi-scale priors and color budgets in image generation.

entry.title: The Evaluation Game: Beyond Static LLM Benchmarking

author.name: Paul Wang, Jade Garcia-Bourr\'ee, Anne-Marie Kermarrec, Vincent Corruble

entry.summary: Introduces a game-theoretic framework formalizing the interaction between an LLM evaluator finding jailbreaks and a trainer defending against them, using group actions to represent data augmentation.

entry.title: Quantifying the Pre-training Dividend: Generative versus Latent Self-Supervised Learning for Time Series Foundation Models

author.name: Noam Major, Kathy Razmadze, Yoli Shavit

entry.summary: Compares generative vs. latent self-supervised learning paradigms for time series foundation models. Finds the pre-training dividend is highly asymmetric across tasks, with latent alignment approaches (LeJEPA, DINO adaptations) showing different strengths than generative methods.

entry.title: Spectral Integrated Gradients for Coarse-to-Fine Feature Attribution

author.name: Soyeon Kim, Seongwoo Lim, Kyowoon Lee, Jaesik Choi

entry.summary: Proposes Spectral Integrated Gradients (SIG), which constructs integration paths using SVD of the baseline-to-input difference, introducing features coarse-to-fine for better attribution quality.

entry.title: CriterAlign: Criterion-Centric Rationale Alignment for Code Preference Judging

author.name: Zhenyu Li, Aleksandar Cvejic, Zehui Chen, Peter Wonka

entry.summary: Proposes CriterAlign for pairwise code preference judging that performs direct criterion-level pairwise comparisons rather than independent pointwise scoring, with tie-driven criterion refinement.

entry.title: Real-Time Parallel Counterfactual Regret Minimization

author.name: Boning Li, Longbo Huang

entry.summary: Presents Parallel CFR, the first parallelization framework for real-time depth-limited CFR solving in imperfect-information games, decomposing iterations into pipelined stages with two orthogonal parallelism dimensions.

entry.title: World-Ego Modeling for Long-Horizon Evolution in Hybrid Embodied Tasks

author.name: Zuyao Lin, Jianhui Zhang, Peidong Jia, Xiaoguang Zhao, Shanghang Zhang, Xingyu Chen

entry.summary: Introduces World-Ego Modeling that decomposes future evolution prediction into world (instruction-agnostic scene) and ego (robot-centric conditioned dynamics) components for long-horizon embodied tasks with interleaved navigation and manipulation.

entry.title: Atoms of Thought: Universal EEG Representation Learning with Microstates

author.name: Xinyang Tian, Ruitao Liu, Ziyi Ye, Siyang Xue, Xin Wang, Xuesong Chen

entry.summary: Proposes using EEG microstates (discrete building blocks of brain activity patterns) as a universal tokenization scheme for EEG representation learning, building a microstate tokenizer from a large medical dataset and applying it across multiple downstream BCI tasks.

entry.title: Evaluating Memory Condensation Strategies for Coding Agents in Data-Driven Scientific Discovery

author.name: Renuka Chintalapati, Sid Raskar, Anurag Acharya, Jared Willard, Patrick Emami, Sameera Horawalavithana

entry.summary: Evaluates eight memory condensation strategies for coding agents on scientific discovery tasks, finding no condenser significantly alters hypothesis quality while LLM-based condensers increase costs by 24-94%, with masking tool-call outputs achieving 8.6% savings.

entry.title: A Geometric Analysis of Sign-Magnitude Asymmetry in a ReLU + RMSNorm Block under Ternary Quantization

author.name: Lei Dong

entry.summary: Gives a geometric explanation for why RMSNorm transformers tolerate ternary quantization well: sign-flips produce 2.75x more output energy than magnitude perturbations, and sign-quantization error naturally aligns with the less-damaging perturbation type.

entry.title: GAE Falls Short in Imperfect-Information Self-Play Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zhiyuan Fan, Gabriele Farina

entry.summary: Shows that Generalized Advantage Estimation suffers from additional variance in imperfect-information self-play RL due to stochastic policies, and introduces Q-boosting, a variance-reduced advantage estimator using centralized action-value information.

entry.title: What Makes a Representation Good for Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction?

author.name: Wenkang Jiang, Yuhang Liu, Yichao Cai, Erdun Gao, Jiayi Dong, Ehsan Abbasnejad, Lina Yao, Javen Qinfeng Shi

entry.summary: Proposes PerturbedVAE for single-cell perturbation prediction, addressing the challenge that gene expression is dominated by perturbation-invariant information while perturbation-specific signals are sparse.

entry.title: Adynamical systems view of training generativemodels and the memorization phenomenon

author.name: Siva Athreya, Chiranjib Bhattacharya, Vivek S. Borkar

entry.summary: Provides a dynamical systems explanation of memorization in generative models using two-time-scale dynamics in SGD. Uses a stylized loss function model with strong/weak variable dependence to explain the double descent phenomenon and memorization through training dynamics alone.

entry.title: B-cos GNNs: Faithful Explanations through Dynamic Linearity

author.name: Joschka Gro{\ss}, Mohammad Shaique Solanki, Verena Wolf

entry.summary: Introduces B-cos GNNs that produce exact per-node, per-feature attribution explanations through dynamic linearity, requiring only a single forward-backward pass. Replaces non-linear message functions with B-cos transforms that induce weight-input alignment.

entry.title: Set-Valued Policy Learning

author.name: Laura Fuentes-Vicente, Mathieu Even, Ga\"elle Dormion, Antoine Chambaz, Uri Shalit, Julie Josse

entry.summary: Proposes set-valued policy learning for clinical treatment recommendations, where policies output a set of plausible treatments rather than a single recommendation. Enables intrinsic uncertainty quantification with set size reflecting confidence.

entry.title: Guiding Neuro-Symbolic Scenario Generation with Spatio-Temporal Logic

author.name: Lorenzo Bonin, Francesco Giacomarra, Luca Bortolussi, Jyotirmoy V. Deshmukh, Francesca Cairoli

entry.summary: Introduces STRELGen for targeted generation of safety-critical autonomous driving scenarios by combining trajectory diffusion models with spatio-temporal logic (STREL) specifications encoding safety and realism properties.

entry.title: Increasing Missingness to Reduce Bias: Richardson-SGD with Missing Data

author.name: Ferdinand Genans (SU, LPSM), Erwan Scornet (SU, LPSM)

entry.summary: Proves that all parametric models exhibit gradient bias under imputation with missing data, and proposes Richardson-SGD that deliberately adds missingness to debias gradient estimates via Richardson extrapolation.

entry.title: Awakening the Hydra: Stabilizing Multi-Concept Backdoor Injection in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models

author.name: Kai Wang, Jiale Zhang, Chengcheng Zhu, Chuang Ma, Songze Li

entry.summary: Studies the problem of multiple backdoor injections accumulating in text-to-image diffusion models through open-source reuse, showing how semantic conflicts can destabilize attacks, and proposes methods to stabilize multi-concept backdoor coexistence.

entry.title: Retrieval-Augmented Linguistic Calibration

author.name: Yi-Fan Yeh, Linwei Tao, Minjing Dong, Tao Huang, Jialin Yu, Philip Torr, Chang Xu

entry.summary: Models linguistic confidence as a distribution over perceived probability values and introduces Faithfulness Divergence (FD), an information-theoretic metric for evaluating whether stated confidence matches actual model uncertainty.

entry.title: Are Tools Always Beneficial? Learning to Invoke Tools Adaptively for Dual-Mode Multimodal LLM Reasoning

author.name: Qinghe Ma, Zhen Zhao, Yiming Wu, Jian Zhang, Lei Bai, Yinghuan Shi

entry.summary: Introduces AutoTool, a model that adaptively decides whether to invoke tools during multimodal reasoning using RL with dual-mode rewards, showing that redundant tool use can harm performance.

entry.title: What Are LLMs Doing to Scientific Communication? Measuring Changes in Writing Practices and Reading Experience

author.name: Filip Mileti\'c, Neele Falk

entry.summary: Measures how LLM usage has changed scientific writing style in NLP papers (2020-2024) using a 37K paper corpus, finding significant changes in word frequency, usage contexts, and complex stylistic features.

entry.title: TIDE: Efficient and Lossless MoE Diffusion LLM Inference with I/O-aware Expert Offload

author.name: Zhiben Chen, Youpeng Zhao, Yang Sui, Jun Wang, Yuzhang Shang

entry.summary: Proposes TIDE, an inference system for MoE diffusion LLMs that exploits temporal stability of expert activations during the diffusion process to enable efficient expert offloading on resource-constrained devices.

entry.title: MedFM-Robust: Benchmarking Robustness of Medical Foundation Models

author.name: Xiangxiang Cui, Tianjin Huang, Yifang Wang, Lijie Hu, Lu Yin

entry.summary: Introduces MedFM-Robust, a benchmark for evaluating robustness of medical foundation models including Med-VLMs and segmentation models under various perturbation conditions relevant to clinical deployment.

entry.title: Return of Frustratingly Easy Unsupervised Video Domain Adaptation

author.name: Pengfei Wei, Yiqun Sun, Zhiqiang Xu, Yiping Ke, Lawrence B. Hsieh

entry.summary: Proposes MetaTrans, a simple unsupervised video domain adaptation method that separately handles spatial and temporal divergence through architectural design. Uses a temporal-static subtraction module with only two loss terms, achieving strong results.

entry.title: White-Balance First, Adjust Later: Cross-Camera Color Constancy via Vision-Language Evaluation

author.name: Shuwei Li, Lei Tan, Robby T. Tan

entry.summary: Proposes VLM-CC, a feedback-guided color constancy framework using iterative VLM-based evaluation for cross-camera generalization. White-balances images iteratively with VLM assessment rather than direct illuminant estimation.

entry.title: PrAda: Few-Shot Visual Adaptation for Text-Prompted Segmentation

author.name: Gabriele Rosi, Fabio Cermelli, Carlo Masone, Barbara Caputo

entry.summary: Introduces PrAda for few-shot visual adaptation of text-prompted segmentation models under domain shift. Identifies misclassification rather than mask generation as the main error source and proposes prototype-based adaptation.

entry.title: MSAVBench: Towards Comprehensive and Reliable Evaluation of Multi-Shot Audio-Video Generation

author.name: Yujie Wei, Yujin Han, Zhekai Chen, Yongming Li, Kaixun Jiang, Zhihang Liu, Quanhao Li, Zhiwu Qing, Xiang Wang, Zhen Xing, Ruihang Chu, Lingyi Hong, Yefei He, Junjie Zhou, Junqiu Yu, Yang Shi, Difan Zou, Kai Zhu, Shiwei Zhang, Yingya Zhang, Yu Liu, Xihui Liu, Hongming Shan

entry.summary: MSAVBench introduces the first comprehensive benchmark for multi-shot audio-video generation, covering video, audio, shot transitions, and reference fidelity across diverse scenarios with up to 15 shots. It provides an adaptive hybrid evaluation framework for this emerging generation paradigm.

entry.title: HEAT: Heterogeneous End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Trajectory-Guided World Models

author.name: Hoonhee Cho, Giwon Lee, Jae-Young Kang, Hyemin Yang, Heejun Park, Kuk-Jin Yoon

entry.summary: HEAT addresses the challenge of training end-to-end autonomous driving models across multiple heterogeneous domains (different cities, sensors, traffic patterns) using trajectory-guided world models to handle conflicting learning signals.

entry.title: Distributionally Robust Control via Stein Variational Inference for Contact-Rich Manipulation

author.name: Hrishikesh Sathyanarayan, Victor Vantilborgh, Harish Ravichandar, Tom Lefebvre, Ian Abraham

entry.summary: Proposes distributionally robust control for contact-rich manipulation using Stein Variational Inference, expanding model-based control capabilities through flexible non-parametric uncertainty modeling while maintaining computational efficiency.

entry.title: CEER: Compliant End-Effector and Root Control as a Unified Interface for Hierarchical Humanoid Loco-Manipulation

author.name: Xinyuan Luo, Xingrui Chen, Xunjian Yin, Hongxuan Wu, Boxi Xia, Zhuoqun Chen, Jinzhou Li, Boyuan Chen, Xianyi Cheng

entry.summary: CEER proposes a compliant end-effector-root control abstraction for humanoid loco-manipulation that provides a planner-compatible interface enabling compliance-aware whole-body control with plug-and-play integration of different high-level planners.

entry.title: The Thermodynamic Costs of Simple Linear Regression

author.name: Samuel H. D'Ambrosia, Sultan M. Daniels, Michael R. DeWeese, Anant Sahai

entry.summary: Studies the thermodynamic lower bounds on the energy costs of simple linear regression (both exact and SGD), deriving energy-cost-aware scaling laws for optimal dataset size given generalization error requirements.

entry.title: B\'ezier Degradation Modeling for LiDAR-based Human Motion Capture

author.name: Xiaoqi An, Lin Zhao, Jun Li, Chen Gong, Jian Yang

entry.summary: Proposes BMLiCap for LiDAR-based human motion capture using temporally compressible Bézier curves. Introduces progressive motion reconstruction with Time-scale Motion Transformer for handling unstable inputs and severe occlusions.

entry.title: Landscape-Awareness for Geometric View Diffusion Model

author.name: Yan-Ting Chen, Hao-Wei Chen, Tsu-Ching Hsiao, Chun-Yi Lee

entry.summary: Proposes a landscape-aware approach for geometric view diffusion models that addresses nonconvex optimization challenges in camera viewpoint estimation. Analyzes failure cases from geometric ambiguities like symmetry and self-similarity.

entry.title: Trustworthy Agent Network: Trust in Agent Networks Must Be Baked In, Not Bolted On

author.name: Yixiang Yao, Yuhang Yao, Xinyi Fan, Jiechao Gao, Jie Wang, Minjia Zhang, Srivatsan Ravi, Carlee Joe-Wong

entry.summary: Vision paper arguing that trustworthiness in Agent-to-Agent (A2A) networks must be architecturally embedded ('baked in') rather than retrofitted. Identifies systemic vulnerabilities like adversarial composition, semantic misalignment, and cascading failures.

entry.title: Conflict-Resilient Multi-Agent Reasoning via Signed Graph Modeling

author.name: Longgang He, Longzhu He, Daojing He, Chaozhuo Li

entry.summary: Introduces SIGMA, a signed-graph multi-agent reasoning framework that explicitly models trust, conflict, and neutral relations between agents. Addresses error propagation from conflicting signals in cooperative multi-agent systems.

entry.title: When Skills Don't Help: A Negative Result on Procedural Knowledge for Tool-Grounded Agents in Offensive Cybersecurity

author.name: Samuel Jacob Chacko, James Hugglestone, Chashi Mahiul Islam, Xiuwen Liu

entry.summary: Negative result showing that procedural knowledge (Agent Skills) fails to help in offensive cybersecurity CTF tasks. Re-analyzes 180-run controlled study showing documentation conditions map exactly to a No-Skill ceiling.

entry.title: HELLoRA: Hot Experts Layer-Level Low-Rank Adaptation for Mixture-of-Experts Models

author.name: Jia Wei, Zhonghao Zhang, Ping Chen, Qianyang li, Yancheng Pan, Shaoxun Wang, Ziyi Qiu, Longxiang Wang

entry.summary: Proposes HELLoRA, which attaches LoRA adapters only to the most frequently activated experts in MoE models rather than all parameters. Achieves parameter reduction while improving performance through structured regularization.

entry.title: Composition of Memory Experts for Diffusion World Models

author.name: Sebastian Stapf, Pablo Acuaviva Huertos, Aram Davtyan, Paolo Favaro

entry.summary: Proposes a diffusion-based world model framework that integrates heterogeneous memory models (transformer, recurrent, state-space) through a contrastive product-of-experts formulation to overcome the memory trade-off in future prediction.

entry.title: From Sparsity to Simplicity: Enabling Simpler Sequential Replacements via Sparse Attention Distillation

author.name: Yuxin Ren, Maxwell D Collins, Miao Hu, Huanrui Yang

entry.summary: Revisits attention replacement through the lens of sparsity patterns, showing that some transformer layers can be replaced with simpler sequential modules without loss. Uses sparse attention distillation to identify and replace layers.

entry.title: ZeroUnlearn: Few-Shot Knowledge Unlearning in Large Language Models

author.name: Yujie Lin, Chengyi Yang, Zhishang Xiang, Yiping Song, Jinsong Su

entry.summary: Proposes ZeroUnlearn, a few-shot knowledge unlearning framework that reformulates unlearning as precise knowledge re-mapping via model editing, enforcing representational orthogonality to remove sensitive information while preserving model utility.

entry.title: Does Your Wildfire Prediction Model Actually Work, or Just Score Well?

author.name: Yangshuang Xu, Yuyang Dai, Liling Chang, Qi Wang, Yushun Dong

entry.summary: Introduces WILDFIRE-FM, the first foundation model pretrained specifically for wildfire prediction, along with a fixed-contract evaluation framework addressing the sparse nature of wildfire events. Challenges existing evaluation practices for Earth foundation models.

entry.title: ReacTOD: Bounded Neuro-Symbolic Agentic NLU for Zero-Shot Dialogue State Tracking

author.name: Yanjun Lin, Zimo Xiao, Kartik Natarajan, Mahesh Sankaranarayanan, Niraj Nawanit, Rakshit Parashar, Austin Zhang, Karthik Konaraddi, Rishita Mote, Wei Niu

entry.summary: Proposes ReacTOD, a bounded neuro-symbolic architecture for task-oriented dialogue that reformulates NLU as discrete tool calls within a self-correcting ReAct loop with deterministic validation. Improves accuracy up to 9.3% over single-pass inference.

entry.title: RE-VLM: Event-Augmented Vision-Language Model for Scene Understanding

author.name: Hanqing Liu, Mingjie Liu, Luoping Cui, Endian Lin, Donghong Jiang, Chuang Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes RE-VLM, the first dual-stream vision-language model combining RGB images and event camera streams for robust scene understanding under adverse conditions (low light, fast motion, high dynamic range).

entry.title: STAR-P\'olyaMath: Multi-Agent Reasoning under Persistent Meta-Strategic Supervision

author.name: Jiaao Wu, Xian Zhang, Hanzhang Liu, Sophia Zhang, Fan Yang, Yinpeng Dong

entry.summary: Introduces STAR-PólyaMath, a multi-agent mathematical reasoning framework with meta-level supervision and structured Reasoner-Verifier interaction, governed by a reasoning-free Python orchestrator.

entry.title: Conflict-Free Replicated Data Types for Neural Network Model Merging: A Two-Layer Architecture Enabling CRDT-Compliant Model Merging Across 26 Strategies

author.name: Ryan Gillespie

entry.summary: Proves that all 26 tested neural network merge strategies fail CRDT algebraic properties. Proposes CRDTMergeState, a two-layer architecture wrapping any merge strategy in CRDT-compliant semantics for distributed model merging.

entry.title: Unlocking the Potential of Continual Model Merging: An ODE Perspective

author.name: Lihong Lin, Haidong Kang

entry.summary: Proposes an ODE-based perspective for continual model merging that constructs smooth trajectories between task models rather than treating them as isolated parameter points. This provides explicit control over capacity allocation between old and new tasks.

entry.title: Investigating Cross-Modal Skill Injection: Scenarios, Methods, and Hyperparameters

author.name: Zhiyu Xu, Lean Wang, Yuanxin Liu, Lei Li, Hao Zhou, Fandong Meng, Jie Zhou, Xu Sun

entry.summary: Investigates cross-modal skill injection from LLMs to VLMs through model merging, studying when and how domain-specific text skills can be transferred to vision-language models without additional training.

entry.title: Mega-ASR: Towards In-the-wild^2 Speech Recognition via Scaling up Real-world Acoustic Simulation

author.name: Zhifei Xie, Kaiyu Pang, Haobin Zhang, Deheng Ye, Xiaobin Hu, Shuicheng Yan, Chunyan Miao

entry.summary: Introduces Mega-ASR for robust speech recognition in the wild, combining a 2M-sample compound acoustic scenario dataset with progressive fine-tuning and dual-granularity WER-gated policy optimization.

entry.title: GEM: GPU-Variability-Aware Expert to GPU Mapping for MoE Systems

author.name: Sourish Wawdhane, Avinash Kumar, Poulami Das

entry.summary: Proposes GEM for GPU-variability-aware expert-to-GPU mapping in MoE serving, addressing stragglers caused by both load imbalance and inherent GPU speed differences in heterogeneous clusters.

entry.title: A Case for Agentic Tuning: From Documentation to Action in PostgreSQL

author.name: Hongyu Lin, Mingyu Li, Weichen Zhang, Yihang Lou, Mingjie Xing, Yanjun Wu, Haibo Chen

entry.summary: Proposes PerfEvolve for PostgreSQL tuning, translating expert tuning methodologies into executable skills for LLM agents that perform version verification, workload profiling, and multi-parameter optimization.

entry.title: VL-DPO: Vision-Language-Guided Finetuning for Preference-Aligned Autonomous Driving

author.name: Zhefan Xu, Ghassen Jerfel, Marina Haliem, Qi Zhao, Jeonhyung Kang, Khaled S. Refaat

entry.summary: Proposes VL-DPO using vision-language models as zero-shot reasoners to generate preference pairs for aligning autonomous driving motion forecasting with human preferences via DPO.

entry.title: Beyond Isotropy in JEPAs: Hamiltonian Geometry and Symplectic Prediction

author.name: Robert Jenkinson Alvarez

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis showing that isotropic Gaussian regularization in JEPAs (Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures) is suboptimal when downstream tasks have structured geometry, and that no fixed marginal target is universally optimal.

entry.title: Spectral Gradient Surgery for Domain-Generalizable Dataset Distillation

author.name: Minyoung Oh, Najeong Chae, Jae-Young Sim

entry.summary: Introduces Domain Generalizable Dataset Distillation (DGDD) with Spectral Gradient Surgery, addressing the problem that distilled datasets fail under distribution shift by incorporating domain generalization into the distillation process.

entry.title: TabQL: In-Context Q-Learning with Tabular Foundation Models

author.name: Qisai Liu, Zhanhong Jiang, Timilehin Ayanlade, Ashutosh Kumar Nirala, Yang Li, Aditya Balu, Soumik Sarkar

entry.summary: Proposes TabQL, replacing the parametric Q-network in DQN with a tabular foundation model for in-context Q-value inference, enabling rapid adaptation from limited online interaction.

entry.title: SAGA: A Sequence-Adaptive Generative Architecture for Multi-Horizon Probabilistic Forecasting with Adaptive Temporal Conformal Prediction

author.name: Gustav Olaf Yunus Laitinen-Fredriksson Lundstr\"om-Imanov, Hafize Gonca C\"omert

entry.summary: Proposes SAGA, a decoder-only transformer for irregular tabular panel sequences paired with conformal prediction, trained on 2.1M individuals over 30 years of Swedish earnings data for lifetime earnings forecasting.

entry.title: PMF-CL: Pareto-Minimal-Forgetting Continual Learner for Conflicting Tasks

author.name: Srijith Nair (Kevin), Atilla Eryilmaz (Kevin), Jia (Kevin), Liu

entry.summary: Proposes PMF-CL, a Pareto-minimal-forgetting approach for continual learning when tasks conflict (no common global minimizer exists), providing theoretical framework for inevitable forgetting scenarios.

entry.title: DeRegiME: Deep Regime Mixtures for Probabilistic Forecasting under Distribution Shift

author.name: Kieran Wood, Stefan Zohren, Stephen J. Roberts

entry.summary: Introduces DeRegiME, a probabilistic forecaster that separates latent uncertainty regimes from underlying signals using a sparse variational GP with nonstationary regime-mixing kernel, exposing interpretable regime structure.

entry.title: TIDE: Asymmetric Neural Circuits for Stabilized Temporal Inhibitory-Excitatory Dynamics

author.name: Alexander Kyuroson, Denis Kleyko, Marcus Liwicki

entry.summary: Proposes TIDE, a neuro-inspired architecture that stabilizes neural dynamics using excitatory-inhibitory networks and Wilson-Cowan dynamics, improving upon the Continuous Thought Machine. Balances biological realism with practical performance through game-theoretic loss optimization.

entry.title: JAXenstein: Accelerated Benchmarking for First-Person Environments

author.name: Ruo Yu Tao, George Konidaris

entry.summary: Introduces JAXenstein, a JAX-based first-person 3D environment for reinforcement learning research, filling a gap in the JAX RL ecosystem for visual partial-observability tasks. Enables hardware-accelerated simulation for faster algorithm iteration.

entry.title: Conformal Prediction via Transported Beta Laws

author.name: Thiago R. Ramos, Helton Graziadei, Luben M. C. Cabezas

entry.summary: Studies conformal prediction's calibration-conditional coverage using beta distributions as a reference. Shows the calibration-conditional coverage follows Beta(k,n+1-k) in the continuous i.i.d. case and quantifies departures using Wasserstein distances.

entry.title: Probabilistic Multivariate Time Series Forecasting with Diffusion Copulas

author.name: David Huk, Dongshan Wang, Miha Bresar

entry.summary: Proposes a Diffusion-Copula framework for multivariate time series forecasting that decouples marginal distribution learning from dependence structure modeling, addressing the 'normality bias' of end-to-end diffusion models for financial risk assessment.

entry.title: The Annotation Scarcity Paradox in Low-Resource NLP Evaluation: A Decade of Acceleration and Emerging Constraints

author.name: Vukosi Marivate

entry.summary: Presents a critical survey of low-resource NLP evaluation identifying the 'Annotation Scarcity Paradox': while NLP has progressed rapidly, deep sociolinguistic expertise needed for evaluation is severely strained and structurally marginalized.

entry.title: Lost in Interpretation: The Plausibility-Faithfulness Trade-off in Cross-Lingual Explanations

author.name: Somnath Banerjee, Pranav Jha, Rima Hazra, Animesh Mukherjee

entry.summary: Uncovers a systematic trade-off in cross-lingual explanations: English-pivot explanations achieve higher span agreement with human rationales but are less causally grounded in the model's prediction, with comprehensiveness degrading up to 5.7x.

entry.title: LambdaPO: A Lambda Style Policy Optimization for Reasoning Language Models

author.name: Zhe Yuan, Yipeng Zhou, Jinghan Li, Xinyuan Chen, Bowen Deng, Zhiqian Chen, Liang Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces LambdaPO, a policy optimization method that replaces GRPO's monolithic baseline with rank-sensitive advantage estimation, preserving fine-grained preference topology in the trajectory space for better RL alignment.

entry.title: Artifact-Bench: Evaluating MLLMs on Detecting and Assessing the Artifacts of AI-Generated Videos

author.name: Yuqi Tang, Yang Shi, Zhuoran Zhang, Qixun Wang, Xuehai Bai, Yue Ding, Ruizhe Chen, Bohan Zeng, Xinlong Chen, Xuanyu Zhu, Bozhou Li, Yuran Wang, Yifan Dai, Chengzhuo Tong, Xinyu Liu, Yiyan Ji, Yujie Wei, Yuhao Dong, Shilin Yan, Fengxiang Wang, Yi-Fan Zhang, Haotian Wang, Yuanxing Zhang, Pengfei Wan

entry.summary: Introduces Artifact-Bench for evaluating MLLMs on detecting and analyzing artifacts in AI-generated videos, covering temporal inconsistencies, structural distortions, and semantic incoherence across diverse domains.

entry.title: Towards Data-Efficient Video Pre-training with Frozen Image Foundation Models

author.name: Svetlana Orlova, Niccol\`o Cavagnero, Gijs Dubbelman

entry.summary: Explores building video understanding models by freezing pre-trained image foundation models and training only a recurrent temporal module, investigating whether competitive video models can be built from reused spatial representations.

entry.title: Selective, Regularized, and Calibrated: Harnessing Vision Foundation Models for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Junyuan Ma, Xunzhi Xiang, Wenbin Li, Qi Fan, Yang Gao

entry.summary: Proposes HERA, a three-stage select-regularize-calibrate framework for cross-domain few-shot segmentation using vision foundation models. Addresses overfitting with limited exemplars and domain shift issues through hierarchical adaptation strategies.

entry.title: DocQT: Improving Document Forgery Localization Robustness via Diverse JPEG Quantization Tables

author.name: Kylian Ronfleux-Corail (L3I), Guillaume Bernard (L3I), Micka\"el Coustaty (L3I), Nicolas Sid\`ere (L3I)

entry.summary: Identifies JPEG quantization table mismatch as a critical overlooked factor in document forgery localization model generalization failures. Shows that operationally calibrated quantization table augmentation significantly improves robustness.

entry.title: Towards Fine-Grained Robustness: Attention-Guided Test-Time Prompt Tuning for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Jia-Wei Hai, Yijun Wang, Xiu-Shen Wei

entry.summary: Proposes A-TPT for attention-guided test-time prompt tuning of VLMs to improve adversarial robustness. Preserves discriminative regions in fine-grained scenarios during augmentation-based adaptation.

entry.title: PiG-Avatar: Hierarchical Neural-Field-Guided Gaussian Avatars

author.name: Julian Kaltheuner, Jan Spindler, Sina Kitz, Patrick Stotko, Reinhard Klein

entry.summary: PiG-Avatar decouples Gaussian avatar representation from body template topology by anchoring Gaussians in a volumetric canonical space governed by a neural field, using the parametric body model only for kinematic transport. This enables better capture of off-body clothing geometry.

entry.title: RoVLA: Multi-Consistency Constraints for Robust Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Jingzhou Luo, Yifan Wen, Yongjie Bai, Xinshuai Song, Yang Liu, Liang Lin

entry.summary: RoVLA addresses the brittleness of VLA models under visual changes and paraphrased instructions by enforcing multi-consistency constraints within the policy, pushing models toward stable couplings among task semantics, environment states, and actions.

entry.title: Probabilistic Recursively Feasible Motion Planning Under Uncertain Environments

author.name: Hyeontae Sung, Hyeongchan Ham, Junyoung Park, Kai Ren, Heejin Ahn

entry.summary: PRF-MPC guarantees recursive feasibility with specified probability for motion planning in uncertain time-varying environments, deriving closed-form expressions for predicted trajectory distributions to construct probabilistic safety constraints.

entry.title: Let's have more partial insiders.

author.name: Cleo Nardo

entry.summary: Argues for the concept of 'partial insiders'—non-employees who hold some attributes of lab employees—as a valuable and underexplored position for AI safety work. Lists attributes of insiders and suggests labs should make partial-insider arrangements easier.

entry.title: Progressive Autonomy as Preference Learning: A Formalization of Trust Calibration for Agentic Tool Use

author.name: Changkun Ou

entry.summary: Formalizes trust calibration for agentic tool use as preferential Bayesian optimization, using Gaussian processes over human risk-tolerance functions to decide when agents need human approval.

entry.title: SceneCode: Executable World Programs for Editable Indoor Scenes with Articulated Objects

author.name: Puyi Wang, Yuhao Wang, Linjie Li, Zhengyuan Yang, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Yangguang Li, Yu Cheng

entry.summary: Presents SceneCode, a framework compiling natural language prompts into executable code-driven indoor worlds with articulated objects for embodied AI and robotic simulation.

entry.title: Prior Knowledge or Search? A Study of LLM Agents in Hardware-Aware Code Optimization

author.name: Dmitry Redko (Applied AI Institute), Albert Fazlyev (AI Talent Hub, ITMO University), Konstantin Sozykin (Applied AI Institute), Maria Ivanova (YSDA, Applied AI Institute), Evgeny Burnaev (Applied AI Institute), Egor Shvetsov (Applied AI Institute)

entry.summary: Studies LLM agents in hardware-aware code optimization through controlled experiments, finding that LLMs act as greedy optimizers in black-box settings and that explicit input information has no measurable effect on kernel generation.

entry.title: Neurosymbolic Learning for Inference-Time Argumentation

author.name: Gabriel Freedman, Adam Dejl, Adam Gould, Mansi, Lihu Chen, Jianqi Jiang, Francesca Toni

entry.summary: Introduces inference-time argumentation (ITA), a neurosymbolic framework for ternary claim verification using formal argumentation semantics to guide LLM training and compute predictions with faithful explanations.

entry.title: The 99% Success Paradox: When Near-Perfect Retrieval Equals Random Selection

author.name: Vyzantinos Repantis, Harshvardhan Singh, Tony Joseph, Cien Zhang, Akash Vishwakarma, Svetlana Karslioglu, Michael Wyatt Thot, Ameya Gawde

entry.summary: Introduces Bits-over-Random (BoR), a chance-corrected metric for retrieval selectivity revealing when high retrieval success rates actually mask random-level performance. Argues LLMs as consumers need much cleaner retrieval than humans.

entry.title: EVA-0: Test-Time Model Evolution with Only Two Forward Passes per Sample

author.name: Guohao Chen, Shuaicheng Niu, Geng Li, Yunbei Zhang, Shilin Shan, Chunyan Miao, Jianfei Yang

entry.summary: Proposes EVA-0, a test-time model evolution method requiring only two forward passes per sample (no backpropagation). Addresses zeroth-order optimization challenges for adaptation on edge devices and black-box models.

entry.title: Auditing Reasoning-Trace Memorization Claims after Unlearning with Head-Conditioned Canaries

author.name: Yanhang Li, Zhichao Fan, Zexin Zhuang

entry.summary: Audits reasoning-trace memorization after unlearning in DeepSeek-R1, finding that apparent memory bypass (thinking trace emitting forgotten content while answer looks unlearned) may be an artifact of trace prefilling rather than true memorization.

entry.title: Markov Chain Decoders Overcome the Heavy-Tail Limitations of Lipschitz Generative Models

author.name: Abdelhakim Ziani (MICS), Andras Horvath (UNITO), Paolo Ballarini (MICS)

entry.summary: Proves that standard VAEs with Gaussian decoder likelihoods and Lipschitz-constrained networks are structurally incapable of producing heavy-tailed outputs. Proposes Markov Chain decoders to overcome this limitation.

entry.title: ContextFlow: Hierarchical Task-State Alignment for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents

author.name: Shuhan Guo, Kun Zhang, Haifei Liu, Xingyu Gao, Yongqi Zhang, Yaqing Wang, Quanming Yao

entry.summary: Proposes ContextFlow, an alignment framework for long-horizon embodied agents that detects and prevents task-state misalignment between planning, monitoring, memory, and execution components.

entry.title: Implicit Action Chunking for Smooth Continuous Control

author.name: Bosun Liang, Shuo Pei, Zirui Chen, Chuanzhi Fan, Chen Sun, Yuankai Wu, Huachun Tan, Yong Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Dual-Window Smoothing (DWS), an implicit action chunking framework for smooth RL control that enforces temporal coherence without expanding action space, using execution and planning windows.

entry.title: Multi-Headed Transformer Architectures as Time-dependent Wasserstein Gradient Flows

author.name: Alex Massucco, Leonardo Del Grande, Marcello Carioni, Christoff Brune, Carola-Bibiane Sch\"onlieb

entry.summary: Models multi-headed transformer architectures as time-dependent Wasserstein gradient flows, allowing different weights per head and layer without initialization constraints, proving well-posedness results.

entry.title: Deep Neural Sheaf Diffusion

author.name: Remi Bourgerie, Sarunas Girdzijauskas, Viktoria Fodor

entry.summary: Proposes Deep Neural Sheaf Diffusion (DNSD), replacing the sheaf Laplacian with a sheaf adjacency operator to maintain informative signals at depth, addressing the vanishing disagreement signal problem in deep graph neural networks.

entry.title: Sequential Consensus for Multi-Agent LLM Debates: A Wald-SPRT compute governor with calibration-based failure detection

author.name: Andrea Morandi

entry.summary: Adapts Wald's Sequential Probability Ratio Test as a plug-in compute governor for multi-agent LLM debates, dynamically allocating rounds based on convergence signals rather than using fixed round counts.

entry.title: Hierarchical Contrastive Learning for Multi-Domain Protein-Ligand Binding

author.name: Shuo Zhang, Rongqi Hong, Huifeng Zhang, Jian K. Liu

entry.summary: Introduces HCLBind, a hierarchical contrastive learning framework for predicting binding affinity in multi-domain proteins where inter-domain dynamics govern molecular recognition. Uses a general-to-specific pre-training paradigm with novel hierarchical decoy strategies.

entry.title: Towards Distillation Guarantees under Algorithmic Alignment for Combinatorial Optimization

author.name: Thien Le, Melanie Weber

entry.summary: Studies when knowledge distillation succeeds for combinatorial optimization tasks by connecting distillation to algorithmic alignment. Shows that GNNs aligned with dynamic programming algorithms can be effectively distilled under the linear representation hypothesis.

entry.title: Provably Data-driven Lagrangian Relaxation for Mixed Integer Linear Programming

author.name: Tung Quoc Le, Anh Tuan Nguyen, Viet Anh Nguyen

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of learning Lagrangian relaxation multipliers for MILP through the lens of data-driven algorithm design. Bridges empirical ML approaches with provable guarantees for predicting optimal multipliers.

entry.title: Neuron Incidence Redistribution for Fairness in Medical Image Classification

author.name: Abin Shoby, Lyle John Palmer, Nikhil Cherian Kurian

entry.summary: Identifies that in transfer-learned medical imaging models, dominant activation channels correlate with both disease presence and demographic privilege, causing systematic over/under-diagnosis. Proposes Neuron Incidence Redistribution as a lightweight fix.

entry.title: SciCustom: A Framework for Custom Evaluation of Scientific Capabilities in Large Language Models

author.name: Yiyang Gu, Junwei Yang, Junyu Luo, Ye Yuan, Bin Feng, Yingce Xia, Shufang Xie, Kaili Liu, Bohan Wu, Qi Shi, Haoran Li, Beier Xiao, Zhiping Xiao, Xiao Luo, Weizhi Zhang, Philip S. Yu, Zequn Liu, Ming Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes SciCustom, a framework for creating custom LLM evaluation benchmarks from large-scale scientific data using ontology-grounded knowledge units and automated tagging, enabling evaluation of application-specific scientific capabilities.

entry.title: FlexDraft: Flexible Speculative Decoding via Attention Tuning and Bonus-Guided Calibration

author.name: Yaojie Zhang, Jianuo Huang, Junlong Ke, Yuhang Han, Yongji Long, Tianchen Zhao, Biqing Qi, Linfeng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes FlexDraft for parallel speculative decoding that uses attention tuning and bonus-guided calibration to improve drafting within a single target forward pass, avoiding costly continual pretraining.

entry.title: Inverse Design of Metasurface based Absorbers using Physics Guided Conditional Diffusion Models

author.name: Vineetha Joy, Jamshed Palai, Satwik Sahoo, Anshuman Kumar, Amit Sethi, Hema Singh

entry.summary: Proposes physics-guided conditional diffusion framework for inverse design of metasurface absorbers. Addresses limitations of conventional optimization and generative approaches for manufacturing-feasible electromagnetic designs.

entry.title: Preferences Order, Ratings Anchor: From Fused Expert Aesthetic Ground Truth to Self-Distillation

author.name: Yuanpei Zhao, Jie Lin, Chao Zhang, Yilin Wang, Mao Li, Chenhui Li, Jie Hou, Tangjie Lv

entry.summary: Introduces PPaint, a dual-protocol benchmark combining pairwise preferences and pointwise ratings for Chinese painting aesthetic assessment. Shows preferences yield better ordinal rankings while ratings anchor absolute scales, and proposes fusion methods.

entry.title: TravExplorer: Cross-Floor Embodied Exploration via Traversability-Aware 3-D Planning

author.name: Han Zheng, Zhe Chen, Yudong Huang, Haoran Liu, Jinghao Wang, Ming Yang, Tong Qin

entry.summary: TravExplorer extends zero-shot object navigation to multi-floor environments by maintaining a unified volumetric map that distinguishes traversable surfaces including stairs and landings, enabling cross-floor exploration with semantic guidance.

entry.title: MOCHA: Multi-Objective Chebyshev Annealing for Agent Skill Optimization

author.name: Md Mehrab Tanjim, Jayakumar Subramanian, Xiang Chen, Branislav Kveton, Subhojyoti Mukherjee, Anlan Zhang, Sungchul Kim, Somdeb Sarkhel, Sunav Choudhury

entry.summary: Introduces MOCHA, a multi-objective optimization framework for LLM agent skills that handles platform constraints (truncation, context windows). Uses Chebyshev annealing to find Pareto-optimal skill configurations.

entry.title: Projecting Latent RL Actions: Towards Generalizable and Scalable Graph Combinatorial Optimization

author.name: Franco Terranova (UL, LORIA, Inria), Guillermo Bernardez (UC Santa Barbara), Albert Cabellos-Aparicio (UPC), Nina Miolane (UC Santa Barbara), Abdelkader Lahmadi (LORIA, UL, Inria)

entry.summary: Introduces projection agents for graph combinatorial optimization that operate in continuous GNN-based action embedding spaces, predicting latent actions in single forward passes for better scalability.

entry.title: FineBench: Benchmarking and Enhancing Vision-Language Models for Fine-grained Human Activity Understanding

author.name: Gueter Josmy Faure, Min-Hung Chen, Jia-Fong Yeh, Hung-Ting Su, Winston H. Hsu

entry.summary: Introduces FineBench, a human-centric video QA benchmark with 199K multiple-choice questions testing fine-grained understanding of human activities including frame-level spatial/temporal grounding.

entry.title: Active Context Selection Improves Simple Regret in Contextual Bandits

author.name: Mohammad Shahverdikondori, Jalal Etesami, Negar Kiyavash

entry.summary: Studies contextual bandits where the learner can actively choose which context (subpopulation) to sample from. Shows active sampling achieves √(1/T·‖p‖₁) regret versus √(n/T·‖p‖_{1/2}) for passive sampling, fully characterizing tight regret rates.

entry.title: Dual-Channel Tensor Neural Networks: Finite-Sample Theory and Conformal Structure Selection

author.name: Elynn Chen, Jiayu Li, Zheshi Zheng, Jian Pei

entry.summary: Proposes Dual-Channel Tensor Neural Networks that decompose tensor inputs into low-rank core and sparse refinement, processing them through coupled neural channels. Provides non-asymptotic estimation rates and structure selection via conformal inference.

entry.title: GeoMamba: A Geometry-driven MambaVision Framework and Dataset for Fine-grained Optical-SAR Object Retrieval

author.name: Tiantong Fang, Xiuwei Wang, Jing Xiao, Wujie Zhou, Liang Liao, Mi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes GeoMamba for optical-SAR cross-modal fine-grained object retrieval with geometry-driven feature injection. Introduces a new dataset and framework for handling modality discrepancy in remote sensing.

entry.title: AQuaUI: Visual Token Reduction for GUI Agents with Adaptive Quadtrees

author.name: Yuankai Li, Tinghui Zhu, Ha Min Son, Zhe Zhao, Xin Liu, Muhao Chen

entry.summary: Proposes AQuaUI, a training-free token reduction method for GUI agents using adaptive quadtrees that exploit non-uniform information density in screenshots. Reduces visual tokens while maintaining performance.

entry.title: PRISM: A Benchmark for Programmatic Spatial-Temporal Reasoning

author.name: Qiran Zhang, Yuheng Wang, Runde Yang, Lin Wu, Jingru Fan, Shu Yao, Jie Zhang, Tianle Zhou, Huatao Li, Ruijie Shi, Yihan Li, Chen Qian

entry.summary: Introduces PRISM, a large-scale benchmark of 10,372 instruction-code pairs for evaluating programmatic video generation (code-based animations). Covers 437 subject categories with funnel-style evaluation.

entry.title: Query-Aware Flow Diffusion for Graph-Based RAG with Retrieval Guarantees

author.name: Zhuoping Zhou, Davoud Ataee Tarzanagh, Sima Didari, Wenjun Hu, Baruch Gutow, Oxana Verkholyak, Masoud Faraki, Heng Hao, Hankyu Moon, Seungjai Min

entry.summary: Proposes QAFD-RAG, a training-free graph-based RAG framework using query-aware flow diffusion for dynamic graph traversal. Provides theoretical retrieval guarantees unlike heuristic graph exploration methods.

entry.title: Theory-optimal Quantization Based on Flatness

author.name: Xiusheng Huang, Zhe Li, Xuanwu Yin, Lu Wang, Yequan Wang, Dong Li, Emad Barsoum, Kang Liu

entry.summary: Introduces a 'Flatness' metric for quantization that models the mathematical relationship between quantization error and outliers. Uses this to develop theory-optimal post-training quantization for LLMs.

entry.title: Hybrid-LoRA: Bridging Full Fine-Tuning and Low-Rank Adaptation for Post-Training

author.name: Chengqian Zhang, Wei Zhu, Kyumin Lee

entry.summary: Proposes Hybrid-LoRA that bridges full fine-tuning and LoRA for post-training LLMs, particularly for RLVR (reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards). Aims to maintain FFT-level performance at LoRA-level cost.

entry.title: TwinRouterBench: Fast Static and Live Dynamic Evaluation for Realistic Agentic LLM Routing

author.name: Pei Yang, Wanyi Chen, Tongyun Yang, Pengbin Feng, Jiarong Xing, Wentao Guo, Yuhang Yao, Yuhang Han, Hanchen Li, Xu Wang, Zeyu Wang, Jie Xiao, Anjie Yang, Liang Tian, Lynn Ai, Eric Yang, Tianyu Shi

entry.summary: Introduces TwinRouterBench, a step-level routing benchmark with static and live tracks for evaluating LLM routers in long-horizon agentic applications. Tests whether cheaper models preserve downstream task success at intermediate agent steps.

entry.title: MoCo-EA: Exploiting Adversarial Mode Connectivity for Efficient Evolutionary Attacks

author.name: Hyo Seo Kim, Gang Luo, Can Chen, Binghui Wang, Yue Duan, Ren Wang

entry.summary: Introduces MoCo-EA, which replaces traditional crossover in evolutionary adversarial attacks with a Bézier curve operator that exploits mode connectivity between adversarial examples. Shows adversarial perturbations lie on connected manifolds.

entry.title: RLFTSim: Realistic and Controllable Multi-Agent Traffic Simulation via Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning

author.name: Ehsan Ahmadi, Hunter Schofield, Behzad Khamidehi, Fazel Arasteh, Jinjun Shan, Lili Mou, Dongfeng Bai, Kasra Rezaee

entry.summary: Introduces RLFTSim, a reinforcement learning fine-tuning framework for traffic simulation that improves realism by aligning rollouts with real-world data distributions and enables goal-conditioned controllability.

entry.title: LiFT: Lifted Inter-slice Feature Trajectories for 3D Image Generation from 2D Generators

author.name: Xinhe Zhang, Yuyang Zhang, Pengfei Jin, Arnau Marin-Llobet, Na Li, Quanzheng Li

entry.summary: Proposes LiFT, a framework for 3D medical image generation that factorizes volume synthesis into per-slice generation and inter-slice trajectory learning. Uses tri-planar drifting loss to maintain anatomical consistency.

entry.title: FormalASR: End-to-End Spoken Chinese to Formal Text

author.name: Wanyi Ning, Yinshang Guo, Haitao Qian, Jiyuan Cheng, Weiyuan Feng, Yufei Zhang

entry.summary: Presents FormalASR, compact models (0.6B and 1.7B) that directly transcribe spoken Chinese into formal written text, eliminating the need for separate ASR+LLM post-editing pipelines.

entry.title: EviTrack: Selection over Sampling for Delayed Disambiguation

author.name: Omer Haq

entry.summary: Introduces EviTrack, a test-time inference framework that maintains competing trajectory hypotheses and uses evidence-based selection to delay commitment until supported by data, addressing delayed disambiguation in sequential prediction.

entry.title: CaptchaMind: Training CAPTCHA Solvers via Reinforcement Learning with Explicit Reasoning Supervision

author.name: Pengcheng Wang, Haoxiang Liu, Yang Dai, Xiangxiang Zeng, Guanhua Chen, Baotian Hu, Longyue Wang, Weihua Luo

entry.summary: Introduces CaptchaBench, the first large-scale CAPTCHA training benchmark with 16K samples and process-level annotations across 8 task categories. Proposes CaptchaMind using RL with explicit reasoning supervision to solve CAPTCHAs.

entry.title: LIFT and PLACE: A Simple, Stable, and Effective Knowledge Distillation Framework for Lightweight Diffusion Models

author.name: Hyunsoo Han, Sangyeop Yeo, Jaejun Yoo

entry.summary: Proposes LIFT and PLACE for knowledge distillation of diffusion models, using a coarse-to-fine framework with linear fitting-based alignment followed by spatially adaptive refinement.

entry.title: Smooth Piecewise Cutting for Neural Operator to Handle Discontinuities and Sharp Transitions

author.name: Ha Dang, Sebastian Schmidt, Juergen Hesser

entry.summary: Proposes Cut-DeepONet for handling discontinuities in neural operators by reformulating via lifting strategy, partitioning domains into smooth subregions while representing discontinuities as boundaries.

entry.title: Beyond Prediction Accuracy: Target-Space Recovery Profiles for Evaluating Model-Brain Alignment

author.name: Ken Nakamura, Tomoya Nakai, Ryuto Yashiro, Ayumu Yamashita, Kaoru Amano

entry.summary: Introduces a framework for evaluating model-brain alignment that goes beyond prediction accuracy to identify which specific dimensions of brain response space are recovered, using repeated fMRI measurements and both model-brain and brain-brain comparisons.

entry.title: Efficient Conditioning Why Pseudo Observation Batch Bayesian Optimization Works When It Does not

author.name: Kumbha Nagaswetha, Rabi Pathak

entry.summary: Provides a unified theory for pseudo-observation batch Bayesian optimization methods (Constant Liar, Kriging Believer, fantasy models), proving Gaussian Processes produce distinct batch points with guaranteed separation under efficient conditioning.

entry.title: From Llama to Cria: Scaling Down Neural Networks via Neuron-Level Spectral Structural Importance Evaluation

author.name: Yongyu Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a neuron pruning framework based on spectral structural importance evaluation using graph signal processing, treating neurons as graph nodes and hidden states as graph signals to identify structurally important neurons.

entry.title: Position: Graph Condensation Needs a Reset -- Move Beyond Full-dataset Training and Model-Dependence

author.name: Mridul Gupta, Samyak Jain, Vansh Ramani, Hariprasad Kodamana, Sayan Ranu

entry.summary: Position paper arguing graph condensation needs fundamental rethinking, criticizing gradient matching approaches that require full dataset training (contradicting efficiency goals) and suffer from poor cross-architecture generalization.

entry.title: Worst-Group Equalized Odds Regularization for Multi-Attribute Fair Medical Image Classification

author.name: Nikhil Cherian Kurian, Victor Caquilpan Parra, Abin Shoby, Luke Whitbread, Lauren Oakden-Rayner, Robert Vandersluis, Jessica Schrouff, Lyle J. Palmer, Mark Jenkinson

entry.summary: Proposes a worst-group equalized-odds margin regularizer for multi-attribute fair medical image classification, targeting disparities at the operating point rather than aggregate AUC.

entry.title: BrainDyn: A Sheaf Neural ODE for Generative Brain Dynamics

author.name: Siddharth Viswanath, Panayiotis Ketonis, Chen Liu, Michael Perlmutter, Dhananjay Bhaskar, Smita Krishnaswamy

entry.summary: Introduces BrainDyn, a sheaf neural ODE model for generating continuous-time brain dynamics that respects anatomical organization, with components aligning to brain regions.

entry.title: Optimal Reconstruction from Linear Queries

author.name: Yuval Filmus, Shay Moran, Elizaveta Nesterova

entry.summary: Characterizes optimal reconstruction error from approximate linear queries as a function of query count, dimension, and noise. Shows the optimal error converges to √(2d/(d+1))δ and establishes excess error rates analogous to Bayes optimal error in supervised learning.

entry.title: MSAlign: Aligning Molecule and Mass Spectra Foundation Models for Metabolite Identification

author.name: Paul Krzakala, Gabriel Melo, Camille Lan\c{c}on, Charlotte Laclau, R\'emi Flamary, Etienne Th\'evenot, Florence d'Alch\'e-Buc

entry.summary: Proposes MSAlign for metabolite identification by aligning molecule and mass spectra foundation models using contrastive learning. Addresses reproducibility issues in the field by providing unified implementations and benchmarks.

entry.title: Heterogeneity-Aware Dataset Scheduling for Efficient Audio Large Language Model Training

author.name: Yanru Wu, Jianning Wang, Chongxin Gan, Yang Li

entry.summary: Proposes Grouped Sequential Training for audio large language models that strategically organizes heterogeneous datasets into affinity-aware groups with progressive scheduling. Addresses conflicting gradients from dataset heterogeneity during multi-dataset training.

entry.title: Do Better Volatility Forecasts Lead to Better Portfolios? Evidence from Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Rylan Wade

entry.summary: Tests whether better volatility forecasts from graph neural networks translate to better portfolio performance. Finds that the model with lowest forecast MSE, highest ranking accuracy, and highest Sharpe ratio are three different models.

entry.title: CompoSE: Compositional Synthesis and Editing of 3D Shapes via Part-Aware Control

author.name: Habib Slim, Shariq Farooq Bhat, Mohamed Elhoseiny, Yifan Wang, Mike Roberts

entry.summary: Introduces CompoSE for compositional 3D shape synthesis and editing using part-aware control with bounding box primitives. Uses a diffusion transformer alternating between local part processing and global context aggregation.

entry.title: Diffusion Graph Posterior Sampling for Nonlinear Inverse Problems with Application to Electrical Impedance Tomography

author.name: Giovanni S. Alberti, Damiana Lazzaro, Serena Morigi, Matteo Santacesaria, Shibo Wang

entry.summary: Extends diffusion posterior sampling to graph-structured data for solving nonlinear inverse problems, specifically electrical impedance tomography on unstructured meshes. Introduces a regularized variant (RDPS) with explicit regularization terms.

entry.title: Minimalist Visual Inertial Odometry

author.name: Francesco Pasti, Jeremy Klotz, Nicola Bellotto, Shree K. Nayar

entry.summary: Demonstrates that just four downward-facing photodiodes with optical Gabor masks plus an IMU can provide robust planar odometry for differential-drive robots, using a TCN trained jointly with mask parameter optimization.

entry.title: Prompting language influences diagnostic reasoning and accuracy of large language models

author.name: Adrien Bazoge, Josselin Corvellec, Sofiane Djillali Sid-Ahmed, Pierre-Antoine Gourraud

entry.summary: Evaluates how prompting language (English vs French) affects diagnostic reasoning and accuracy across five LLMs on 180 clinical vignettes, finding that four of five models perform significantly better in English.

entry.title: Where Does Authorship Signal Emerge in Encoder-Based Language Models?

author.name: Francis Kulumba, Guillaume Vimont, Laurent Romary, Florian Cafiero

entry.summary: Uses mechanistic interpretability to explain why different scoring mechanisms in authorship attribution models lead to 4x performance differences, showing that mean pooling forces early consolidation while late interaction defers it.

entry.title: MixRea: Benchmarking Explicit-Implicit Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Yuanqing Cai, Ziyi Huang, Minhao Liu, Lixin Duan, Wen Li, Yanru Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces MixRea, a benchmark of 2,246 questions testing explicit-implicit reasoning in LLMs, inspired by inattentional blindness, finding that even Gemini 2.5 Pro achieves only limited performance on implicit reasoning.

entry.title: MotionMERGE: A Multi-granular Framework for Human Motion Editing, Reasoning, Generation, and Explanation

author.name: Bizhu Wu, Jinheng Xie, Wenting Chen, Zhe Kong, Jianfeng Ren, Linlin Shen, Ruibin Bai, Rong Qu

entry.summary: Proposes MotionMERGE, a unified framework for fine-grained human motion understanding and editing at part and temporal levels within a single LLM, bridging the granularity gap in motion-language models.

entry.title: HAVEN: Hierarchically Aligned Multimodal Benchmark for Unified Video Understanding

author.name: Mengqi Shi, Haopeng Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces HAVEN, a hierarchically aligned multimodal benchmark for video understanding that provides frame, shot, and video-level annotations with explicit continuous alignment between modalities.

entry.title: Self-Creative Text-to-Object Generation using Semantic-Aware Spatial Weighting

author.name: Yue Yu, Haibo Chen, Shuo Chen, Jian Yang, Jun Li

entry.summary: Proposes SCDiff for creative text-to-image generation with a learnable spatial weighting module and visual-semantic mixing loss. Aims to push generation beyond high-probability regions toward novel outputs with artistic value.

entry.title: Reconfigurable Nonlinear Photonic Networks for In-Situ Learning and Memory Formation via Driven-Dissipative Dynamics

author.name: Isaac Yorke

entry.summary: Proposes a Reconfigurable Nonlinear Photonic Decision Network where computation, memory, and learning emerge from driven-dissipative dynamics of optical systems, going beyond traditional reservoir computing by enabling in-situ learning rather than just readout training.

entry.title: Graph Neural Planning and Predictive Control for Multi-Robot Communication-Constrained Unlabeled Motion Planning

author.name: Manohari Goarin, Yang Zhou, Giuseppe Loianno

entry.summary: Combines Graph Attention Networks for cooperative multi-robot planning with Nonlinear MPC for safety enforcement, addressing the gap between GNN-based scalable planning and real-world deployment challenges like dynamic feasibility and communication constraints.

entry.title: FlyMirage: A Fully Automated Generation Pipeline for Diverse and Scalable UAV Flight Data via Generative World Model

author.name: Jinhan Li, Xijie Huang, Zhaoqi Wang, Yijin Wang, Weiqi Ge, Qiyi He, Mo Zhu, Fei Gao, Yuze Wu, Xin Zhou

entry.summary: FlyMirage is a fully automated pipeline for generating aerial vision-language navigation data using LLMs for scene design and generative world models (3D Gaussian Splatting) for high-fidelity scene instantiation, reducing human labor in VLN dataset creation.

entry.title: AI emotions and aligned behavior

author.name: lisunshiny

entry.summary: Explores whether AI emotional states could be leveraged as a middle layer for alignment between pure value alignment and pure control, drawing analogy to how emotional nudges (like construction zone signs) modify human behavior.

entry.title: Outsiders should focus on specs/constitutions (among other things)

author.name: Cleo Nardo

entry.summary: Argues that the external AI safety community should prioritize work on model specs/constitutions because it requires no ML knowledge, no internal codebase access, and has low integration cost (copy-pasting text into a document).

entry.title: SimGym: A Framework for A/B Test Simulation in E-Commerce with Traffic-Grounded VLM Agents

author.name: Han Li, Vibhor Malik, Zahra Zanjani Foumani, Alberto Castelo, Shuang Xie, Ailin Fan, Keat Yang Koay, Yuanzheng Zhu, Meysam Feghhi, Ronie Uliana, Zhaoyu Zhang, Angelo Ocana Martins, Mingyu Zhao, Francis Pelland, Jonathan Faerman, Nikolas LeBlanc, Aaron Glazer, Andrew McNamara, Zhong Wu, Lingyun Wang

entry.summary: Presents SimGym, a framework for simulating A/B tests on e-commerce storefronts using VLM agents in live browsers. Derives buyer personas from production clickstream data and validates against real experiments.

entry.title: Generative-Evaluative Agreement: A Necessary Validity Criterion for LLM-Enabled Adaptive Assessment

author.name: Grandee Lee, Yue Wang, Che Yee Lye, Luke Peh

entry.summary: Introduces Generative-Evaluative Agreement (GEA), a validity criterion for LLM-based adaptive assessment measuring whether an LLM's scoring recovers the skill levels its generation was instructed to produce. Finds systematic biases.

entry.title: When Tabular Foundation Models Meet Strategic Tabular Data: A Prior Alignment Approach

author.name: Xinpeng Lv, Yunxin Mao, Renzhe Xu, Chunyuan Zheng, Yikai Chen, Haoxuan Li, Jinxuan Yang, Kun Kuang, Yuanlong Chen, Mingyang Geng, Wanrong Huang, Shixuan Liu, Shaowu Yang, Wenjing Yang, Zhouchen Lin, Haotian Wang
