entry.summary: Studies strategic manipulation in tabular foundation models (PFNs), showing that strategic agents create prior-mismatch between training and deployment. Proposes prior alignment approach.

entry.title: A Methodology for Selecting and Composing Runtime Architecture Patterns for Production LLM Agents

author.name: Vasundra Srinivasan

entry.summary: Proposes a methodology for selecting and composing runtime architecture patterns for production LLM agents, introducing the 'stochastic-deterministic boundary' (SDB) as a core architectural primitive.

entry.title: Riemannian Networks over Full-Rank Correlation Matrices

author.name: Ziheng Chen, Xiaojun Wu, Bernhard Sch\"olkopf, Nicu Sebe

entry.summary: Introduces Riemannian neural networks over full-rank correlation matrices using five recently developed correlation geometries. Extends MLR, FC, and convolutional layers to these geometries with accurate backpropagation.

entry.title: Planner-Admissible Graph-PDE Value Extensions for Sparse Goal-Conditioned Planning

author.name: Shiheng Zhang

entry.summary: Studies graph-PDE value extensions for sparse goal-conditioned planning, proving conditions under which surrogate values maintain planner admissibility. Shows AMLE (p-infinity Laplacian) provides better guarantees than harmonic extension.

entry.title: EgoCoT-Bench: Benchmarking Grounded and Verifiable Operation-Centric Chain of Thought Reasoning for MLLMs

author.name: Yang Dai, Dian Jiao, Tianwei Lin, Wenqiao Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces EgoCoT-Bench for evaluating multimodal LLMs on fine-grained egocentric video understanding, specifically grounded chain-of-thought reasoning about hand-object interactions and operation-centric processes.

entry.title: Synthesis and Evaluation of Long-term History-aware Medical Dialogue

author.name: Hebin Hu, Renke Dai, Ah-Hwee Tan, Yilin Kang

entry.summary: Introduces a framework for synthesizing long-term medical dialogues with realistic longitudinal patient histories using LLMs, enabling evaluation of cross-session reasoning in healthcare agents.

entry.title: Block-Sphere Vector Quantization

author.name: Heesang Ann, Joongkyu Lee, Min-hwan Oh

entry.summary: Introduces Block-Sphere Vector Quantization with unified theoretical comparison of rotation-based quantizers (EDEN, RabitQ, TurboQuant), showing their relative advantages are criterion-dependent.

entry.title: From Cumulative Constraints to Adaptive Runtime Safety Control for Nonstationary Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Timofey Tomashevskiy

entry.summary: Proposes Constraint Projection Safety Shield (CPSS), a runtime mechanism that converts cumulative safety budgets into adaptive state-level control constraints for safe RL under nonstationarity.

entry.title: Beyond Extrapolation: Knowledge Utilization Paradigm with Bidirectional Inspiration for Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Liu Chong, Yingjie Zhou, Hao Li, Pengyang Wang, Qingsong Wen, Ce Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes using post-target continuation information (how trajectories evolve after the forecast horizon) as structural knowledge for bidirectional forecasting, obtaining approximate proxies of future data at inference time.

entry.title: Online Market Making and the Value of Observing the Order Book

author.name: Davide Maran, Marcello Restelli

entry.summary: Studies online market making where the learner gains informative feedback when trades don't occur (seeing supply/demand information from the order book). Shows this additional feedback fundamentally changes learnability, achieving O(√T) regret without discretization.

entry.title: Take It or Leave It: Intent-Controlled Partial Optimal Transport

author.name: Salil Parth Tripathi, Bertrand Chapron, Fabrice Collard, Nicolas Courty, Ronan Fablet

entry.summary: Introduces intent-controlled partial optimal transport (IC-POT) that replaces global mass rejection with pointwise rejection costs depending on side-specific reliability and geometry. Provides theoretical guarantees and practical algorithms.

entry.title: Code-Guided Reasoning for Small Language Models: Evaluating Executable MCQA Scaffolds

author.name: Prateek Biswas, Dhaval Patel, Vedant Khandelwal, Shuxin Lin, Amit Sheth

entry.summary: Introduces Code-Guided Reasoning (CGR), an evaluation protocol measuring when executable reasoning scaffolds improve small language model performance on multiple-choice QA. Standardizes the evaluation of code-augmented reasoning for SLMs.

entry.title: Bayesian Latent Space Models for Graphs Are Misspecified: Toward Robust Inference via Generalized Posteriors

author.name: Aldric Labarthe (CB, UNIGE)

entry.summary: Shows that Bayesian latent space models for networks are misspecified when geometry or link function assumptions are violated, causing overconfidence. Proposes Link-Sequential R-SafeBayes for adaptive posterior regularization exploiting dyadic independence.

entry.title: Robust Mitigation of Age-Dependent Confounding Effects via Sample-Difficulty Decorrelation

author.name: Nikhil Cherian Kurian, Victor Caquilpan Parra, Abin Shoby, Luke Whitbread, Lyle J. Palmer

entry.summary: Proposes a framework to mitigate age-dependent confounding in medical image classification by targeting spurious age-linked trends rather than enforcing strict age invariance. Uses sample difficulty characterization to decorrelate confounding effects.

entry.title: Scalable, Energy-Efficient Optical-Neural Architecture for Multiplexed Deepfake Video Detection

author.name: Parnian Ghapandar Kashani, Shiqi Chen, Aydogan Ozcan

entry.summary: Presents a hybrid digital-analog deepfake detection framework using optical computing with spatial light modulators. Processes 15+ video streams simultaneously in a single optical propagation pass for massively parallel inference.

entry.title: Tail Annealing for Heavy-Tailed Flow Matching

author.name: Jean Pachebat

entry.summary: Proposes 'tail annealing' for flow matching with heavy-tailed data: applying a soft-log transform per-coordinate before training and exponentiating after generation, with a Hill diagnostic deciding which coordinates to transform.

entry.title: Dual-Prompt CLIP with Hybrid Visual Encoders for Occluded Person Re-Identification

author.name: Zhangjian Ji, Shaotong Qiao, Kai Feng, Wei Wei

entry.summary: Proposes DPL-ReID for occluded person re-identification using dual prompt learning with CLIP, incorporating textual cues for pedestrian semantics and real-world occlusion augmentation.

entry.title: InterLight: Leveraging Intrinsic Illumination Priors for Low-Light Image Enhancement

author.name: Ziqi Wang, Xu Zhang, Laibin Chang, Shi Chen, Jiaqi Ma, Huan Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes InterLight for low-light image enhancement using intrinsic illumination priors based on Retinex theory. Constructs illumination-aware pipeline with sensor-level priors to avoid over-enhancement and color distortion.

entry.title: Adversarial Stress Testing of SPARK Humanoid Safety Filters

author.name: Saurav Ghosh, Abdou Sow, Luke Zhang

entry.summary: Studies the robustness of SPARK humanoid safety filters through replication and adversarial stress testing in MuJoCo, evaluating multiple safety filter algorithms (RSSA, RSSS, SSA, CBF, PFM, SMA) under harder conditions than standard benchmarks.

entry.title: D-CLING: Prior-Preserving Depth-Conditioned Fine-Tuning for Navigation Foundation Models

author.name: Shintaro Nakaoka, Takayuki Kanai, Kazuhito Tanaka

entry.summary: D-CLING proposes depth-conditioned fine-tuning for Navigation Foundation Models that preserves pre-trained generalization while improving obstacle avoidance and goal reaching in novel scenarios through depth conditioning and prior-preservation techniques.

entry.title: RoHIL: Robust Human-in-the-Loop Robotic Reinforcement Learning Against Illumination Variations

author.name: Shuoqin Zhang, Yixin Xiong, Xiru Gao, Kai Liu, Ke Wang, Xichuan Zhou, Zhe Hu

entry.summary: RoHIL addresses the collapse of human-in-the-loop RL policies when moved to new workstations with different lighting, using a world-model-based image relighter to re-synthesize training data under new illumination conditions without additional robot interaction.

entry.title: Formal Skill: Programmable Runtime Skills for Efficient and Accurate LLM Agents

author.name: Xi Zhang, Meijun Gao, Yuntian Zhao, Xinyu Tan, Yilun Yao, Feiyu Wang, Yanshu Wang, Dingsiyi, Tong Yang

entry.summary: Introduces Formal Skill, a runtime-native abstraction for LLM agents with JSON metadata, Python executors, hook-governed control logic, and skill-local state. Goes beyond informal Markdown-based skills.

entry.title: Beyond Rational Illusion: Behaviorally Realistic Strategic Classification

author.name: Xinpeng Lv, Yunxin Mao, Renzhe Xu, Chunyuan Zheng, Yikai Chen, Haoxuan Li, Yang Shi, Jinxuan Yang, Zhouchen Lin, Yuanlong Chen, Yuanxing Zhang, Shaowu Yang, Wenjing Yang, Haotian Wang

entry.summary: Defines behaviorally realistic strategic classification where agents' manipulations are shaped by cognitive biases (prospect theory). Proposes Prospect-Guided Strategic Classification.

entry.title: CogScale: Scalable Benchmark for Sequence Processing

author.name: Yannis Bendi-Ouis (Mnemosyne), Romain de Coudenhove (ENS-PSL), Xavier Hinaut (Mnemosyne)

entry.summary: Proposes CogScale, a benchmark of 14 scalable synthetic tasks designed to evaluate cognitive and memory abilities of sequence processing architectures at different parametrizable scales.

entry.title: CRAFT: Critic-Refined Adaptive Key-Frame Targeting for Multimodal Video Question Answering

author.name: Mahesh Bhosale, Abdul Wasi, Vishvesh Trivedi, Pengyu Yan, Akhil Gorugantu, David Doermann

entry.summary: Introduces CRAFT, a pipeline for multi-video question answering that combines dynamic keyframe selection, ASR with multilingual fallback, and a hybrid critic loop for claim verification. Achieves best performance on MAGMaR 2026.

entry.title: MANGO: Meta-Adaptive Network Gradient Optimization for Online Continual Learning

author.name: Ankita Awasthi, Marco Apolinario, Kaushik Roy

entry.summary: Proposes MANGO for online continual learning that uses meta-adaptive gradient optimization to balance stability and plasticity. Addresses limitations of replay-based methods through learned gradient modulation.

entry.title: Concept-Guided Noisy Negative Suppression for Zero-Shot Classification and Grounding of Chest X-Ray Findings

author.name: Chenyu Lian, Hong-Yu Zhou, Chun-Ka Wong, Jing Qin

entry.summary: Proposes CoNNS, a concept-guided noisy-negative suppression framework for vision-language alignment in chest X-ray analysis. Addresses the problem of similar findings across different patients being treated as negative pairs.

entry.title: A Two-Parameter Weibull Framework for Diagnosing Transformer Weight Distributions

author.name: Tiexin Ding

entry.summary: Applies Weibull distribution as a diagnostic framework for transformer weight magnitude distributions, revealing training dynamics patterns across 12 models from 7 architectural families and identifying anomalous layers.

entry.title: Smooth Partial Lotteries for Stable Randomized Selection

author.name: Alexander Goldberg, Giulia Fanti, Nihar B. Shah

entry.summary: Proposes smoothness (Lipschitz condition) as a design principle for partial lotteries used in competitive selection processes. Shows existing lottery designs are inherently unstable to small score changes and provides stable alternatives.

entry.title: Noise scheduling and linear dynamics in diffusion models on Lie groups

author.name: Javad Komijani

entry.summary: Investigates noise schedules in diffusion processes on Lie groups for lattice gauge theory applications. Shows that a specific schedule yields linear decay of Wilson action expectation, naturally arising from the Lie group structure without requiring explicit drift terms.

entry.title: A Unified Framework for Structure-Aware Clustering and Heterogeneous Causal Graph Learning

author.name: Honglin Du, Muxuan Liang, Xiang Zhong

entry.summary: Proposes DAG-DC-ADMM, a unified framework for jointly learning cluster assignments and cluster-specific causal DAG structures from heterogeneous populations. Uses groupwise truncated Lasso fusion penalty for subject clustering.

entry.title: LaCoVL-FER: Landmark-Guided Contrastive Learning Network with Vision-Language Enhancement for Facial Expression Recognition

author.name: Jiaxin Wang, Muwei Jian, Hui Yu, Junyu Dong, Yifan Xia

entry.summary: Proposes LaCoVL-FER for facial expression recognition integrating geometric priors from landmarks and semantic priors from vision-language models through contrastive learning.

entry.title: WoundFormer: Multi-Scale Spatial Feature Fusion for Multi-Class Wound Tissue Segmentation

author.name: Muhammad Ashad Kabir, Rabin Dulal

entry.summary: Proposes WoundFormer, a transformer-based framework for multi-class wound tissue segmentation using hierarchical spatial feature fusion. Replaces standard SegFormer decoder with spatially-preserving multi-scale architecture.

entry.title: Beyond Waypoints: Dual-Heatmap Grounding for Cross-Embodiment Semantic Navigation

author.name: Kaijie Yun, Yue Chen

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-heatmap representation for semantic navigation that predicts both a semantic target heatmap and a reachability heatmap, avoiding the failure modes of deterministic waypoint regression that often targets non-traversable locations.

entry.title: Position: Let's Develop Data Probes to Fundamentally Understand How Data Affects LLM Performance

author.name: Shiqiang Wang, Herbert Woisetschl\"ager, Hans Arno Jacobsen, Mingyue Ji

entry.summary: Position paper advocating for systematic 'data probes' - synthetic sequences from defined random processes - to understand how specific data characteristics drive LLM behavior across training, tuning, and alignment. Argues current approaches are compute-intensive and lack principled understanding.

entry.title: Agentic Trading: When LLM Agents Meet Financial Markets

author.name: Yihan Xia, Panpan You, Taotao Wang, Fang Liu, Han Qi, Xiaoxiao Wu, Shengli Zhang

entry.summary: Survey/evidence map of 77 studies on LLM-based trading agents, finding severe protocol incomparability: only 2/19 primary studies share enough methodology for direct comparison. Reframes LLM trading as expert-system decision pipelines.

entry.title: Streamlined Constraint Reasoning via CNN Pattern Recognition on Enumerated Solutions

author.name: Patrick Spracklen

entry.summary: Proposes using CNNs trained contrastively on enumerated solutions to detect structural patterns and automatically generate streamliner constraints for constraint programming.

entry.title: STAR: Semantic-Tuned and Tail-Adaptive Retriever for Graph-Augmented Generation

author.name: Shuai Li, Chen Huang, Duanyu Feng, Wenqiang Lei, See-Kiong Ng

entry.summary: Proposes STAR, a retriever for GraphRAG that addresses sparse semantic information in knowledge graphs through token-level interaction learning and tail-adaptive mechanisms. Identifies and mitigates Semantic Shortcut Bias and Long-Tail Path Bias in graph retrieval.

entry.title: Compositional Literary Primitives in Instruction-Tuned LLMs: Cross-Architectural SAE Features for Self, Style, and Affect

author.name: Joao Paulo Cavalcante Presa, Savio Salvarino Teles de Oliveira

entry.summary: Uses sparse autoencoders to identify compositional literary primitives in instruction-tuned LLMs (Llama 3.1, Gemma 2), finding feature classes for naming-gates, first-person register, stylistic modulators, and compositional emotions.

entry.title: FLUIDSPLAT: Reconstructing Physical Fields from Sparse Sensors via Gaussian Primitives

author.name: Huaxi Huang, Meng Li, Zhengqing Gao, Xi Zhou, Xiaoshui Huang, Xiao Sun

entry.summary: Introduces FLUIDSPLAT, using Gaussian Splatting-inspired primitives for reconstructing continuous flow fields from sparse sensors. Proves O(K^{-s/d}) approximation rate and demonstrates spatial interpretability.

entry.title: Prediction Is Not Physics: Learning and Evaluating Conserved Quantities in Neural Simulators

author.name: Andrew Bukowski, Aditya Kothari, Simba Shi, Ishir Rao

entry.summary: Shows that diffusion models trained on Hamiltonian trajectories can achieve low MSE but violate energy conservation by 4+ orders of magnitude. Demonstrates structured energy models can achieve R²≥0.9999 for conservation law discovery.

entry.title: Stability and Discretization Error of State Space Model Neural Operators

author.name: Abderrahim Bendahi, Adrien Fradin, Johan Peralez, Julie Digne, Madiha Nadri

entry.summary: Establishes theoretical guarantees for discretization error and stability of State Space Model neural operators for solving PDEs. Bridges the gap between continuous formulation and discrete numerical implementation in neural operator architectures.

entry.title: Automated Grading of Handwritten Mathematics Using Vision-Capable LLMs

author.name: Jacob Levine, Miguel Aenlle, Craig Zilles, Matthew West, Mariana Silva

entry.summary: Evaluates vision-capable LLMs for automated grading of handwritten mathematical work using instructor-defined rubrics. Tests reliability in authentic university STEM courses with photographic student submissions.

entry.title: GOAL: Graph-based Objective-Aligned Diffusion Solvers for Dynamic Multi-Objective Optimization

author.name: Xingyu Li

entry.summary: Proposes GOAL, a conditioned diffusion solver over relational graph representations for dynamic multi-objective optimization. Uses heterogeneous graph encoding with distinct edge types for different constraint classes.

entry.title: Are Rationales Necessary and Sufficient? Tuning LLMs for Explainable Misinformation Detection

author.name: Bing Wang, Rui Miao, Ximing Li, Chen Shen, Shaotian Yan, Changchun Li, Kaiyuan Liu, Xiaosong Yuan, Jieping Ye

entry.summary: Proposes a pipeline for fine-tuning LLMs for explainable misinformation detection, moving beyond prompt-based approaches to dedicated training with collected rationales.

entry.title: PAVE: A Cognitive Architecture for Legitimate Violation in Generative Agent Societies

author.name: Ahmad Yehia, Abduallah Mohamed, Kun Qian, Tianyi Wang, Jiseop Byeon, Omar Hassanin, Christian Claudel

entry.summary: Proposes PAVE, a cognitive architecture for LLM-based generative agents to reason about legitimate rule-violation in emergency scenarios. Includes perception, assessment, verdict, and emulation modules.

entry.title: EmbGen: Teaching with Reassembled Corpora

author.name: Arun K Lenin, Kai Rouse, Andrea Nicastro, Anna Leontjeva

entry.summary: Introduces EmbGen, a synthetic data generation pipeline that decomposes corpora into entity-description pairs and reassembles them using embedding similarity for generating training QA pairs through various sampling strategies.

entry.title: Resilient Byzantine Agreement with Predictions

author.name: Julien Dallot, Darya Melnyk, Tijana Milentijevic, Stefan Schmid, Patrik Welters

entry.summary: Studies Byzantine Agreement with predictor access, providing complete characterization of consistency-robustness trade-offs. Shows how algorithmic resilience can be improved when nodes have access to (potentially inaccurate) predictions about faulty behavior.

entry.title: CANINE: Coaching Visually Impaired Users for Interactive Navigation with a Robot Guide Dog

author.name: Cunjun Yu, Zishuo Wang, Anxing Xiao, Linfeng Li, David Hsu

entry.summary: Presents CANINE, an automated coaching system that trains visually impaired users to interact with robot guide dogs through personalized, adaptive verbal feedback using knowledge tracing and sub-skill decomposition.

entry.title: Operationalising Artificial Intelligence Bills of Materials (AIBOMs) for Verifiable AI Provenance and Lifecycle Assurance

author.name: Petar Radanliev, Omar Santos, Carsten Maple, Kay Atefi

entry.summary: Presents an AIBOM (AI Bill of Materials) schema extending CycloneDX for AI-specific provenance, model lineage, and cryptographic validation with autonomous agent-driven auditing.

entry.title: ST-TGExplainer: Disentangling Stability and Transition Patterns for Temporal GNN Interpretability

author.name: Hongjiang Chen, Xin Zheng, Pengfei Jiao, Huan Liu, Zhidong Zhao, Huaming Wu, Feng Xia, Shirui Pan

entry.summary: Proposes ST-TGExplainer for temporal graph neural network interpretability that disentangles stability patterns (previously seen interactions) from transition patterns (new interactions) for faithful explanations.

entry.title: StableGrad: Backward Scale Control without Batch Normalization

author.name: Jose I. Mestre, Alberto Fern\'andez-Hern\'andez, Cristian P\'erez-Corral, Manuel F. Dolz, Enrique S. Quintana-Ort\'i

entry.summary: Proposes StableGrad for controlling backward gradient scale without batch normalization, particularly useful for Physics-Informed Neural Networks where batch normalization is problematic.

entry.title: Learning with Foresight: Enhancing Neural Routing Policy via Multi-Node Lookahead Prediction

author.name: Xia Jiang, Yaoxin Wu, Yew-Soon Ong, Yingqian Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces Multi-node Lookahead Prediction (MnLP) for neural vehicle routing, training models to predict multiple future nodes simultaneously while maintaining inference-time efficiency through causal modules active only during training.

entry.title: k-Inductive Neural Barrier Certificates for Unknown Nonlinear Dynamics

author.name: Ben Wooding, Hongchao Zhang, Taylor T. Johnson, Abolfazl Lavaei

entry.summary: Proposes k-inductive neural barrier certificates for safety verification of partially unknown nonlinear systems, combining neural networks with data-driven methods to avoid the need for SMT solvers while providing formal safety guarantees.

entry.title: Safe Continual Reinforcement Learning under Nonstationarity via Adaptive Safety Constraints

author.name: Timofey Tomashevskiy

entry.summary: Proposes LILAC+, a framework for safe continual RL under nonstationarity combining context-based safety constraints, adaptation-speed constraints, and budget-to-state safety enforcement.

entry.title: Navigating the Emotion Tree: Hierarchical Hyperbolic RAG for Multimodal Emotion Recognition

author.name: Zeheng Wang, Bo Zhao, Yijie Zhu, Zhishu Liu, Hui Ma, Ruixin Zhang, Shouhong Ding, Qianyu Xie, Zitong Yu

entry.summary: Proposes HyperEmo-RAG, a retrieval-augmented framework for multimodal emotion recognition that uses hierarchical hyperbolic embeddings to capture the taxonomic structure of emotions and a knowledge base to reduce over-interpretation of noisy cues.

entry.title: Understanding Dynamics of Adam in Zero-Sum Games: An ODE Approach

author.name: Yi Feng, Weiming Ou, Xiao Wang

entry.summary: Derives ODEs as continuous-time limits of the Adam descent-ascent optimizer for zero-sum games, providing a tractable framework for analyzing local convergence and implicit gradient regularization. The approach reveals distinct roles of first- and second-moment estimates in game dynamics.

entry.title: Fast Tensorization of Neural Networks via Slice-wise Feature Distillation

author.name: Safa Hamreras, Sukhbinder Singh, Rom\'an Or\'us

entry.summary: Proposes slice-wise feature distillation for neural network tensorization, decomposing networks into independently compressed slices rather than requiring costly global finetuning. Achieves near-lossless compression on ResNet-34 with reduced data requirements.

entry.title: CAMERA: Adapting to Semantic Camouflage in Unsupervised Text-Attributed Graph Fraud Detection

author.name: Junjun Pan, Yixin Liu, Yu Zheng, Lianhua Chi, Alan Wee-Chung Liew, Shirui Pan

entry.summary: Proposes CAMERA for detecting fraudsters who use semantic camouflage (mimicking legitimate users' text) on social platforms. Uses an ego-decoupled mixture-of-experts framework for unsupervised detection without labeled fraud data.

entry.title: Variational Diffusion Channel Decoder

author.name: Chengwei Zhang, Yifan Du, Siyu Liao

entry.summary: Proposes a variational diffusion model-based channel decoder that integrates belief propagation with diffusion models for error-correcting codes. Aims to reduce computational complexity of neural decoders while maintaining learning capability.

entry.title: Precision Physical Activity Prescription via Reinforcement Learning for Functional Actions

author.name: Gefei Lin, Rui Miao, Jennifer Sacheck, Xiaoke Zhang

entry.summary: Develops an offline RL algorithm for personalized physical activity prescriptions using daily step distributions as functional actions. Applied to the All of Us Research Program data for cardiometabolic risk optimization.

entry.title: Factor Augmented High-Dimensional SGD

author.name: Shubo Li, Yuefeng Han, Xiufan Yu

entry.summary: Proposes Factor-Augmented SGD (FSGD) that leverages latent factor representations in streaming high-dimensional learning. Provides theoretical framework incorporating factor estimation error into SGD convergence analysis.

entry.title: Boosting Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Core Token Attention-Based Seed Selection

author.name: Yunzhe Zhang, Hongfu Liu, Pengyu Hong

entry.summary: Introduces a training-free method (ABSS) that selects optimal random seeds for text-to-image diffusion models by analyzing cross-attention dynamics over content-bearing tokens in early denoising steps. This addresses the well-known seed sensitivity problem without modifying the model or noise.

entry.title: Gaussian Approximation and Multiplier Bootstrap for Federated Linear Stochastic Approximation

author.name: Ilya Levin, Maksim Shuklin, Eric Moulines, Paul Mangold, Sergey Samsonov

entry.summary: Establishes Berry-Esseen bounds for federated linear stochastic approximation, quantifying effects of local step size, number of local updates, and heterogeneity on convergence. Develops an online multiplier bootstrap for inference on the last iterate.

entry.title: LLMEval-Logic: A Solver-Verified Chinese Benchmark for Logical Reasoning of LLMs with Adversarial Hardening

author.name: Ming Zhang, Qiyuan Peng, Yinxi Wei, Yujiong Shen, Kexin Tan, Yuhui Wang, Zhenghao Xiang, Junjie Ye, Zhangyue Yin, Zhiheng Xi, Shihan Dou, Tao Gui, Maxm Pan, Ruizhi Yang, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang

entry.summary: Presents LLMEval-Logic, a Chinese logical reasoning benchmark with Z3-verified answers, expert-audited formalizations, and adversarial hardening that current frontier models struggle with.

entry.title: Language Mutations Sustain the Persistences of Conspiracy Theories on Social Media

author.name: Calvin Yixiang Cheng, Dorian Quelle, Scott A. Hale

entry.summary: Studies how language mutations (semantic, psycholinguistic, and structural changes) affect the persistence of conspiracy theories on social media, finding that greater semantic mutations substantially extend conspiracy claim lifespans.

entry.title: Personalized Face Privacy Protection From a Single Image

author.name: Zachary Yahn, Fatih Ilhan, Tiansheng Huang, Selim Tekin, Sihao Hu, Yichang Xu, Margaret Loper, Ling Liu

entry.summary: Proposes FaceCloak, a system generating personalized face privacy masks from a single image that causes facial recognition to fail, using synthetic face generation and iterative perturbation learning focused on key identity-leakage regions.

entry.title: iDiff: Interpretable Difference-aware Framework for Pairwise Image Quality Assessment

author.name: Xinli Yue, JianHui Sun, Tao Shao, Liangchao Yao, Fan Xia, Yuetang Deng

entry.summary: Proposes iDiff for pairwise image quality assessment with interpretable reasoning, using a dual-branch design with Answer Model and Thinking Model. Developed for the NTIRE 2026 RAIM challenge.

entry.title: Physics-informed simulation framework for realistic sonar image generation and statistical validation

author.name: Kamal Basha S, Athira Nambiar

entry.summary: Presents ACOUSIM, a physics-informed framework for generating and validating synthetic sonar imagery. Uses Gazebo-based simulation with explicit physical controls and quantitative statistical validation against real sonar datasets.

entry.title: CLUE: Adaptively Prioritized Contextual Cues by Leveraging a Unified Semantic Map for Effective Zero-Shot Object-Goal Navigation

author.name: Taeyun Kim, Alvin Jinsung Choi, Dasol Hong, Hyun Myung

entry.summary: CLUE is a zero-shot object-goal navigation framework that adaptively balances room-level and object-level contextual cues using LLM commonsense knowledge, building a unified semantic map for more efficient exploration.

entry.title: Fast Spawn\&Prune (FS\&P): Global convergence of stochastic conic particle gradient descent via birth/death process

author.name: Yohann De Castro (ICJ, ECL, IUF, PSPM), S\'ebastien Gadat (TSE-R, IUF), Cl\'ement Marteau (ICJ, UCBL, PSPM)

entry.summary: Introduces Fast Spawn&Prune (FS&P), a stochastic algorithm combining Conic Particle Gradient Descent with a birth-death process for global optimization of the BLASSO objective, proving almost-sure global convergence.

entry.title: Implications Of Predicting The Next Token

author.name: jdp

entry.summary: Explains why 'predict the next token' is fundamentally different from Markov chains, arguing that effective next-token prediction requires building rich internal representations of meaning, causality, and world structure to actually minimize loss.

entry.title: PixVerve: Advancing Native UHR Image Generation to 100MP with a Large-Scale High-Quality Dataset

author.name: Haojun Chen, Haoyang He, Chengming Xu, Qingdong He, Junwei Zhu, Yabiao Wang, Zhucun Xue, Xianfang Zeng, Zhennan Chen, Xiaobin Hu, Hao Zhao, Yong Liu, Jiangning Zhang, Dacheng Tao

entry.summary: Introduces PixVerve-95K, a large-scale UHR text-to-image dataset with 95K images at 100MP minimum, and takes steps toward native ultra-high-resolution image generation. First work pushing T2I to 100MP resolution.

entry.title: Towards Multi-Model LLM Schedulers: Empirical Insights into Offloading and Preemption

author.name: Mert Yildiz, Pietro Spadaccino, Alexey Rolich, Francesca Cuomo, Andrea Baiocchi

entry.summary: Empirical study of multi-model LLM scheduling on shared hardware, examining performance implications of layer offloading between CPU/GPU and preemption under memory constraints.

entry.title: Pseudocode-Guided Structured Reasoning for Automating Reliable Inference in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Weicong Ni, Tianbao Jiang, Linlin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes PStar, a pseudocode-guided structured reasoning framework for Vision-Language Models in robotic automation. Adaptively selects reasoning paths to reduce hallucinations in physical deployments.

entry.title: M3DocDep: Multi-modal, Multi-page, Multi-document Dependency Chunking with Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Joongmin Shin, Jeongbae Park, Jaehyung Seo, Heuiseok Lim

entry.summary: Proposes M3DocDep, a vision-language model pipeline for chunking multi-page industrial documents by recovering block-level dependencies (parent-child relations, figure-caption bindings) before constructing chunks along the document tree.

entry.title: Symmetry in the Wild: The Role of Equivariance in Neural Fluid Surrogates

author.name: Patryk Rygiel, Julian Suk, Kak Khee Yeung, Christoph Brune, Jelmer M. Wolterink

entry.summary: Investigates when group-equivariant architectures help vs. hurt for neural fluid simulation surrogates. Finds that equivariance can be detrimental when datasets have strong distributional alignment that breaks symmetry.

entry.title: Fine-Grained Benchmark Generation for Comprehensive Evaluation of Foundation Models

author.name: Mohammed Saidul Islam, Negin Baghbanzadeh, Farnaz Kohankhaki, Afshin Cheraghi, Ali Kore, Shayaan Mehdi, Elham Dolatabadi, Arash Afkanpour

entry.summary: Introduces a framework for automated benchmark generation using multi-agent architectures and solution-graph-driven strategies. Generates benchmarks in ML, Corporate Finance, and Personal Finance with improved ground-truth reliability.

entry.title: CounterFlow: A Two-Phase Inference-Time Sampling for Counterfactual Video Foley Generation

author.name: Gyubin Lee, Junwon Lee, Juhan Nam

entry.summary: Investigates counterfactual video foley generation where the sound source contradicts visual evidence. Proposes CounterFlow, an inference-time sampling scheme for flow-matching video-to-audio models that separates temporal structure from timbre.

entry.title: SynGR: Unleashing the Potential of Cross-Modal Synergy for Generative Recommendation

author.name: Wei Chen, Xingyu Guo, Shuang Li, Fuwei Zhang, Meng Yuan, Jing Fan, Zhao Zhang, Deqing Wang, Fuzhen Zhuang

entry.summary: Proposes SynGR for generative recommendation that captures synergistic cross-modal information beyond simple alignment-centric fusion. Targets emergent item properties that cannot be inferred from single modalities alone.

entry.title: Toward an AI-Powered Computational Testbed for Workforce Policy

author.name: Sumer S. Vaid, Ashley V. Whillans

entry.summary: Proposes using LLM-powered generative agents seeded with HR records and psychometric measures to simulate employee responses to workforce policy changes, creating a computational testbed for workforce transformation.

entry.title: Knowing When Not to Predict: Self Supervised Learning and Abstention for Safer DR Screening

author.name: Muskaan Chopra, Lorenz Sparrenberg, Jan H. Terheyden, Rafet Sifa

entry.summary: Studies how SSL pretraining length influences calibrated confidence and abstention in diabetic retinopathy screening. Shows SSL pretraining improves selective prediction for safety-critical medical imaging.

entry.title: Toward User Comprehension Supports for LLM Agent Skill Specifications

author.name: Zikai Alex Wen

entry.summary: Studies comprehension supports in LLM agent skill specifications (SKILL.md files). Finds only 2.3% of 878 cybersecurity skills exhibit cues for all four comprehension anchors, suggesting users may have poor expectations.

entry.title: Targeted Downstream-Agnostic Attack

author.name: Zhuxin Lei, Ziyuan Yang, Yi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes targeted downstream-agnostic adversarial attacks on pre-trained encoders under a stricter threat model requiring both targeted and downstream-agnostic attacks, which is more challenging since the downstream task is unknown.

entry.title: Lens Privacy Sealing: A New Benchmark and Method for Physical Privacy-Preserving Action Recognition

author.name: Mengyuan Liu, Ziyi Wang, Peiming Li, Junsong Yuan

entry.summary: Proposes Lens Privacy Sealing, a physical hardware solution using laminating film over camera lenses to provide pre-sensor privacy protection for action recognition. Introduces the P³AR dataset with 114K videos.

entry.title: P2DNav: Panorama-to-Downview Reasoning for Zero-shot Vision-and-Language Navigation

author.name: Kai Sheng, Liuyi Wang, Haojie Dai, Jinlong Li, Yongrui Qin, Zongtao He, Chengju Liu, Qijun Chen

entry.summary: Proposes P2DNav for zero-shot vision-and-language navigation, decomposing decisions hierarchically into panoramic direction selection and downview-based precise navigation, avoiding waypoint prediction modules.

entry.title: A Framework for Evaluating Zero-Shot Image Generation in Concept-based Explainability

author.name: Giacomo Astolfi, Matteo Bianchi, Riccardo Campi, Antonio De Santis, Marco Brambilla

entry.summary: Investigates using zero-shot text-to-image models to generate synthetic concept datasets for concept-based XAI, evaluating faithfulness through multiple analyses comparing synthetic to real concepts.

entry.title: Training Neural Networks with Optimal Double-Bayesian Learning

author.name: Vy Bui, Hang Yu, Karthik Kantipudi, Ziv Yaniv, Stefan Jaeger

entry.summary: Proposes a double-Bayesian framework for learning rate selection involving two antagonistic Bayesian processes, deriving theoretically optimal learning rates for SGD.

entry.title: Emergence of a Flow-Assisted Casting Strategy for Olfactory Navigation via Memory-Augmented Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Changxu Zhao, Dongxiao Zhao, Xin Bian, Gaojin Li

entry.summary: Shows that RL agents in unsteady flows develop flow-assisted casting strategies for odor navigation, with non-monotonic dependence on memory length that reveals an optimal integration window.

entry.title: Descriptive versus Regulatory Uncertainty in Bounded Predictive Systems

author.name: Ahmed Gamal Eldin

entry.summary: Introduces a formal distinction between descriptive uncertainty (doesn't affect policy) and regulatory uncertainty (drives adaptive restructuring) in bounded predictive systems, proving transformers are confined to descriptive uncertainty at inference.

entry.title: An Exterior Method for Nonnegative Matrix Factorization

author.name: Qiujing Lu, Tonmoy Monsoor, Ehsan Ebrahimzadeh, Kartik Sharma, Vwani Roychowdhury

entry.summary: Proposes an exterior method for NMF that separates low-rank approximation from nonnegativity enforcement, initializing from optimal unconstrained factorization and rotating toward the nonnegative orthant.

entry.title: Implicit Bias of Mirror Flow in Homogeneous Neural Networks: Sparse and Dense Feature Learning

author.name: Tom Jacobs, Guido Montufar

entry.summary: Studies max-margin solutions of mirror flow in deep networks with homogeneous activations, deriving novel balance equations and convergence characterizations. Demonstrates that distinct mirror maps can induce the same max-margin solution and identifies extremely slow convergence regimes.

entry.title: Normative Networks for Source Separation via Local Plasticity and Dendritic Computation

author.name: Bariscan Bozkurt, Efe Ali Gorguner, Francesco Innocenti, Rafal Bogacz

entry.summary: Proposes Predictive Entropy Maximization for blind source separation using only local weight updates, making it biologically plausible. Avoids complex nonlocal recurrent dynamics while achieving competitive BSS performance.

entry.title: D$^3$-Subsidy: Online and Sequential Driver Subsidy Decision-Making for Large-Scale Ride-Hailing Market

author.name: Taijie Chen, Rui Su, Siyuan Feng, Laoming Zhang, Hongyang Zhang, Haijiao Wang, Zhaofeng Ma, Jintao Ke

entry.summary: Introduces D³-Subsidy for large-scale ride-hailing driver subsidy optimization at DiDi, combining online sequential decision-making with strict budget constraints and low-latency execution. Addresses real production deployment challenges.

entry.title: EgoTraj: Real-World Egocentric Human Trajectory Dataset for Multimodal Prediction

author.name: Ahmad Yehia, Abduallah Mohamed, Tianyi Wang, Jiseop Byeon, Kun Qian, Junfeng Jiao, Christian Claudel

entry.summary: Introduces EgoTraj, an egocentric multimodal dataset recorded with Meta Quest Pro containing 75 sequences of human navigation in urban environments with synchronized RGB video, 6-DoF head poses, and 3D eye gaze vectors.

entry.title: Information Processing Capacity of Stationary Physical Systems: Theory, Data-efficient Estimation Methods, and Photonic Demonstration

author.name: Rahul Uma Ramachandran, Serge Massar

entry.summary: Extends the Information Processing Capacity framework to stationary physical computing systems, proving bounds on individual capacities and their sums. Introduces data-efficient estimation methods and demonstrates on a photonic computing system.

entry.title: Density-Ratio Losses for Post-Hoc Learning to Defer

author.name: Alexander Soen, Ragnar Thobaben, Joakim Jald\'en, Richard Nock

entry.summary: Studies post-hoc Learning to Defer through density-ratio estimation, deriving losses that allow deferral decisions via thresholding without retraining. Recovers Chow's rule as a special case and connects to expert-tilted Bayes posteriors.

entry.title: KoRe: Compact Knowledge Representations for Large Language Models

author.name: Davide Cavicchini, Fausto Giunchiglia, Jacopo Staiano

entry.summary: Proposes KoRe, compact knowledge representations for LLMs using knowledge graphs that avoid extensive retraining or finetuning, addressing hallucination and opacity of parametric knowledge storage.

entry.title: D-Convexity: A Unified Differentiable Convex Shape Prior via Quasi-Concavity for Data-driven Image Segmentation

author.name: Shengzhe Chen, Hao Yan

entry.summary: Proposes D-Convexity, a unified differentiable convex shape prior based on quasi-concavity of mask functions, enabling end-to-end trainable convexity constraints for segmentation through local differentiable inequalities.

entry.title: Cardiac fat segmentation using computed tomography and an image-to-image conditional generative adversarial neural network

author.name: Guilherme Santos da Silva, Dalcimar Casanova, Jefferson Tales Oliva, Erick Oliveira Rodrigues

entry.summary: Presents a deep learning methodology using conditional GANs for autonomous segmentation of cardiac fat deposits from CT images. Aims to replace manual segmentation workflows in clinical practice.

entry.title: Automatically Improving Simulation Physics for Articulated Objects

author.name: Anh-Quan Pham

entry.summary: Thesis work on automatically improving simulation physics for articulated objects by defining 'interaction-readiness' and proposing a framework to systematically evaluate and fix physical properties needed for stable robotic manipulation simulation.

entry.title: Bilateral Teleoperation with Compliant 6-DOF Pose-and-Force Sensing

author.name: Yue Feng, Weicheng Huang, I-Ming Chen

entry.summary: Presents a bilateral teleoperation framework using a low-cost compliant 6-DOF pose-and-force sensing end-effector (Delta6) on both leader and follower sides, eliminating the need for expensive rigid force/torque sensors through a hardware-agnostic middleware.

entry.title: MCNav: Memory-Aware Dynamic Cognitive Map for Zero-shot Goal-oriented Navigation

author.name: Jingyu Li, Zhe Liu, Wenxiao Wu, Li Zhang

entry.summary: MCNav proposes memory-aware navigation with a dynamic cognitive map that stores queryable information about objects in explored areas, addressing the common failure mode of missing targets in previously visited regions during zero-shot navigation.

entry.title: Semi-Parametric Bayesian Additive Regression Trees for Risk Prediction with High-Dimensional Epigenetic Signatures and Low-Dimensional Covariates

author.name: Saurabh Bhandari, Brian C. -H. Chiu, Parveen Bhatti, Yuan Ji

entry.summary: Proposes semi-parametric BART (spBART) that separates low-dimensional clinical covariates into a parametric component from high-dimensional epigenetic data modeled nonparametrically, enabling interpretable effect estimation alongside strong prediction.

entry.title: Memory-Augmented Reinforcement Learning Agent for CAD Generation

author.name: Yin Xiaolong, Liu Yu, Shen Jiahang, Lu Xingyu, Ni Jingzhe, Fan Fengxiao, Sang Fan

entry.summary: Proposes a memory-augmented reinforcement learning framework for CAD model generation agents, with structured toolchains and closed-loop error correction for complex operation sequences.

entry.title: AgentNLQ: A General-Purpose Agent for Natural Language to SQL

author.name: Olena Bogdanov, Yeunji Jung, Chandra Dhir, Pareekshitreddy Gaddam, Saurabh Jain, Lakshmi Tumati, Vijay Parthasarathy, Anup Shirgaonkar

entry.summary: Presents AgentNLQ, a multi-agent NL2SQL system achieving 78.1% semantic accuracy on the BIRD benchmark. Uses semantically enriched schema representations and business rules to improve query generation.

entry.title: EMO-BOOST: Emotion-Augmented Audio-Visual Features for Improved Generalization in Deepfake Detection

author.name: Aritra Marik, Marcel Klemt, Anna Rohrbach

entry.summary: Proposes EMO-BOOST, a multimodal deepfake detection framework using emotional cues as high-level semantic features to improve generalization to unseen manipulation types.

entry.title: EngiAI: A Multi-Agent Framework and Benchmark Suite for LLM-Driven Engineering Design

author.name: Gioele Molinari, Florian Felten, Soheyl Massoudi, Mark Fuge

entry.summary: Introduces EngiAI, a multi-agent framework and benchmark for LLM-driven engineering design with three evaluation dimensions: workflow, RAG, and HPC orchestration benchmarks.

entry.title: Improving Retrieval-Augmented Generation without Taxonomy-based Error Categorization

author.name: Gongbo Zhang, Yifan Peng, Chunhua Weng

entry.summary: Proposes RePAIR, a response-action learning paradigm that improves RAG without explicit error categorization. Directly maps flawed responses to corrective actions, bypassing potentially unreliable taxonomy-based critic feedback.

entry.title: Lost and Found in Translation: Variational Diagnostics for Neural Codebook Channels

author.name: Yusuke Hayashi

entry.summary: Introduces a neural codebook channel diagnostic for VAEs that checks whether the decoder reads each latent code under the encoder's convention. Bounds off-diagonal mass by an architecture-dependent quantity.

entry.title: Distributional Energy-Based Models for Uncertainty-Aware Structured LLM Reasoning

author.name: Shireen Kudukkil Manchingal, Abhey Kalia, Fernanda Gon\c{c}alves, Shebin Rawther

entry.summary: Proposes decomposed energy functions combining learned quality scorers with deterministic constraint penalties for verifying structured LLM outputs. Uses heterogeneous ensemble of LoRA adapters for uncertainty-driven regeneration.

entry.title: Don't Let Bandit Feedback Pull Continual LLM-Recommender Updates Off Target

author.name: Taesan Kim, Hyeongjun Yun, Jaegul Choo, Chung Park

entry.summary: Proposes ABPO framework for continual LLM recommender updates that handles bandit feedback bias by inserting exposed recommendations as logged anchors in GRPO rollout groups, addressing exposure bias and feedback ambiguity.

entry.title: Dynamic Model Merging Made Slim

author.name: Guodong Du, Wanyu Lin

entry.summary: Proposes DiDi-Merging, a dynamic model merging framework using differentiable rank allocation to balance shared and expert parameters. Includes data-free refinement step for recovering lost information.

entry.title: SCAFDS: Edge-Feature Graph Attention for Interbank Fraud Detection with Attribution-Grounded SAR Generation

author.name: Mohammad Nasir Uddin

entry.summary: Introduces SCAFDS, a seven-stage fraud detection system that models fraud propagation across interbank networks using graph attention with edge features, and generates forensically traceable SAR narratives for regulatory compliance.

entry.title: HypergraphFormer: Learning Hypergraphs from LLMs for Editable Floor Plan Generation

author.name: Nikita Klimenko, Hesam Salehipour, Parham Eftekhar, Amir Khasahmadi, Ramon Elias Weber

entry.summary: Proposes HypergraphFormer, which uses LLMs to generate hypergraph-based textual representations for floor plan generation. Trained via supervised fine-tuning to encode spatial relationships and connectivity.

entry.title: Neural Operators for Design-Space Surrogate Modeling of Tendon-Actuated Continuum Robots

author.name: Branden Frieden, James M. Ferguson, Alan Kuntz, Varun Shankar

entry.summary: Formulates surrogate modeling for tendon-driven continuum robots as an operator learning problem, enabling single models to generalize across robot designs rather than training per-robot models.

entry.title: Bridge: Retrieval-Augmented Spatiotemporal Modeling for Urban Delivery Demand

author.name: Yihong Tang, Tong Nie, Junlin He, Qianjun Huang, Dingyi Zhuang, Lijun Sun

entry.summary: Proposes Bridge, a retrieval-augmented spatiotemporal graph framework for urban delivery demand forecasting that handles cold-start regions by retrieving similar region-time windows from a time-aware memory.

entry.title: KappaPlace: Learning Hyperspherical Uncertainty for Visual Place Recognition via Prototype-Anchored Supervision

author.name: Maya Yanko, Yoli Shavit

entry.summary: Proposes KappaPlace for uncertainty-aware visual place recognition using von Mises-Fisher distributions on hyperspheres. Learns a concentration parameter as a proxy for aleatoric uncertainty without needing negative mining.

entry.title: Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models: Benchmarks, Architectures, Evaluation, and Open Challenges

author.name: Husnain Amjad, Raja Khurram Shahzad, Aamir Shahzad, Mehwish Fatima

entry.summary: Survey paper synthesizing advances in mathematical reasoning with LLMs through analysis of ~120 studies, covering datasets, architectures, training strategies, and evaluation protocols.

entry.title: FLUXtrapolation: A benchmark on extrapolating ecosystem fluxes

author.name: Anya Fries, Jacob A Nelson, Martin Jung, Markus Reichstein, Jonas Peters

entry.summary: Introduces FLUXtrapolation, a benchmark for extrapolating ecosystem fluxes under distribution shifts for carbon/water/energy cycle estimation, framing flux upscaling as a domain generalization problem.

entry.title: CADENet: Condition-Adaptive Asynchronous Dual-Stream Enhancement Network for Adverse Weather Perception in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Sherif Khairy, Catherine M. Elias

entry.summary: Presents CADENet, a training-free three-thread system for adverse weather object detection in autonomous driving, with separate threads for real-time detection, quality assessment, and enhancement.

entry.title: Fast and Featureless Node Representation Learning with Partial Pairwise Supervision

author.name: Sujan Chakraborty, Saptarshi Bej

entry.summary: Introduces Contrastive FUSE for fast node representation learning in featureless graphs with partial pairwise labels, combining spectral contrastive objectives with community-aware structural signals.

entry.title: StruMPL: Multi-task Dense Regression under Disjoint Partial Supervision and MNAR Labels

author.name: Reza M. Asiyabi, Juan Alberto Molina-Valero, The SEOSAW Partnership, Steven Hancock, Casey M. Ryan

entry.summary: Proposes StruMPL for multi-task dense regression with disjoint partial supervision and missing-not-at-random labels, applied to forest biomass estimation from heterogeneous Earth observation data.

entry.title: Accurate Evaluation of Quickest Changepoint Detectors via Non-parametric Survival Analysis

author.name: Taiki Miyagawa, Akinori F. Ebihara

entry.summary: Proposes non-parametric estimators (KM-ARL and KM-ADD) for quickest changepoint detection metrics under finite and irregular sequence lengths, drawing on survival analysis methodology with proven asymptotic unbiasedness.

entry.title: INAR-VL: Input-Aware Routing for Edge-Cloud Vision-Language Inference

author.name: Ahmed \v{S}abanovi\'c, Paul Joe Maliakel, Ivona Brandi\'c

entry.summary: Presents INAR-VL, a lightweight edge-cloud routing system for vision-language model inference that uses image and text complexity signals to route simple queries locally and offload complex ones to cloud.

entry.title: FedMental: Evaluating Federated Learning for Mental Health Detection from Social Media Data

author.name: Nuredin Ali Abdelkadir, Anjali Ratnam, Zeerak Talat, Stevie Chancellor

entry.summary: Evaluates federated learning and differentially private FL for mental health detection from social media, simulating realistic non-IID settings with each user as a client, finding performance gaps compared to centralized training.

entry.title: CLIC: Contextual Language-Informed Cardiac Pathology Classification

author.name: Giovani D. Lucafo, Rafael da Costa Silva, Jo\~ao Lucas Luz Lima Sarcinelli, Andre Guarnier De Mitri, Diego Furtado Silva

entry.summary: Proposes CLIC, a method for ECG cardiac pathology classification that integrates technical metadata and demographic variables through language-informed contextual conditioning, going beyond signal-only analysis.

entry.title: From Simple to Complex: Curriculum-Guided Physics-Informed Neural Networks via Gaussian Mixture Models

author.name: Jianan Yang, Yiran Wang, Shuai Li, Fujun Cao, Xuefei Yan, Junmin Liu

entry.summary: Proposes CGMPINN, combining Gaussian mixture modeling with curriculum learning for physics-informed neural networks, progressively shifting training focus from easy to harder spatial regions based on PDE residual distributions.

entry.title: Exploiting Non-Negativity in DAG Structure Learning

author.name: Samuel Rey, Madeline navarro, Gonzalo Mateos

entry.summary: Exploits non-negative edge weight constraints in DAG structure learning to obtain simplified optimization problems. Shows that the non-negativity restriction enables better-behaved optimization landscapes for causal graph discovery.

entry.title: TrajTok: Adaptive Spatial Tokenization for Trajectory Representation Learning

author.name: Zhen Xiong, Shang-Ling Hsu, Cyrus Shahabi

entry.summary: Presents TrajTok, a trajectory encoder using multi-resolution hexagonal tokenization and factorized transformer with cross-attention for learning transferable GPS trajectory embeddings. Handles noise and irregular sampling through adaptive spatial discretization.

entry.title: Hyrax: An Extensible Framework for Rapid ML Experimentation and Unsupervised Discovery in the Era of Rubin, Roman, and Euclid

author.name: Aritra Ghosh, Drew Oldag, Michael Tauraso, Andrew J. Connolly, Peter Ferguson, Derek Jones, Gourav Khullar, Argyro Sasli, Samarth Venkatesh, Gracia Wang, Maxine West, Dylan Berry, Neven Caplar, Colin Orion Chandler, Tanawan Chatchadanoraset, Michael W. Coughlin, Melissa DeLucchi, Alexandra Junell, Diego Miura, Felipe Fontinele Nunes, Wilson Beebe, Doug Branton, Sandro Campos, Liam Cunningham, Mi Dai, Jeremy Kubica, Konstantin Malanchev, Rachel Mandelbaum, Sean McGuire, Imad Pasha, Dan S. Taranu, Tianqing Zhang

entry.summary: Presents Hyrax, an open-source ML framework for astronomy supporting the full lifecycle from data acquisition to inference, with capabilities for multimodal datasets, vector databases, and latent-space exploration. Designed for next-generation survey telescopes.

entry.title: Learning Interpretable Point-Based Clinical Risk Scores via Direct Optimization

author.name: Ying Cui, Albert M Li, Vivek Charu, Yeon-Mi Hwang, Tina Hernandez-Boussard, Lu Tian

entry.summary: Proposes direct optimization of integer-weighted clinical risk scores as an alternative to regression-then-rounding approaches. Addresses the computational challenges of integer programming while maintaining interpretability of point-based scores.

entry.title: Activation Functions, Statistics and Learning of Higher-Order Interactions in Restricted Boltzmann Machines

author.name: Giovanni di Sarra, Yasser Roudi

entry.summary: Analyzes how different activation functions in Restricted Boltzmann Machines induce different higher-order interaction statistics. Characterizes the space of representable models analytically through moments of induced interaction distributions.

entry.title: MAM-CLIP: Vision-Language Pretraining on Mammography Atlases for BI-RADS Classification

author.name: Halil Ibrahim Gulluk, Olivier Gevaert

entry.summary: Proposes MAM-CLIP using vision-language pretraining on mammography atlas image-caption pairs for BI-RADS classification. Uses contrastive learning with PubMedBERT to transfer rich caption information to the vision encoder.

entry.title: Inferring Sensitive Attributes from Knowledge Graph Embeddings: Attack and Defense Strategies

author.name: Yasmine Hayder (PETSCRAFT)

entry.summary: Investigates privacy risks in knowledge graph embeddings by demonstrating attribute inference attacks and proposing defense strategies that balance privacy protection with utility preservation.

entry.title: Convergence of Consensus-Based Particle Methods for Nonconvex Bi-Level Optimization

author.name: Yutong Chao, Xudong Sun, Konstantin Riedl, Majid Khadiv, Jalal Etesami

entry.summary: Studies consensus-based particle methods for nonconvex bi-level optimization, providing convergence guarantees for both mean-field dynamics and finite-particle approximations using smooth quantile selection with Gibbs-type approximation.

entry.title: K-Quantization and its Impact on Output Performance

author.name: Robin Baki Davidsson, Pierre Nugues

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates the impact of k-quantization (2-6 bit) on eight LLMs across knowledge, code comprehension, and reading tasks, finding consistent quality degradation below 4-bit precision.

entry.title: CLIF: Concept-Level Influence Functions for Transparent Bottleneck Models

author.name: Yike Sun, Mingkun Xu, Mu You, Zhongzhi He, Henghua Shen, Zehan Tan, Derek F. Wong, Tao Fang

entry.summary: Proposes using influence functions for concept-level interpretability in NLP models, demonstrating that model performance can be restored by adjusting labels/weights of impactful training samples without retraining.

entry.title: Text-to-SPARQL Generation with Reinforcement Learning: A GRPO-based Approach on DBLP

author.name: Jann Pfeifer, Debayan Banerjee, Ricardo Usbeck

entry.summary: Applies GRPO reinforcement learning with execution-based rewards to train a small 1.7B model for zero-shot Text-to-SPARQL generation on DBLP, using structural and answer-level rewards without gold query annotations.

entry.title: X-Ray cardiac angiographic vessel segmentation based on pixel classification using machine learning and region growing

author.name: E O Rodrigues, L O Rodrigues, J J Lima, D Casanova, F Favarim, E R Dosciatti, V Pegorini, L S N Oliveira, F F C Morais

entry.summary: Proposes a pixel-classification approach for vessel segmentation in X-ray angiograms using Random Forests with textural features and region-growing-controlled classification (ELEMENT methodology).

entry.title: AnchorFlow: Editable SVG Reconstruction via Sparse Anchor Point Fields

author.name: Mengnan Jiang, Christian Franke, Michele Franco Adesso, Antonio Haas, Grace Li Zhang

entry.summary: AnchorFlow proposes a method for image-to-SVG reconstruction that focuses on optimizing anchor point placement on Bezier curves rather than path count or point density, addressing the fundamental trade-off between fidelity and editability in vector graphics generation.

entry.title: CosFly: Plan in the Matrix, Fly in the World

author.name: Hanxuan Chen, Xiangyue Wang, Songsheng Cheng, Ruilong Ren, Jie Zheng, Shuai Yuan, Tianle Zeng, Hanzhong Guo, Binbo Li, Kangli Wang, Ji Pei

entry.summary: CosFly provides a modular planning and multimodal simulation pipeline for UAV aerial tracking, along with CosFly-Track, a large-scale dataset for dynamic target tracking across diverse environments generated from CARLA simulation.

entry.title: Explainable Wastewater Digital Twins: Adaptive Context-Conditioned Structured Simulators with Self-Falsifying Decision Support

author.name: Gary Simethy, Daniel Ortiz Arroyo, Petar Durdevic

entry.summary: Develops an explainable digital twin for wastewater treatment with interpretable locally-linear experts and conformal risk control for decision support with safety guarantees.

entry.title: RecoAtlas: From Semantic Plausibility to Set-Level Utility in LLM Recommendation Agents

author.name: Imad Aouali, Flavian Vasile, Otmane Sakhi, Alexandre Gilotte, Benjamin Heymann

entry.summary: Introduces RecoAtlas, a benchmark for evaluating LLM shopping recommendation agents with behavior-grounded metrics covering relevance, complementarity, diversity, and explanation quality in controlled tool environments.

entry.title: Euclidean Embedding of Data Using Local Distances

author.name: Dimitris Arabadjis

entry.summary: Studies Euclidean embedding from local distance graphs by solving a variational problem matching local graph distances to Euclidean metric. Derives coordinate-free Euler-Lagrange equations evaluated from the distance graph alone.

entry.title: LP-Eval: Rubric and Dataset for Measuring the Quality of Legal Proposition Generation

author.name: Shanshan Xu, Johan Lindholm, Amogh Raina, Henrik Palmer Olsen, Daniel Hershcovich

entry.summary: Introduces LP-Eval, a rubric and dataset for evaluating LLM-generated legal propositions from EU Court of Justice decisions, with expert annotations covering formal validity and substantive quality.

entry.title: A Two-Phase Adaptive Balanced Penalty Method for Controllable Pareto Front Learning under Split Feasibility Conditions

author.name: Nguyen Viet Hoang, Dung D. Le, Tran Ngoc Thang

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Balanced Penalty algorithm for controllable Pareto front learning under split feasibility conditions with convergence guarantees, applied to hypernetwork training.

entry.title: Atomistic Modeling of Chemical Disorder in Materials: Bridging Classical Methods and AI-Assisted Approaches

author.name: Jiayu Peng, Peichen Zhong

entry.summary: Reviews classical and AI-assisted approaches for modeling chemical disorder in materials, addressing the representation gap between experimental partial occupancies and atomistic simulations that require fully specified configurations.

entry.title: Domain-Adaptive Communication-Rate Optimization for Sim-to-Real Humanoid-Robot Wireless XR Teleoperation

author.name: Caolu Xu, Zhiyong Chen, Meixia Tao, Li Song, Feng Yang, Wenjun Zhang

entry.summary: Develops a domain-adaptive communication-rate optimization system for humanoid robot wireless XR teleoperation, using sim-to-real transfer with offline real-domain data correction to minimize communication energy while maintaining motion reconstruction accuracy.

entry.title: Goal-Oriented Lower-Tail Calibration of Gaussian Processes for Bayesian Optimization

author.name: Aur\'elien Pion, Emmanuel Vazquez

entry.summary: Addresses lower-tail miscalibration of Gaussian process predictive distributions in Bayesian optimization, proposing goal-oriented calibration below a threshold to improve expected improvement sampling decisions.

entry.title: Geo-Data-Driven HD Map Generation Workflow with Integrated Reference-Free Constraint-Based Verification

author.name: Ruidi He, Vaibhav Tiwari, Mohanad Al-Ghobari, Meng Zhang, Andreas Rausch

entry.summary: Presents a workflow for generating HD maps for autonomous driving from openly available geo-engineering datasets rather than expensive sensor-intensive mobile mapping campaigns, with integrated reference-free verification.

entry.title: KIO-planner: Attention-Guided Single-Stage Motion Planning with Dual Mapping for UAV Navigation

author.name: Dexing Yao, Haochen Li, Junhao Wei, Yifu Zhao, Yanxiao Li, Jiahui Xu, Jinxuan Hu, Lele Tian, Baili Lu, Zikun Li, Xu Yang, Sio-Kei Im, Dingcheng Yang, Yapeng Wang

entry.summary: KIO-planner is an attention-guided single-stage motion planning framework for UAV navigation in confined environments, using CBAM attention for depth image processing and dual mapping for obstacle avoidance without falling into local minima.

entry.title: Interoceptive Divergence in Aesthetic Evaluation and Implications for Human-AI Alignment

author.name: Yoshia Abe, Tatsuya Daikoku, Yasuo Kuniyoshi

entry.summary: Studies divergence between human and AI aesthetic evaluation, focusing on how interoceptive (bodily) processes influence beauty judgments in ways that AI systems cannot replicate.

entry.title: Quantum Machine Learning for Cyber-Physical Anomaly Detection in Unmanned Aerial Vehicles: A Leakage-Free Evaluation with Proxy-Audited Feature Sets

author.name: Carlos A. Dur\'an Paredes, Javier E. Le\'on Calder\'on, Nicol\'as S\'anchez Perea, German Dar\'io D\'iaz, Camilo Segura Quintero

entry.summary: Evaluates quantum machine learning for UAV anomaly detection with a leakage-free evaluation protocol. Shows that much reported QML accuracy stems from data leakage through random splits and temporal proximity.

entry.title: Topology-Optimized Pneumatic Soft Actuator: Design and Experimental Validation

author.name: Sumit Mehta, Konstantinos Poulios

entry.summary: Demonstrates computational design of soft pneumatic actuators using 3D nonlinear topology optimization extended from 2D, fabricating and experimentally validating two designs that maximize bending response under large deformations.

entry.title: DAG-Based QoS-Aware Dynamic Task Placement for Networked Multi-Stage Control Pipelines

author.name: Thien Tran, Jonathan Kua, Thuong Hoang, Minh Tran, Yuemin Ding, Jiong Jin

entry.summary: Proposes DAG-based dynamic task placement for networked robot control pipelines, addressing the 3C (Control-Communication-Computing) co-design challenge of distributing perception and planning tasks across robot hardware and edge compute.

entry.title: Learn-by-Wire Training Control Governance: Bounded Autonomous Training Under Stress for Stability and Efficiency

author.name: Anis Radianis

entry.summary: Introduces Learn-by-Wire Guard (LBW-Guard), a training control layer that sits above AdamW to detect and mitigate training instabilities. Evaluated on Qwen2.5 models (3B-14B) under stress conditions using WikiText-103.

entry.title: Can Large Language Models Revolutionize Survey Research? Experiments with Disaster Preparedness Responses

author.name: Yan Wang, Ziyi Guo, Christopher McCarty

entry.summary: Evaluates LLMs across a five-stage survey research framework for disaster preparedness, testing questionnaire design through post-collection analysis. Uses Hurricane Milton preparedness survey (n=946) as testbed.

entry.title: BLINKG: A Benchmark for LLM-Integrated Knowledge Graph Generation

author.name: Carla Castedo, Enrique Iglesias, Manuel Lama, Alberto Bugarin-Diz, Maria-Esther Vidal, David Chaves-Fraga

entry.summary: Introduces BLINKG, a benchmark for evaluating how well LLMs can assist in Knowledge Graph construction by establishing correspondences between data sources and ontology terms.

entry.title: From Prompts to Pavement Through Time: Temporal Grounding in Agentic Scene-to-Plan Reasoning

author.name: Ahmed Y. Gado, Omar Y. Goba, Alaa Hassanein, Catherine M. Elias, Ahmed Hussein

entry.summary: Explores temporal grounding in autonomous vehicle planning with LLM/LMM ensembles, proposing three planner architectures with progressively increasing temporal integration.

entry.title: Using Aristotle API for AI-Assisted Theorem Proving in Lean 4: A Formalisation Case Study of the Grasshopper Problem

author.name: Gabriel Rongyang Lau

entry.summary: Reports a case study using Aristotle API for AI-assisted theorem proving in Lean 4, attempting to formalize IMO 2009 Problem 6. Achieves partial formalization with verified helper lemmas but main theorem remains unresolved.

entry.title: An Efficient Multilevel Preconditioned Nonlinear Conjugate Gradient Method for Incremental Potential Contact

author.name: Yu Zhang, Xing Shen, Kemeng Huang, Wei Chen, Yin Yang, Taku Komura, Tiantian Liu, Xingang Pan

entry.summary: Presents MAS-PNCG, combining Multilevel Additive Schwarz preconditioning with Preconditioned Nonlinear Conjugate Gradient for Incremental Potential Contact simulation, avoiding expensive Hessian assembly.

entry.title: Retrieve Only Relevant Tables Whether Few or Many: Adaptive Table Retrieval Method

author.name: Taehee Kim, Seungbin Yang, Jihwan Kim, Jaegul Choo

entry.summary: Proposes an adaptive table retrieval method that dynamically adjusts the number of retrieved tables per query rather than using a fixed top-k. Uses a lightweight model to predict when sufficient tables have been retrieved for text-to-SQL tasks.

entry.title: DualView: Adaptive Local-Global Fusion for Multi-Hop Document Reranking

author.name: Litong Zhang, Jiaxin Li, Kuo Zhao

entry.summary: Presents DualView, a cascaded reranking framework for multi-hop document retrieval combining local cross-attention scoring with global inter-document dependency modeling via Transformers. Features adaptive fusion through a gate network.

entry.title: The Insurability Frontier of AI Risk: Mapping Threats to Affirmative Coverage, Silent Exposures, and Exclusions

author.name: Alex Leung, Rex Zhang, Ervin Ling, Kentaroh Toyoda, SiewMei Loh

entry.summary: Maps AI-related risks to the insurance landscape, coding 55 AI threat classes against 26 insurance products to identify a four-tier insurability frontier from affirmatively insured to uninsurable perils.

entry.title: VCR: Learning Valid Contextual Representation for Incomplete Wearable Signals

author.name: Yuxuan Weng, Wenhan Luo, Qijia Shao

entry.summary: Proposes VCR, a self-supervised framework for learning robust representations from incomplete wearable sensor signals. Uses orthogonal tokenization to disentangle modality-specific from shared information without hallucinating missing signals.

entry.title: MO-CAPO: Multi-Objective Cost-Aware Prompt Optimization

author.name: Jan B\"ussing, Moritz Schlager, Timo Hei{\ss}, Tom Zehle, Matthias Feurer

entry.summary: Introduces MO-CAPO, a multi-objective prompt optimization algorithm jointly optimizing performance and inference cost with budget allocation for cost-efficient optimization.

entry.title: Data-Free Client Contribution Estimation via Logit Maximization for Federated Learning

author.name: Asim Ukaye, Nurbek Tastan, Mubarak Abdu-Aguye, Karthik Nandakumar

entry.summary: Proposes CELM, a data-free contribution estimation for federated learning using logit maximization to probe client updates for class-wise evidence scores without sharing data or metadata.

entry.title: Cross-Subject Intracranial EEG Reconstruction from Scalp Recordings Using Multi-Scale Cross-Attention Transformers

author.name: Tien-Dat Pham, Xuan-The Tran

entry.summary: Proposes CAST for cross-subject intracranial EEG reconstruction from scalp EEG, using cross-attention spatial-temporal transformers to predict invasive brain signals for unseen patients without requiring their surgical data.

entry.title: Benchmarking Commercial ASR Systems on Code-Switching Speech: Arabic, Persian, and German

author.name: Sajjad Abdoli (MAD), Ghassan Al-Sumaidaee (MAD), Clayton W. Taylor (MAD), Ahmad (MAD), ElShiekh, Ahmed Rashad

entry.summary: Benchmarks five commercial ASR systems on code-switching speech across Arabic-English, Persian-English, and German-English pairs. Reveals significant performance gaps in multilingual conditions.

entry.title: Learning Long-Term Temporal Dependencies in Photovoltaic Power Output Prediction Through Multi-Horizon Forecasting

author.name: Sumit Laha, Ankit Sharma, Hassan Foroosh

entry.summary: Proposes multi-horizon forecasting framework for photovoltaic power prediction using ground-based sky images, showing architecture-independent accuracy improvements over single-horizon approaches.

entry.title: On-Device Continual Learning with Dual-Stage Buffer and Dynamic Loss for Point-of-Care Pneumonia Diagnosis

author.name: Danu Kim

entry.summary: Presents PneumoNet for on-device continual learning in pneumonia diagnosis, combining lightweight CNN with dual-stage balanced buffer and dynamic class-weighted loss. Achieves 86.6% accuracy with minimal forgetting.

entry.title: Skinned Motion Retargeting with Spatially Adaptive Interaction Guidance

author.name: Soojin Choi, Seokhyeon Hong, Chaelin Kim, Junghyun Nam, Junhyuk Jeon, Junyong Noh

entry.summary: Presents a geometry-aware motion retargeting framework that preserves interaction semantics through spatially adaptive anchors that dynamically reposition for target characters with different body proportions.

entry.title: The Accessibility Capability Boundary: Operational Limits and Expansion Potential of AI-Generated Browser-Native Accessibility Systems

author.name: Rizwan Jahangir, Daisuke Ishii

entry.summary: Introduces the Accessibility Capability Boundary (ACB) framework for reasoning about limits of AI-driven browser accessibility systems, modeling accessibility as a dynamic multidimensional capability space.

entry.title: TERGAD: Structure-Aware Text-Enhanced Representations for Graph Anomaly Detection

author.name: Wen Shi, Zhe Wang, Huafei Huang, Qing Qing, Ziqi Xu, Qixin Zhang, Xikun Zhang, Renqiang Luo, Feng Xia

entry.summary: Proposes TERGAD for graph anomaly detection that enriches structural semantics through text-enhanced representations, addressing the gap where existing methods neglect structural context of nodes.

entry.title: PromptRad: Knowledge-Enhanced Multi-Label Prompt-Tuning for Low-Resource Radiology Report Labeling

author.name: Ying-Jia Lin, Tzu-Chin Lo, Ping-Chien Li, Chi-Tung Cheng, Chien-Hung Liao, Hung-Yu Kao

entry.summary: Proposes PromptRad for low-resource radiology report labeling using knowledge-enhanced prompt tuning with UMLS synonyms integrated into multi-word verbalizers for masked language modeling.

entry.title: INSHAPE: Instance-Level Shapelets for Interpretable Time-Series Classification

author.name: Seongjun Lee, Seokhyun Lee, Changhee Lee

entry.summary: Proposes INSHAPE, a method for instance-level shapelets in time-series classification that addresses limitations of population-level approaches by finding discriminative patterns specific to individual instances while capturing temporal dependencies between patterns.

entry.title: Cross-Paradigm Knowledge Distillation: A Comprehensive Study of Bidirectional Transfer Between Random Forests and Deep Neural Networks for Big Data Applications

author.name: Mahdi Naser Moghadasi

entry.summary: Proposes bidirectional knowledge distillation between Random Forests and Deep Neural Networks, including progressive multi-stage distillation and multi-teacher ensemble approaches.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Graph Neural Network Surrogates for Turbulent Nanoparticle Dispersion in Dental Clinical Environments

author.name: Takshak Shende, Viktor Popov

entry.summary: Develops ELGIN, a physics-informed graph neural network surrogate for simulating nanoparticle dispersion in dental clinics, coupling multi-head graph transformers with Euler-Lagrange particle tracking. Aims to replace expensive RANS simulations for real-time clinical decision support.

entry.title: SAGE: Scalable Automatic Gating Ensemble for Confident Negative Harvesting in Fraud Detection

author.name: Sudheer Tubati, Amit Goyal

entry.summary: Presents SAGE for music streaming fraud detection, using SimHash-based stratified sampling with modular gating ensemble for identifying confident negatives from unlabeled data. Addresses the challenge of distinguishing super-fans from coordinated fraud.

entry.title: Optimizing Computational-Statistical Runtime for Wasserstein Distance Estimation

author.name: Peter Matthew Jacobs, Jeff M. Phillips

entry.summary: Studies the computational-statistical runtime for Wasserstein distance estimation, achieving improved bounds by exploiting smoothness of underlying measures and allowing precision scaling with sample size.

entry.title: Interpretable Computer Vision for Defect Detection in X-ray Tomography of Aerospace SiC/SiC Composites

author.name: Antonio Pe\~na Corredor (SES), Julien Lesseur (SES), Romain Nunez (SES), Paul Rivalland (SES), Thomas Philippe

entry.summary: Introduces p-ResNet-50, a prototype-based ResNet that provides interpretable case-based explanations for defect detection in aerospace SiC/SiC composites via X-ray tomography, with prototypes aligned to expert-defined semantic categories.

entry.title: MMoA: An AI-Agent framework with recurrence for Memoried Mixure-of-Agent

author.name: Rui Chu

entry.summary: Proposes MMoA, a recurrent Mixture-of-Agents architecture that integrates LSTM-based gating into agent selection, allowing context-aware routing based on current inputs and historical routing decisions.

entry.title: How Do Document Parsers Break? Auditing Structural Vulnerability in Document Intelligence

author.name: Yue Chen, Yihao Wang, Ziyi Tang, Keze Wang

entry.summary: Identifies 'Footprint Bias' in document layout analysis evaluation and proposes a lightweight auditing framework that decouples probe construction from structure-aware diagnosis, revealing that affected area weakly tracks actual perturbation-induced failures.

entry.title: Can Large Language Models Reliably Correct Errors in Low-Resource ASR? A Contamination-Aware Case Study on West Frisian

author.name: Yun Hao, Reihaneh Amooie, Wietse de Vries, Rik van Noord, Martijn Wieling

entry.summary: Investigates LLM-based generative error correction for low-resource Frisian ASR, using both public and non-public texts to control for data contamination, finding that GER improves performance with GPT-5 achieving the best results.

entry.title: Smartphone-based Circular Plot Sampling for Forest Inventory

author.name: Su Sun, Jui-Cheng Chiu, Nabin Khanal, Songlin Fei, Yingjie Victor Chen

entry.summary: Presents a smartphone-based pipeline for forest inventory that enables tree measurement from a single walkthrough video, integrating monocular depth estimation and tree instance segmentation for circular plot sampling.

entry.title: Closed-Loop Hybrid Digital Twin Platform for Connected and Automated Vehicle Validation

author.name: Kanglong Quan, Zhebing Xia, Linfeng Jiang, Hao Yu, Ziheng Qiao, Dapeng Dong, Dongyao Jia

entry.summary: A hybrid digital twin platform that tightly couples CARLA-SUMO simulation with a physical test site and real vehicle via V2X communication for connected and automated vehicle validation. Custom middleware synchronizes real vehicle state as a shadow in simulation.

entry.title: GLUT: 3D Gaussian Lookup Table for Continuous Color Transformation

author.name: Danna Xue, David Serrano-Lozano, Shaolin Su, Javier Vazquez-Corral

entry.summary: GLUT uses 3D Gaussian primitives to represent color lookup tables as a continuous, explicit representation, avoiding the capacity-memory trade-off of grid-based 3D LUTs while maintaining interpretability and enabling localized editing.

entry.title: Multi-Session Ground Texture SLAM in Low-Dynamic Environments

author.name: Kyle M. Hart, Brendan Englot

entry.summary: Explores multi-session ground texture SLAM in low-dynamic environments where surface wear or weather causes gradual changes, studying techniques for maintaining trajectory estimation accuracy across sessions using ground texture as the only available mapping feature.

entry.title: Trajectory Planning and Control near the Limits: an Open Experimental Benchmark on the RoboRacer Platform

author.name: Mattia Piccinini, Patrick Zambiasi, Aniello Mungiello, Mattia Piazza, Felix Jahncke, Johannnes Betz

entry.summary: Presents a modular benchmarking framework for trajectory planning and control at the limits of vehicle dynamics on a 1:10 scale autonomous racing platform, including a model-structured neural network for learning inverse dynamics for steering.

entry.title: Transforming Constraint Programs to Input for Local Search

author.name: Jo Devriendt, Patrick De Causmaecker, Marc Denecker

entry.summary: Establishes a link between symmetry properties of constraint optimization problems and local search neighborhoods, enabling automatic generation of neighborhoods from constraint specifications.

entry.title: Mask-to-Correct$^+$: Leveraging Retriever Diversity for Masking-guided Faithful Fact Correction

author.name: Payel Santra, Lavisha Sharma, Madhusudan Ghosh, Partha Basuchowdhuri

entry.summary: Proposes Mask-to-Correct, a training-free RAG framework for fact correction that uses diversity-aware masking to identify erroneous spans in claims and evaluates correction faithfulness using retrieved evidence.

entry.title: Hamilton--Jacobi Reachability for Spacecraft Collision Avoidance

author.name: Larry Hui, Jordan Kam, William Su, Jianshu Zhou
