entry.title: Prompt2Fingerprint: Plug-and-Play LLM Fingerprinting via Text-to-Weight Generation

author.name: Sixu Chen, Xiang Chen, Hongyao Yu, Jiaxin Hong, Hao Fang, Shuoyang Sun, Bin Chen, Shu-Tao Xia

entry.summary: Introduces Prompt2Fingerprint (P2F), a framework that uses text-to-weight generation to create unique fingerprints for LLMs without requiring separate fine-tuning for each identity. This reformulates fingerprinting as conditional parameter generation, dramatically improving scalability of model provenance tracking.

entry.title: Vision-OPD: Learning to See Fine Details for Multimodal LLMs via On-Policy Self-Distillation

author.name: Qianhao Yuan, Jie Lou, Xing Yu, Hongyu Lin, Le Sun, Xianpei Han, Yaojie Lu

entry.summary: Proposes Vision-OPD, a self-distillation framework that transfers a multimodal LLM's stronger regional perception (from evidence-centered crops) to its full-image policy, addressing the regional-to-global perception gap in fine-grained visual understanding.

entry.title: PluRule: A Benchmark for Moderating Pluralistic Communities on Social Media

author.name: Zoher Kachwala, Bao Tran Truong, Rasika Muralidharan, Haewoon Kwak, Jisun An, Filippo Menczer

entry.summary: Introduces PluRule, a multimodal, multilingual benchmark for community-specific content moderation across 1,989 Reddit communities with 2,885 rules in 9 languages. Shows even GPT-5.2 struggles significantly with pluralistic rule application.

entry.title: Mixture of Experts for Low-Resource LLMs

author.name: Ori Bar Joseph, Smadar Arvatz, Noam Kayzer, Dan Revital, Sarel Weinberger

entry.summary: Analyzes routing dynamics in Mixture-of-Experts models for low-resource languages (Hebrew), finding that both Transformer and hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE models exhibit 'deep-layer routing collapse' for underrepresented languages. Continual pre-training on balanced bilingual data corrects this imbalance.

entry.title: KVDrive: A Holistic Multi-Tier KV Cache Management System for Long-Context LLM Inference

author.name: Jian Lin, Jiazhi Mi, Zicong Hong, Haodong Wang, Qianli Liu, Haodyue Zhang, Peng Li, Song Guo

entry.summary: Presents KVDrive, a multi-tier KV cache management system spanning GPU, DRAM, and SSD for long-context LLM inference. Takes a systems perspective on the transfer bottleneck rather than pursuing greater sparsity.

entry.title: Algorithmic Cultivation: How Social Media Feeds Shape User Language

author.name: Olivia Pal, Agam Goyal, Eshwar Chandrasekharan, Koustuv Saha

entry.summary: Large-scale longitudinal study (235M posts, 4M users on Bluesky) examining how sustained algorithmic feed exposure shapes user language. Uses quasi-experimental matching to compare users exposed to News, Science, and Blacksky feeds.

entry.title: TRACE: Trajectory Correction from Cross-layer Evidence for Hallucination Reduction

author.name: Tej Sanibh Ranade

entry.summary: Introduces TRACE, a method for hallucination reduction that uses cross-layer evidence from intermediate transformer layers, showing that factual evidence is sometimes present internally but suppressed in later layers.

entry.title: Scalable Environments Drive Generalizable Agents

author.name: Jiayi Zhang, Fanqi Kong, Guibin Zhang, Maojia Song, Zhaoyang Yu, Jianhao Ruan, Jinyu Xiang, Bang Liu, Chenglin Wu, Yuyu Luo

entry.summary: Position paper arguing that generalizable AI agents require environment scaling (expanding diverse rule-sets) rather than just collecting more trajectories in fixed environments. Proposes a taxonomy for environment diversity.

entry.title: Auditing Multimodal LLM Raters: Central Tendency Bias in Clinical Ordinal Scoring

author.name: Jiaqing Zhang, Sandeep Elluri, Bhanu Cherukuvada, Yonah Joffe, Jessica Sena, Miguel Contreras, Scott Siegel, Subhash Nerella, Catherine Price, Parisa Rashidi

entry.summary: Audits multimodal LLMs as clinical raters, finding that all LLM families exhibit central tendency bias (compressing toward middle scores) on ordinal clinical scales, even when overall accuracy appears competitive.

entry.title: Mamba-VGGT: Persistent Long-Sequence Video Geometry Grounded Transformer via External Sliding Window Mamba Memory

author.name: Tianchen Deng, Zhenxiang Xiong, Nailin Wang, Fangjinhua Wang, Jiuming Liu, Jianfei Yang, Hesheng Wang

entry.summary: Extends Visual Geometry Grounded Transformers (VGGT) with a Sliding Window Mamba memory module to handle long video sequences for 3D reconstruction without catastrophic geometric forgetting. Combines selective state-space modeling with external memory tokens to maintain global geometric priors.

entry.title: Rethinking Point Clouds as Sequences: A Causal Next-Token Predictive Learning Framework

author.name: Yumeng Yao, Jingzhi Dong, Haowen Gu, Tao Chen, Zonghan Wu, Xiaoshui Huang, Yazhou Yao

entry.summary: Introduces PointNTP, reformulating point cloud pre-training as causal next-token prediction in latent space, aligning 3D understanding with the predictive pre-training paradigm used in language models.

entry.title: GEM: Gaussian Evolution Model for Occupancy Forecasting and Motion Planning

author.name: Cheng Chen, Hao Huang, Saurabh Bagchi

entry.summary: Proposes GEM, a Gaussian Evolution Model for non-autoregressive occupancy forecasting using continuous 4D Gaussian primitives with learned dynamics for autonomous driving.

entry.title: Imaging Hidden Objects with Consumer LiDAR via Motion Induced Sampling

author.name: Siddharth Somasundaram, Aaron Young, Akshat Dave, Adithya Pediredla, Ramesh Raskar

entry.summary: Demonstrates non-line-of-sight imaging with consumer LiDAR devices using multi-frame fusion inspired by burst photography and synthetic aperture radar, overcoming low signal quality limitations.

entry.title: Vision Foundation Models as Generalist Tokenizers for Image Generation

author.name: Anlin Zheng, Qi Han, Xin Wen, Chuofan Ma, Lanxi Gong, Gang Yu, Xiangyu Zhang, Xiaojuan Qi

entry.summary: Proposes VFMTok, a generalist image tokenizer built on frozen vision foundation models with region-adaptive quantization to eliminate spatial redundancy and semantic reconstruction objectives. Works in both discrete and continuous latent spaces.

entry.title: Incantation: Natural Language as the Action Interface for Multi-Entity Video World Models

author.name: Shangwen Zhu, Qianyu Peng, Zhao Pu, Zhilei Shu, Xiangrui Ke, Zhaohu Xing, Zizhao Tong, Zeqing Wang, Xinyu Cui, Huangji Wang, Jian Zhao, Yeying Jin, Fan Cheng, Ruili Feng

entry.summary: Incantation proposes natural language as the action interface for interactive video world models, enabling per-frame multi-entity control and cross-entity concept transfer without fixed rendering pipelines. First model with per-0.25s natural language conditioning.

entry.title: Leveraging Latent Visual Reasoning in Silence

author.name: Dongyao Zhu, Zhen Wang, Xi Xiao, Han Jiang, Saeed Vahidian, Wei-Lun Chao, Tanya Berger-Wolf, Yu Su, Raju Vatsavai, Jianyang Gu

entry.summary: Investigates whether latent visual reasoning tokens are necessary at inference time, finding that replacing them with noise causes little degradation. Argues their value is as training-time scaffolding rather than inference-time format, with latent tokens guiding learning.

entry.title: Watermarks Attack Watermarks: Re-Watermarking as a Generic Removal Strategy

author.name: Maria Bulychev, Neil G. Marchant, Benjamin I. P. Rubinstein

entry.summary: Demonstrates that watermarks can be used to attack other watermarks - re-watermarking as a generic removal strategy. Shows that the properties sought by watermarks (imperceptible changes triggering detectors) are analogous to attack requirements.

entry.title: WorldArena 2.0: Extending Embodied World Model Benchmarking on Modality, Functionality and Platform

author.name: Yu Shang, Yinzhou Tang, Yiding Ma, Zhuohang Li, Lei Jin, Weikang Su, Xin Jin, Zhaolu Wang, Ziyou Wang, Xin Zhang, Haisheng Su, Weizhen He, Wei Wu, Haoyi Duan, Gordon Wetzstein, Xihui Liu, Dhruv Shah, Zhaoxiang Zhang, Zhibo Chen, Jun Zhu, Yonghong Tian, Tat-Seng Chua, Wenwu Zhu, Chen Gao, Yong Li

entry.summary: Introduces WorldArena 2.0, a benchmark expanding embodied world model evaluation along modality (adding visuotactile), functionality, and platform dimensions. Moves beyond vision-only, offline, simulator-based evaluation of world models.

entry.title: Beyond the Cartesian Illusion: Testing Two-Stage Multi-Modal Theory of Mind under Perceptual Bottlenecks

author.name: Yajing Zhou, Xiangyu Kong

entry.summary: Probes the limits of multi-modal LLMs on Theory of Mind tasks requiring spatial reasoning about other agents' beliefs, exposing the 'Cartesian Illusion' where models rely on text-based distributions rather than grounded 3D understanding.

entry.title: How to Instruct Your Robot: Dense Language Annotations Power Robot Policy Learning

author.name: Bosung Kim, Ruiyi Wang, David Acuna, Jaehun Jung, Alexander Trevithick, Brandon Cui, Yejin Choi, Prithviraj Ammanabrolu

entry.summary: Introduces DeMiAn, a dense multi-aspect annotation approach that re-labels robot demonstrations with VLM-generated annotations along four aspects (motion, scene, pose, reasoning) to extract more signal from fixed demonstration corpora.

entry.title: Interaction-Aware Influence Functions for Group Attribution

author.name: Jaeseung Heo, Kyeongheung Yun, Youngbin Choi, Sehyun Hwang, Jungseul Ok, Dongwoo Kim

entry.summary: Proposes interaction-aware influence functions for group data attribution that capture pairwise interactions between training examples (redundancy vs. complementarity) beyond simple summation of individual influences.

entry.title: DiLA: Disentangled Latent Action World Models

author.name: Tianqiu Zhang, Muyang Lyu, Yufan Zhang, Fang Fang, Si Wu

entry.summary: Introduces DiLA, a disentangled latent action world model that resolves the trade-off between action abstraction and generation fidelity through content-structure disentanglement, where the predictive bottleneck drives disentanglement.

entry.title: HydroAgent: Closing the Gap Between Frontier LLMs and Human Experts in Hydrologic Model Calibration via Simulator-Grounded RL

author.name: Zhi Li, Songkun Yan, Jie Cao, Mofan Zhang, Anjiang Wei, Jinwoong Yoo, Yang Hong

entry.summary: HydroAgent benchmarks nine frontier LLM agents (Claude, GPT-5, Gemini variants) on hydrologic model calibration, finding they fall short of human experts, and proposes simulator-grounded RL to close the gap.

entry.title: OrbiSim: World Models as Differentiable Physics Engines for Embodied Intelligence

author.name: Jiajian Li, Jingyuan Huang, Junru Gong, Qi Wang, Xiaokang Yang, Yunbo Wang

entry.summary: Presents OrbiSim, a fully differentiable physics engine for robotics that enables end-to-end gradient flow through state transitions and visual observations, supporting differentiable contact modeling and gradient-based policy optimization.

entry.title: Skills on the Fly: Test-Time Adaptive Skill Synthesis for LLM Agents

author.name: Jingxing Wang, Chenyu Zhou, Zhihui Fu, Jun Wang, Weiwen Liu, Weinan Zhang, Jianghao Lin

entry.summary: Proposes SkillTTA, a test-time adaptive skill synthesis method that retrieves relevant training trajectories and synthesizes them into task-specific textual skills at inference time, keeping the solver model fixed. Shows improvements on SpreadsheetBench and BigCodeBench.

entry.title: Event-Grounded Sparse Autoencoders for Vision-Language-Action Policies

author.name: Xinchen Jin, Aditya Chatterjee, Pranav Kumar, Rohan Paleja

entry.summary: Proposes an event-grounded interpretability pipeline for Vision-Language-Action policies using Sparse Autoencoders, anchoring feature analysis to behavioral events rather than text contexts for mechanistic understanding of VLA internals.

entry.title: GQLA: Group-Query Latent Attention for Hardware-Adaptive Large Language Model Decoding

author.name: Fanxu Meng

entry.summary: GQLA modifies DeepSeek's Multi-head Latent Attention to expose two algebraically equivalent decoding paths (MQA and GQA), enabling hardware-adaptive inference across different GPU types including export-restricted H20.

entry.title: SkiP: When to Skip and When to Refine for Efficient Robot Manipulation

author.name: Mingtong Dai, Guanqi Peng, Yongjie Bai, Feng Yan, Chunjie Chen, Lingbo Liu, Liang Lin, Xinyu Wu

entry.summary: Proposes Skip Policy (SkiP) for robot manipulation that dynamically identifies key steps requiring precise prediction vs. smooth motion phases that can be skipped, using action relabeling to leap over redundant timesteps.

entry.title: VAGS: Velocity Adaptive Guidance Scale for Image Editing and Generation

author.name: Yan Luo, Ahmadou Aidara, Jingyi Lu, Jeremy Moebel, Kai Han, Mengyu Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Velocity-Adaptive Guidance Scale (VAGS) for flow-based image generation that dynamically adjusts classifier-free guidance strength based on temporal signal level and velocity alignment, replacing fixed guidance scales.

entry.title: Reducing Credit Assignment Variance via Counterfactual Reasoning Paths

author.name: Fei Ding, Yongkang Zhang, Yeling Peng, Youwei Wang, Guoxiong Zhou, Zijian Zeng

entry.summary: Introduces a counterfactual comparison framework for credit assignment in LLM reasoning, transforming sparse terminal rewards into step-level advantages by comparing multiple trajectories under the same input.

entry.title: TriAxialKV: Toward Extreme Low-Precision KV-Cache Quantization for Agentic Inference Tasks

author.name: Hanzhang Shen, Haoran Wu, Yiren Zhao, Robert Mullins

entry.summary: Proposes TriAxialKV, a KV-cache quantization method for agentic LLM workloads that exploits heterogeneity along three axes (temporal recency, modality, semantic role) to achieve extreme low-precision compression.

entry.title: Self-Supervised On-Policy Distillation for Reasoning Language Models

author.name: Zhiquan Tan, Yinrong Hong

entry.summary: Proposes Self-Supervised On-Policy Distillation (SSOPD) that uses correct completions within GRPO groups as self-generated teachers for wrong completion prefixes, converting intra-group contrast into dense process supervision.

entry.title: Agent Bazaar: Enabling Economic Alignment in Multi-Agent Marketplaces

author.name: Seth Karten, Cameron Crow, Chi Jin

entry.summary: Agent Bazaar is a multi-agent simulation framework evaluating economic alignment of LLM agents in marketplaces, identifying two failure modes: algorithmic instability causing market collapse and Sybil deception in C2C markets.

entry.title: Generative Adversarial Learning from Deterministic Processes

author.name: Joris C. K\"uhl, Hanno Gottschalk

entry.summary: Provides theoretical justification for training GANs on deterministic time series from chaotic dynamical systems, proving that sufficiently chaotic systems allow learning their invariant distribution from a single trajectory. Explains the empirical success of physical AI methods on non-i.i.d. data.

entry.title: CATA: Continual Machine Unlearning via Conflict-Averse Task Arithmetic

author.name: Shen Lin, Junhao Dong, Rongjie Chen, Xiaoyu Zhang, Li Xu, Xiaofeng Chen

entry.summary: First study of continual machine unlearning for vision-language models, identifying challenges of effectiveness, fidelity, and persistence. Proposes CATA using conflict-averse task arithmetic to handle sequential removal requests without catastrophic interference.

entry.title: Implicit Hierarchical GRPO: Decoupling Tool Invocation from Execution for Tool-Integrated Mathematical Reasoning

author.name: Li Wang, Xiaohan Wang, Xiaodong Lu, Zipeng Zhang, Jinyang Wu, Jiajun Chai, Wei Lin, Guojun Yin

entry.summary: Proposes decoupling tool invocation from execution in LLM reasoning, introducing delayed execution with explicit hierarchical control. Derives a surrogate loss enabling implicit hierarchical policy learning through GRPO optimization.

entry.title: Generalization or Memorization? Brittleness Testing for Chess-Trained Language Models

author.name: Ethan Tang

entry.summary: Trains a small 25M-parameter chess model that outperforms much larger models, arguing that impressive benchmark performance of chess-trained LLMs is largely explained by pattern-matching rather than genuine understanding.

entry.title: Test-Time Hinting for Black-Box Vision-Language Models

author.name: Kaihua Hou, Abhijith Varma Mudunuri, Jiaxing Qiu, Roxana Daneshjou, Thomas Hartvigsen, Ahmed Alaa

entry.summary: Proposes Test-Time Hinting for VLMs that improves performance with a single API call by training a lightweight model to predict failure-pattern-specific hints, applicable to black-box closed-weight models.

entry.title: Does Theory of Mind Improvement Really Benefit Human-AI Interactions? Empirical Findings from Interactive Evaluations

author.name: Nanxu Gong, Zixin Chen, Haotian Li, Zishu Zhao, Jianxun Lian, Huamin Qu, Yanjie Fu, Xing Xie

entry.summary: This paper examines whether improving Theory of Mind (ToM) in LLMs actually benefits human-AI interactions, finding that existing ToM benchmarks (third-person, multiple-choice) don't capture the dynamic first-person nature of real interactions. Proposes a new interactive evaluation paradigm.

entry.title: Nudging Beyond the Comfort Zone: Efficient Strategy-Guided Exploration for RLVR

author.name: Chanuk Lee, Sangwoo Park, Minki Kang, Sung Ju Hwang

entry.summary: NudgeRL proposes strategy-guided exploration for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), conditioning rollouts on lightweight strategy-level contexts to induce diverse reasoning trajectories.

entry.title: Formal Methods Meet LLMs: Auditing, Monitoring, and Intervention for Compliance of Advanced AI Systems

author.name: Parand A. Alamdari, Toryn Q. Klassen, Sheila A. McIlraith

entry.summary: Proposes combining formal methods with ML for AI governance, enabling offline auditing and runtime monitoring of LLM behavioral constraints using temporal logic specifications and sampling-based predictive monitoring.

entry.title: Fully Open Meditron: An Auditable Pipeline for Clinical LLMs

author.name: Xavier Theimer-Lienhard, Mushtaha El-Amin, Fay Elhassan, Sahaj Vaidya, Victor Cartier-Negadi, David Sasu, Lars Klein, Mary-Anne Hartley

entry.summary: Fully Open Meditron introduces the first completely open pipeline for clinical LLM decision support, including auditable training corpus, reproducible framework, and use-aligned evaluation - going beyond just open-weight releases.

entry.title: Reading the Cell, Designing the Cure: Perturbation-Conditioned Molecular Diffusion for Function-Oriented Drug Design

author.name: Ziyu Xu, Zijian Zhang, Liang Wang, Zhiyuan Liu, Qiang Liu, Shu Wu, Liang Wang

entry.summary: CURE formalizes Transcriptome-based Drug Design as a generative inverse problem and proposes a multi-resolution transcriptome-guided diffusion framework for designing drugs conditioned on desired cellular state transitions.

entry.title: GQA-{\mu}P: The maximal parameterization update for grouped query attention

author.name: Kyle R. Chickering, Huijuan Wang, Mengxi Wu, Alexander Moreno, Muhao Chen, Xuezhe Ma, Daria Soboleva, Joel Hestness, Zhengzhong Liu, Eric Xing

entry.summary: Derives the maximal update parameterization (μP) for grouped query attention, enabling hyperparameter transfer across GQA model architectures and promoting spectral norm conditions as the definition of feature learning.

entry.title: LEAP: Trajectory-Level Evaluation of LLMs in Iterative Scientific Design

author.name: Marilyn Zhang, Tianfeng Chen, Fabi\'an Barzuna, Ankita Rathod, Mark E. Whiting

entry.summary: Proposes LEAP, a trajectory-level evaluation framework for LLMs in iterative scientific design that measures learning efficiency over time rather than just final outcomes. Highlights how evaluation methodology choices can change conclusions about LLM capabilities.

entry.title: PanoWorld: Geometry-Consistent Panoramic Video World Modeling

author.name: Le Jiang, Xiangyu Bai, Bishoy Galoaa, Shayda Moezzi, Caleb James Lee, Tooba Imtiaz, Edmund Yeh, Jennifer Dy, Yanzhi Wang, Sarah Ostadabbas

entry.summary: Presents PanoWorld, a panoramic video world model that generates geometry-consistent 360° video from a single image and caption, using depth consistency and optical flow regularizers to ensure 3D coherence.

entry.title: Differentially Private Motif-Preserving Multi-modal Hashing

author.name: Zehua Cheng, Wei Dai, Jiahao Sun

entry.summary: Proposes differentially private motif-preserving multi-modal hashing that addresses the 'Hubness Explosion' problem in graph-structured data where hub nodes cause unbounded sensitivity, enabling privacy-preserving cross-modal retrieval.

entry.title: Offline Reinforcement Learning with Universal Horizon Models

author.name: Hojun Chung, Junseo Lee, Songhwai Oh

entry.summary: Introduces Universal Horizon Models (UHM) for offline model-based RL that generalize geometric horizon models by directly predicting future states under arbitrary horizons, with a winsorized horizon distribution for stable training.

entry.title: Sharp Spectral Thresholds for Logit Fixed Points

author.name: Tongxi Wang

entry.summary: Proves sharp spectral thresholds for softmax feedback systems, showing that classical stability analysis misses an entire stable regime. The true threshold depends on a projected operator norm rather than classical conservative bounds.

entry.title: Modeling Music as a Time-Frequency Image: A 2D Tokenizer for Music Generation

author.name: Yuqing Cheng, Xingyu Ma, Guochen Yu, Xiaotao Gu

entry.summary: Proposes BandTok, a 2D Mel-spectrogram tokenizer for music generation that represents each frame with frequency band tokens from a single shared codebook, avoiding the sequential dependency issues of residual multi-codebook quantization.

entry.title: Towards Generalization of Block Attention via Automatic Segmentation and Block Distillation

author.name: Shuaiyi Li, Zhisong Zhang, Yan Wang, Lei Zhu, Dongyang Ma, Chenlong Deng, Yang Deng, Wai Lam

entry.summary: Addresses block attention generalization by creating SemanticSeg (30k+ instances across 16 categories) for text segmentation and proposing block distillation to avoid performance degradation. Improves KV cache reuse for RAG and long-context scenarios.

entry.title: Looped SSMs: Depth-Recurrence and Input Reshaping for Time Series Classification

author.name: M\'onika Farsang, Ramin Hasani, Daniela Rus, Radu Grosu

entry.summary: Shows that looped (depth-recurrent) SSMs with k parameters iterated L times match or outperform standard SSMs with k·L parameters across multiple architectures and benchmarks, despite a strictly smaller hypothesis space.

entry.title: Misspecified Explore-then-Exploit Leads to Supra-Competitive Prices

author.name: Jackie Baek, Vivek F. Farias, Farrell Wu

entry.summary: Shows that simple explore-then-exploit pricing algorithms with misspecified demand models can converge to supra-competitive (collusive-like) prices above Nash equilibrium, characterized via fluid-limit ODE analysis.

entry.title: Lost or Hidden? A Concept-Level Forgetting in Supervised Continual Learning

author.name: Katarzyna Filus, Kamil Faber, Roberto Corizzo, Christopher Kanan

entry.summary: Proposes a diagnostic framework using Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to analyze what catastrophic forgetting actually corresponds to in a vision model's representation space, distinguishing between output-level accessibility and internal structural changes.

entry.title: Strategic Over-Parameterization for Generalizable Low-Rank Adaptation

author.name: Jing Gao, Zhong-Yi Lu, Pan Zhang, Ze-Feng Gao

entry.summary: LoRA-Over enriches the optimization landscape during training through over-parameterization, then collapses it at inference to maintain standard LoRA efficiency. Shows parameter efficiency and adaptation capacity aren't fundamentally at odds.

entry.title: R2V Agent: Teaching SLMs When to Ask for Help

author.name: Raghu Vamshi Hemadri, Humaira Firdowse Mohammed, Rishabh Maheshwary, Srivatsava Daruru, Sagar Davasam, Vikas Yadav, Srinivas Sunkara, Sai Rajeswar

entry.summary: R2V-Agent introduces a risk-calibrated routing framework that decides mid-trajectory whether to escalate from a cheap SLM to an expensive LLM, using a process verifier and calibrated step-level router rather than pre-execution routing.

entry.title: Your SaaS Is an Insurance Product: A Modeling Framework

author.name: Caio Gomes (Magalu)

entry.summary: Argues that capped-usage SaaS products (LLM subscriptions, cloud platforms) are structurally identical to insurance products and should be modeled using actuarial science tools for pricing and reserve management.

entry.title: Convex Dataset Valuation for Post-Training

author.name: Siqi Zeng, Christopher Jung, Rui Li, Zhe Kang, Ming Li, Nima Noorshams, Zhigang Wang, Fuchun Peng, Han Zhao, Xue Feng

entry.summary: Studies dataset valuation for LLM post-training as a subset selection problem, showing gradient alignment scores are incomplete and proposing convex optimization to identify optimal dataset weights under budget constraints.

entry.title: Learning Unbiased Permutations via Flow Matching

author.name: Yimeng Min, Carla P. Gomes

entry.summary: PermFlow uses conditional flow matching on the affine subspace of doubly-stochastic matrices to learn multimodal permutation distributions, with closed-form constraint preservation and nearest-target coupling for mode diversity.

entry.title: Distinguishable Deletion: Unifying Knowledge Erasure and Refusal for Large Language Model Unlearning

author.name: Puning Yang, Junchi Yu, Qizhou Wang, Philip Torr, Bo Han, Xiuying Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Distinguishable Deletion (D²) that unifies knowledge deletion and refusal for LLM unlearning, addressing biased deletion in KD and knowledge re-emergence in DR approaches.

entry.title: 1GC-7RC: One Graphic Card -- Seven Research Challenges! How Good Are AI Agents at Doing Your Job?

author.name: Robin-Nico Kampa, Fabian Deuser, Anna B\"o{\ss}end\"orfer, Konrad Habel, Norbert Oswald

entry.summary: Introduces 1GC-7RC, a benchmark evaluating AI coding agents' ability to design, implement, and train ML models from scratch across seven diverse domains on a single GPU, finding agents achieve 38-85% of human baselines.

entry.title: Scale Determines Whether Language Models Organize Representation Geometry for Prediction

author.name: Weilun Xu

entry.summary: Introduces Subspace PGA metric showing that language model representation geometry is organized for prediction in a scale-dependent way: larger models maintain prediction-aligned geometry throughout, while small models lose it in late layers.

entry.title: Parallel Recursive LSTM

author.name: Tristan Gaudreault, Yongyi Mao

entry.summary: Introduces Parallel Recursive LSTM (PR-LSTM) that replaces sequential recurrence with recursive composition over a balanced computation tree, enabling O(log n) parallel depth while maintaining nonlinear state updates.

entry.title: Verifier-Guided Code Translation via Meta-Step Decoding

author.name: Tianyang Zhou, Somesh Jha, Mihai Christodorescu, Kirill Levchenko, Varun Chandrasekaran

entry.summary: Introduces Decoding Time Verification (DTV) for code translation, which interleaves generation with verifier calls at structural boundaries during autoregressive decoding rather than only verifying after generation. Uses a state-machine controller to enforce valid prefixes.

entry.title: Bug or Feature$^2$: Weight Drift, Activation Sparsity, and Spikes

author.name: Egor Shvetsov, Aleksandr Serkov, Shokorov Viacheslav, Redko Dmitry, Vladislav Goloshchapov, Evgeny Burnaev

entry.summary: Identifies and proves a negative weight drift phenomenon in neural networks caused by the interaction between standard losses and positively-biased activation functions. Shows this drift is intrinsic to optimization and persists across architectures (MLP, ResNet, ViT, GPT-nano).

entry.title: Testable and Actionable Calibration for Full Swap Regret

author.name: Konstantina Bairaktari, Lunjia Hu, Huy L. Nguyen, Jonathan Ullman

entry.summary: Develops calibration measures that are both actionable (inform decision makers about utility loss, i.e., swap regret) and testable (efficiently measurable from finite samples). Bridges a gap between theoretical calibration definitions and practical evaluation.

entry.title: AMO: Adaptive Muon Orthogonalization

author.name: Xinlin Zhuang, Panyi Ouyang, Yichen Li, Jiangming Shi, Yizhang Chen, Shuman Liu, Ying Qian, Weiyang Liu, Haibo Zhang, Imran Razzak

entry.summary: AMO (Adaptive Muon Orthogonalization) improves the Muon optimizer by adapting Newton-Schulz iteration schedules per-matrix based on geometry, addressing the finding that orthogonalization difficulty varies across operator types, training stages, and network depths.

entry.title: Function graph transformers universally approximate operators between function spaces

author.name: Takashi Furuya, David Mis, Ivan Dokmani\'c, Maarten V. de Hoop, Matti Lassas

entry.summary: Proves that function graph transformers - which lift functions to measures on their graphs - can universally approximate operators between function spaces. Shows discretization refinement is naturally modeled via convergence of measures.

entry.title: RL4RLA: Teaching ML to Discover Randomized Linear Algebra Algorithms Through Curriculum Design and Graph-Based Search

author.name: Jinglong Xiong, Xiaotian Liu, Ruoxin Wang, Zihang Liu, Yefan Zhou, Yujun Yan, Yaoqing Yang

entry.summary: RL4RLA uses reinforcement learning with curriculum design and graph-based search to automatically discover interpretable randomized linear algebra algorithms from basic primitives, potentially automating expert-driven algorithm design.

entry.title: The Symmetries of Three-Layer ReLU Networks

author.name: Johanna Marie Gegenfurtner, Moritz Grillo, Guido Mont\'ufar

entry.summary: Provides a complete characterization of parameter symmetries in three-layer ReLU networks, yielding explicit semi-algebraic fiber descriptions and a polynomial-time algorithm for deciding functional equivalence. Shows some symmetries induce conservation laws along gradient flow.

entry.title: TabH2O: A Unified Foundation Model for Tabular Prediction

author.name: Pascal Pfeiffer, Dmitry Gordeev, Mathias M\"uller, Laura Fink, Joan Salv\`a Soler, Mark Landry, Branden Murray, Marcos V. Conde, Sri Satish Ambati

entry.summary: Presents TabH2O, a unified tabular foundation model handling both classification and regression via in-context learning in a single forward pass. Introduces architectural improvements including bounded scalable softmax and noise-aware pretraining.

entry.title: Adaptive Experimentation for Censored Survival Outcomes

author.name: Yuxin Wang, Dennis Frauen, Jonas Schweisthal, Maresa Schr\"oder, Emil Javurek, Stefan Feuerriegel

entry.summary: Develops a framework for adaptive experimentation with survival data under right censoring, deriving semiparametric efficiency bounds and optimal allocation policies that generalize Neyman allocation to survival settings.

entry.title: Protein Fold Classification at Scale: Benchmarking and Pretraining

author.name: Dexiong Chen, Andrei Manolache, Mathias Niepert, Karsten Borgwardt

entry.summary: Introduces TEDBench, a large-scale non-redundant benchmark for protein fold classification, and proposes Masked Invariant Autoencoders (MiAE) with 90% masking ratio for self-supervised protein structure representation learning.

entry.title: AMARIS: A Memory-Augmented Rubric Improvement System for Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Peilin Wu, Xinlu Zhang, Kun Wan, Wentian Zhao, Gang Wu, Xinya Du, Zhiyu Chen

entry.summary: Proposes AMARIS, a memory-augmented system for rubric-based reward shaping in LLM RL training that accumulates evaluation diagnostics over time, enabling curriculum-like progression and detection of recurring suboptimal behaviors.

entry.title: Perfect Parallelization in Mini-Batch SGD with Classical Momentum Acceleration

author.name: Sachin Garg, Micha{\l} Derezi\'nski

entry.summary: Develops a general theory of momentum acceleration for mini-batch SGD in the interpolation regime, proving perfect parallelization where a B-fold larger mini-batch yields B-fold faster convergence without additional assumptions.

entry.title: Pocket Foundation Models: Distilling TFMs into CPU-Ready Gradient-Boosted Trees

author.name: Aditya Tanna, Nassim Bouarour, Mohamed Bouadi, Vinay kumar Sankarapu, Pratinav Seth

entry.summary: Proposes distilling tabular foundation models into CPU-ready gradient-boosted trees, achieving 96.5% of teacher AUC at 38-860x speedup by using stratified out-of-fold teacher labeling to prevent context leakage.

entry.title: Learning Normal Representations for Blood Biomarkers

author.name: Aashna P. Shah, Michelle M. Li, Yash Lal, Seffi Cohen, Liat F. Antwarg, Morgan Sanchez, James A. Diao, Chirag J. Patel, Ben Y. Reis, Ran D. Balicer, Noa Dagan, Arjun K. Manrai

entry.summary: Leverages 2 billion longitudinal lab measurements to learn personalized normal representations for blood biomarkers, enabling detection of meaningful deviations from individual baselines rather than relying on population reference intervals.

entry.title: ANNEAL: Adapting LLM Agents via Governed Symbolic Patch Learning

author.name: Safayat Bin Hakim, Keyan Guo, Wenkai Tan, Alvaro Velasquez, Shouhuai Xu, Houbing Herbert Song

entry.summary: Introduces ANNEAL, a neuro-symbolic agent that converts recurring LLM agent failures into governed symbolic edits of a process knowledge graph without modifying model weights, providing governance guarantees for safe deployment.

entry.title: Kelvin v1.0: A Neural Pre-Encoder for H.264: A standards-compliant learned preprocessor with -27.62% BD-VMAF on UVG

author.name: Marco Graziano

entry.summary: Presents Kelvin, a lightweight learned pre-encoder for H.264 that applies bounded pixel adjustments (+/-1/255) before standard encoding, achieving -27.62% BD-VMAF bitrate savings while maintaining full standards compliance.

entry.title: Attend Locally, Remember Linearly: Linear Attention as Cross-Frame Memory for Autoregressive Video Diffusion

author.name: Kunyang Li, Mubarak Shah, Yuzhang Shang

entry.summary: Proposes ARL2, a hybrid attention module for autoregressive video diffusion that uses linear attention as fixed-size cross-frame memory, replacing quadratic cross-frame attention to enable scalable long video generation.

entry.title: AgentKernelArena: Generalization-Aware Benchmarking of GPU Kernel Optimization Agents

author.name: Sharareh Younesian, Wenwen Ouyang, Sina Rafati, Mehdi Rezagholizadeh, Sharon Zhou, Ji Liu, Yue Liu, Yuchen Yang, Hao Li, Ziqiong Liu, Dong Li, Vikram Appia, Zhenyu Gu, Emad Barsoum

entry.summary: Presents AgentKernelArena, a benchmark for evaluating AI coding agents on GPU kernel optimization with 196 tasks spanning HIP, Triton, and PyTorch translation, including generalization testing.

entry.title: A Fourier perspective on the learning dynamics of neural networks: from sample complexities to mechanistic insights

author.name: Fabiola Ricci, Claudia Merger, Sebastian Goldt

entry.summary: Studies neural network simplicity bias from a Fourier perspective, showing networks learn amplitude (pair-wise correlations) before phase information (edges/higher-order features), with theoretical analysis for translation-invariant data with power-law spectra.

entry.title: Reliability and Effectiveness of Autonomous AI Agents in Supply Chain Management

author.name: Carol Xuan Long, David Simchi-Levi, Feng Zhu, Huangyuan Su, Andre P. Calmon, Flavio P. Calmon

entry.summary: Studies autonomous AI agents in supply chains using the MIT Beer Game, finding reasoning models exceed human performance but identifying an 'agent bullwhip effect' where decision unreliability amplifies across echelons.

entry.title: Contrastive Conceptor Activation Steering (COAST): Unlocking Vision-Language-Action Models through Hidden States

author.name: Miranda Muqing Miao, Subin Kim, Brandon Yang, Lyle Ungar

entry.summary: Proposes COAST, which uses contrastive conceptors to identify success-critical subspaces in VLA model latent spaces and steers inference toward success, improving task outcomes across three different robot policies.

entry.title: ADR: An Agentic Detection System for Enterprise Agentic AI Security

author.name: Chenning Li, Pan Hu, Justin Xu, Baris Ozbas, Olivia Liu, Caroline Van, Manxue Li, Wei Zhou, Mohammad Alizadeh, Pengyu Zhang, KK Sriramadhesikan, Ming Zhang

entry.summary: Presents ADR, a production enterprise security framework for AI agents operating through Model Context Protocol (MCP), addressing observability, robustness, and cost challenges in detecting attacks on AI agent systems.

entry.title: DyGRO-VLA: Cross-Task Scaling of Vision-Language-Action Models via Dynamic Grouped Residual Optimization

author.name: Sixu Lin, Yunpeng Qing, Litao Liu, Ming Zhou, Ruixing Jin, Xiaoyi Fan, Guiliang Liu

entry.summary: Introduces DyGRO-VLA, a two-stage optimization framework for Vision-Language-Action models that captures cross-task latent representations to prevent overfitting to narrow task sets during RL fine-tuning.

entry.title: Guard: Scalable Straggler Detection and Node Health Management for Large-Scale Training

author.name: Guanliang Liu, Abhinandan Patni, Congzhu Lin, Zoe Zeng, Jack Wittmayer, Josh Wu, Ashvin Nihalani, Binxuan Huang, Yinghong Liu, Rory Na, Anthony Ko, Alexander Zhipa, Cong Cheng, Mi Sun, Vijay Rajakumar, Rejith George Joseph, Parthasarathy Govindarajen

entry.summary: Presents Guard, a scalable system for detecting performance stragglers and managing node health in large-scale GPU training clusters, combining online monitoring with offline node-sweep qualification.

entry.title: A More Word-like Image Tokenization for MLLMs

author.name: Hyun Lee, Hyemin Jeong, Yejin Kim, Hyungwook Choi, Hyunsoo Cho, Soo Kyung Kim, Joonseok Lee

entry.summary: Proposes Disentangled Visual Tokenization (DiVT) that clusters patch embeddings into coherent semantic units for MLLMs, making visual tokens behave more like the discrete word tokens that LLMs are trained to process.

entry.title: Forward-Learned Discrete Diffusion: Learning how to noise to denoise faster

author.name: Grigory Bartosh, Teodora Pandeva, Sushrut Karmalkar, Javier Zazo

entry.summary: Proposes Forward-Learned Discrete Diffusion (FLDD) with a learnable forward noising process that reduces the gap between target and model distributions, enabling few-step generation in discrete diffusion.

entry.title: When Outcome Looks Right But Discipline Fails: Trace-Based Evaluation Under Hidden Competitor State

author.name: Peiying Zhu, Sidi Chang

entry.summary: Introduces 'discipline stability,' a trace-based evaluation paradigm for RL agents that goes beyond outcome-only metrics to assess whether agents maintain behavioral discipline. Shows that reward-only PPO can achieve good outcomes while violating deployable behavioral constraints.

entry.title: An Approximation Algorithm for Graph Label Selection

author.name: Josia John, Maximilian Probst Gutenberg, Simon Meierhans

entry.summary: Presents the first O(log^1.5 n)-approximation algorithm for graph label selection under standard budget constraints, without resource augmentation. Prior work either used augmentation or had no provable guarantees.

entry.title: Statistical Limits and Efficient Algorithms for Differentially Private Federated Learning

author.name: Arnab Auddy, Xiangni Peng, Subhadeep Paul

entry.summary: Studies trade-offs among estimation accuracy, privacy, and communication cost in differentially private federated M-estimation. Proposes FedHybrid and FedNewton algorithms that achieve better accuracy-communication trade-offs than standard FedAvg and FedSGD.

entry.title: CompactAttention: Accelerating Chunked Prefill with Block-Union KV Selection

author.name: Jiwon Song, Dongwon Jo, Beomseok Kang, Jae-Joon Kim

entry.summary: Proposes CompactAttention for chunked prefill in long-context LLM serving, using block-union KV selection to efficiently identify relevant KV blocks across queries in a chunk without per-query overhead or KV copying.

entry.title: Effort as Ceiling, Not Dial: Reasoning Budget Does Not Modulate Cognitive Cost Alignment Between Humans and Large Reasoning Models

author.name: Yueqing Hu, Tianhong Wang

entry.summary: Studies whether reasoning budget in Large Reasoning Models modulates alignment between model compute (CoT length) and human cognitive costs. Finds alignment is invariant to effort settings, suggesting allocation policy is fixed at training time.

entry.title: A Data-Efficient Path to Multilingual LLMs: Language Expansion via Post-training PARAM$\Delta$ Integration into Upcycled MoE

author.name: Hao Zhou, Tianhao Li, Zhijun Wang, Shuaijie She, Linjuan Wu, Hao-Ran Wei, Baosong Yang, Jiajun Chen, Shujian Huang

entry.summary: Proposes a method to expand LLMs to new languages by upcycling into MoE architecture with language-specific experts, then grafting alignment capabilities through parameter deltas. Resolves the conflict between preserving original abilities and acquiring new languages.

entry.title: Context Memorization for Efficient Long Context Generation

author.name: Yasuyuki Okoshi, Hao Mark Chen, Guanxi Lu, Hongxiang Fan, Masato Motomura, Daichi Fujiki

entry.summary: Proposes attention-state memory, a training-free approach that externalizes prefix processing into cached attention states that can be recalled without attending to the original prefix during generation. Addresses both prefix influence fade and computational cost.

entry.title: Knowledge-to-Verification: Exploring RLVR for LLMs in Knowledge-Intensive Domains

author.name: Zhonghang Yuan, Zhefan Wang, Fang Hu, Zihong Chen, Jinzhe Li, Gang Li, Jie Ying, Huanjun Kong, Songyang Zhang, Nanqing Dong

entry.summary: Proposes Knowledge-to-Verification (K2V), extending RLVR (reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards) to knowledge-intensive domains through automated verifiable data synthesis and verification of the reasoning process, not just final answers.

entry.title: Code as Agent Harness

author.name: Xuying Ning, Katherine Tieu, Dongqi Fu, Tianxin Wei, Zihao Li, Yuanchen Bei, Jiaru Zou, Mengting Ai, Zhining Liu, Ting-Wei Li, Lingjie Chen, Yanjun Zhao, Ke Yang, Bingxuan Li, Cheng Qian, Gaotang Li, Xiao Lin, Zhichen Zeng, Ruizhong Qiu, Sirui Chen, Yifan Sun, Xiyuan Yang, Ruida Wang, Rui Pan, Chenyuan Yang, Dylan Zhang, Liri Fang, Zikun Cui, Yang Cao, Pan Chen, Dorothy Sun, Ren Chen, Mahesh Srinivasan, Nipun Mathur, Yinglong Xia, Hong Li, Hong Yan, Pan Lu, Lingming Zhang, Tong Zhang, Hanghang Tong, Jingrui He

entry.summary: A comprehensive survey framing 'code as agent harness' - arguing that code serves not just as output but as operational substrate for agent reasoning, acting, environment modeling, and execution-based verification. Organizes around three layers.

entry.title: How do Humans Process AI-generated Hallucination Contents: a Neuroimaging Study

author.name: Shuqi Zhu, Yi Zhong, Ziyi Ye, Bangde Du, Yujia Zhou, Qingyao Ai, Yiqun Liu

entry.summary: Uses EEG neuroimaging to study how humans cognitively process AI-generated hallucinations during a verification task with MLLM-generated image descriptions. Reveals distinct neural patterns for semantic integration, memory retrieval, and cognitive load.

entry.title: FastOCR: Dynamic Visual Fixation via KV Cache Pruning for Efficient Document Parsing

author.name: Zihan Tang, Leqi Shen, Hui Chen, Ao Wang, Ben Wan, Yan Feng, Ke Zhang, Sicheng Zhao, Tongxuan Liu, Guiguang Ding

entry.summary: Proposes FastOCR, which uses dynamic KV cache pruning for efficient document parsing by exploiting temporal sparsity in attention patterns during decoding, avoiding permanent token eviction that degrades OCR accuracy.

entry.title: Causal Intervention-Based Memory Selection for Long-Horizon LLM Agents

author.name: Saksham Sahai Srivastava

entry.summary: Proposes Causal Memory Intervention (CMI) for LLM agents that estimates causal effects of candidate memories on task performance, selecting helpful memories while suppressing irrelevant or harmful ones.

entry.title: Generative AI Advertising as a Problem of Trustworthy Commercial Intervention

author.name: Jingyi Qiu, Qiaozhu Mei

entry.summary: Argues that generative AI advertising fundamentally changes the ad model from content placement to process intervention, creating less observable commercial influence channels. Proposes a taxonomy of influence tiers.

entry.title: GeoSym127K: Scalable Symbolically-verifiable Synthesis for Multimodal Geometric Reasoning

author.name: Jinhao Jing, Zheng Ma, Jinwei Liang, Qiannian Zhao, Shawn Chen, Jing Yang, Por Lip Yee, Prayag Tiwari, Jingjing Bai, Benyou Wang, Lewei Lu, Zhan Su

entry.summary: Introduces GeoSym Engine for automated generation of symbolically-verified geometric reasoning data with exact ground truths, creating GeoSym127K dataset with 127K questions and difficulty-stratified CoT answers.

entry.title: Visual Agentic Memory: Enabling Online Long Video Understanding via Online Indexing, Hierarchical Memory, and Agentic Retrieval

author.name: Aiden Yiliu Li, Nels Numan, Anthony Steed

entry.summary: Proposes Visual Agentic Memory (VAM) for long video understanding with online indexing, hierarchical memory, and agentic retrieval that searches and verifies evidence before producing grounded answers. Achieves strong results on OVO-Bench.

entry.title: GeoWorld-VLM: Geometry from World Models for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Renjie Gu, Kaichen Zhou, Yan Luo, Mengyu Wang

entry.summary: Introduces GeoWorld-VLM that distills geometric structure from frozen video world models into VLMs to improve spatial reasoning (left-of, behind, between), fine-tuning only the image encoder and projector.

entry.title: EVA01: Unified Native 3D Understanding and Generation via Mixture-of-Transformers

author.name: Zongyuan Yang, Mingjing Yi, Wanli Ma, Chenzhuo Fan, Bocheng Li, Baolin Liu, Yuke Lou, Yingde Song, Yongping Xiong, Zhengdong Guo, Shimu Wang

entry.summary: Introduces EVA01, a unified framework extending MLLMs to natively incorporate 3D mesh understanding, generation, and editing using Mixture-of-Transformers architecture.

entry.title: LiteFrame: Efficient Vision Encoders Unlock Frame Scaling in Video LLMs

author.name: Jihwan Kim, Nikhil Parthasarathy, Danfeng Qin, Junhwa Hur, Deqing Sun, Bohyung Han, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Boqing Gong

entry.summary: Introduces LiteFrame, an efficient video encoder for Video LLMs trained via Compressed Token Distillation, addressing the bottleneck shift from LLM to vision encoder when scaling to long-form video.

entry.title: Omni-Customizer: End-to-End MultiModal Customization for Joint Audio-Video Generation

author.name: Yuheng Chen, Qingdong He, Teng Hu, Yuji Wang, Yabiao Wang, Lizhuang Ma, Jiangning Zhang

entry.summary: Presents Omni-Customizer, an end-to-end framework for joint audio-video generation that preserves visual identities and vocal timbres across multiple subjects. Introduces Omni-Context Fusion and Masked TTS Cross-Attention to prevent identity leakage.

entry.title: $\textit{Don't Guess, Just Ask}$: Resolving Ambiguity in Referring Segmentation via Multi-turn Clarification

author.name: Yuting Yang, Haichao Jiang, Tianming Liang, Quan Zhang, Jian-Fang Hu

entry.summary: Introduces IC-Seg, an agentic framework that resolves ambiguity in referring segmentation through multi-turn clarification dialogues rather than arbitrarily guessing user intent when queries are ambiguous.

entry.title: SparseSAM: Structured Sparsification of Activations in Segment Anything Models

author.name: Hoai-Chau Tran, Chi H. Nguyen, Duy M. H. Nguyen, Mathias Niepert, Fan Lai, Khoa D. Doan

entry.summary: Proposes SparseSAM, a training-free structured sparsification framework for SAM that jointly accelerates attention and MLP layers while preserving token identity, using Stripe-Sort Attention with Z-order permutation.

entry.title: GraSP-VL: Length as a Semantic Granularity Interface for Vision-Language Representations

author.name: Zesheng Li, Chengchang Pan, Honggang Qi

entry.summary: Proposes GraSP-VL, which turns embedding length into a controllable semantic granularity interface for frozen VLM embeddings, creating a 'Semantic Matryoshka' where shorter prefixes encode coarser semantics.

entry.title: LatentUMM: Dual Latent Alignment for Unified Multimodal Models

author.name: Yinyi Luo, Wenwen Wang, Hayes Bai, Marios Savvides, Jindong Wang

entry.summary: Proposes LatentUMM for unified multimodal models, constructing an enhanced shared latent space to explicitly align encoding and decoding transformations for cross-modal consistency in understanding and generation.

entry.title: Stabilizing, Scaling & Enhancing MeanFlow for Large-scale Diffusion Distillation

author.name: Xiao He, Yang Li, Peizhen Zhang, Songtao Liu, Zhao Zhong, Nannan Wang

entry.summary: Proposes methods to stabilize and scale MeanFlow for large-scale diffusion distillation, introducing warm-up with discrete solutions and addressing mean-seeking bias for industrial deployment.

entry.title: Functionalization via Structure Completion and Motion Rectification

author.name: Mingrui Zhao, Sai Raj Kishore Perla, Kai Wang, Sauradip Nag, Duc Anh Nguyen, Jiayi Peng, Ruiqi Wang, Angel X. Chang, Manolis Savva, Ali Mahdavi-Amiri, Hao Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces 'object functionalization' - transforming visually plausible but non-functional 3D models into physically operable ones through graph completion over functional graph representations.

entry.title: Self-Evolving Spatial Reasoning in Vision Language Models via Geometric Logic Consistency

author.name: Junming Liu, Yuqi Li, Yifei Sun, Maonan Wang, Piotr Koniusz, Yirong Chen, Ding Wang

entry.summary: Proposes SAGE, a self-evolving framework that improves spatial reasoning in VLMs by enforcing geometric logic consistency through duality operations (geometric and linguistic transformations). Uses consistency as reward in GRPO training to achieve robust spatial reasoning beyond instance-level correctness.

entry.title: InstructAV2AV: Instruction-Guided Audio-Video Joint Editing

author.name: Haojie Zheng, Yixin Yang, Siqi Yang, Shuchen Weng, Boxin Shi

entry.summary: InstructAV2AV is the first end-to-end framework for instruction-guided joint audio-video editing, accompanied by InsAVE-80K, the first large-scale audio-video editing dataset with source-to-target pairs.

entry.title: Lance: Unified Multimodal Modeling by Multi-Task Synergy

author.name: Fengyi Fu, Mengqi Huang, Shaojin Wu, Yunsheng Jiang, Yufei Huo, Hao Li, Yinghang Song, Fei Ding, Jianzhu Guo, Qian He, Zheren Fu, Zhendong Mao, Yongdong Zhang

entry.summary: Lance presents a lightweight unified multimodal model supporting understanding, generation, and editing for images and videos through collaborative multi-task training with dual-stream mixture-of-experts and modality-aware rotary positional encoding.

entry.title: SafeDiffusion-R1: Online Reward Steering for Safe Diffusion Post-Training

author.name: Komal Kumar, Ankan Deria, Abhishek Basu, Fahad Shamshad, Hisham Cholakkal, Karthik Nandakumar

entry.summary: SafeDiffusion-R1 proposes online RL with GRPO for safe diffusion model post-training, eliminating need for expensive supervised safe/unsafe paired data. Uses online generation with safety rewards rather than offline synthetic data.

entry.title: Spectral Progressive Diffusion for Efficient Image and Video Generation

author.name: Howard Xiao, Brian Chao, Lior Yariv, Gordon Wetzstein

entry.summary: Spectral Progressive Diffusion exploits the frequency-domain autoregressive nature of diffusion to progressively grow resolution during denoising, with spectral noise expansion and optimal resolution scheduling. Supports training-free acceleration.

entry.title: SCAR: Self-Supervised Continuous Action Representation Learning

author.name: Hongjia Liu, Fan Feng, Minghao Fu, Xinyue Wang, Haofei Lu, Biwei Huang

entry.summary: SCAR proposes a joint inverse-forward dynamics framework for learning transferable action representations across embodiments from visual transitions, treating action as a distinct representational factor that decouples controllable change from actuation.

entry.title: MARQUIS: A Three-Stage Pipeline for Video Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Debashish Chakraborty, Dengjia Zhang, Jialiang Jin, Hanting Liu, Katherine Guerrerio, Hanxiang Qin, Tyler Skow, Alexander Martin, Reno Kriz, Benjamin Van Durme

entry.summary: Presents MARQUIS, a three-stage pipeline for video retrieval-augmented generation that handles query expansion/reranking, structured evidence extraction, and article generation. Addresses limitations of current approaches on complex multi-faceted queries across large video corpora.

entry.title: LACE: Latent Visual Representation for Cross-Embodiment Learning

author.name: Yoo Sung Jang, Kanchana Ranasinghe, Cristina Mata, Yichi Zhang, Jorge Mendez-Mendez, Michael S. Ryoo

entry.summary: Proposes LACE, a framework that aligns human and robot visual representations in latent space using body-part correspondences as sparse supervision. Enables cross-embodiment learning from human demonstrations with a single robot demonstration.

entry.title: HCLM: A Hierarchical Framework for Cooperative Loco-Manipulation with Dual Quadrupeds

author.name: Qixuan Li, Chen Le, Jincheng Yu, Xinlei Chen

entry.summary: Introduces HCLM, a hierarchical framework for cooperative loco-manipulation with dual quadrupedal robots using a centralized Joint Diffusion Policy with SE(3)-invariant representations and a whole-body controller.

entry.title: From a Single Demonstration to a General Policy for Contact-Rich Manipulation

author.name: Xing Li, Oliver Brock

entry.summary: Presents a one-shot LfD framework for contact-rich manipulation that represents demonstrations as sequences of environmental constraints, separating task-general structure from instance-specific details for generalization.

entry.title: Unified Walking, Running, and Recovery for Humanoids via State-Dependent Adversarial Motion Priors

author.name: Yidan Lu, Yichao Zhong, Liu Zhao, Wanyue Li, Peng Lu

entry.summary: Proposes a unified RL framework enabling walking, running, and fall recovery on the Unitree G1 humanoid with state-dependent adversarial motion priors. Validates on physical hardware without mode-switching commands.

entry.title: Attention-based PCA

author.name: Rodrigo Maulen-Soto (LPSM, SU), Claire Boyer (IUF)

entry.summary: Shows that attention mechanisms (softmax and linear) trained on Gaussian data learn parameters aligned with principal eigenvectors of the covariance matrix, establishing a direct connection between attention and PCA in both finite and infinite prompt regimes.

entry.title: H-Mem: A Novel Memory Mechanism for Evolving and Retrieving Agent Memory via a Hybrid Structure

author.name: Jiawei Yu, Yixiang Fang, Xilin Liu, Yuchi Ma

entry.summary: Introduces H-Mem, a hybrid memory mechanism for LLM agents using temporal and semantic tree structures that model memory evolution over time and enable efficient retrieval for question-answering tasks.

entry.title: Shapley Neuron Values for Continual Learning: Which Neurons Matter Most?

author.name: Mohammad Ali Vahedifar, Abhisek Ray, Qi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Shapley Neuron Valuation (SNV) for continual learning that uses cooperative game theory to quantify neuron importance, selectively freezing important neurons while keeping others plastic, without requiring replay buffers.

entry.title: Mutual Enhancement Between Global Tokens and Patch Tokens: From Theory to Practice

author.name: Xiusheng Huang, Xin Jiang, Jun Zhao, Kang Liu, Yequan Wang

entry.summary: Proposes TaTok, an adaptive image tokenization framework using global tokens that model mutual information across patch tokens and a Dynamic Token Filtering algorithm based on information entropy for variable-rate compression.

entry.title: From Feedback Loops to Policy Updates: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for LLM-Based Alpha Factor Discovery

author.name: Lingzhe Zhang, Tong Jia, Yunpeng Zhai, Zixuan Xie, Chiming Duan, Minghua He, Philip S. Yu, Ying Li

entry.summary: Applies reinforcement fine-tuning to LLMs for alpha factor discovery in quantitative trading, replacing prompt-level feedback loops that suffer from context explosion and feedback drift with direct policy updates.

entry.title: $\alpha$-TCAV: A Unified Framework for Testing with Concept Activation Vectors

author.name: Ekkehard Schnoor, Jawher Said, Malik Tiomoko, Wojciech Samek, Alexander Jung

entry.summary: Proposes α-TCAV, a generalized framework for Testing with Concept Activation Vectors that replaces the discontinuous indicator function with smooth parameterized functions, fixing fundamental statistical instability issues.

entry.title: SignMuon: Communication-Efficient Distributed Muon Optimization

author.name: Neel Mishra, Kushagara Trivedi, Pawan Kumar

entry.summary: Proposes SignMuon, a 1-bit communication optimizer combining majority-vote sign aggregation with Muon's polar-step framework for distributed training, with convergence guarantees under spectral-norm smoothness.

entry.title: FML-bench: A Controlled Study of AI Research Agent Strategies from the Perspective of Search Dynamics

author.name: Qiran Zou, Hou Hei Lam, Wenhao Zhao, Tingting Chen, Yiming Tang, Samson Yu, Yingtao Zhu, Srinivas Anumasa, Zufeng Zhang, Tianyi Zhang, Chang Liu, Zhengyao Jiang, Anirudh Goyal, Dianbo Liu

entry.summary: Introduces FML-Bench with 18 ML research tasks across 10 domains to benchmark AI research agents, separating agent strategy from execution infrastructure to enable principled comparison of search strategies.

entry.title: Text2CAD-Bench: A Benchmark for LLM-based Text-to-Parametric CAD Generation

author.name: Liang Wang, Heng Meng, Zekai Xiang, Jin Liu, Pingyi Zhou, Litao Chen, Yongqiang Tang

entry.summary: Introduces Text2CAD-Bench, the first systematic benchmark for evaluating LLM-based text-to-parametric CAD generation across four complexity levels including freeform surfaces and real-world domains. Includes 600 human-curated examples with paired text-CAD data.

entry.title: Self-supervised local learning rules learn the hidden hierarchical structure of high-dimensional data

author.name: Ariane Delrocq, Wu S. Zihan, Guillaume Bellec, Wulfram Gerstner

entry.summary: Studies biologically plausible learning rules on hierarchical data, showing that both feedback-based and self-supervised local rules can learn the hierarchical structure of high-dimensional data without backpropagation.

entry.title: When AI Tells You What You Want to Hear: Sycophantic Behavior of Large Language Models in Dementia Care Settings

author.name: Christian Kolb

entry.summary: Investigates LLM sycophantic behavior in dementia care settings, testing whether models adapt responses to social expectation signals rather than maintaining professional quality. All tested models (GPT-5, Claude 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Mistral Large) showed significant quality decline.

entry.title: How Many Visual Tokens Do Multimodal Language Models Need? Scaling Visual Token Pruning with F^3A

author.name: YiJie Huang, Yiqun Zhang, Zhuoyue Jia, Xiaocui Yang, Junzhao Huang, Zihan Wang, Shi Feng, Daling Wang, Yifei Zhang, Yongkang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes F³A, a training-free router for visual token pruning that operates before the language model, framing visual token selection as task-conditioned evidence search under budget constraints.

entry.title: From LLM-Generated Conjectures to Lean Formalizations: Automated Polynomial Inequality Proving via Sum-of-Squares Certificates

author.name: Ruobing Zuo, Hanrui Zhao, Gaolei He, Zhengfeng Yang, Jianlin Wang

entry.summary: Combines LLMs with symbolic Sum-of-Squares certificates for automated polynomial inequality proving, using LLMs to generate conjectures that are then formally verified in Lean.

entry.title: SaaS-Bench: Can Computer-Use Agents Leverage Real-World SaaS to Solve Professional Workflows?

author.name: Kean Shi, Zihang Li, Tianyi Ma, Zengji Tu, Jialong Wu, Xinbo Xu, Qingyao Yang, Ruoyu Wu, Weichu Xie, Ming Wu, Jason Zeng, Michael Heinrich, Elvis Zhang, Liang Chen, Kuan Li, Baobao Chang

entry.summary: SaaS-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating computer-using agents on realistic professional workflows in Software-as-a-Service environments, involving dynamic states, cross-application coordination, and long-horizon dependencies.

entry.title: Look Before You Leap: Autonomous Exploration for LLM Agents

author.name: Ziang Ye, Wentao Shi, Yuxin Liu, Yu Wang, Zhengzhou Cai, Yaorui Shi, Qi Gu, Xunliang Cai, Fuli Feng

entry.summary: Identifies autonomous exploration as a critical underexplored capability for LLM agents, proposing Exploration Checkpoint Coverage as a metric and developing training strategies to address premature exploitation.

entry.title: Universal Approximation of Nonlinear Operators and Their Derivatives

author.name: Filippo de Feo

entry.summary: Proves the first universal approximation theorems for nonlinear k-times differentiable operators between Banach spaces and their derivatives, generalizing classical results in operator learning.

entry.title: Amortized Energy-Based Bayesian Inference

author.name: Hojjat Kaveh, Ricardo Baptista, Andrew M. Stuart

entry.summary: Proposes a transport-based amortized Bayesian inference method that learns observation-dependent maps by minimizing energy-distance objectives, requiring only joint samples without density evaluation.

entry.title: Runtime-Structured Task Decomposition for Agentic Coding Systems

author.name: Shubhi Asthana, Bing Zhang, Chad DeLuca, Hima Patel, Ruchi Mahindru

entry.summary: Proposes runtime-structured task decomposition for agentic coding systems where task partitioning and execution flow are managed through executable control logic rather than monolithic prompts, improving debuggability and reducing retry costs.

entry.title: Learning with Conflicts of Interest

author.name: Nischal Aryal, Arash Termehchy, Ali Vakilian, Marianne Winslett

entry.summary: Addresses the problem of ML systems with conflicts of interest between system owners and users, proposing solutions that recognize these conflicts and protect users against biased information without requiring owner cooperation.

entry.title: Embracing Biased Transition Matrices for Complementary-Label Learning with Many Classes

author.name: Tan-Ha Mai, Chao-Kai Chiang, Han-Hwa Shih, Gang Niu, Masashi Sugiyama, Hsuan-Tien Lin

entry.summary: Shows that complementary-label learning can scale to many classes by deliberately designing biased (non-uniform) label generation processes that restrict complementary labels to subsets, overcoming a decade-long bottleneck.

entry.title: VLMs Trace Without Tracking: Diagnosing Failures in Visual Path Following

author.name: Hyesoo Hong, Minsoo Kim, Wonje Jeung, Sangyeon Yoon, Dongjae Jeon, Albert No

entry.summary: Diagnoses failures of VLMs in line tracing tasks, showing that even state-of-the-art models frequently lose target paths when nearby alternatives look locally similar, indicating lack of robust visual tracking capability.

entry.title: GAP: Geometric Anchor Pre-training for Data-Efficient Visuomotor Learning of Manipulation Tasks

author.name: Davide Buoso, Andrea Protopapa, Stefano Di Carlo, Francesca Pistilli, Giuseppe Averta

entry.summary: Proposes Geometric Anchor Pre-training (GAP) for data-efficient visuomotor learning that provides robustness-oriented inductive biases to prevent frozen vision foundation models from latching onto task-irrelevant shortcuts.

entry.title: Symplectic Neural Operators for Learning Infinite Dimensional Hamiltonian Systems

author.name: Yeang Makara, Yusuke Tanaka, Takashi Matsubara, Takaharu Yaguchi

entry.summary: Introduces Symplectic Neural Operators (SNOs) that preserve symplectic structure in Hamiltonian PDEs, providing theoretical stability guarantees and improved energy conservation. This combines neural operators with structure-preserving numerical methods for infinite-dimensional systems.

entry.title: RecMem: Recurrence-based Memory Consolidation for Efficient and Effective Long-Running LLM Agents

author.name: Zijie Dai, Shiyuan Deng, Sheng Guan, Yizhou Tian, Xin Yao, Xiao Yan, James Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes RecMem, a memory system for long-running LLM agents that uses recurrence-based consolidation, only invoking LLMs when sustained semantic recurrence is observed, reducing token consumption significantly.

entry.title: Argus: Evidence Assembly for Scalable Deep Research Agents

author.name: Zhen Zhang, Liangcai Su, Zhuo Chen, Xiang Lin, Haotian Xu, Simon Shaolei Du, Kaiyu Yang, Bo An, Lidong Bing, Xinyu Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Argus, a deep research agent system where Searcher and Navigator cooperate to assemble complementary evidence pieces rather than duplicating effort through parallel rollouts.

entry.title: DACA-GRPO: Denoising-Aware Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning in Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Amin Karimi Monsefi, Dominic Culver, Nikhil Bhendawade, Lokesh Boominathan, Manuel R. Ciosici, Yizhe Zhang, Irina Belousova

entry.summary: Proposes DACA-GRPO for reinforcement learning in diffusion language models, introducing temporal credit assignment across denoising steps and addressing bias in likelihood estimates.

entry.title: PropGuard: Safeguarding LLM-MAS via Propagation-Aware Exploration and Remediation

author.name: Bingyu Yan, Xiaoming Zhang, Jinyu Hou, Chaozhuo Li, Ziyi Zhou, Xiaozhe Zhang, Litian Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes PropGuard for safeguarding LLM multi-agent systems via propagation-aware exploration and remediation, tracking how malicious instructions propagate across agents and rounds.

entry.title: Augmenting Human Evaluation with LLM Judges: How Many Human Reviews Do You Need?

author.name: Jane Paik Kim

entry.summary: Formalizes the role of LLM judges as auxiliary rather than substitutive to human evaluation, proposing a statistical framework for determining how many human reviews are needed when augmented by LLM judgments.

entry.title: Membership Inference Attacks on Discrete Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Shailesh Kasivelrajan

entry.summary: Studies membership inference attacks on Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs), showing they are more vulnerable than previously suggested. Extracts features from reconstruction loss at multiple masking ratios, achieving AUC 0.878 with XGBoost.

entry.title: Structure-Aware Masking for Protein Representation Learning

author.name: Thomas Walton, Ayan Goel, Amirali Aghazadeh

entry.summary: Bucket Masking selects groups of spatially proximate residues for masking during protein language model training, preferentially masking structurally coupled regions rather than random individual residues.

entry.title: Lever: Speculative LLM Inference on Smartphones

author.name: Tuowei Wang, Fengzu Li, Yanfan Sun, Wei Gao, Ju Ren

entry.summary: Lever enables speculative LLM inference on smartphones by keeping a small draft model in DRAM while a larger target model resides on flash storage, addressing prolonged I/O latency and limited parallelism on mobile devices.

entry.title: Ranking-Aware Calibration for Reliable Multimodal Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Peng Cui, Boyao Yang, Jun Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes Ranking-Aware Calibration (RAC) for vision-language models post-trained with RL, addressing poor confidence calibration by using group-based rollout comparisons to enforce that better rollouts receive higher confidence.

entry.title: D$^2$Evo: Dual Difficulty-Aware Self-Evolution for Data-Efficient Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ru Zhang, Renda Li, Ziyu Ma, Weijie Qiu, Chongyang Tao, Yong Wang, Xiangxiang Chu

entry.summary: Proposes D²Evo, a dual difficulty-aware self-evolution RL framework that dynamically generates medium-difficulty training samples by mining anchors from current model capability and co-evolving problem generators with the solver.

entry.title: The Geometry of Projection Heads: Conditioning, Invariance, and Collapse

author.name: Faris Chaudhry

entry.summary: Develops geometric theory of projection heads in self-supervised learning, modeling them as trainable Riemannian metrics. Proves nonlinear heads create negative curvature at collapsed equilibria, making collapse unstable.

entry.title: Drift Flow Matching

author.name: Chenrui Ma, Xi Xiao, Lin Zhao, Tianyang Wang, Ferdinando Fioretto, Yanning Shen

entry.summary: Proposes Drift Flow Matching (DFM), connecting one-step drift models with multi-step flow matching to enable flexible test-time compute scaling while preserving efficient single-step generation capability.

entry.title: LEAP: Learnable End-to-End Adaptive Pruning of Large Language Models

author.name: Mohammad Mozaffari, Younes Hourri, Mohammad Rastegari, Mahyar Najibi

entry.summary: Introduces LEAP, learnable end-to-end adaptive pruning using per-weight Bernoulli-via-Gumbel-sigmoid relaxation for unstructured LLM sparsity, scaling to full LLM sizes where prior learnable mask methods couldn't.

entry.title: WinQ: Accelerating Quantization-Aware Training of Language Models Around Saddle Points

author.name: Dongyue Li, Zechun Liu, Kai Yi, Zhenshuo Zhang, Changsheng Zhao, Raghuraman Krishnamoorthi, Harshit Khaitan, Hongyang R. Zhang, Steven Li

entry.summary: Analyzes QAT convergence failure, finding weights converge to saddle points with increasing Hessian eigenvalue concentration near zero. Proposes WinQ using window-based perturbation to escape saddle points.

entry.title: LLMForge: Multi-Backend Hardware-Aware Neural Architecture Search with Infinite-Head Attention for Edge Language Models

author.name: Xinting Jiang, Junyi Luo, Ruichen Qi, Kauna Lei, Ben Laurie, Gregory Kielian, Mehdi Saligane

entry.summary: LLMForge is a hardware-aware neural architecture search framework for sub-billion parameter edge language models, introducing Infinite-Head Attention (IHA) that decouples query heads, KV groups, and per-head dimensions for efficient on-device inference.

entry.title: PEIRA: Learning Predictive Encoders through Inter-View Regressor Alignment

author.name: Michael Arbel, Basile Terver, Jean Ponce

entry.summary: Analyzes a variant of Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) using regularized linear regressors, fully characterizing stability conditions. Shows non-collapsed stable equilibria align with leading nonlinear canonical correlation subspaces.

entry.title: $\boldsymbol{f}$-OPD: Stabilizing Long-Horizon On-Policy Distillation with Freshness-Aware Control

author.name: Xianwei Chen, Shimin Zhang, Jibin Wu

entry.summary: f-OPD addresses the tension between asynchronous efficiency and on-policy accuracy in LLM distillation by introducing a freshness score to quantify sample staleness and adaptively regulate stale-sample influence.

entry.title: Training data attribution in diffusion models via mirrored unlearning and noise-consistent skew

author.name: Joan Serr\`a, Dipam Goswami, Fabio Morreale, Wei-Hsiang Liao, Yuki Mitsufuji

entry.summary: Proposes training data attribution for diffusion models using mirrored unlearning and noise-consistent skew (MUCS), systematically outperforming existing methods across three benchmarks for identifying which training examples influenced generated outputs.

entry.title: Protection Is (Nearly) All You Need: Structural Protection Dominates Scoring in Globally Capped KV Eviction

author.name: Gabriel Garcia

entry.summary: Studies KV cache eviction policies under a unified harness, finding that structural protection (reserving 10% of cache at boundaries) dominates scoring-based policies, with all policies collapsing without it.

entry.title: PH-Dreamer: A Physics-Driven World Model via Port-Hamiltonian Generative Dynamics

author.name: Xueyu Luan, Chenwei Shi

entry.summary: Introduces PH-Dreamer, a world model that embeds Port-Hamiltonian physics priors into recurrent state space transitions, ensuring conservation and dissipation principles are respected in latent dynamics. This bridges physics-informed machine learning with model-based RL by structuring energy routing in latent space.

entry.title: Spherical Harmonic Optimal Transport: Application to Climate Models Comparisons

author.name: Pierre Hou\'edry, Iskander Legheraba, L\'eo Buecher, Nicolas Courty

entry.summary: Establishes theoretical convergence of heat-kernel-based optimal transport costs on the 2-sphere and leverages spherical harmonics for efficient computation. Applied to comparing climate models, demonstrating practical utility for geophysical data.

entry.title: GAMMA: Global Bit Allocation for Mixed-Precision Models under Arbitrary Budgets

author.name: Zhangyang Yao, Haiyan Zhao, Haoyu Wang, Tianbo Huang, Lihua Zhang, Xu Han

entry.summary: Introduces GAMMA, a framework for mixed-precision quantization of LLMs that learns module-wise precision preferences through teacher-forced hidden-state reconstruction without requiring quantization-aware training or search.

entry.title: Beyond Scaling: Agents Are Heading to the Edge

author.name: Chunlin Tian, Dongqi Cai, Wanru Zhao, Nicholas D. Lane

entry.summary: A position paper arguing that personal AI agents must move to edge devices due to structural requirements of high-fidelity local context and zero-latency execution loops, proposing three structural shifts for edge-based agentic intelligence.

entry.title: Physics-Aligned Canonical Equivariant Fourier Neural Operator under Symmetry-Induced Shifts

author.name: Jiaxiao Xu, Changhong Mou, Yeyu Zhang, Fengxiang He

entry.summary: Proposes PACE-FNO, which separates coordinate alignment from physical evolution in neural operators by using known symmetries to map inputs to a reference frame before applying a standard FNO, improving out-of-distribution generalization.

entry.title: A Production-Ready RL Framework for Personalized Utility Tuning with Pareto Sweeping in Pinterest Recommender Systems

author.name: Yichu Zhou, Mehdi Ben Ayed, Lin Yang, Jiacong He, Andreanne Lemay, Jiaye Wang, Jaewon Yang, Josie Zeng, Dhruvil Deven Badani, Yijie Dylan Wang, Jiajing Xu, Charles Rosenberg

entry.summary: Proposes PRL-PUTS, a production-ready RL framework for personalized utility-weight tuning in Pinterest's recommender system, casting multi-objective utility tuning as a one-step value-based RL problem with Pareto sweeping for visualization.

entry.title: StAD: Stein Amortized Divergence for Fast Likelihoods with Diffusion and Flow

author.name: Gurjeet Jagwani, Stephen Thorp, Sinan Deger, Hiranya Peiris

entry.summary: Introduces StAD, a distillation method that learns to predict the divergence of probability flow ODEs in diffusion/flow models using the Langevin-Stein operator, avoiding expensive Jacobian computation for likelihood evaluation.

entry.title: Prediction-Intervention Games and Invariant Sets

author.name: Linus K\"uhne, Felix Schur, Jonas Peters

entry.summary: Analyzes prediction-intervention games where a leader chooses a prediction function and a follower intervenes in a causal model, proving that invariant/causal subsets provide robust strategies with bounded performance loss.

entry.title: Charon: A Unified and Fine-Grained Simulator for Large-Scale LLM Training and Inference

author.name: Mengtian Yang, Zhekun Zhang, Mingheng Wu, Jianwen Yan, Hanshi Sun, Li-wen Chang

entry.summary: Introduces Charon, a modular simulator for predicting LLM training and inference performance across different parallelism strategies and hardware configurations, achieving under 5.35% prediction error.

entry.title: Longwang: Zero-Shot Global Spatiotemporal Precipitation Downscaling with a Latent Generative Prior

author.name: Yue Wang, Daniele Visioni

entry.summary: Introduces Longwang, a zero-shot latent generative framework for global spatiotemporal precipitation downscaling that combines learned generative priors with physically informed observation operators through posterior sampling.

entry.title: Divergence-Suppressing Couplings for Rectified Flow

author.name: Yimeng Min, Carla P. Gomes

entry.summary: Proposes divergence-suppressing couplings for Rectified Flow that attenuate divergent velocity field components during coupling generation, improving trajectory straightness without modifying the base model.

entry.title: Canonical Regularisation of Wide Feature-Learning Neural Networks

author.name: George Whittle, Pranav Vaidhyanathan, Juliusz Ziomek, Natalia Ares, Maike A. Osborne

entry.summary: Studies canonical regularization in wide feature-learning neural networks, proving that ridge regularization biases gradient flow even in the vanishing limit, unlike the kernel regime where it doesn't.

entry.title: Improved Baselines with Representation Autoencoders

author.name: Jaskirat Singh, Boyang Zheng, Zongze Wu, Richard Zhang, Eli Shechtman, Saining Xie

entry.summary: Systematically investigates Representation Autoencoder design choices, finding that summing last k encoder layers improves reconstruction, and that RAE and REPA are complementary rather than substitutive.

entry.title: EvoMemBench: Benchmarking Agent Memory from a Self-Evolving Perspective

author.name: Yuyao Wang, Zhongjian Zhang, Mo Chi, Kaichi Yu, Yuhan Li, Miao Peng, Bing Tong, Chen Zhang, Yan Zhou, Jia Li

entry.summary: Introduces EvoMemBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agent memory along in-episode vs cross-episode scope and knowledge vs execution content axes, comparing 15 memory methods against long-context baselines.

entry.title: PACE: Geometry-Aware Bridge Transport for Single-Cell Trajectory Inference

author.name: Chenglei Yu*, Chuanrui Wang*, Bangyan Liao, Tailin Wu

entry.summary: Proposes PACE, a geometry-aware bridge transport framework for single-cell trajectory inference that handles asynchronous development by constructing pseudotime-aligned representations and learning continuous transport dynamics from destructive time-course snapshots.

entry.title: PQR: A Framework to Generate Diverse and Realistic User Queries that Elicit QA Agent Failures

author.name: Yunan Lu, Luigi Liu, Omar Yahia, Arpit Sharma, Zhou Yu

entry.summary: Introduces PQR, a framework for generating diverse, realistic user queries that elicit QA agent failures while resembling real user intents, unlike prior work focused on adversarial users. Uses iterative query and prompt refinement modules.

entry.title: SKG-Eval: Stateful Evaluation of Multi-Turn Dialogue via Incremental Semantic Knowledge Graphs

author.name: Avijit Shil, Suman Samui

entry.summary: Proposes SKG-Eval, an interpretable framework for evaluating multi-turn dialogue by modeling conversations as evolving semantic knowledge graphs of entities, relations, and commitments. Detects long-range issues like contradiction and entity inconsistency.

entry.title: E-PMQ: Expert-Guided Post-Merge Quantization with Merged-Weight Anchoring

author.name: Wenjun Wang, Yanggan Gu, Shuo Cai, Yuanyi Wang, Pengkai Wang, Jianmin Wu, Hongxia Yang
