entry.summary: IBAL proposes an information-theoretic framework for robust multi-agent RL that constructs attacks disrupting inter-agent coordination and trains agents to be robust to such interaction-breaking perturbations.

entry.title: FLAG: Foundation model representation with Latent diffusion Alignment via Graph for spatial gene expression prediction

author.name: Qi Si, Penglei Wang, Yushuai Wu, Yifeng Jiao, Xuyang Liu, Xin Guo, Yuan Qi, Yuan Cheng

entry.summary: FLAG uses a diffusion-based framework with spatial graph encoding and gene foundation model alignment for predicting spatial gene expression from H&E images, addressing the 'Gene Dimension Curse' in high-dimensional joint modeling.

entry.title: DiPRL: Learning Discrete Programmatic Policies via Architecture Entropy Regularization

author.name: Chengpeng Hu, Yingqian Zhang, Hendrik Baier

entry.summary: Proposes DiPRL for learning discrete programmatic policies via architecture entropy regularization, addressing the performance drop when converting continuous relaxations back to discrete programs in programmatic RL.

entry.title: XCTFormer: Leveraging Cross-Channel and Cross-Time Dependencies for Enhanced Time-Series Analysis

author.name: Israel Zexer, Omri Azencot

entry.summary: Proposes XCTFormer for multivariate time series that leverages both cross-channel and cross-time dependencies through a novel architecture, addressing the surprising finding that channel-independent models often outperform channel-dependent ones.

entry.title: Efficient and Noise-Tolerant PAC Learning of Multiclass Linear Classifiers

author.name: Rita Adhikari, Shiwei Zeng

entry.summary: Shows computationally efficient PAC learning algorithms exist for multiclass linear classifiers under malicious noise when data is a mixture of bounded-variance distributions with a margin condition.

entry.title: Distilling Tabular Foundation Models for Structured Health Data

author.name: Aditya Tanna, Nassim Bouarour, Mohamed Bouadi, Vinay Kumar Sankarapu, Pratinav Seth

entry.summary: Studies distillation of tabular foundation models specifically for healthcare datasets, finding distilled students retain 90%+ of teacher AUC while running 26x faster on CPU with preserved calibration.

entry.title: Reducing Hallucination in Vision-Language Models via Stage-wise Preference Optimization under Distribution Shift

author.name: Qinwu Xu

entry.summary: Proposes a stage-wise preference optimization framework for reducing hallucination in vision-language models by constructing targeted preference pairs near known failure boundaries, addressing spatial orientation, object relationships, and OCR uncertainty.

entry.title: Universal Graph Backdoor Defense: A Feature-based Homophily Perspective

author.name: Mengting Pan, Fan Li, Chen Chen, Xiaoyang Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a universal graph backdoor defense that works against both subgraph-based and feature-based attacks by analyzing homophily properties from a feature perspective.

entry.title: Topo-GS: Continuous Volumetric Embedding of High-Dimensional Data via Topological Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Jo\~ao Paulo Gois, Luis Gustavo Nonato

entry.summary: Introduces Topo-GS, repurposing 3D Gaussian Splatting for dimensionality reduction by treating projection as meshless volumetric reconstruction with topological constraints.

entry.title: Taming Audio VAEs via Target-KL Regularization

author.name: Prem Seetharaman, Rithesh Kumar

entry.summary: Proposes target-KL regularization for audio VAEs in latent diffusion models, enabling training at specific bitrates and providing a framework to study the trade-off between reconstruction quality and latent predictability.

entry.title: Multi-task Linear Regression without Eigenvalue Lower Bounds: Adaptivity, Robustness and Safety

author.name: Seok-Jin Kim

entry.summary: Studies multi-task linear regression with contaminated tasks, proposing matrix-weighted norm regularization that works without eigenvalue lower bounds and introduces a relative balancedness condition.

entry.title: Stable Routing for Mixture-of-Experts in Class-Incremental Learning

author.name: Zirui Guo, Quan Cheng, Da-Wei Zhou, Lijun Zhang

entry.summary: Addresses routing drift in mixture-of-experts for class-incremental learning, proposing stable routing that prevents reassignment of earlier-class samples to newly added experts while maintaining plasticity for new classes.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Calibrated Recommendations for Low-Active Users

author.name: Bob Junyi Zou, Sai Li, Tianyun Sun, Wentao Guo, Qinglei Wang

entry.summary: Introduces an uncertainty-calibrated recommendation framework that differentiates strategies for low-active vs high-active users, using model uncertainty to warn of low-quality recommendations for LAUs while diversifying for HAUs.

entry.title: Lost in the Folds: When Cross-Validation Is Not a Deep Ensemble for Uncertainty Estimation

author.name: Kirscher Tristan (ICube, DKFZ), Bujotzek Markus (DKFZ), Kirchhoff Yannick (DKFZ), Rokuss Maximilian (DKFZ), Isensee Fabian (DKFZ), Kahl Kim-Celine (DKFZ), Kovacs Balint (DKFZ), Maier-Hein Klaus (DKFZ)

entry.title: Generalized Functional ANOVA in Closed-Form: A Unified View of Additive Explanations

author.name: Baptiste Ferrere, Nicolas Bousquet, Fabrice Gamboa, Jean-Michel Loubes

entry.summary: Derives closed-form generalized functional ANOVA decomposition for dependent continuous inputs using Hilbert space methods, connecting to SHAP values and generalized additive models.

entry.title: Evaluation Drift in LLM Personality Induction: Are We Moving the Goalpost?

author.name: Prateek Rajput, Yewei Song, Iyiola E. Olatunji, Jacques Klein, Tegawend\'e F. Bissyand\'e

entry.summary: Investigates evaluation drift in LLM personality induction, showing that fine-tuning (SFT, DPO, ORPO) stabilizes questionnaire scores under prompt rephrasings but struggles to induce specific Big Five profiles from unguided essays.

entry.title: AMATA: Adaptive Multi-Agent Trajectory Alignment for Knowledge-Intensive Question Answering

author.name: Taolin Zhang, Dongyang Li, Chen Chen, Qizhou Chen, Jiuheng Wan, Xiaofeng He, Chengyu Wang, Richang Hong

entry.summary: Proposes AMATA, an adaptive multi-agent trajectory alignment framework for knowledge-intensive QA using six specialized agents with trajectory preference alignment and question-aware reward modeling.

entry.title: Learning Faster with Better Tokens: Parameter-Efficient Vocabulary Adaptation for Specialized Text Summarization

author.name: Gunjan Balde, Soumyadeep Roy, Mainack Mondal, Niloy Ganguly

entry.summary: Proposes targeted vocabulary adaptation combining domain-specific token augmentation with selective replacement of under-trained tokens for LLM-based text summarization, evaluated on legal and medical domains.

entry.title: Temporal Decay of Co-Citation Predictability: A 20-Year Statute Retrieval Benchmark from 396M Ukrainian Court Citations

author.name: Volodymyr Ovcharov

entry.summary: Constructs UA-StatuteRetrieval, a benchmark measuring co-citation predictability across 20 years of 396M Ukrainian court citations. Demonstrates genuine temporal decay (33% MRR decline) in co-citation signals, challenging assumptions of stability in legal retrieval systems.

entry.title: PPAI: Enabling Personalized LLM Agent Interoperability for Collaborative Edge Intelligence

author.name: Zile Wang, Qianli Liu, Kaibin Guo, Haodong Wang, Jian Lin, Zicong Hong, Song Guo

entry.summary: Introduces PPAI, the first personalized LLM agent interoperability system for peer-to-peer collaboration on edge devices, enabling users to delegate tasks to remote agents with better expertise for specific queries.

entry.title: Hilbert-Geo: Solving Solid Geometric Problems by Neural-Symbolic Reasoning

author.name: Ruoran Xu, Haoyu Cheng, Bin Dong, Qiufeng Wang

entry.summary: Introduces Hilbert-Geo, the first unified formal language framework for solid geometry with a predicate library and theorem bank. Proposes Parse2Reason method for solving 3D geometry problems by parsing to formal representation then reasoning.

entry.title: ChemVA: Advancing Large Language Models on Chemical Reaction Diagrams Understanding

author.name: Mingyang Rao, Kehua Feng, Zhihui Zhu, Jiangzhen Fu, Hao Yu, Keyan Ding, Huajun Chen

entry.summary: Proposes ChemVA framework to help LLMs understand chemical reaction diagrams by addressing visual deficits in parsing molecular graphs and semantic disconnects in chemical notation. Uses a Visual Anchor mechanism for functional group detection and semantic alignment for better chemical reasoning.

entry.title: A neurosymbolic Approach with Epistemic Deep Learning for Hierarchical Image Classification

author.name: Ezel Kilicdere, Shireen Kudukkil Manchingal, Fabio Cuzzolin

entry.summary: Proposes a neurosymbolic framework combining Swin Transformers with focal set reasoning and differentiable fuzzy logic for hierarchical image classification with epistemic uncertainty.

entry.title: Vision Transformer-Conditioned UNet for Domain-Adaptive Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Joel Valdivia Ortega, Tingying Peng, Marion Jasnin

entry.summary: Introduces ViTC-UNet, which conditions a UNet on frozen ViT representations through learnable tokens and two-way attention for domain-adaptive biomedical segmentation, combining global ViT priors with local UNet decoding.

entry.title: Multi-hop Relational Contrastive Learning: Extending Spatial Contrastive Pre-training Beyond Pairwise Relations

author.name: Sheikh Tanvir Ahmed, Md. Tanvir Raihan

entry.summary: Introduces Multi-Hop Relational Contrastive Learning (MRCL) that extends spatial contrastive learning to graph-structured scene representations by tracing k-hop paths through scene graphs.

author.name: Marawan Elbatel, Mohamed Ghonim, Jiaji Mao, Zhuosheng Lin, Katharina Eckstein, Andr\'es Mart\'inez Mora, Jonathan Deissler, Maximilian Rokuss, Constantin Ulrich, Zdravko Marinov, Wenhui Deng, Baoxun Li, Huijun Hu, Jun Shen, Mohanad Ghonim, Khadiga Omar Nassar, Mariam Elbakry, Menna Dyab, Amr Muhammad Abdo Salem, Nouran Elghitany, Noha Elghitany, Yi Qin, Xuanqi Huang, Haonan Wang, Shao-Woo Yen, Ahmed Elghamry Saba, Salma Ahmad, Xinyan Fang, Jiahao Zhang, Xiaodi Wang, Xinghua Ma, Gongning Luo, Jessica C. Niederer, Moona Mazher, Rachika E. Bron, Stefan Klein, Ahmed Abouelhoda, Amira Adel, Susan Adil Ali, Rainer Stiefelhagen, Klaus H. Maier-Hein, Fabian Isensee, Aya Yassin, Xiaomeng Li

entry.title: SCARED-C: Corrected Camera Poses for Endoscopic Depth Estimation

author.name: John J. Han, Adam Schmidt, Max Allan, Jie Ying Wu, Omid Mohareri

entry.summary: Presents SCARED-C, correcting camera poses in the SCARED endoscopic dataset from 35 to 17,135 reliable RGB-D pairs using COLMAP-based SfM and metric scale recovery.

entry.title: Observation-Aligned Mask Priors for Learning Physical Dynamics from Authentic Occlusions

author.name: Chiyuan Ma, Zihan Zhou, Tianshu Yu

entry.summary: Proposes Observation-Aligned Mask Priors for learning physical dynamics from authentic (non-random) occlusions, using Bayesian Flow Networks to model real occlusion distributions for training from incomplete data.

entry.title: Metric-Guided Feature Fusion of Visual Foundation Models for Segmentation Tasks

author.name: Yachan Guo, JoseLuis Gomez Zurita, Danna Xue, Yi Xiao, AntonioManuel Lopez Pena

entry.summary: Proposes metric-guided approach to fuse features from multiple visual foundation models (SAM2, DINOv3) for segmentation tasks, with interpretable principles for leveraging their complementary features.

entry.title: Towards Generalized Image Manipulation Localization via Score-based Model

author.name: Yunfei Wang, Bo Du, Zhe Yang, Xin Liu, Zhiyu Lin, Tianxin Xu, Ji-Zhe Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes DiffIML, a framework using score-based generative modeling for image manipulation localization, approximating the score function to capture mask distributions rather than learning fixed decision boundaries.

entry.title: LASAR: Towards Spatio-temporal Reasoning with Latent Cognitive Map

author.name: Jinzhou Tang, Sidi Liu, Waikit Xiu, Weixing Chen, Keze Wang

entry.summary: Introduces LASAR with dual-memory system for embodied AI spatial reasoning, using Spatio-temporal Contextual Representation Learning to force encoding of fine-grained spatial relationships.

entry.title: WOW-Seg: A Word-free Open World Segmentation Model

author.name: Danyang Li, Tianhao Wu, Bin Li, Zhenyuan Chen, Yang Zhang, Yuxuan Li, Ming-Ming Cheng, Xiang Li

entry.summary: Proposes WOW-Seg, a word-free open world segmentation model using a Mask2Token module to transform masks into visual prompts, bridging SAM's segmentation capability with semantic understanding.

entry.title: HighSync: High-Quality Lip Synchronization via Latent Diffusion Models

author.name: Saeed Firouzi Daghigh, Majid Iranpour Mobarekeh, Mostafa Alavi, Mehdi Bagheri

entry.summary: Presents HighSync, a diffusion-based lip synchronization framework operating at 512x512 resolution, identifying and eliminating a data leakage phenomenon that silently plagued prior methods.

entry.title: P2GS: Physical Prior-guided Gaussian Splatting for Photometrically Consistent Urban Reconstruction

author.name: Kota Shimomura, Hidehisa Arai, Tsubasa Takahashi, Takayoshi Yamashita, Hironobu Fujiyoshi

entry.summary: Proposes P2GS for photometrically consistent urban 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstruction that handles varying exposure and tone mapping in real driving data for autonomous driving simulation.

entry.title: OmniVL-Guard Pro: A Tool-Augmented Agent for Omnibus Vision-Language Forensics

author.name: Jinjie Shen, Zheng Huang, Yuchen Zhang, Yujiao Wu, Yaxiong Wang, Lechao Cheng, Shengeng Tang, Tianrui Hui, Nan Pu, Zhun Zhong

entry.summary: Proposes OmniVL-Guard Pro, a tool-augmented agent for vision-language forensics that extends from closed-world prediction to open-world investigation using external tools for real-time verification.

entry.title: Rethinking the State Update Gate for Long-Sequence Recurrent 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Kejun Ren, Lei Jin, Tianxin Huang, Lianming Xu, Li Wang

entry.summary: Identifies structural bottleneck in recurrent 3D reconstruction where per-token gates have limited magnitude, causing memory horizon of only ~3 frames. Proposes frame-level gating to address long-sequence drift.

entry.title: DreamEdit3D: Personalization of Multi-View Diffusion Models for 3D Editing

author.name: Jinxin Ai, Matthias Nie{\ss}ner, Ziya Erko\c{c}

entry.summary: Presents DreamEdit3D for personalization of multi-view diffusion models for 3D editing, learning distinct token embeddings for scene components through multi-view textual inversion and fine-tuning.

entry.title: HyperVision: A Channel-Adaptive Ground-Based Hyperspectral Vision Pre-trained Backbone

author.name: Guanyiman Fu, Jingtao Li, Zihang Cheng, Zhuanfeng Li, Diqi Chen, Yan Xu, Fengchao Xiong, Jianfeng Lu, Jun Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes HyperVision, the first ground-based hyperspectral pre-trained backbone with channel-adaptive dynamic embedding for handling varying spectral configurations across sensors.

entry.title: SpecSem-Net: Integrating Spectral and Semantic Features for Robust AI-generated Video Detection

author.name: Zixi Wei, Huixuaun Zhang, Xiaojun Wan

entry.summary: Proposes SpecSem-Net, the first framework combining semantic-guided spectral denoising for detecting high-fidelity AI-generated videos from models like Sora and Veo.

entry.title: VISTA: Triplet-Supervised Video Style Transfer with Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Yiren Song, Wangzi Yao, Haofan Wang, Mike Zheng Shou

entry.summary: Introduces VISTA-1000 dataset with 1,000 styles and motion-aligned triplets for video style transfer, enabling principled training that jointly models style, content, and motion disentanglement.

entry.title: VoxShield: Protecting 3D Medical Datasets from Unauthorized Training via Frequency-Aware Inter-Slice Disruption

author.name: Xinyao Liu, Zhipeng Deng, Wenhan Jiang, Haolin Wang, Xun Lin, Yafei Ou, Yefeng Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes VoxShield for protecting 3D medical datasets from unauthorized training by disrupting inter-slice continuity and frequency-domain correlations that 3D segmentation networks rely on.

entry.title: DeTrack: A Benchmark and Altitude-Aware Dual World Model for Drone-embodied Tracking

author.name: Guyue Hu, Haoming Liu, Siyuan Song, Chenglong Li, Feng Chen, Jin Tang

entry.summary: Defines drone-embodied tracking task (DeTrack) where drones actively control flight to track targets in 3D environments, with benchmark of 11,368 trajectories and altitude-aware dual world model.

entry.title: GCE-MIL: Faithful and Recoverable Evidence for Multiple Instance Learning in Whole-Slide Imaging

author.name: Xiangyu Li, Ran Su

entry.summary: Proposes GCE-MIL that optimizes evidence quality directly in whole-slide image classification, addressing failures where attention-selected patches are insufficient, unnecessary, and unrecoverable.

entry.title: HL-OutPaint: Coarse-to-Fine Video Outpainting for High-Resolution Long-Range Videos

author.name: Jeongeun Park, Janghyeok Han, Geonung Kim, Hyun-Seung Lee, Kyuha Choi, Youngseok Han, Sunghyun Cho

entry.summary: Proposes HL-OutPaint, a coarse-to-fine video outpainting framework for high-resolution long sequences, using Global Coarse Guidance for spatio-temporal consistency at scale.

entry.title: TouchMap-OR: Multi-View 3D Mapping of Hand-Surface Contacts

author.name: Sophokles Ktistakis, Rui Wang, Bastian Grande, Hugo Sax

entry.summary: Introduces TouchMap-OR, a multi-view RGB-D system for tracking hand-surface contacts in operating rooms to help understand pathogen transmission during medical procedures.

entry.title: Towards Universal Physical Adversarial Attacks via a Joint Multi-Objective and Multi-Model Optimization Framework

author.name: Ziyang Liu, Hongyuan Wang, Zijian Wang, Yinxi Lu, Yunzhao Zang, Zhiqiang Yan, Qianhao Ning

entry.summary: Proposes JMOF framework for universal physical adversarial attacks using multi-objective optimization across multiple surrogate models with Orthogonal Gradient Alignment to resolve gradient conflicts.

entry.title: Learning to Balance: Decoupled Siamese Diffusion Transformer for Reference-Based Remote Sensing Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Bin Luo, Runmin Dong, Zhaoyang Luo, Jinxiao Zhang, Jiyao Zhao, Fan Wei, Haohuan Fu

entry.summary: Proposes DS-DiT for reference-based remote sensing super-resolution using a Decoupled Siamese Diffusion Transformer that separates LR structural and reference texture interactions at the attention level.

entry.title: DSAA: Dual-Stage Attribute Activation for Fine-grained Open Vocabulary Detection

author.name: Donghong Jiang, Endian Lin, Hanqing Liu, Mingjie Liu, Luoping Cui, Zhao Yang, Chuang Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes DSAA, a dual-stage attribute activation framework for fine-grained open-vocabulary detection that strengthens attribute semantics when category signals dominate.

entry.title: DanceHMR: Hand-Aware Whole-Body Human Mesh Recovery from Monocular Videos

author.name: Wenhao Shen, Ming Zhou, Hengyuan Zhang, Siyuan Bian, Youjiang Xu, Xi Lin

entry.summary: Presents DanceHMR, a whole-body human mesh recovery framework for monocular videos that unifies body motion and hand articulation through residual body-hand fusion in a temporal architecture.

entry.title: Best Segmentation Buddies for Image-Shape Correspondence

author.name: Itai Lang, Dongwei Lyu, Dale Decatur, Rana Hanocka

entry.summary: Addresses the underexplored task of finding segmentation correspondences between 2D images and untextured 3D shapes by distilling deep visual features from 2D vision models onto 3D surfaces and computing Best Segmentation Buddies for matching.

entry.title: Enhancing Train-Free Infinite-Frame Generation for Consistent Long Videos

author.name: X. Feng, J. Zhu, M. Wu, C. Chen, F. Mao, H. Guo, J. Wu, X. Chu, K. Huang

entry.summary: Proposes MIGA for train-free infinite-frame long video generation with a two-stage alignment mechanism to reduce training-inference gap and maintain long-term consistency in autoregressive frame generation frameworks.

entry.title: Code-as-Room: Generating 3D Rooms from Top-Down View Images via Agentic Code Synthesis

author.name: Yixuan Yang, Zhen Luo, Wanshui Gan, Jinkun Hao, Junru Lu, Jinghao Yan, Zhaoyang Lyu, Xudong Xu

entry.summary: Code-as-Room proposes an MLLM-based agentic framework that generates 3D rooms from top-down view images using Blender code synthesis, with a structured execution harness to prevent instability and infinite looping.

entry.title: Articulation in Prime: Primitive-Based Articulated Object Understanding from a Single Casual Video

author.name: Arslan Artykov, Tom Ravaud, Nicol\'as Violante-Grezzi, Vincent Lepetit

entry.summary: Proposes a category-agnostic optimization framework for articulated object understanding from monocular video using geometric primitives as proxy representations, avoiding reliance on point tracking or category-specific training.

entry.title: Flow Matching with Optimized Subclass Priors for Medical Image Augmentation

author.name: Felix N\"utzel, Mischa Dombrowski, Bernhard Kainz

entry.summary: Proposes flow matching with optimized subclass priors for medical image augmentation of rare diseases, using Gaussian mixture modeling to partition coarse labels into coherent submodes and provide informative source distributions.

entry.title: CATRF: Codec-Adaptive TriPlane Radiance Fields for Volumetric Content Delivery

author.name: Tung-I Chen, Lingdong Wang, Subhransu Maji, Ramesh K. Sitaraman

entry.summary: Presents CATRF, a codec-in-the-loop training framework for compressing radiance fields by quantizing feature planes into codec-friendly canvases and running standard codec roundtrips during training. Uses straight-through estimators to make non-differentiable codecs trainable.

entry.title: Nori Bot: A Sub-$1,000 Floor-to-Counter Mobile Manipulator

author.name: Antonio Li, Sungjoon Park, Wen Ni Chew

entry.summary: Presents Nori Bot, a $947 17-DoF dual-arm mobile manipulator with a Z-axis lift, proactive agent runtime, and software safety stack. Addresses key limitations of existing sub-$1000 platforms.

entry.title: Beyond Safety Filtering: Control Barrier Function-Informed Reinforcement Learning for Connected and Automated Vehicles

author.name: Jianye Xu, Bassam Alrifaee

entry.summary: Proposes CBF-informed reward design for multi-agent RL in autonomous driving, converting control barrier function constraint values into reward signals. Outperforms heuristic baselines at a four-way intersection.

entry.title: CosFly-Track: A Large-Scale Multi-Modal Dataset for UAV Visual Tracking via Multi-Constraint Trajectory Optimization

author.name: Xiangyue Wang, Hanxuan Chen, Songsheng Cheng, Ruilong Ren, Jie Zheng, Shuai Yuan, Tianle Zeng, Hanzhong Guo, Kangli Wang, Ji Pei

entry.summary: Introduces CosFlyTrack, a large-scale multi-modal dataset (12,000 trajectories, 2.4M timesteps, 334 hours) for UAV visual tracking with multi-constraint trajectory optimization in urban environments.

entry.title: TacSE3: Equivariant SE(3) Motion Estimation from Low-Texture Visuotactile Images for In-Gripper Tracking and Compensation

author.name: Zhongyuan Liao, Junzhe Wang, Qingyang Liu, Zhenmin Huang, Jun Ma, Yi Cai, Fei Meng, Haobo Liang, Michael Yu Wang

entry.summary: Presents TacSE3, a tactile motion estimation pipeline that converts low-texture visuotactile observations into force fields and estimates SE(3) rigid-body motion for in-gripper tracking and compensation.

entry.title: From Saddle Points Toward Global Minima: A Newton-Type Method on Wasserstein Space

author.name: Razvan-Andrei Lascu, Taiji Suzuki

entry.summary: Proposes Wasserstein Saddle-Free Newton (WSFN), a second-order optimization method on Wasserstein space that escapes saddle points while providing fast local convergence near global minimizers of non-convex functionals.

entry.title: RoPE Distinguishes Neither Positions Nor Tokens in Long Contexts, Provably

author.name: Yufeng Du, Phillip Harris, Minyang Tian, Eliu A Huerta, Srikanth Ronanki, Subendhu Rongali, Aram Galstyan, Hao Peng

entry.summary: As first covered in Research yesterday, Proves that RoPE (Rotary Positional Embeddings) loses both locality bias and token relevance consistency as context length increases, with failure probability approaching 0.5 (random chance). Provides theoretical explanation for long-context degradation.

entry.title: Verifiable Agentic Infrastructure: Proof-Derived Authorization for Sovereign AI Systems

author.name: Jun He, Deying Yu

entry.summary: Proposes a proof-derived authorization system for AI agents in cloud/sovereign systems, where agents must submit intents with cryptographic proofs of safety before execution is permitted.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Goal Recognition with Large Language Models

author.name: Kin Max Piamolini Gusm\~ao, Nathan Gavenski, Nir Oren, Felipe Meneguzzi

entry.summary: First systematic zero-shot evaluation of frontier LLMs as goal recognizers on classical PDDL benchmarks, finding that LLM competence is uneven - some models scale with evidence while others remain anchored to world-knowledge priors.

entry.title: PRISM: Prompt Reliability via Iterative Simulation and Monitoring for Enterprise Conversational AI

author.name: Keshava Chaitanya, Jahnavi Gundakaram

entry.summary: PRISM treats prompt engineering as continuous reliability engineering, detecting and repairing prompt regressions caused by silent LLM behavior changes over time through iterative simulation and monitoring.

entry.title: Sign-Separated Finite-Time Error Analysis of Q-Learning

author.name: Donghwan Lee

entry.summary: Develops sign-separated finite-time error analysis for Q-learning, decomposing error into positive and negative parts and connecting the asymmetry to overestimation bias.

entry.title: AgentStop: Terminating Local AI Agents Early to Save Energy in Consumer Devices

author.name: Dzung Pham, Kleomenis Katevas, Ali Shahin Shamsabadi, Hamed Haddadi

entry.summary: AgentStop investigates early termination of local LLM agents to save energy on consumer devices, addressing the resource-intensive nature of agentic workflows that often fail without completing tasks.

entry.title: MR2-ByteTrack: CNN and Transformer-based Video Object Detection for AI-augmented Embedded Vision Sensor Nodes

author.name: Luca Bompani, Manuele Rusci, Luca Benini, Daniele Palossi, Francesco Conti

entry.summary: Introduces MR2-ByteTrack, a video object detection method for ultra-low-power microcontrollers that alternates between full and low-resolution inference and uses ByteTrack for frame linking, achieving real-time performance on embedded devices.

entry.title: Bridging Silicon and the Hippocampus: Algebro-Deterministic Memory "VaCoAl" as a Substrate for Vector-HaSH and TEM

author.name: Hiroyuki Chuma, Kanji Otsuka, Yoichi Sato

entry.summary: Bridges hippocampal neuroscience models (Vector-HaSH, TEM) with an algebraic deterministic memory system (VaCoAl) using Galois-field operations, proposing hardware-friendly alternatives to random projections for associative memory.

entry.title: Bidirectional Fusion Guided by Cardiac Patterns for Semi-Supervised ECG Segmentation

author.name: Jeonghwa Lim, Minje Park, Sunghoon Joo

entry.summary: Introduces CardioMix, a semi-supervised ECG segmentation framework using bidirectional CutMix guided by cardiac patterns to exchange information between labeled and unlabeled sets.

entry.title: A Topology-Aware Spatiotemporal Handover Framework for Continuous Multi-UAV Tracking

author.name: Jianlin Ye, Christos Kyrkou, Panayiotis Kolios

entry.summary: Presents a topology-aware multi-UAV tracking framework for maintaining vehicle identity persistence across multiple drone fields of view, enabling network-level traffic analysis.

entry.title: Can Vision Language Models Be Adaptive in Mathematics Education? A Learner Model-based Rubric Study

author.name: Jie Gao, Yongan Yu, Junzhu Su, Yiran Lin, Adam K. Dube, Jackie Chi Kit Cheung

entry.summary: Evaluates whether vision-language models can adapt their mathematical tutoring to different learner profiles, proposing an evaluation framework based on learner model theory from education.

entry.title: XSearch: Explainable Code Search via Concept-to-Code Alignment

author.name: Yiming Liu, Ruofan Liu, Yun Lin, Zicong Zhang, Weiyu Kong, Pengnian Qi, Xiao Cheng, Weinan Zhang, Qianxiang Wang, Linpeng Huang

entry.summary: Proposes XSearch, an explainable code search framework that decomposes queries and code into aligned concepts, providing intrinsic explanations for retrieval results while improving generalization under distribution shift.

entry.title: Towards Trustworthy and Explainable AI for Perception Models: From Concept to Prototype Vehicle Deployment

author.name: Till Beemelmanns, Shayan Sharifi, Manas Mehrotra, Ayushman Choudhuri, Lutz Eckstein

entry.summary: Proposes a Trustworthy AI perception module for autonomous driving with attention-based explanations, calibrated uncertainty estimates, and deployment on a prototype vehicle.

entry.title: Phase Transitions in Driven Informational Systems: A Two-Field Perspective on Learning Theory and Non-Equilibrium Chemistry

author.name: Truong Xuan Khanh

entry.summary: Proposes a two-field perspective connecting phase transitions in deep learning (grokking, emergence) with non-equilibrium chemistry, describing both as driven informational systems governed by entropy production and information rate fields.

entry.title: Federated Nested Learning: Collaborative Training of Self-Referential Memories for Test-Time Adaptation

author.name: Hong Chen, Pengcheng Wu, Yuanguo Lin, Peilin Zhao, Xiuze Zhou, Fan Lin, Han Yu

entry.summary: Proposes Federated Nested Learning, reformulating FL as three-level nested optimization with Titans-based linear attention enabling zero-shot test-time adaptation for non-IID data.

entry.title: Two-Valued Symmetric Circulant Matrices: Applications in Deep Learning

author.name: Jayakrishna Amathi, Venkata Prasanth Yanambaka, Saraju P. Mohanty, Elias Kougianos

entry.summary: Proposes Two-Valued Symmetric Circulant Matrix (TVSCM) for extreme compression of fully connected layers, using only two weights per layer while maintaining circulant and symmetric structure for negligible storage costs.

entry.title: Automatic Unsupervised Ensemble Outlier Model Selection--Extended Version

author.name: Hong-Phuc Phan, Tuan-Anh Vu, Tung Kieu, Son Ha Xuan, Bin Yang, Christian S. Jensen

entry.summary: MetaEns learns to predict marginal ensemble gains for composing outlier detection ensembles without labeled data, avoiding ensemble saturation where redundant models degrade performance.

entry.title: Learning What Evaluators Value: A Reliable Approach to Modeling Evaluator Preferences

author.name: Madeline Celi Kitch, Nihar B. Shah

entry.summary: Addresses the problem of learning evaluator preferences from criteria-to-overall-evaluation mappings, developing reliable methods without restrictive modeling assumptions about how evaluators combine criteria.

entry.title: MedMIX: Modality-Internal Expert Fusion for Multimodal Medical Diagnosis

author.name: Seungik Cho, Anqi Li, Wei Qiu

entry.summary: MedMIX combines intra-modality expert fusion from multiple foundation models, learned inter-modality fusion, and teacher-student collaboration for robust medical prediction under missing modalities.

entry.title: Extending Pretrained 10-Second ECG Foundation Models to Longer Horizons

author.name: Wei Tang, Jinpei Han, Kangning Cui, Mattia Carletti, Fredrik K. Gustafsson, Shreyank N Gowda, Patitapaban Palo, Anshul Thakur, Lei Clifton, Jean-michel Morel, Raymond H. Chan, David A. Clifton, Xiao Gu

entry.summary: Proposes a parameter-efficient framework to extend pretrained 10-second ECG foundation models to longer and variable-length recordings without retraining, addressing structural and semantic challenges of temporal aggregation.

entry.title: When Dynamics Shift, Robust Task Inference Wins: Offline Imitation Learning with Behavior Foundation Models Revisited

author.name: Rishabh Agrawal, Rahul Jain, Ashutosh Nayyar

entry.summary: Formulates Behavior Foundation Model task-inference as a robust minimax optimization problem to handle dynamics shifts (friction, actuation changes) in offline imitation learning, without modifying pretraining.

entry.title: Anytime and Difficulty-Adaptive PAC-Bayes for Constrained Density-Ratio Network with Continual Learning Guarantees

author.name: Paulo Akira F. Enabe

entry.summary: Presents a unified PAC-Bayes framework for learning under covariate shift with a constrained density-ratio network, providing anytime generalization certificates and difficulty-adaptive bounds for continual learning.

entry.title: Fidelity Probes for Specification--Code Alignment

author.name: Ferhat Erata, Hao Zhou, Luke Huan

entry.summary: Introduces fidelity probes: natural-language questions with code-derived ground truth used to measure specification-code alignment, achieving 0.63→0.94 fidelity improvement on a COBOL benchmark through iterative spec refinement.

entry.title: When Molecular Similarity Works: Property Cliffs Reveal Hidden Errors

author.name: Di Hu, Kun Li, Haojie Rao, Longtao Hu, Jiameng Chen, Wenbin Hu, Yizhen Zheng, Jiajun Yu, Duanhua Cao

entry.summary: Introduces CliffSplit (cliff-aware evaluation) and CliffLoss (training mitigation) for molecular property prediction, exposing failures where structurally similar molecules have vastly different properties.

entry.title: Radial-Angular Geometry for Reliable Update Diagnosis in Noisy-Label Learning

author.name: Ningkang Peng, Jingyang Mao, Xiaoqian Peng, Weiguang Qu, Yanhui Gu

entry.summary: Proposes radial-angular geometry for noisy label detection using the empirical Fisher trace decomposed into prediction-residual and feature-sensitivity terms, providing backward-space reliability diagnosis.

entry.title: The Silent Brush: Evaluating Artistic Style Leakage in AI Art Generation

author.name: Ninad Joshi, Ashutosh Ranjan, Vivek Srivastava, Shirish Karande

entry.summary: Evaluates 'The Silent Brush' phenomenon where generative models reproduce learned artistic styles without explicit prompting, proposing evaluation methods for unintended stylistic resurfacing across prompts.

entry.title: MARR: Module-Adaptive Residual Reconstruction for Low-Bit Post-Training Quantization

author.name: Le Su, Xing Luo, Zhi Jin

entry.summary: MARR proposes module-adaptive residual reconstruction for low-bit post-training quantization, using per-module scaling coefficients to balance Hessian approximation bias correction against accumulated error correction.

entry.title: S2Aligner: Pair-Efficient and Transferable Pre-Training for Sparse Text-Attributed Graphs

author.name: Yuhan Wang, Haopeng Zhang, Yibo Ding, Jiaqi Yu, Xinyu Zhao, Yuhang Liu, Ziwei Zhang, Xiao Wang, Ruijie Wang

entry.summary: Proposes S2Aligner for pre-training on sparse text-attributed graphs, addressing the challenge of weak or missing textual anchors in real-world graphs through a sparsity-aware LLM-as-Aligner framework.

entry.title: A No-Defense Defense Against Gradient-Based Adversarial Attacks on ML-NIDS: Is Less More?

author.name: Mohamed elShehaby, Ashraf Matrawy

entry.summary: Investigates whether careful architectural choices (shallow networks, reduced features, ReLU) alone can make DNN-based network intrusion detection systems robust to gradient-based adversarial attacks without explicit defenses.

entry.title: Public-Decay Homomorphic State Space Models for Private Sequence Inference

author.name: Luis Brito

entry.summary: Presents public-decay homomorphic state space models (HSSMs) for privacy-preserving sequence inference, keeping encrypted state updates through ciphertext-plaintext operations while minimizing expensive ciphertext-ciphertext multiplications.

entry.title: VolTA-3D: Self-Supervised Learning for Brain MRI using 3D Volumetric Token Alignment

author.name: Amy Makawana, Abhijeet Parida, Marius George Linguraru, Julia Ive, Syed Muhammad Anwar

entry.summary: Presents VolTA-3D, a self-supervised 3D Vision Transformer for brain MRI that jointly aligns global and local tokens in a student-teacher paradigm, enabling transferable volumetric representations across tasks.

entry.title: Diffusion-Based Stochastic Operator Networks for Uncertainty Quantification in Stochastic Partial Differential Equations

author.name: Phuoc-Toan Huynh, Richard Archibald, Feng Bao

entry.summary: Introduces Stochastic Operator Networks combining DeepONet with diffusion-based generative modeling for uncertainty quantification in stochastic PDEs, learning from noisy data to output mean solutions and uncertainty estimates.

entry.title: Position: Age Estimation Models Do Not Process Biometric Data

author.name: Nikita Marshalkin

entry.summary: Position paper arguing that age estimation neural networks do not process biometric data in a legal sense, providing empirical evidence across 14 models showing they fall far short of identification thresholds on face verification benchmarks.

entry.title: On Gaussian approximation for entropy-regularized Q-learning with function approximation

author.name: Artemy Rubtsov, Rahul Singh, Eric Moulines, Alexey Naumov, Sergey Samsonov

entry.summary: Derives convergence rates for the central limit theorem of Polyak-Ruppert averaged iterates in entropy-regularized Q-learning with linear function approximation, establishing Gaussian approximation bounds.

entry.title: Dynamic robotic cloth folding with efficient Koopman operator-based model predictive control

author.name: Edoardo Caldarelli, Franco Coltraro, Adri\`a Colom\'e, Lorenzo Rosasco, Carme Torras

entry.summary: Tackles dynamic robotic cloth folding using Koopman operator-based model predictive control, generating fast folding trajectories that leverage cloth dynamics while maintaining precision.

entry.title: Beyond Morphology: Quantifying the Diagnostic Power of Color Features in Cancer Classification

author.name: Farnaz Kheiri, Shahryar Rahnamayan, Masoud Makrehchi

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates standalone discriminative power of global color features (excluding morphology) for cancer classification in histopathology. Shows that pixel intensity alone can achieve surprisingly strong classification performance across multiple experimental settings.

entry.title: Scaling Accessible Mathematics on arXiv: HTML Conversion and MathML 4

author.name: Deyan Ginev, Brian Caruso, Bruce Miller, Jeff Sank, Jacob Weiskoff

entry.summary: Reports on arXiv's HTML Papers conversion effort, covering community-driven improvements, MathML 4 intent annotations for accessibility, and an in-progress Rust port of LaTeXML. Currently at 75% error-free HTML, targeting 90%.

entry.title: JSPG: Dynamic Dictionary Filtering via Joint Semantic-Pinyin-Glyph Retrieval for Chinese Contextual ASR

author.name: Shilin Zhou, Zhenghua Li

entry.summary: Proposes JSPG, a dynamic dictionary filtering framework for Chinese contextual ASR that jointly integrates semantic, pinyin, and glyph features to handle homophonic errors that defeat standard semantic retrieval.

entry.title: NewsLens: A Multi-Agent Framework for Adversarial News Bias Navigation

author.name: Joy Bose

entry.summary: Presents NewsLens, a five-agent adversarial pipeline for structured news bias navigation that exposes ideological omissions and framing boundaries rather than just classifying bias labels.

entry.title: From Documents to Segments: A Contextual Reformulation for Topic Assignment

author.name: Hoonsang Yoon, Takyoung Kim, Wonkee Lee, Ilmin Cho, Dilek Hakkani-T\"ur, Stanley Jungkyu Choi

entry.summary: Introduces segment-based topic allocation (SBTA), reformulating topic modeling to assign topics to short coherent text spans rather than entire documents. This addresses topic contamination in multi-topic documents like reviews and survey responses.

entry.title: WASIL: In-the-Wild Arabic Spoken Interactions with LLMs

author.name: Zien Sheikh Ali, Hamdy Mubarak, Soon-Gyo Jung, Hunzalah Hassan Bhatti, Firoj Alam, Shammur Absar Chowdhury

entry.summary: Releases WASIL, an Arabic spoken interaction dataset with audio, ASR hypotheses, assistant responses, and like/dislike feedback (8,529 turns). Covers MSA and four major dialects with gold transcripts and answerability annotations.

entry.title: Recall Isn't Enough: Bounding Commitments in Personalized Language Systems

author.name: Rui Tang, Yichi Zhang, Xi Chen, Chen Dong, Youwei Yang, Yumeng Shen

entry.summary: Introduces Contract-Bounded Evidence Activation (CBEA) with Lexicographic Commitment Validation (LCV) for personalized language systems, addressing failure modes where systems turn noisy hints into hard constraints or forget obligations.

entry.title: RAG-based EEG-to-Text Translation Using Deep Learning and LLMs

author.name: Enrico Collautti, Xiaopeng Mao, Luca Tonin, Stefano Tortora, Sadasivan Puthusserypady

entry.summary: Proposes a RAG-based pipeline for EEG-to-text decoding combining an EEG encoder aligned with semantic embeddings, vector retrieval, and LLM refinement. Claims to surpass random baselines without teacher forcing.

entry.title: NERVE: A Neuromorphic Vision and Radar Ensemble for Multi-Sensor Fusion Research

author.name: Omar Mansour, Pietro Martinello, Ethan Milon, YingFu Xu, Manolis Sifalakis, Guangzhi Tang, Amirreza Yousefzadeh

entry.summary: Presents NERVE, a multi-sensor dataset with 257 minutes of synchronized DVS, RGB-D, and radar data for evaluating neuromorphic vision and radar fusion in office environments.

entry.title: CT-DegradBench: A Physics-Informed Benchmark for CT Degradation Detection and Severity Estimation

author.name: Yousra Nabila Taifour, Marouane Tliba, Zuheng Ming, Marie Luong, Nour Aburaed, Aladine Chetouani, Gorkem Durak, Alessandro Bruno, Faouzi Alaya Cheikh, Habib Zaidi, Ulas Bagci, Azeddine Beghdadi

entry.summary: Introduces CT-DegradBench, a benchmark for CT degradation detection and severity estimation under controlled artifact settings, with a proposed Semantic-Spectral CT method for degradation classification.

entry.title: MAVEN A Multi-Agent Framework for Multicultural Text-to-Video Generation

author.name: Shuowei Li, Yuming Zhao, Parth Bhalerao, Oana Ignat

entry.summary: Introduces MAVEN, a multi-agent framework for culturally faithful text-to-video generation using specialized agents for person, action, and location dimensions across Chinese, American, and Romanian cultures.

entry.title: Diffeomorphic Cortical Alignment via Direct Warping of Streamline Endpoints

author.name: Yang Xiang, Martin Cole, Zhengwu Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces a connectivity-based cortical surface registration method that aligns surfaces using white-matter fiber-tract endpoints directly, modeling them as point clouds on a product manifold.

entry.title: NeuroLiDAR: Adaptive Frame Rate Depth Sensing via Neuromorphic Event-LiDAR Fusion

author.name: Darshana Rathnayake, Dulanga Weerakoon, Meera Radhakrishnan, Archan Misra

entry.summary: Presents NeuroLiDAR, an adaptive depth sensing framework achieving ~66 Hz effective frame rates by fusing sparse LiDAR with dense neuromorphic event camera inputs, dynamically adjusting sensing rate based on scene dynamics.

entry.title: DecoRec: Decomposed 3D Scene Reconstruction from Single-View Images via Object-Level Diffusion

author.name: Yuhan Ping, Yuan Liu, Xiaoxiao Long, Peng Wang, Junhui Hou, Jianyi Zheng, Jia Pan, Xin Li, Cheng Lin

entry.summary: Introduces DecoRec, a system for single-view to decomposed 3D scene mesh reconstruction using diffusion-based object-level reconstruction with a refinement pipeline for scene-level consistency.

entry.title: Prefix-Adaptive Block Diffusion for Efficient Document Recognition

author.name: Mingxu Chai, Ziyu Shen, Chenyu Liu, Kaidi Zhang, Jiazheng Zhang, Dingwei Zhu, Zhiheng Xi, Ruoyu Chen, Jun Long, Jihua Kang, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes PA-BDM for document recognition, replacing bidirectional block denoising with causal denoising and adaptive block sizes, enabling more efficient KV caching and better structure-sensitive recognition.

entry.title: VGGT-Occ: Geometry-Grounded and Density-Aware Gated Fusion for 3D Occupancy Prediction

author.name: Xun Chen, Tianchen Deng, Rui Wang, Fangjinhua Wang, Junyi Ma, Hongming Shen, Hesheng Wang, Danwei Wang

entry.summary: Proposes VGGT-Occ for 3D occupancy prediction with geometry tokens throughout the pipeline, using Projection-Aware Deformable Attention to inject camera geometry into attention stages.

entry.title: StreamingEffect: Real-Time Human-Centric Video Effect Generation

author.name: Yiren Song, Cheng Liu, Yuxin Jiang, Mike Zheng Shou

entry.summary: Presents StreamingEffect for real-time human-centric video effects using in-context video editing with efficient distillation, enabling live streaming applications like e-commerce and entertainment.

entry.title: iMiGUE-3K: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Micro-Gesture Analysis with Self-Supervised Learning

author.name: Chengyan Wang, Haoyu Chen, Hui Wei, Yueyi Yang, Yunquan Chen, Guoying Zhao

entry.summary: Presents iMiGUE-3K, a large-scale benchmark for micro-gesture-based emotion understanding with a new dataset and foundation models, addressing the lack of pre-training data for micro-gesture recognition.

entry.title: LongDPM: Overlap-Aware 4D Reconstruction from Long Monocular Videos

author.name: Chenyi Xu, Yihao Wu, Liqi Yan, Chao Yang, Jianhui Zhang, Fangli Guan, Pan Li

entry.summary: Proposes LongDPM for overlap-aware 4D reconstruction from long monocular videos using overlapping chunks with confidence-weighted alignment between chunk-local coordinate systems.

entry.title: MSIQ: Moment-based Scale-Invariant Quality Measure for Single Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Leonid Bedratyuk

entry.summary: Proposes MSIQ, a scale-invariant quality metric for super-resolution based on normalized central geometric moments, enabling direct comparison of images with different spatial resolutions without forced resizing.

entry.title: Unleashing the Representational Power of Fourier Shapes for Attacking Infrared Object Detection

author.name: Yixing Yong, Jian Wang, Ming Lei, Lijun He, Fan Li

entry.summary: Introduces learnable Fourier shapes for infrared adversarial attacks, providing a differentiable framework where compact Fourier coefficients define adversarial thermal shape boundaries.

entry.title: Rad-VLSM: A Cross-Modal Framework with Semantics-Assisted Prompting for Medical Segmentation and Diagnosis

author.name: Fengyi Zhang, Xujie Zeng, Mohan Liu, Zengyi Wang, Yalong Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes Rad-VLSM, a two-stage cross-modal framework combining BLIP-2 for lesion focusing with SAM for segmentation and visually grounded diagnosis in medical images.

entry.title: GaussianZoom: Progressive Zoom-in Generative 3D Gaussian Splatting with Geometric and Semantic Guidance

author.name: Jiale Shi, Jiarui Hu, Zesong Yang, Kaixuan Luan, Hujun Bao, Zhaopeng Cui

entry.summary: GaussianZoom introduces a progressive zoom-in 3D reconstruction system combining geometry-consistent modeling with multi-scale semantic reasoning using depth-based feature warping and VLM-driven detail synthesis for extreme zoom-in rendering from low-resolution inputs.

entry.title: Benchmarking transferability of SSL pretraining to same and different modality segmentation tasks

author.name: Jue Jiang, Harini Veeraraghavan

entry.summary: Benchmarks nine SSL pretext-task families pretrained on 10K 3D CT scans for transferability across nine segmentation tasks, analyzing convergence speed, CT-to-MRI transfer, and feature-reuse patterns.

entry.title: Weakly Supervised Cross-Modal Learning for 4D Radar Scene Flow Estimation

author.name: Jingyun Fu, Zhiyu Xiang, Na Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes a weakly supervised framework for 4D radar scene flow estimation using only images and odometry for supervision during training, avoiding the need for expensive LiDAR sensors to generate pseudo labels.

entry.title: Efficient Feature-Free Initialization for Monocular Visual-Inertial Systems Using a Feed-Forward 3D Model

author.name: Yuantai Zhang, Jiaqi Yang, Huajian Zeng, Changhao Chen, Haoang Li, Liang Li, Dezhen Song, Xingxing Zuo

entry.summary: Proposes a feature-free visual-inertial initialization framework using feed-forward 3D models to predict point clouds from images, eliminating the need for visual feature correspondences and reducing initialization time from 3-4 seconds.

entry.title: Von Economo neurons enable reliable social skill acquisition in recurrent spiking neural networks: a computational account with clinical predictions

author.name: Esila Keskin

entry.summary: Models Von Economo neurons in a spiking neural network to study their computational role in social learning. VEN-intact networks converge reliably (98%) vs VEN-ablated (70%), offering predictions relevant to frontotemporal dementia and autism.

entry.title: Pedestrian-Aware LLM-Driven Behavioral Planning for Autonomous Vehicles

author.name: Aidana Baimbetova, Haruki Yonekura, Hamada Rizk, Hirozumi Yamaguchi

entry.summary: Introduces an LLM-based decision-making framework for pedestrian-aware autonomous vehicle behavioral planning, converting scene observations into natural-language reasoning prompts for safe driving decisions.

entry.title: Generalizable and Actionable Parts Pose Estimation with Symmetry Annotation-Free Learning Strategy

author.name: Wenxiao Chen, Xueyu Yuan, Liu Liu, Di Wu, Dan Guo

entry.summary: Proposes SAFAG, a symmetry annotation-free framework for generalizable and actionable parts pose estimation. Uses stepwise refinement for quaternion regression without requiring rich symmetry annotations.

entry.title: Visual Sculpting: Visually-Aligned Planning Representations for Long-Horizon Robot Clay Sculpting

author.name: Peter Schaldenbrand, Jean Oh

entry.summary: Proposes Visual Sculpting, a method for robotic clay sculpting using visually-aligned dynamics modeling that captures lighting and texture features, enabling long-horizon deformable material manipulation planning.

entry.title: Learning-Based Adaptive Control for Surgical Robotic Exposure Task on Deformable Tissues

author.name: Jiayi Liu, Kaiqi Wei, Yiwei Wang, Huan Zhao, Han Ding

entry.summary: Proposes a learning-based adaptive control framework for autonomous surgical tissue retraction, using online optimization based on visual boundary monitoring and a deep deformation estimation model.

entry.title: FUSE: A Framework for Unified State Estimation in Robotic SLAM Systems

author.name: Wei Wu, Honglin Chen, Wenhan Cao, Yao Lyu, Jiangtao Li, Tao Zhang, Shengbo Eben Li

entry.summary: Presents FUSE, a modular framework for unified state estimation in SLAM that separates temporal processing, geometric association, estimator formulation, and map-update policy into interchangeable components.

entry.title: Conditional Predictive Inference for General Structured Data with Group Symmetries

author.name: Yichen Shen, Mengxin Yu

entry.summary: Studies distribution-free predictive inference for data with group symmetries, establishing near-conditional coverage guarantees beyond exchangeability for structured data like networks, clusters, and imaging.

entry.title: Stable Causal Discovery via Directed Acyclic Graph Aggregation

author.name: Yunan Wu, Yue Wang, Chunlin Li, Chenglong Ye

entry.summary: Proposes DAGgr, a model averaging framework that aggregates multiple candidate DAGs into a stable causal graph weighted by out-of-sample predictive likelihood, with guarantees that the result preserves acyclicity.

entry.title: Hidden in Memory: Sleeper Memory Poisoning in LLM Agents

author.name: Sidharth Pulipaka, Stanislau Hlebik, Leonidas Raghav, Sahar Abdelnabi, Vyas Raina, Ivaxi Sheth, Mario Fritz

entry.summary: As first covered in Research yesterday, Introduces 'sleeper memory poisoning' - a novel attack where adversaries manipulate external content to inject fabricated memories into LLM assistants with persistent memory, which can remain dormant and re-emerge across future conversations. This reveals a fundamental security risk in stateful AI assistants.

entry.title: Context Pruning for Coding Agents via Multi-Rubric Latent Reasoning

author.name: Jingjing Wang, Xiwen Chen, Wenhui Zhu, Huayu Li, Zhengxiao He, Feiyang Cai, Ana S. Carreon-Rascon, Xuanzhao Dong, Feng Luo

entry.summary: LaMR decomposes code relevance for context pruning into two interpretable dimensions (semantic evidence and dependency support) using dedicated CRF models, reducing token costs for coding agents.

entry.title: X-SYNTH: Beyond Retrieval -- Enterprise Context Synthesis from Observed Human Attention

author.name: Guruprasad Raghavan, George Nychis, Rohan Narayana Murthy

entry.summary: X-SYNTH proposes synthesizing enterprise context for AI agents by learning from observed human attention patterns rather than traditional retrieval, addressing the gap between what's stored in systems and what knowledge workers actually need.

entry.title: Petri Net Induced Heuristic Search for Resource Constrained Scheduling

author.name: Ido Lublin, Dor Atzmon, Izack Cohen

entry.summary: Formulates the Resource-Constrained Project Scheduling Problem as optimal search over Petri Net reachability graphs, using A* with consistent heuristics that outperform MILP baselines on PSPLIB benchmarks.

entry.title: Agent4POI: Agentic Context-Conditioned Affordance Reasoning for Multimodal Point-of-Interest Recommendation

author.name: Jinze Wang, Yangchen Zeng, Tiehua Zhang, Lu Zhang, Yuze Liu, Yongchao Liu, Xingjun Ma, Zhu Sun

entry.summary: Agent4POI generates dynamic context-conditioned representations for POI recommendation at inference time rather than using static pre-computed embeddings, formally proving static encoders cannot satisfy context-sensitive ranking.

entry.title: Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models for Schema-Constrained Clinical Information Extraction

author.name: A H M Rezaul Karim, Ozlem Uzuner

entry.summary: Proposes a modular RAG pipeline for extracting structured observations from nurse-patient transcripts, combining schema-constrained prompting with retrieval from training exemplars.

entry.title: Lamarckian Inheritance in Dynamic Environments: How Key Variables Affect Evolutionary Dynamics

author.name: K. Ege de Bruin, Kyrre Glette, Kai Olav Ellefsen

entry.summary: Studies how key variables affect the benefit of Lamarckian inheritance in evolutionary robotics with dynamic environments, reconciling conflicting evidence in the literature.

entry.title: CHoE: Cross-Domain Heterogeneous Graph Prompt Learning via Structure-Conditioned Experts

author.name: Peiyuan Li, Yongqi Huang, Jitao Zhao, Dongxiao He, Di Jin, Weixiong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes CHoE for cross-domain heterogeneous graph prompt learning using expert networks to handle distribution shifts between pre-training and downstream domains. Addresses a real limitation of existing graph prompt methods that only work in-domain.

entry.title: Multi-level Self-supervised Pretraining on Compositional Hierarchical Graph for Molecular Property Prediction

author.name: Xiayu Liu, Zhengyi Lu, Hou-biao Li

entry.summary: Proposes MolCHG, a multi-level self-supervised pretraining framework on a compositional hierarchical molecular graph that elevates bond-level information to independent node representations.

entry.title: paper.json: A Coordination Convention for LLM-Agent-Actionable Papers

author.name: Arquimedes Canedo

entry.summary: Proposes paper.json, a JSON companion file for academic papers to make them more actionable by LLM agents, with stable claim IDs, explicit scope limitations, and reproducibility commands.

entry.title: ReTAMamba: Reliability-Aware Temporal Aggregation with Mamba for Irregular Clinical Time Series Prediction

author.name: Jinwoong Kim, Sangjin Park

entry.summary: ReTAMamba combines Mamba architecture with reliability-aware temporal aggregation for irregular clinical time series, estimating observation reliability from missingness and elapsed time to handle the decay of information quality.

entry.title: Nested Spatio-Temporal Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Yinghao Ai, Yukai Zhou, Ruoxi Jiang, Junyi An, Chao Qu, Zhijian Zhou, Shiyu Wang, Fenglei Cao, Zenglin Xu, Furao Shen, Yuan Qi

entry.summary: Proposes a nested spatiotemporal forecasting framework that couples macro-level regional trends with micro-level observations, using spectral clustering to construct semantically coherent regions for top-down guidance.

entry.title: World Model-Enabled Causal Digital Twins for Semantic Communications in Physical AI Systems

author.name: Lingyi Wang, Tingyu Shui, Walid Saad, Pascal Adjakple

entry.summary: Proposes world model-enabled causal digital twins for semantic communications in physical AI systems, formulating goal-oriented communications as a long-horizon optimization problem for closed-loop sensing-communication-inference-control.

entry.title: Isolating Nonlinear Independent Sources in fMRI with $\beta$-TCVAE Models

author.name: Qiang Li, Shujian Yu, Jesus Malo, Jingyu Liu, T\"ulay Adali, Vince D. Calhoun

entry.summary: Uses β-TCVAE to learn nonlinear independent sources from fMRI data, going beyond linear ICA to capture complex brain dynamics with validation on real neuroimaging data.

entry.title: PULSE: Generative Phase Evolution for Non-Stationary Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Yangyou Liu, Zezhi Shao, Xinyu Chen, Hu Chen, Fei Wang, Yuankai Wu

entry.summary: PULSE formalizes non-stationary time series dynamics through physical hypotheses and proposes phase-anchored disentanglement to address 'Phase Amnesia' where models lose track of evolving global context.

entry.title: Learning Multi-Timescale Abstractions for Hierarchical Combinatorial Planning

author.name: Vivienne Huiling Wang, Tinghuai Wang, Joni Pajarinen

entry.summary: Introduces a model-based hierarchical RL framework for sequential stochastic combinatorial optimization, combining latent-space tree-search with an SMDP-aware world model that handles variable-duration actions.

entry.title: Towards Principled Test-Time Adaptation for Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Haochun Wang, Ruichen Xu, Georgios Kementzidis, Karen Cho, Sebastian Ramirez Villarreal, Yuefan Deng

entry.summary: Proposes principled test-time adaptation for time series forecasting using a clean protocol based on matured ground truth, with frequency-domain diagnosis revealing existing adapters make limited spectral modifications.

entry.title: Learning Higher-Order Structure from Incomplete Spatiotemporal Data: Multi-Scale Hypergraph Laplacians with Neural Refinement

author.name: Keshu Wu, Sixu Li, Zihao Li, Zhiwen Fan, Xiaopeng Li, Yang Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes Multi-Scale Hypergraph Laplacians for imputing spatiotemporal sensor data with structured (non-random) missingness patterns, capturing higher-order relations among sensor groups.

entry.title: Q-LocalAdam: Memory-Efficient Client-Side Adaptive Optimization for Edge Federated Learning

author.name: Vedant Waykole, Haroon R. Lone

entry.summary: Proposes Q-LocalAdam with distribution-aware 8-bit quantization of Adam optimizer states for federated edge learning, exploiting the observation that momentum is symmetric while variance is log-normal.

entry.title: Beyond Accuracy: Robustness, Interpretability and Expressiveness of EEG Foundation Models

author.name: Urban \v{S}irca, Maryam Alimardani, Stefanos Zafeiriou, Konstantinos Barmpas

entry.summary: Benchmarks six EEG foundation models beyond accuracy, testing robustness to noise/dropout, interpretability via attribution methods, and representational quality, finding no model dominates all dimensions.

entry.title: Counterfactual Explanations Under Concept Drift

author.name: Marcin Kostrzewa, Jerzy Stefanowski, Maciej Zi\k{e}ba

entry.summary: Identifies that counterfactual explanations become invalid under concept drift in streaming settings and proposes a lightweight model-agnostic update scheme to repair existing explanations while preserving proximity to original instances.

entry.title: Efficient Bilevel Optimization for Meta Label Correction in Noisy Label Learning

author.name: Ba Hoang Anh Nguyen, Viet Cuong Ta

entry.summary: Proposes dynamic barrier gradient descent for meta label correction to reduce computational cost of hypergradient computation, achieving approximately first-order complexity while preventing leakage of noisy labels.

entry.title: Improving Spatio-Temporal Residual Error Propagation by Mitigating Over-Squashing

author.name: Seyed Mohamad Moghadas, Esther Rodrigo Bonet, Bruno Cornelis, Adrian Munteanu

entry.summary: Teger proposes a structured uncertainty module for multivariate time series forecasting that models both spatial and temporal error correlations, mitigating over-squashing in residual error propagation.

entry.title: Attacking the First-Principle: A Black-Box, Query-Free Targeted Mimicry Attack on Binary Function Classifiers

author.name: Gabriel Sauger (UL, CNRS, LORIA, Inria), Jean-Yves Marion (UL, CNRS, LORIA, Inria), Sazzadur Rahaman (CNRS, UL, LORIA, Inria), Victor Matrat (CNRS, UL, LORIA, Inria), Vincent Tourneur (UL, CNRS, LORIA, Inria), Muaz Ali

entry.summary: Kelpie is a framework for black-box, zero-query targeted mimicry attacks on binary function classifiers using code transformations that preserve malicious functionality while causing misclassification.

entry.title: KairosHope: A Next-Generation Time-Series Foundation Model for Specialized Classification via Dual-Memory Architecture

author.name: Luis Balderas, Jos\'e Alberto Rodr\'iguez, Miguel Lastra, Antonio Arauzo-Azofra, Jos\'e M. Ben\'itez

entry.summary: Introduces KairosHope, a time-series foundation model for classification using a dual-memory architecture (Titans modules + Continuum Memory System) replacing standard attention to address computational bottlenecks.

entry.title: Helping Customers in Distress: An LLM-powered Agent that Converses, Probes, and Routes

author.name: Alankar Atreya, Stefan Sylvius Wanger, Devesh Batra, Robert Hankache, Cristovao Iglesias Jr, Patrick Sinclair, Giulio Pelosio, Michael McMillan, Greig A. Cowan, Raad Khraishi

entry.summary: Develops an LLM-powered triaging agent for bank fraud/scam reports that conducts multi-turn conversations and routes customers to appropriate specialist teams, using synthetic digital twins for evaluation.

entry.title: Overcoming the Intrinsic Performance Limitations of MEMS IMU via Diffusion-Based Generative Learning

author.name: Jiarui Lv, Feng Zhu, Xiaohong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a diffusion-based framework for synthesizing high-fidelity virtual IMU data from low-cost MEMS IMU measurements, using conditional diffusion to overcome inherent hardware limitations.

entry.title: Multilingual OCR-Aware Fine-Tuning and Prompt-Guided Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Qinwu Xu, Xin Liu, Yifan Jiang, Haoyu Ren

entry.summary: Presents an OCR-aware multilingual training framework combining synthetic data generation, LoRA fine-tuning, and visual chain-of-thought prompting to improve multimodal LLM performance on challenging OCR tasks.

entry.title: Isotonic Survival Regression: Calibrated Survival Distributions from Deep Cox Models

author.name: Anchit Jain, Kevin Zhang, Stephen Bates

entry.summary: Proposes a post-hoc calibration method for Deep Cox survival models using isotonic regression to improve predicted survival probabilities without affecting discriminative power.

entry.title: Learning Relative Representations for Fine-Grained Multimodal Alignment with Limited Data

author.name: Shiwon Kim, Yu Rang Park

entry.summary: Proposes a post-hoc multimodal alignment method using relative representations at the token level, enabling fine-grained cross-modal matching with limited paired data.

entry.title: CAST: Causal Anchored Simplex Transport for Distribution-Valued Time Series

author.name: Jiecheng Lu, Jieqi Di, Runhua Wu, Yuwei Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces CAST for causal forecasting of distribution-valued time series on the probability simplex, using successor retrieval, persistence anchoring, and bounded local transport.

entry.title: SHED: Style-Homogenized Embedding Alignment for Domain Generalization

author.name: Kai Gan, Tong Wei

entry.summary: Proposes SHED, a CLIP-based domain generalization method that aligns style-homogenized embeddings by removing domain-specific visual styles before alignment to address information asymmetry between image and text modalities.

entry.title: Empirical evaluation of Time Series Foundation Models for Day-ahead and Imbalance Electricity Price Forecasting in Belgium

author.name: Chi Bui, Maria Margarida Mascarenhas, Arnaud Verstraeten, Hussain Kazmi

entry.summary: Evaluates time series foundation models (Chronos-2, TimesFM 2.5) for Belgian electricity price forecasting, finding Chronos-2 in ARX mode produces most accurate forecasts with 18.8% lower MAE than best ML ensemble.

entry.title: Weighted Flow Matching and Physics-Informed Nonlinear Filtering for Parameter Estimation in Digital Twins

author.name: Yasar Yanik, Himadri Basu, Ricardo G. Sanfelice, Daniele Venturi

entry.summary: Develops weighted flow matching integrated with physics-informed nonlinear filtering for parameter estimation in digital twins, using dynamic sample reweighting to focus on informative parameter regimes.

entry.title: StatQAT: Statistical Quantizer Optimization for Deep Networks

author.name: Mehmet Aktukmak, Daniel Huang, Ke Ding

entry.summary: Presents StatQAT, a statistical error analysis framework for uniform and floating-point quantization, proposing iterative quantizers for arbitrary distributions and analytic quantizers for Gaussian-like weights.

entry.title: The MixCount Dataset: Bridging the Data Gap for Open-Vocabulary Object Counting

author.name: Corentin Dumery, Niki Amini-Naieni, Shervin Naini, Pascal Fua

entry.summary: Introduces MixCount dataset for mixed-object counting, addressing systematic failures of current models in multi-class counting scenarios, with an automated pipeline for generating diverse synthetic counting scenes.

entry.title: SIREM: Speech-Informed MRI Reconstruction with Learned Sampling

author.name: Md Hasan, Nyvenn Castro, Daiqi Liu, Lukas Mulzer, Jana Hutter, Jonghye Woo, Moritz Zaiss, Andreas Maier, Paula A. Perez-Toro

entry.summary: Proposes SIREM, a speech-informed MRI reconstruction framework that uses synchronized speech audio as cross-modal prior to improve real-time vocal tract MRI quality under k-space undersampling.

entry.title: Better Together: Evaluating the Complementarity of Earth Embedding Models

author.name: Thijs L van der Plas, Jacob JW Bakermans, Vishal Nedungadi, Gabriel\.e Tij\=unaityt\.e, Marc Ru{\ss}wurm, Ioannis N Athanasiadis

entry.summary: Evaluates complementarity of Earth embedding models (AlphaEarth, Tessera, GeoCLIP, SatCLIP) by measuring performance gains from fusion. Introduces an embedding complementarity index to assess how well different models combine.

entry.title: Closing the Gap at CRAC 2026: Two-Stage Adaptation for LLM-Based Multilingual Coreference Resolution

author.name: Antoine Bourgois, Olga Seminck, Thierry Poibeau

entry.summary: Presents a Gemma-3-27b based system for multilingual coreference resolution that ranked first in the LLM track at CRAC 2026, using two-stage adaptation with multilingual base adapter followed by dataset-specific adapters.

entry.title: Agentic AI Translate: An Agentic Translator Prototype for Translation as Communication Design

author.name: Masaru Yamada

entry.summary: Presents Agentic AI Translate, a prototype implementing four-stage agentic translation cycle grounded in translation studies theory (skopos theory, register, audience), replacing the standard text-in/text-out MT paradigm.

entry.title: Analyzing Error Propagation in Korean Spoken QA with ASR-LLM Cascades

author.name: Donghyuk Jung, Youngwon Choi

entry.summary: Analyzes how ASR errors propagate through ASR-LLM cascades in Korean spoken QA, finding that relative degradation is consistent across LLMs and identifying single-character Korean errors as a distinct semantic-failure channel.

entry.title: Vector RAG vs LLM-Compiled Wiki: A Preregistered Comparison on a Small Multi-Domain Research

author.name: Theodore O. Cochran

entry.summary: Preregistered comparison of Vector RAG vs. LLM-compiled wiki for answering questions over a small research corpus. Finds wiki better at cross-paper connections but RAG better for single-fact lookups, with wiki using more query tokens than expected.

entry.title: DriveSafe: A Framework for Risk Detection and Safety Suggestions in Driving Scenarios

author.name: Sainithin Artham, Shankar Gangisetty, Avijit Dasgupta, C. V. Jawahar

entry.summary: Proposes DriveSafe, a framework for risk-aware scene understanding in autonomous driving that generates spatially grounded captions with multimodal context (motion, spatial, depth) for fine-grained risk assessment.

entry.title: RAGA: Reading-And-Graph-building-Agent for Autonomous Knowledge Graph Construction and Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Chengrui Han, Zesheng Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes RAGA, an LLM-based autonomous knowledge graph construction and retrieval framework with atomic CRUD operations and a Read-Search-Verify-Construct cognitive constraint in a ReAct loop.

entry.title: UCSF-PDGM-VQA: Visual Question Answering dataset for brain tumor MRI interpretation

author.name: Shiv Ghosh (Catherine), Junayd Lateef (Catherine), Chih-Hua (Catherine), Liu, Yannan Yu, Andreas M. Rauschecker, Madhumita Sushil

entry.summary: Introduces UCSF-PDGM-VQA, a clinically relevant Visual Question Answering dataset for brain tumor MRI interpretation, aimed at evaluating VLMs for semi-automated neuro-oncology image analysis.

entry.title: Stabilizing Temporal Inference Dynamics for Online Surgical Phase Recognition

author.name: Yang Liu, Ning Zhu, Jingjing Peng, Xiwu Chen, Alejandro Granados, Guotai Wang, Sebastien Ourselin

entry.summary: Proposes a unified framework for online surgical phase recognition that addresses temporal instability through error cascade prevention and evidence-accumulation-based phase transition detection.

entry.title: ChronoSC: Task-Oriented Semantic Communication via Temporal-to-Color Encoding

author.name: Phuc H. Nguyen, Trung T. Nguyen, Quy N. Duong, Van-Dinh Nguyen

entry.summary: Proposes ChronoSC, a semantic communication framework for video QA that encodes temporal dynamics into a single static image via Chrono-Color Stacking, enabling extreme temporal compression before transmission.

entry.title: Contrastive-SDXL: Annotation-Preserving Night-Time Augmentation for Pedestrian Detection

author.name: Franky George, Muhammad Khalid, Adil Khan

entry.summary: Presents Contrastive-SDXL, a day-to-night augmentation framework for pedestrian detection using SDXL-Turbo with LoRA fine-tuning, preserving semantic correspondence between domains.

entry.title: Agentic Pipeline for Self-Synchronized Multiview Joint Angle Monitoring in Uncalibrated Environments

author.name: Juncheng Yu, Lusi A, Haoxuan Xie, Weiming Wang

entry.summary: Proposes an agentic pipeline using multimodal LLMs for automatic video synchronization and joint angle monitoring in rehabilitation from uncalibrated multi-view cameras without hardware triggers.

entry.title: REC-RL: Referring expression counting via Gaussian and range-based reward optimization

author.name: Hui Liu, Yunlai Teng, Kunlong Bai, Pengfei Qi, Haotian Yan, Liang Li, Junlan Feng

entry.summary: Proposes REC-RL for referring expression counting using reinforcement learning with a think-range-answer paradigm and dual rewards (Gaussian accuracy + range supervision) to improve visual reasoning quality.

entry.title: MHMamba: Multi-Head Mamba for 3D Brain Tumor Segmentation

author.name: Hanjun Tao, Hua Wang, Fan Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes MHMamba for 3D brain tumor segmentation using a multi-head state-space model in U-shaped architecture, splitting channels into parallel SSM heads to balance long-range modeling with efficiency.

entry.title: Employing Vision-Language Models for Face Image Quality Assessment

author.name: Erdi Sar{\i}ta\c{s}, Eren Onaran, Vitomir \v{S}truc, Haz{\i}m Kemal Ekenel

entry.summary: Investigates using off-the-shelf Vision-Language Models for Face Image Quality Assessment in zero-shot settings, providing human-interpretable justifications unlike black-box FIQA methods.

entry.title: UST-Hand: An Uncertainty-aware Spatiotemporal Point Cloud Interaction Network for 3D Self-supervised Hand Pose Estimation

author.name: Tianhao Han, Haoyang Zhang, Liang Xie, Haochen Chang, Kun Gao, Yuan Cheng, Pengfei Ren, Erwei Yin

entry.summary: Proposes UST-Hand, a self-supervised hand pose estimation framework using uncertainty-aware spatiotemporal point cloud interactions to handle noisy pseudo-labels.

entry.title: Network Knowledge Prior Guided Learning for Data-Efficient Surface Defect Detection

author.name: Hang-Cheng Dong, Guodong Liu, Dong Ye, Bingguo Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a knowledge-guided loss function for data-efficient surface defect detection that integrates saliency-based interpretability into training without additional inference cost.

entry.title: Dance Across Shifts: Forward-Facilitation Continual Test-Time Adaptation through Dynamic Style Bridging

author.name: Zhilin Zhu, Yabin Wang, Zhiheng Ma, Yaguang Song, Yaowei Wang, Xiaopeng Hong

entry.summary: Proposes Dynamic Style Bridging for Continual Test-Time Adaptation, introducing a forward-facilitation paradigm that adapts generated class exemplars to incoming test data through multi-level bridging, rather than backward alignment to source domain.

entry.title: A Large-Scale Study on the Accuracy vs Cost Trade-offs of Training and Evaluation Settings in Fine-Grained Image Recognition

author.name: Edwin Arkel Rios, Augusto Christian Surya, Oswin Gosal, Fernando Mikael, Mary Madeline Nicole, Kisoon Jang, Bo-Cheng Lai, Min-Chun Hu

entry.summary: Large-scale empirical study (2000+ experiments) examining accuracy-vs-cost trade-offs in fine-grained image recognition across training/evaluation settings, backbones, and datasets. Extends CAL with cross-image discriminative region mixing.

entry.title: BIDO: A Biometric Identity Online Authentication Framework

author.name: Aditya Mithra, Sibi Chakkaravarthy S, Srinivas Kankanala

entry.summary: BIDO presents a device-free biometric authentication standard achieving AAL2 without storing biometric templates, deriving ECDSA keys deterministically from live biometric measurements at each authentication event.

entry.title: Fixed External Cameras as Common Prior Maps for Active 3D Scene Graph Generation

author.name: Giorgia Modi, Davide Buoso, Giuseppe Averta, Daniele De Martini

entry.summary: Proposes using fixed external RGB cameras as Common Prior Maps for active 3D scene graph generation, initializing semantic and geometric priors before robot motion begins. Uses a hardware-agnostic RGB-only pipeline.

entry.title: RGB-only Active 3D Scene Graph Generation for Indoor Mobile Robots

author.name: Giorgia Modi, Davide Buoso, Giuseppe Averta, Daniele De Martini

entry.summary: Presents a fully visual RGB-only framework for active, incremental 3D scene graph construction without depth sensors, using active viewpoint selection based on partially built scene representations.

entry.title: A Mechanistic Model for Collective Motion from Sensorimotor Regularities

author.name: Vito Mengers, Bao Duc Cao, Oliver Brock

entry.summary: Presents a mechanistic model for collective animal motion based on sensorimotor regularities rather than abstract interaction forces, where agents perceive neighbors through limited sensing and execute physically grounded behaviors.

entry.title: SSTL: Self-Sensing Tendon Loop for Hysteresis Modeling and Compensation in Tendon-Sheath Mechanisms

author.name: Myeongbo Park, Junhyun Park, Ihsan Ullah, Chunggil An, Minho Hwang

entry.summary: Proposes the Self-Sensing Tendon Loop (SSTL), a double-pass tendon mechanism that enables proximal measurement of both input and output tensions for hysteresis modeling and compensation in flexible endoscopic robots.

entry.title: Generating Realistic Safety-Critical Scenarios for Vehicle-Pedestrian Interactions

author.name: Qingwen Pu, Kun Xie, Yuan Zhu, Guocong Zhai

entry.summary: Proposes a three-stage framework combining real-world grounding with adaptive simulation to generate realistic safety-critical vehicle-pedestrian scenarios at scale, using multi-agent state-space Transformer-enhanced DDPG.

entry.title: Motion-Uncertainty-Aware Next-Best-View Planning for Moving Object Reconstruction

author.name: Karen Li, Mattia Mantovani, Robert J. Wood, Lorenzo Sabattini, Stephanie Gil

entry.summary: Presents a motion-uncertainty-aware next-best-view framework for reconstructing unknown moving objects, accounting for motion uncertainty during decision-to-execution delay.

entry.title: Active Defense Against False Data Injection Attacks in Robotic Manipulators

author.name: Gabriele Gualandi, Carl Mikael Larsson, Alessandro V. Papadopoulos

entry.summary: Addresses active defense against False Data Injection Attacks on robotic manipulators, proposing anomaly-aware virtual damping and manipulability reduction with probabilistic guarantees on task execution.

entry.title: Consent Chain Degradation in Embodied Multi-Agent Systems: Bridging the Gap Between AI Agent Governance and Robot Ethics

author.name: Mehmet Haklidir

entry.summary: Introduces 'consent chain degradation' (CCD), a conceptual framework analyzing how human consent degrades when physical robots delegate tasks to other robots in multi-agent systems affecting humans.

entry.title: DRS-GUI: Dynamic Region Search for Training-Free GUI Grounding

author.name: Yichao Liu, Huawen Shen, Liu Yu, Shiyu Liu, Zeyu Chen, Yu Zhou

entry.summary: DRS-GUI proposes a training-free dynamic region search framework for GUI grounding that mimics human perceptual strategies (Focus, Shift, Scatter) to progressively locate task-relevant UI elements in high-resolution screenshots.

entry.title: ScreenSearch: Uncertainty-Aware OS Exploration

author.name: Michael Solodko, Justin Wagle

entry.summary: ScreenSearch combines structural screen retrieval with an ambiguity-aware PUCT graph-bandit for large-scale desktop exploration, addressing partial observability in GUI agent environments.

entry.title: Learning Sim-Grounded Policies for Bimanual Rope Manipulation from Human Teleoperation Data

author.name: Gina Wigginghaus, Tim Missal, Berk Guler, Simon Manschitz, Jan Peters

entry.summary: Investigates whether lack of generalization in egocentric visual policies for bimanual rope manipulation stems from the observation space rather than policy architecture, comparing visual vs. sim-grounded approaches.

entry.title: Federated Imputation under Heterogeneous Feature Spaces

author.name: Imane Hocine, Chaimaa Medjadji, Sylvain Kubler, Gregoire Danoy, Yves Le Traon
