entry.summary: Investigates how VGG16 layer selection for feature-based losses affects super-resolution of brain diffusion MRI. Finds deeper layers cause grid-like artifacts while shallow layers provide better structural consistency.

entry.title: SDF2Net: Shallow to Deep Feature Fusion Network for PolSAR Image Classification

author.name: Mohammed Q. Alkhatib, M. Sami Zitouni, Mina Al-Saad, Nour Aburaed, and Hussain Al-Ahmad

entry.summary: Introduces SDF2Net, a three-branch complex-valued CNN for PolSAR image classification that fuses shallow to deep features. Achieves competitive results on PolSAR benchmarks.

entry.title: CAX-Agent: A Lightweight Agent Harness for Reliable APDL Automation

author.name: Chenying Lin and Yichen Hai and Yi He and Ran Wang and Haiyan Qiang and Liang Yu

entry.summary: Presents CAX-Agent, a lightweight agent harness for MAPDL finite-element simulation automation with a recovery ladder escalation policy for handling simulation failures.

entry.title: Learning Selective Merge Policies for Deadline-Constrained Coded Caching via Deep Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Amirhossein Yousefiramandi

entry.summary: Proposes a DRL-based solution for deadline-constrained coded caching that learns selective merge policies using graph-attention networks for online decision making in video streaming.

entry.title: From Full and Partial Intraoral Scans to Crown Proposal: A Classification-Guided Restoration Assistance Pipeline

author.name: Rabin Kunwar, Dikshya Parajuli, Rujal Acharya, Romik Gosai, Prince Panta, Kundan Siwakoti, Shuvangi Adhikari, Saugat Kafley, Louis Digiorgio, Amit Regmi, Akio Tanaka, Masahiko Inada, Yuriko Komagamine, Kennta Kashiwazaki and Manabu Kanazawa

entry.summary: Proposes an end-to-end pipeline for dental crown proposal from intraoral scans that handles both full and partial scans through classification-guided routing and conditional generation.

entry.title: PDRNN: Modular Data-driven Pedestrian Dead Reckoning on Loosely Coupled Radio- and Inertial-Signalstreams

author.name: Peter Bauer and Andreas Porada and Felix Ott and Christopher Mutschler and Tobias Feigl

entry.summary: Proposes a modular RNN architecture for pedestrian dead reckoning that handles asynchronous sensor data streams and dynamic movements better than traditional fusion methods.

entry.title: Wind-Aware Optimal Trajectory Planning for Efficient Gliding of Fixed-Wing Aerial Systems

author.name: Luca Morando, Nishanth Bobbili and Giuseppe Loianno

entry.summary: Presents a nonlinear multi-cost trajectory planner for small UAV gliders that incorporates wind awareness and energy management at the planning level rather than reactive control. Generates smooth trajectories using Bernstein polynomials with online replanning.

entry.title: Highly Detailed and Generalizable Broadleaf Tree Crown Instance Segmentation from UAV Imagery

author.name: Mitsutaka Nakada (1), Takahiko Ikebata (1), Kengo Ikebata (1), Yuji Mizuno (2), Yusuke Onoda (3), Ryuichi Takeshige (3 and 4), Kyaw Kyaw Htoo (3), Kanehiro Kitayama (3 and 5), Robert Ong (6), Masanori Onishi (1 and 3) ((1) DeepForest Technologies Co., Ltd., (2) YM Lab., (3) Graduate School of Agriculture, Kyoto University, (4) Graduate School of Science, Osaka Metropolitan University, (5) Faculty of Tropical Forestry, Universiti Malaysia Sabah, (6) Forest Research Centre)

entry.summary: Presents a deep-learning instance segmentation model for individual tree crown delineation in broadleaf forests from UAV imagery. Uses 18,507 manually delineated crown polygons across seven Japanese forests for training.

entry.title: Structured Jacobian Construction for Motion Optimization with High-Order Time Derivatives in Multi-Link Systems

author.name: Taiki Ishigaki, Ko Ayusawa, Eiichi Yoshida

entry.summary: Presents a framework for efficient Jacobian computation in motion optimization for multi-link systems involving higher-order time derivatives (jerk, force variation), exploiting multi-link structure for computational efficiency.

entry.title: On RGB-TIR Stereo Calibration under Extreme Resolution Asymmetry

author.name: Micha{\l} Kr\'ol, Micha{\l} Salamonowicz, W{\l}adys{\l}aw Skarbek, Micha{\l} Tomaszewski

entry.summary: Presents a practical stereo calibration framework for RGB-thermal infrared camera systems with extreme resolution asymmetry (1:625 pixel ratio), using an active OLED screen for modality-specific patterns and specialized corner detection.

entry.title: Driving Through the Network: Performance and Workload Under Latency and Video Impairment

author.name: Ines Trautmannsheimer, Ahmed Azab and Frank Diermeyer

entry.summary: Reports a driving simulator study on teleoperation performance under varying latency (100/300ms) and video bitrate (500/2000 kbit/s), measuring multimodal metrics including performance, oculomotor behavior, physiology, and subjective workload.

entry.title: A Stochastic Birth-and-Death Approach for Street Furniture Geolocation in Urban Environments

author.name: Evan Murphy, Marco Viola, Vladimir A. Krylov

entry.summary: Proposes a probabilistic framework using stochastic birth-and-death optimization for geolocating street furniture in urban environments, integrating GIS data for improved localization.

entry.title: Fault tolerance estimation in digital circuits with visualised generative networks

author.name: Sascha Biel, Carl Alexander Gaede, Amiel Glaser, Jan Wolter, Alexej Schelle

entry.summary: Proposes using GANs for estimating fault tolerance of digital circuits by comparing generated ideal signals against realistic outputs including various error modes.

entry.title: DiscoExplorer: An Open Interface for the Study of Multilingual Discourse Relations

author.name: Amir Zeldes

entry.summary: Presents DiscoExplorer, an open-source web interface for studying multilingual discourse relations across 16 languages, making DISRPT shared task datasets publicly accessible.

entry.title: Hybrid LLM-based Intelligent Framework for Robot Task Scheduling

author.name: Swayamjit Saha, Subhabrata Das, Haonan Duan, and Xiao-Yang Liu

entry.summary: Uses dual LLM agents (generator and supervisor) for construction robot task scheduling, with natural language interface for communication with professionals.

entry.title: ADAPT: A Self-Calibrating Proactive Autoscaler for Container Orchestration

author.name: Himanshu Singh Baghel

entry.summary: Presents ADAPT, an online estimator for cold-start duration that feeds a dynamic planning horizon into a Model Predictive Controller for proactive container autoscaling. Addresses the practical challenge that provisioning delays vary across environments.

entry.title: A Reproducible and Physically Feasible Dynamic Parameter Identification Framework for a Low-Cost Robot Arm

author.name: Junji Oaki, Koki Yamane, Koki Inami and Sho Sakaino

entry.summary: Presents a reproducible dynamic parameter identification framework for a low-cost robot arm, combining structured trajectory design, ordinary least squares, semidefinite programming for physical feasibility, and closed-loop refinement.

entry.title: Next Token Prediction is a Misleading Term

author.name: Adam Newgas

entry.summary: Argues that calling LLMs 'next token predictors' is misleading because it ignores the complexity of what's required to predict the next token well, and conflates base training with the full training pipeline including RLHF and other post-training steps.

entry.title: A Gradient Boosted Mixed-Model Machine Learning Framework for Vessel Speed in the U.S. Arctic

author.name: Mauli Pant, Linda Fernandez, Indranil Sahoo

entry.summary: Applies gradient boosted decision trees with random effects in a two-stage ML framework to model vessel speed in the U.S. Arctic using AIS data integrated with environmental features.

entry.title: Optimizing Line Segment Inspection with Limited-Range Drones

author.name: Jos\'e-Miguel D\'iaz-B\'a\~nez, Jos\'e-Manuel Higes, Alina Kasiuk, Inmaculada Ventura

entry.summary: Addresses optimization of drone inspection paths for line segments (e.g., solar plant pipes) with limited battery life, requiring periodic returns to a base station. Proposes efficient path planning algorithms for multi-drone coverage.

entry.title: On getting unstuck

author.name: Joe Rogero

entry.summary: Discusses Claude AI beating Pokémon Red as a lens for thinking about getting unstuck in problem-solving more generally. Highlights how the AI's improvement came from gradual capability gains rather than a single breakthrough, and draws parallels to human stuckness.

entry.title: Heuristic-Based Merging of HPC Traces to Extend Hardware Counter Coverage

author.name: J\'ulia Orteu Aubach, Fabio Banchelli, Marc Clasc\`a Ram\'irez, Marta Garcia-Gasulla

entry.summary: Proposes a heuristic-based methodology to merge HPC execution traces from multiple instrumentation runs into unified datasets with broader hardware counter coverage, enabling better performance modeling.

entry.title: AgriMind: An Ensemble Deep Learning Framework for Multi-Class Plant Disease Classification

author.name: Salma Hoque Talukdar Koli and Fahima Haque Talukder Jely

entry.summary: Presents AgriMind, an ensemble of ResNet50, EfficientNet-B0, and DenseNet121 for plant disease classification on PlantVillage, achieving 99.23% accuracy through softmax averaging.

entry.title: Operator-Controlled 6G: From Connectivity Infrastructure to Guaranteed Digital Services

author.name: David Soldani

entry.summary: Position paper arguing 6G networks should reverse vendor-led architecture by prioritizing operator control and customer outcomes over technology-first approaches.

entry.title: A Unified Generative-AI Framework for Smart Energy Infrastructure: Intelligent Gas Distribution, Utility Billing, Carbon Analytics, and Quantum-Inspired Optimisation

author.name: Pavan Manjunath, Thomas pruefer

entry.summary: Proposes an end-to-end framework combining generative AI for utility billing, transformer-based forecasting, carbon analytics, and quantum-inspired optimization for smart energy infrastructure.

entry.title: Falling for the statistical parrot

author.name: FlorianH

entry.summary: A personal reflection on the author's experience of forming an emotional connection with Claude AI, despite having previously felt immune to anthropomorphizing AI systems. Explores the psychological experience of interacting extensively with AI assistants.

entry.title: From Observed Viability to Internal Predictive Approximation: A Single-Subject Latent-Space Analysis of Gait Dynamics Under Occlusal Constraint

author.name: Jacques Raynal, Pierre Slangen, Elsa Raynal, Jacques Margerit

entry.summary: Explores latent-space analysis of gait dynamics under occlusal constraint in a single Parkinsonian participant, using PCA on instrumented insole data across multiple occlusal conditions.

entry.title: A Generative AI Framework for Intelligent Utility Billing CO 2 Analytics and Sustainable Resource Optimisation

author.name: Pavan Manjunath, Thomas Pruefer

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for utility billing that combines generative AI for natural-language bill statements, transformer-based consumption forecasting, and CO2 analytics.

entry.title: James C. Scott: Seeing Like a State

author.name: Martin Sustrik

entry.summary: Book review of James C. Scott's 'Seeing Like a State' that pushes back on the common anti-central-planning takeaway, noting that scientific agriculture and the Green Revolution also came from top-down approaches and feed 8 billion people today.

entry.title: Are You Not Rationalists?

author.name: J Thomas Moros

entry.summary: An impassioned post warning about AI existential risk, using Lovecraftian 'Shoggoth' imagery to describe AI systems and calling on the rationalist community to take AI danger more seriously and act with greater urgency.

entry.title: How to Reason about Your Health Issues

author.name: Taylor G. Lunt

entry.summary: Argues that when reasoning about health issues, the root cause should always be traced to something outside the body rather than internal mechanisms. Suggests this reframing leads to better treatment decisions by focusing on environmental and behavioral factors.

entry.title: How to Quit Fandom: Apostasy

author.name: Laiba Rehman

entry.summary: A personal blog post about the author's experience leaving religious fandom behavior after becoming an atheist, exploring how obsessive fandom involvement evaporated alongside religious belief.

entry.title: Research Summary: May 17, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary: No items to analyze.
